criterion: **Given** a user holds Security.AccessAdminPanel and the native permission of each area, **when** they open Configuration > Settings, Plugins and Widgets, System > Schedule tasks, Log and Maintenance, Catalog > Products and Customers, **then** each area opens; an area whose native permission the user lacks is denied (CheckPermission attribute).
basis: D; REQ-MPC-FR-301; FIT (SettingController, PluginController, WidgetController, ScheduleTaskController, LogController, CommonController.Maintenance)

criterion: **Given** a scheduled task exists, **when** an administrator with System.ManageScheduleTasks edits its interval (Seconds), Enabled or StopOnError, or runs it now, **then** the change applies to the whole installation (ScheduleTask has no store scope) and LastStartUtc, LastEndUtc and LastSuccessUtc show the result.

**Given** products are selected in the bulk-edit grid, **when** the catalogue manager changes Name, Sku, Price, OldPrice, Quantity or IsPublished and saves, **then** every selected product is updated in one save (native ProductController.BulkEditSave).

**Given** products are selected, **when** the catalogue manager archives them, **then** they are unpublished (IsPublished false) and disappear from the storefront but stay in admin; deletion (DeleteSelected) is a separate soft delete (Product.Deleted).
basis: D; FIT (no separate archive status; ProductController.DeleteSelected)

criterion: **Given** a customer account is active, **when** an administrator deactivates it (Customer.Active false) with a reason, **then** the customer can no longer sign in and the reason is recorded (AUD-ADM-001); reactivation restores sign-in.
**Given** a customer asks for deletion, **when** an administrator with Customers.GDPRManage processes it, **then** the native GDPR delete runs; consent and privacy rules are those of SEC-007.

**Given** product plugins register DI overrides (INopStartup Order >= 3000), decorators and global action or result filters, **when** the application starts, **then** the ADM INopStartup, which runs after every other product plugin startup (Proposed), reads the IServiceCollection; for each interface in the register it lists the implementation registered by a product plugin; if an interface has more than one product implementation, or an implementation from a plugin that is not its registered owner, the conflict is recorded and shown on System > Warnings through an ADM consumer of SystemWarningCreatedEvent (BR-ADM-001).
basis: Proposed; OVR-REG; FIT (INopStartup.ConfigureServices receives IServiceCollection; SystemWarningCreatedEvent published by Admin CommonModelFactory, Presentation/Nop.Web/Areas/Admin/Factories/CommonModelFactory.cs:1027 in 5.00.1)

criterion: **Given** the register is opened by a user with Administration.Core.Extensions.View, **when** it is shown, **then** every entry of BR-ADM-002 to BR-ADM-008 is listed with target (interface and method, or controller and action), mechanism (DI override, decorator, action filter, result filter, middleware, model-factory override, core modification), owning feature, provider features and the rule that specifies it.

**Given** a feature needs to change the behaviour of a service whose owner in the register is another feature (for example ADM-005 quota checks on IShoppingCartService, owned by CHK-003), **when** the feature is built, **then** it implements the provider interface published by the owner (for example IC-CHK-01) and registers no implementation of the service itself; a build that registers one is shown as a conflict by the start-up check.

**Given** several product plugins register global action filters on the same controller action (for example Admin OrderController.AddShipment: PAY, INV and LOG), **when** the action is requested, **then** the filters run in the order recorded in the register (filter order value, Proposed), each can refuse the request independently, and a refusal by any filter stops the action before it runs (BR-ADM-005).
basis: Proposed; FIT (ASP.NET Core global filter order)

criterion: **Given** the bundled Misc.Brevo plugin, which replaces IWorkflowMessageService (BrevoMessageService, NopStartup Order 3000), is installed in an instance where TRK-005 owns IWorkflowMessageService, **when** the start-up check runs, **then** a conflict is shown; client instances do not install Misc.Brevo (BR-ADM-003).

**Given** an action whose decision has one owner in the register (Admin CustomerController.Impersonate: IAM-026; Nop.Web DownloadController.GetFileUpload and Admin DownloadController.DownloadFile: SEC-002; every upload action: ADM-008), **when** another feature needs to change who is allowed or which files are accepted (for example CRM-015 account managers on impersonation, EGV-002 agency files on downloads, EGV-002 or CAT upload types), **then** it supplies a rule to the owner (a rule provider of the owner filter, or an upload context through IC-ADM-08) and registers no action filter of its own on that action; the register shows the owner and its rule providers (BR-ADM-001, BR-ADM-006, BR-ADM-007), and the release check (T-ADM-09) fails on a second filter.

**Given** a definition with a start, task steps, exclusive and parallel gateways and ends, **when** it is published, **then** it is accepted only if every path reaches an end, every exclusive gateway has a default path and every parallel join matches its split; otherwise publishing is refused with message Adm.WorkflowInvalid naming the faulty element (BR-ADM-010).

**Given** a case reaches an exclusive gateway, **when** its conditions are evaluated (ADM-003 expressions over case variables) in their set order, **then** exactly one outgoing path is taken: the first whose condition is true, else the default path.
**Given** a case reaches a parallel split, **when** it continues, **then** all outgoing branches become active; the matching join continues only when every incoming branch has arrived.
**Given** a definition is saved, **when** it is exported, **then** it is exported and imported as BPMN 2.0 XML; if WF-ENG selects an engine without BPMN 2.0 support this criterion is re-decided.

**Given** a case reaches an approval step naming a role and an authority limit, **when** the step starts, **then** an ADM-006 approval item is created for that role; the case waits until the item is decided and then follows the approved or rejected path.

**Given** a case reaches a notification step with an event code, **when** the step runs, **then** the notification is sent through the TRK-005 notification engine for that event code (IC-TRK-04 SendEvent) and the step completes; a definition naming an event code that is not registered with TRK-005 (IC-TRK-04 RegisterEventCode) is refused at publishing with message Adm.WorkflowInvalid (BR-ADM-085).

**Given** a case reaches a document step with a template code, **when** the step runs, **then** DOC-001 generates the document from the case record, DOC-002 stores it and its reference is added to the case variables.

**Given** a case reaches a payment-release step, **when** the step runs, **then** the step calls the release operation exposed by PAY for that case (for example an escrow stage release, PAY-007) and waits for its result; the workflow never changes payment or order state itself (BR-ADM-011).

**Given** a case reaches a call-to-another-system step, **when** the step runs, **then** it calls the named operation of the step-operation catalogue — an INT adapter operation (INT-005) or a module connector operation that its owning module registered through IC-ADM-01 RegisterStepOperation (for example EGV IC-EGV-02 VerifyOrRegister) — with the configured timeout and retry count; after the last failed retry the case status becomes Failed and an ADM-009 exception is raised; an operation not in the catalogue cannot be named, and publishing is refused with message Adm.WorkflowInvalid.
**Given** an AI summarisation step is in a definition (FC-M02-015), **when** the AI pack is off for the client (PLT-022), **then** publishing is refused with message Adm.WorkflowStepUnavailable.

**Given** a draft definition and a sample data set, **when** the administrator runs the simulator, **then** the path taken, the step where it would wait or block and the outputs of each step are shown; no notification is sent, no document stored, no external call made and no payment step executed (BR-ADM-012).
**Given** cases are running on version 1, **when** version 2 is published, **then** running cases continue on version 1 and new cases start on version 2.

**Given** a case has completed or failed, **when** an auditor opens the replay, **then** each executed step is shown in order with time, actor, inputs, outputs and gateway decisions; the replay is read-only and changes nothing.

**Given** an approval workflow with several sequential internal approval stages is published for a document or order type, **when** an item of that type is submitted, **then** it passes each stage in order and continues only after every stage approves; a rejection at any stage stops it (with ADM-006).

**Given** a shipping workflow is bound to the native shipment events, **when** a shipment is created, sent or delivered (ShipmentCreatedEvent, ShipmentSentEvent, ShipmentDeliveredEvent), **then** the event consumer only enqueues a start or signal request and the engine runner starts or advances the shipping case (BR-ADM-011).
basis: REQ-KTDA-WF-005; FIT (native shipment events; EventPublisher swallows consumer exceptions)

criterion: **Given** a fulfilment workflow is bound to order events, **when** an order is placed or paid (OrderPlacedEvent, OrderPaidEvent), **then** a fulfilment case is started through the queue and runs its configured steps, calling LOG services for allocation, picking and dispatch.

**Given** an e-government service catalogue entry (EGV-001) references a published workflow definition, **when** a citizen or business submits an application for that service (EGV-002), **then** the application runs as a case of that definition.
**Given** a start request carries an idempotency key, **when** the same request is received again, **then** no second case is started (BR-ADM-011).

**Given** a workflow definition is assigned to a service product (EGV-001) and applications have already been submitted on version 1, **when** version 2 of the definition is published, **then** applications already submitted continue on version 1; applications submitted after publication start on version 2 (version pinning per case, as AC-ADM-002-04-01).

**Given** an EGV definition has an "External check" step naming an EGV connector operation (IC-EGV-02 VerifyOrRegister) and a parallel split of pre-approval steps before its approval step, **when** a case reaches the step and then the join, **then** the External check step calls IC-EGV-02 through the EGV service with the configured timeout and retry count and stores the result and external reference in the case variables; the approval step starts only when every pre-approval branch has completed (parallel join, AC-ADM-002-01-03), so EGV approval waits for all pre-approval steps (BR-EGV-005).

**Given** a rule set declared by an owning module with its fact schema (for example Order.Total, Customer.Roles), **when** an administrator writes a rule as a condition (comparison, logical, arithmetic and set operators over declared facts) and an outcome, **then** the rule is saved as a draft; the language offers no code execution, reflection, file, network or database access (BR-ADM-020).
**Given** a rule refers to an undeclared fact or has a syntax error, **when** it is saved, **then** it is refused with message Adm.RuleInvalid giving the position of the error.

**Given** an active rule "Order.Total greater than A gives outcome RequireApproval", with A a client value, **when** a module evaluates the rule set for an order whose total is above A, **then** the outcome RequireApproval is returned with the rule ID and version; for a total not above A the default outcome is returned.

**Given** the pattern library holds patterns in the categories eligibility, pricing, validation and routing, **when** an administrator creates a rule from a pattern, **then** a draft copy is created with the pattern's parameters to fill in; the pattern itself is unchanged.

**Given** a draft rule and a set of sample inputs, **when** the administrator runs the test, **then** each input is shown as pass or fail with the conditions that matched; no entry is written to the production evaluation log and no outcome is acted on.

**Given** two rules of the same rule set both match at least one input of the rule set's test data and give different outcomes, **when** one of them is activated, **then** activation is refused with message Adm.RuleConflict naming both rules, until a precedence order is set or a rule is changed (BR-ADM-021).

**Given** a rule set uses the strategy "first match by priority", **when** several active rules match an input, **then** only the outcome of the highest-priority matching rule is returned; with the strategy "all matches" every matching outcome is returned in priority order.

**Given** a rule set is evaluated in production, **when** the evaluation completes, **then** a log entry holds rule set, matched rule IDs and versions, inputs (fields classified as personal or secret are masked: per SEC-014 when it is delivered, otherwise by replacing the value with "[masked]" for every input field flagged personal or secret in the rule-set definition, Proposed), outcome, time and caller reference; log retention follows PLT-020.

**Given** an active rule is edited, **when** it is saved, **then** a new draft version is created; the active version stays in force until the new version is activated; who, when, old and new expression are audited (AUD-ADM-003).

**Given** the product ships the type registry, **when** it is opened, **then** it lists fixed-price sale (native Product and Order), request for quotation (bundled Misc.RFQ: RequestQuote, Quote, Order), contract (ORD-016), group buying (ORD-023) and scheme application (ORD-024), each with owning module, parameter schema, workflow binding (ADM-002), required documents (DOC-005) and templates (ADM-011); auction and tender types are not offered (D-02).
basis: D; FC-M02-001; FIT (Misc.RFQ Domains RequestQuote, Quote, QuoteStatus); D-02

criterion: **Given** a parameter of a type is marked Required, Optional or Fixed with a data type and allowed values, **when** a transaction of that type is created without a required parameter, **then** creation is refused with message Adm.ParameterRequired.
**Given** a parameter is Fixed at type level, **when** a user tries to change it on a transaction, **then** the change is refused with message Adm.ParameterFixed.

**Given** the operator starts a new transaction, **when** they choose a type, **then** the form shows that type's parameters, the case starts on the type's workflow and the type's document requirements apply.

**Given** a chain "request for quotation, then contract" is defined with a parameter mapping, **when** the quote is accepted (Misc.RFQ quote converted), **then** a contract transaction (ORD-016) is created with the mapped values and linked to the quote; both appear as one chained transaction.
**Given** a transaction overrides a type parameter, **when** it is saved, **then** a reason is required and the override is recorded as a PLT deviation (see PLT-003 rule BR-PLT-017).

**Given** an eligibility rule set (ADM-003) is bound to a customer role, **when** a customer's profile changes, or the nightly recomputation task runs, **then** the customer is added to or removed from that role according to the rule outcome, and native ACL (AclRecord by customer role) then decides which products, categories and topics the customer sees (BR-ADM-050).

**Given** a product is restricted to an eligibility role, **when** a customer outside the role tries to add it to the cart by direct link, **then** the ADM cart rule provider (IC-CHK-01, called by the CHK-003 IShoppingCartService override) returns warning Adm.NotEligible and the item is not added.

**Given** a quota reserves a quantity of a product for a customer role over a period, **when** a customer outside that role adds a quantity that would use the reserved part, **then** the ADM cart rule provider (IC-CHK-01) returns warning Adm.QuotaReserved through the CHK-003 IShoppingCartService override and the quantity is not added; ADM registers no IShoppingCartService implementation of its own (BR-ADM-002); the same check runs again at order placement because PlaceOrderAsync calls GetShoppingCartItemWarningsAsync.
basis: D; FC-M02-028; OVR-REG; FIT (OrderProcessingService.PlaceOrderAsync calls GetShoppingCartWarningsAsync and GetShoppingCartItemWarningsAsync)

criterion: **Given** two customers place orders for the last reserved units at the same moment, **when** both orders are placed, **then** ADM is a placement participant (IC-CHK-06) of the CHK-003 PlaceOrderAsync override: in Reserve it re-checks the quota under ILocker key 'adm-quota-{quotaId}' and reserves the quantity, or refuses placement with message Adm.QuotaReserved; Confirm consumes the reservation per saved sub-order; Release frees it when placement or payment fails (BR-CHK-020); so only one of the two orders gets the last reserved units.

**Given** sanctions screening is enabled for a customer type, **when** a customer of that type registers or places an order, **then** the party is screened through the sanctions-screening adapter; on a possible match the account is flagged, checkout is blocked with message Adm.ScreeningHold and a review item is created (ADM-006).

**Given** a reviewer clears or confirms a match, **when** they decide, **then** cleared: the flag is removed and checkout works; confirmed: the customer is added to the SEL-013 block list; both are audited (AUD-ADM-005).

**Given** approval items exist for several roles and authority limits, **when** an approver opens the queue, **then** only items whose current step names one of the approver's roles, whose amount is within the approver's authority limit, or that are delegated to the approver (IAM-009) are listed (BR-ADM-030).
**Given** an item is not assigned to the user, **when** the user opens it by direct link, **then** access is denied and nothing changes.

**Given** a chain has steps 1 and 2, **when** step 1 approves, **then** the item moves to step 2; the chain and the current step are shown on the item; it is approved only when the last step approves.

**Given** a step has a condition (ADM-003 rule, for example amount above a client threshold), **when** the item reaches that step, **then** the step is included only if the condition is true, otherwise it is skipped and the skip is recorded.

**Given** the requester, or a user who decided an earlier step of the same item, opens the item, **when** they try to approve, **then** the action is refused with message Adm.ApproveOwnItem (BR-ADM-030).

**Given** an approver approves with conditions, **when** they list the corrections, **then** the item becomes ApprovedWithConditions; the owning module is not told to apply the approval until the requester marks every correction done and the approver confirms (SM-ADM-04).

**Given** an approver rejects, **when** no reason code is chosen, **then** the rejection is refused with message Adm.ReasonRequired; with a reason code and text the item becomes Rejected and the requester is notified (TRK-005) with the reason and the recourse options (correct and resubmit, appeal).
**Given** an item is Rejected, **when** the requester resubmits after correcting it, **then** a new round of the same item starts at step 1 and the history of earlier rounds is kept.
**Given** an item is Rejected, **when** the requester appeals, **then** the item goes to the appeal step of the chain (an approver role other than the one that rejected); the appeal outcome is final.

**Given** a seller changes the payout account (SEL-005), **when** the change is submitted, **then** an approval item is created through IC-ADM-03; the old account stays in use until the item is approved; every decision is written to the audit trail (AUD-ADM-004).
**Given** a module registers another action as high-risk, **when** that action is requested, **then** it follows the same approval flow.

**Given** moderation queues are configured for product listings (CAT-022, CAT-043) and seller applications (SEL-003) with an assignment rule (round robin among role members, or by category, or by seller tier), **when** a new item enters a queue, **then** it is assigned to a member by that rule and appears in that member's queue.

**Given** an approval item is decided, **when** the decision is recorded, **then** the owning module's callback (IC-ADM-03) applies the effect through the module's own service; ADM never changes the object itself (BR-ADM-011).

**Given** the owning module of an item's object type implements the pre-decision guard (IC-ADM-03 CanDecide; for example SEL-003 seller-application guards, Sel.ApprovalBlocked), **when** an approver approves, approves with conditions, or confirms that conditions are done, **then** ADM calls the guard before it records the decision; if the guard refuses, nothing is recorded, the item stays in its current status (SM-ADM-04) and message Adm.DecisionBlocked shows the module's reason; rejection is not guarded (BR-ADM-031).
basis: Proposed (SEL round-2 mismatch: decided ADM item with an unchanged SEL object)

criterion: **Given** the user holds Administration.Core.WorkQueues.View and the permission of each queue, **when** they switch between the queue tabs, **then** each tab keeps its filters and scroll position for the session; a queue whose permission the user lacks is not shown.

**Given** orders exist in different fulfilment stages, **when** an operator opens the operational order view, **then** orders are grouped by stage — awaiting pickup, awaiting sorting, awaiting dispatch, out for last-mile delivery — with counts, filters by branch or outlet, and a link to the owning LOG action; the stage of each order is the operational stage that ORD supplies (OrderStageDefinition.OperationalStage, with the LOG shipment stage or the native shipment dates as fallback, BR-ORD-015), and the stage of each open shipment is the one LOG supplies (IC-LOG-07 GetOperationalStage, BR-LOG-170); ADM derives no stage itself.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-162; FIT (Shipment; ShippingStatus); see ORD-002, LOG-011

criterion: **Given** an operator arranges dashboard tiles from the tiles allowed for their role, **when** they sign in again, **then** the same arrangement is shown; tiles show only data the operator may see.
**Given** an operator saves the current filter as a named view, **when** they open the view later, **then** the list shows the same filter applied to current data.

**Given** an operator leaves a form with unsaved changes in an ADM screen, **when** they come back in a later session, **then** the draft is offered for restore; drafts are kept per user and deleted after the retention period (setting, default not stated).

**Given** shortcuts are enabled, **when** an operator presses the shortcut for open queue, approve, reject, comment, escalate or search, **then** the action runs as if its button was pressed, with the same permission checks and confirmations.
**Given** customers were active within CustomerSettings.OnlineCustomerMinutes, **when** the console header is shown, **then** it shows the count of online customers (native online-customer data).
**Given** the console is opened at tablet and phone widths, **when** an operator works a queue, **then** all queue actions are usable without horizontal scrolling.

**Given** a work-queue item (approval item, exception, or a queue item raised by another module) is assigned, completed or reopened, **when** the change is saved, **then** a WorkItemEvent records item, queue, event (Assigned, Completed, Reopened), assignee, actor and time; the events are readable by RPT-009 for operator productivity and service-level metrics (BR-ADM-075).

**Given** an upload policy per context (ADM contexts for native actions: storefront attribute file, checkout attribute file, return-request file, avatar, vendor picture, admin picture, product picture, product 3D object, admin download, data imports, language import, store icons, plugin upload, HTML-editor files, other upload; plus the contexts other modules register through IC-ADM-08) sets allowed extensions and a maximum size, **when** a file with an extension not allowed is uploaded, **then** it is refused with message Adm.UploadTypeNotAllowed before anything is stored.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-324; FIT (upload actions listed in BR-ADM-006 and BR-ADM-007)

criterion: **Given** the same policy, **when** a file larger than the maximum is uploaded, **then** it is refused with message Adm.UploadTooLarge before anything is stored.

**Given** a native per-field limit also applies (ProductAttributeMapping.ValidationFileAllowedExtensions / ValidationFileMaximumSize, CheckoutAttribute equivalents, ReturnRequestSettings.ReturnRequestsFileMaximumSize — moved from OrderSettings in 5.00 — and the elFinder allow-list and 10 MB limit of the HTML editor), **when** a file is uploaded, **then** the stricter of the native limit and the policy applies (BR-ADM-060).
**Given** the file content does not match its extension (file signature check), **when** it is uploaded, **then** it is refused with message Adm.UploadTypeNotAllowed.

**Given** scanning is enabled, **when** a file passes the type and size checks, **then** it is sent to the antivirus engine (IC-ADM-05) before it is stored; a clean file is stored, an infected file is refused with message Adm.UploadInfected and the event is audited (AUD-ADM-006).

**Given** the antivirus engine is unavailable, **when** a file is uploaded, **then** the configured fail mode applies: reject with message Adm.UploadScanUnavailable (Proposed default) or accept into quarantine, not usable until scanned.

**Given** any upload endpoint is used, including ones that read the file through IDownloadService.GetDownloadBitsAsync or IPictureService.InsertPictureAsync, **when** the policy is enforced, **then** a global action filter on the known upload actions (BR-ADM-006, BR-ADM-007) checks Request.Form.Files before the action runs, and DI overrides of IDownloadService.GetDownloadBitsAsync(IFormFile) and IPictureService.InsertPictureAsync(IFormFile, ...) apply the same checks as a backstop (BR-ADM-060).
basis: FIT (5.00.1: DownloadService.GetDownloadBitsAsync and PictureService.InsertPictureAsync are public virtual; Admin PictureController.AsyncUpload, DownloadController.AsyncUpload, ProductController.ProductPictureAdd, ProductController.Upload3dObject, PriceListController.ImportExcel, ElFinderController.Connector; Nop.Web ShoppingCartController, ReturnRequestController, CustomerController.UploadAvatar, VendorController.ApplyVendorSubmit and Info)

criterion: **Given** a module registers an upload context through IC-ADM-08 RegisterUploadContext (code, owning feature, default extensions and size, scan flag, and either the native upload actions it covers with a resolver that recognises its uploads from the route values, or its own upload endpoint) — for example EGV-002 application documents on ShoppingCartController.UploadFileProductAttribute for attributes of e-Government services, IAM trade application documents, RET return evidence, DOC-005 required documents, **when** a file is uploaded through a covered action or endpoint, **then** the ADM-008 filter, or the module endpoint through IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload, applies that context's policy (a resolver match takes precedence over the ADM default context of the action) and the refusal uses the ADM-008 messages; the module keeps no file-type or size check of its own and registers no upload filter (BR-ADM-060).

**Given** an administrator opens the upload policy page, **when** it is shown, **then** every context is listed with its owning feature, covered actions or endpoint and current values; values of a module context are edited here, not in the owning module.

**Given** an upload policy is set for the contexts product 3D object, data imports and HTML-editor files, **when** a file is posted to one of the upload actions added in nopCommerce 5.00 (Admin ProductController.Upload3dObject, PriceListController.ImportExcel, ElFinderController.Connector upload command), **then** the ADM-008 filter applies the context policy and the scan before the action stores the file; a refused file gets Adm.UploadTypeNotAllowed, Adm.UploadTooLarge or Adm.UploadInfected and nothing is written; for elFinder the stricter of the policy and the elFinder allow-list applies.

**Given** modules raise exceptions through IC-ADM-04 (type, severity, reason code, entity reference, details, allowed actions), **when** an operator opens the queue, **then** exceptions are listed by severity, then by age (oldest first), with filters by type, reason code and module.

**Given** an operator resolves an exception, **when** they save the resolution, **then** a reason code and an action are mandatory (message Adm.ReasonRequired if missing) and operator, action, reason code, comment and outcome are recorded (AUD-ADM-007).

**Given** several exceptions of a type that declares an action batch-safe are selected, **when** the operator applies that action (approve, reject, retry or escalate), **then** the action runs on each item through the owning module's handler and the result per item is shown; actions not declared batch-safe are not offered for multiple items.
**Given** a retry fails again, **when** the result returns, **then** the exception returns to Open with the attempt count increased.

**Given** several open exceptions share reason code and source (for example the same integration endpoint) within the configured window, **when** the pattern task runs, **then** they are grouped under one pattern with a count, shown at the top of the queue.

**Given** an alert rule names a measure (orders in status S longer than a set time, service-level breach reported by ORD-011, open exceptions of a type above a count), a threshold, recipients and a channel, **when** the alert task runs and the threshold is crossed, **then** an alert is raised and sent through TRK-005 to the recipients; it is not sent again for the same rule and subject until it is cleared or the repeat interval passes.
**Given** an alert is raised, **when** an operator acknowledges it, **then** it shows who acknowledged and when; when the measure falls back below the threshold the alert clears automatically.
**Given** a rule is created or changed, **when** it is saved, **then** the change is audited (AUD-ADM-008).

**Given** the vertical pack (PLT-003) supplies template defaults, **when** the client library is opened, **then** each client template shows the default it derives from; editing a client template never changes the vertical default.
**Given** a template is changed, **when** it is saved, **then** a new version with author, time and change summary is created; an earlier version can be restored as a new version.
**Given** a child template inherits from a parent, **when** the child is opened, **then** every field shows whether it is inherited or overridden, and an overridden field shows the parent value.
**Given** a template is cloned, **when** the clone is saved, **then** it is a new template with the same values and its own version history.

**Given** an active template is changed, **when** the change is submitted, **then** it waits for approval (ADM-006) by a user holding Administration.Core.Templates.Approve other than the author; transactions keep using the active version until approval.

**Given** the configuration workspace is opened, **when** an administrator chooses an area, **then** they are taken to the owning screen (PLT-006 branding, locale resources, ADM-002 workflows, ADM-003 rules, DOC-001 document templates, TRK-004 notification templates); no area is edited in a second place.

**Given** templates are used by transactions, **when** the analytics page is opened, **then** it shows per template the number of transactions in a chosen period, the date last used, and the number of failed or exception cases; templates unused for the configured period are marked stale.

**Given** a client administrator publishes a template, **when** it is exported, **then** client identifiers (names, codes, addresses, users) are removed and the package goes to the central product library outside every client instance (one installation per client, PLT-002).
**Given** a package from the shared library, **when** another client imports it, **then** it is added as a draft template in that client's library and follows the ADM-011 approval before use.

**Given** TranslationSettings.AllowPreTranslate is on, TranslateFromLanguageId is set and the DeepL or Google key is entered, **when** an editor asks for pre-translation on the product edit page, **then** empty localized fields of every language not in NotTranslateLanguages are filled in the form; nothing is saved until the editor saves.
**Given** a localized field already has text, **when** pre-translation runs, **then** that field is not changed.

**Given** the translation service returns an error for a language, **when** pre-translation runs, **then** the error is written to the system log, fields already translated keep their values and the form shows that errors occurred; for DeepL an unsupported language stops the run.
basis: FIT (TranslationModelFactory: HasErrors, ILogger — async members only in 5.00.1, Libraries/Nop.Services/Logging/ILogger.cs)

criterion: **Given** the AI pack extension is installed, **when** an editor asks for pre-translation on a topic, blog post, news item, menu, message template or vendor edit page, **then** the same pre-fill rules as AC-AI-001-01-01 and 01-02 apply.

**Given** a language pack lacks resource strings present in the source language, **when** an editor runs resource pre-translation, **then** the missing strings are pre-filled into a review list; none is saved as a locale resource until the editor accepts it.

**Given** the approval step is on for an entity type, **when** an editor saves an AI-filled translation, **then** it is held as an AiTranslationDraft (SM-AI-02); the storefront keeps showing the current text until a user with AI.Core.Translation.Approve approves it, which writes it to the native LocalizedProperty and calls IC-PLT-09 SetStatus so the PLT-025 translation status becomes Checked (BR-PLT-090); approval is audited (AUD-AI-002).

**Given** the approval step is off, **when** an editor saves an AI-filled translation, **then** it is saved to LocalizedProperty at once, as in native nopCommerce, and its PLT-025 translation status is Unchecked (BR-PLT-090); AI keeps no translation status of its own.

**Given** ArtificialIntelligenceSettings.Enabled and AllowProductDescriptionGeneration are on and a provider (Gemini, ChatGPT or DeepSeek) is set, **when** a user with Catalog.ProductsCreateEditDelete opens the description generator, enters keywords and tone and generates, **then** the generated text is shown in the popup and is written to the product only when the user saves.

**Given** the provider returns an error, **when** generation is requested, **then** the AI pack shows message Ai.GenerationFailed and keeps the save button disabled; native nopCommerce instead places the error text in the description field, which could then be saved.
basis: FIT (5.00.1: Admin ProductController.FullDescriptionGeneratorPopup catches NopException into GeneratedDescription, Presentation/Nop.Web/Areas/Admin/Controllers/ProductController.cs:1608-1628); Proposed (override)

criterion: **Given** AllowMetaTitleGeneration, AllowMetaKeywordsGeneration and AllowMetaDescriptionGeneration are on, **when** a user generates meta tags for a product, category, manufacturer, blog post, news item, topic or vendor, **then** only meta fields that are empty are filled; a news item is supported only where the bundled Misc.News plugin is installed, through its consumer of MetaTagsGeneratingEvent.
basis: FIT (5.00.1: public ArtificialIntelligenceService.CreateMetaTagsAsync(entity, languageId) and CreateMetaTagsAsync(entityTypeName, entityId, languageId), which publishes MetaTagsGeneratingEvent for entity types outside core, Libraries/Nop.Services/ArtificialIntelligence/ArtificialIntelligenceService.cs:364-400; the entity overload with current meta values became protected, :229-256; Plugins/Nop.Plugin.Misc.News/Services/Events/EventConsumer.cs:196; Admin ArtificialIntelligenceController.GenerateMetaTags)

criterion: **Given** a user lacks the native create-edit-delete permission for that entity type, **when** they call meta-tag generation, **then** the call is refused by the AI pack action filter and nothing is sent to the provider (BR-AI-004).
basis: FIT (5.00.1: GenerateMetaTags has no CheckPermission, Presentation/Nop.Web/Areas/Admin/Controllers/ArtificialIntelligenceController.cs:53); Proposed

criterion: **Given** at least the minimum number of comparable products (setting, default not stated) exist in the same category, region and season window, **when** a seller asks for a price suggestion, **then** a suggested price is shown with the number of comparables and their price range; the product price changes only if the seller saves it.
**Given** fewer comparable products than the minimum exist, **when** a seller asks for a price suggestion, **then** message Ai.NotEnoughData is shown and no price is suggested.

**Given** value rules exist for the category (CAT-005 attribute schemas), **when** a quality check runs on a product, **then** values outside the expected range or inconsistent with another attribute are listed as flags; saving is not blocked.

**Given** an image-generation provider is configured, **when** a seller generates an image from the description, **then** the image is shown for review with the label Ai.GeneratedLabel and becomes a product picture only when the seller accepts it (SM-AI-03).

**Given** the chatbot is enabled for the web widget (IWidgetPlugin in zone body_end_html_tag_before), **when** a shopper asks a question that matches an approved ready-made answer returned by IC-CRM-02 GetApprovedAnswers (CRM-007), **then** the assistant answers with that approved version; draft or unapproved versions are never used, because IC-CRM-02 returns Approved versions only (BR-AI-001).

**Given** the CHN-006 routing setting sends WhatsApp messages to the chatbot first (BR-CHN-014), **when** a shopper sends the same question on WhatsApp, **then** the same approved answer is sent on WhatsApp through IC-CHN-04 SendReply, outside TRK-005 as a conversational reply; SendReply sends nothing when IC-TRK-06 CheckAllowed answers Blocked for that sender (decision MSG-ROUTE, BR-TRK-026).

**Given** a question matches no scripted response and the language-model answer option is on, **when** the shopper asks it, **then** the assistant answers only from approved answers read through IC-CRM-02 and published topics, through the configured provider; if no approved content supports an answer it replies Ai.BotNoAnswer and offers a person (BR-AI-001).
**Given** a conversation starts on any channel, **when** the first message is shown, **then** it begins with the disclosure Ai.Disclosure (BR-AI-010).

**Given** a signed-in shopper asks about an order on the website, **when** the assistant looks it up, **then** it returns the status of that customer's orders only, read through the native order service; it never states order data from the language model.

**Given** a WhatsApp sender asks about an order, **when** the assistant looks it up, **then** it answers only if the sender's number belongs to the order's customer; otherwise it replies Ai.OrderNotFound, the same as for an unknown order (BR-CHN-011).

**Given** the shopper asks for a person, or the assistant fails to answer the configured number of times in a row (default not stated), **when** hand-off is triggered, **then** the conversation and its transcript pass to the live chat console (CRM-008) and the shopper sees Ai.HandOffAgent; when no agent is available a ticket is created through IC-CRM-04 ReceiveInbound with channel Chat (web) or WhatsApp and the transcript, and the shopper sees Ai.HandOffTicket.

**Given** the language-model provider returns an error or exceeds ArtificialIntelligenceSettings.RequestTimeout (native default 30 seconds when unset), **when** the assistant needs it, **then** the assistant replies Ai.BotUnavailable and offers a person; the error is logged.

**Given** a user with AI.Core.Chatbot.CreateEditDelete changes channels, sources, languages or hand-off rules, **when** they save, **then** new conversations use the new settings and the change is audited (AUD-AI-001).

**Given** feature PRD-AI-003 is off for store S (productfeature.PRD-AI-003 read through IC-PLT-02), **when** a page of store S is rendered or a WhatsApp message for store S arrives, **then** the chat widget is not rendered and CHN-006 does not route the message to the chatbot (BR-AI-006).

**Given** questions were answered with Ai.BotNoAnswer or handed off, **when** a user with AI.Core.Chatbot.View opens the unanswered list, **then** each question is listed with its count and last date, with a link to create or update a CRM-007 response.

**Given** drafting is enabled and the agent holds AI.Core.Drafting.Use, **when** the agent asks for a draft on a ticket, **then** a draft labelled Ai.GeneratedLabel is placed in the reply box; nothing is sent until the agent sends it.

**Given** a document is stored in the DOC module, **when** a user with AI.Core.Drafting.Use asks for a summary, **then** a summary labelled Ai.GeneratedLabel is stored linked to the document; the document itself is not changed.

**Given** an OCR service is configured (not named), **when** a document image is submitted, **then** the extracted text and fields are stored with their confidence; fields below the confidence threshold (setting, default not stated) are marked for manual review; the original file is not changed.

**Given** an ID-check service is configured (not named), **when** an identity document is submitted, **then** the result is stored as one of the product identity-result values Verified, NotVerified, Inconclusive or Unavailable (IC-IAM-02 standard, decision ONE-RECORD) with its reasons; the decision on the person is taken by a staff member, never by the service alone (BR-AI-002, BR-IAM-110).

**Given** an OCR service is configured and DOC-005 calls IC-DOC-06 Extract fields with a file and a document type, **when** the service returns, **then** AI-005 returns the field values of that document type, each with its confidence; an unreadable file returns Unreadable and an unavailable service returns the service-unavailable error; DOC-005 decides Match, Mismatch or manual review (BR-DOC-040).

**Given** the fraud-scoring service is configured (not named) and a PAY-018 rule of type model score is active (its threshold and action are held on the PAY-018 rule, BR-PAY-090), **when** PAY-018 requests a score for a payment through IC-AI-03 Score, **then** AI-006 returns the score, the model version and the main reasons and stores them as a ModelResult; PAY stores FraudScore and FraudModelVersion on the transaction; AI applies no threshold and writes no flag: PAY-018 compares the score with the rule threshold, writes the RiskFlag and blocks only if the rule action is Block.

**Given** the scoring service does not answer within the IC-AI-03 timeout (setting, default not stated), **when** a payment is initiated, **then** IC-AI-03 Score returns Unavailable and the missing score is logged; PAY-018 then does not fire the model-score rule, evaluates the other rules and the payment continues (as PAY-018 specifies).

**Given** the recommendation service is configured (not named), **when** SRC-009 asks for suggestions for a customer and a surface (product page, cart, home) through IC-AI-03 Recommend, **then** AI-007 returns the ranked product ids with the model version and stores a ModelResult; AI applies no product filter of its own: SRC-009 removes products that are not eligible under BR-SRC-050 before display (out-of-stock products only where that client rule applies).

**Given** the AI pack is installed and the recommendation service is configured, **when** the AI-007 plugin starts, **then** it registers itself as the SRC-009 recommendation provider (IC-SRC-04) and maps Recommend, SendEvents and DeleteSubjectData to IC-AI-03; when it is uninstalled or disabled SRC-009 uses its own fallback (AC-SRC-009-01-04; AI-007 specifies no fallback of its own).
basis: Proposed (AI-007 is an optional provider to SRC-009)

criterion: **Given** the shopper has given personalisation consent, which SRC-009 checks (BR-SRC-080), **when** SRC-009 passes view, add-to-cart and purchase events through IC-AI-03 SendEvents with a pseudonymous customer key, **then** AI-007 forwards them to the recommendation service with that key only; no name, contact or address is sent (BR-AI-005).

**Given** the shopper withdraws consent, **when** SRC-009 calls IC-AI-03 DeleteSubjectData with the pseudonymous key, **then** AI-007 sends the deletion request to the service and records the request time and the service answer; later events for that key are not forwarded until consent is given again.

**Given** the forecasting service is configured (not named) and receives order history, **when** a forecast run completes, **then** forecasts by category, region and period are stored with the run date and shown in reports; they change no stock or order.

**Given** the inspection service is configured (not named), **when** a product photo is submitted, **then** detected defects are stored with the photo and confidence; a staff member confirms or rejects each finding.

**Given** a DOC-001 template exists and drafting is enabled, **when** a user with AI.Core.Drafting.Use enters the details and asks for a draft, **then** a draft labelled Ai.GeneratedLabel is created from the template; it is issued only after a person edits or approves it and issues it through DOC-001.
**Given** the chatbot is enabled, **when** a conversation starts on any channel, **then** the disclosure Ai.Disclosure is the first message (BR-AI-010).
**Given** content was generated or translated by AI and accepted by a person, **when** it is saved, **then** an AiUseLog entry records feature, user, entity, provider and time (AUD-AI-003).

**Given** the chatbot answered from approved content, **when** the shopper asks why or where the answer came from, **then** the assistant lists the titles of the source responses or topics used (Ai.AnswerSources).
**Given** a model score affected a transaction (AI-006), **when** fraud staff open the flag, **then** the score, the model version and the main reasons are shown.
**Given** a shopper is chatting with the assistant, **when** they ask for a person at any time, **then** hand-off follows AC-AI-003-03-01.

**Given** an AI feature is enabled for a client, **when** an administrator opens the AI use register, **then** the feature is listed with provider, data categories sent, disclosure text, owner and review date; a feature without a register entry is shown as incomplete.

**Given** a model that scores or ranks people is enabled (AI-006, AI-007), **when** its monitoring period ends, **then** the external platform's bias report for that model is linked in the register; a model without a report for the period is shown as overdue.

**Given** a user holds Catalog.CategoriesCreateEditDelete, **when** they create a category with a parent category, **then** it is saved with ParentCategoryId and appears under the parent in the admin tree and, once published, in the storefront category navigation.

**Given** a category has a localized name for each published language, **when** a shopper switches language, **then** the category name is shown in that language; where a localized name is empty the default-language name is shown.
**Given** two categories are given the same search-engine name, **when** the second is saved, **then** it receives a unique slug (native ValidateSeNameAsync).

**Given** a user without Catalog.CategoriesCreateEditDelete (for example a seller), **when** they post a category create or edit, **then** access is denied and nothing changes (native CheckPermission).

**Given** a category is limited to customer role R (SubjectToAcl) and catalogsettings.ignoreacl is false, **when** a customer without role R browses, **then** the category, its page and its menu entry are not shown.
**Given** a category is limited to store S, **when** a shopper browses store T, **then** the category is not shown in store T.
**Given** a category is unpublished, **when** a shopper browses, **then** the category is not shown.
**Given** a published category holds published products and subcategories, **when** a shopper opens the category page, **then** its subcategories and its products are listed, ordered by DisplayOrder.

**Given** a user holds Catalog.ProductsCreateEditDelete, **when** they save a new product with name, short and full description, SKU, GTIN, price, weight and dimensions, **then** the product is stored with those values and the listing starts in state Draft (SM-CAT-01).
**Given** productEditorSettings hide a field, **when** a user opens the product form, **then** the field is not shown on the form (native ProductEditorSettings).

**Given** a seller is signed in to the admin area as a vendor, **when** the seller creates a product, **then** VendorId is forced to the seller (native) and the seller sees and edits only own products.

**Given** a listing lacks any of: name, full description, price (unless call for price), stock quantity (when stock is managed) or at least one picture, **when** the seller submits it for review or anyone tries to publish it, **then** the transition is refused with message Cat.MandatoryFieldMissing listing the missing fields; the listing stays Draft (BR-CAT-002).

**Given** vendorsettings.maximumproductnumber is set above zero, **when** a seller at the limit tries to create a product, **then** creation is refused with the native message Admin.Catalog.Products.ExceededMaximumNumber.

**Given** a seller edits a product, **when** they enter weight, length, width and height, **then** the values are stored on the product in the base weight and dimension units (measuresettings.baseweightid, basedimensionid) and are used by shipping.

**Given** the ADM-008 upload policy for context admin picture sets allowed extensions and a maximum size, **when** a user uploads a product image with another extension or above the size on the product edit page, **then** the upload is refused with message Adm.UploadTypeNotAllowed or Adm.UploadTooLarge and no Picture record is created (BR-CAT-003).

**Given** the ADM-008 upload policy for context admin download sets allowed extensions and a maximum size, **when** a user uploads a product document with another extension or above the size, **then** the upload is refused with message Adm.UploadTypeNotAllowed or Adm.UploadTooLarge and no Download record is created (BR-CAT-003).
**Given** vendorsettings.maximumproductpicturesnumber is set, **when** a seller adds a picture beyond the limit, **then** the picture is refused (native).

**Given** the CAT-002 IProductService override is registered (INopStartup Order >= 3000) and INV registers a sellable-stock adjuster (IC-CAT-04), **when** GetTotalStockQuantityAsync is called for a product, **then** the native result is computed first and then passed through every registered adjuster in their declared order; the adjusted result is returned.

**Given** SRC registers a search filter or ordering contributor (IC-CAT-04), **when** SearchProductsAsync runs for the storefront, **then** the host builds the native 5.00.1 query, applies each filter contributor after the native filters and before ordering and paging — also before the join with the results of an active AI recommendation provider, which in 5.00 returns early — and returns the paged result; admin searches (showHidden true) are not passed to SRC contributors.
basis: OVR-REG; FIT (ProductService.SearchProductsAsync, Libraries/Nop.Services/Catalog/ProductService.cs:822-1148, AI-provider path 895-922; repositories are protected fields)

criterion: **Given** an SRC ordering contributor is registered and the scoped search context carries a sort value it owns (for example popularity or distance), **when** SearchProductsAsync runs for the storefront, **then** the contributor orders the query in place of the native ProductSortingEnum ordering; without such a sort value the native ordering is kept, including the order of search-provider and AI-provider results when orderBy is Position (5.00.1: ProductExtensions.OrderBy with the provider results, Libraries/Nop.Services/Catalog/ProductExtensions.cs:99, called at ProductService.cs:908-910 and 1176).

**Given** a second plugin registers its own IProductService, IPriceCalculationService or IOrderTotalCalculationService implementation, **when** the application starts, **then** the ADM extension register raises the double-registration warning (BR-ADM-001); provider modules register with the CAT host instead (BR-CAT-031).

**Given** the CAT-022 listing lifecycle is not delivered (held) and no publish-gate provider is registered, **when** a product is inserted or updated through the admin form, bulk edit, import or the API, **then** the CAT-002 host runs the native method with the providers that are registered (sellable stock, search contributors) and keeps the Published value the caller set; when CAT-022 is delivered it registers the publish-gate provider (IC-CAT-04) and BR-CAT-005 applies.

**Given** an active SKU pattern exists (tokens Proposed: fixed prefix, year, sequence with a set number of digits), **when** a product is inserted with an empty SKU by any path (form, wizard, import, copy, API), **then** the SKU is generated from the pattern inside the IProductService.InsertProductAsync override before the insert (BR-CAT-004).
basis: D; REQ-MPC-FR-064; FIT (ProductService.InsertProductAsync is public virtual)

criterion: **Given** a generated or typed SKU already exists on another product or attribute combination, **when** the product is saved, **then** a generated SKU takes the next sequence number; a typed SKU is refused with message Cat.SkuDuplicate.

**Given** two products are inserted at the same moment, **when** both need a generated SKU, **then** the sequence is read and advanced under ILocker key 'cat-sku-{PatternId}'; the two SKUs differ; if the lock is not obtained after the configured retries the insert is refused with message Cat.SkuGenerationBusy.
basis: Proposed; FIT (ILocker.PerformActionWithLockAsync returns false when the lock is not acquired)

criterion: **Given** a product is deleted, **when** a new product is generated, **then** the deleted product's sequence number is not reused.
**Given** the pattern is changed, **when** it is saved, **then** the change is audited (AUD-CAT-013); existing SKUs are not changed.

**Given** a specification attribute "Size" with options and a specification attribute "Grade" exist and catalogsettings.enablespecificationattributefiltering is on, **when** products carry these values with AllowFiltering set, **then** the values are available to the category and search filters of SRC-003 and the filter shows only products with the chosen value.

**Given** a product attribute "Pack size" has values with price and weight adjustments, **when** a shopper selects a value, **then** the displayed price and the cart weight change by the adjustment (native).
**Given** attribute and option names have localized values, **when** a shopper views the product in another language, **then** the localized names are shown.

**Given** specification attributes "Fragile" (option) and "Handling notes" (custom text) exist, **when** a seller sets them on a product, **then** they are stored on the product, shown on the product page and passed to shipping documents through LOG (attribute names configured per client).

**Given** a category schema marks specification attribute A and field F as required for category C, **when** a listing in category C without A or F is submitted or published, **then** the transition is refused with message Cat.MandatoryFieldMissing naming A and F (BR-CAT-002).

**Given** category C has a required attribute and subcategory D has none of its own, **when** a listing in D is submitted, **then** the requirement of C applies to D (inheritance, Proposed setting on the schema).
**Given** a listing belongs to two categories with different schemas, **when** it is submitted, **then** the union of both required sets is checked.

**Given** a listing has all required fields but a picture smaller than the configured minimum pixel size, **when** the seller runs the check or submits, **then** a warning with message Cat.ImageQualityLow is shown and the submission is allowed (BR-CAT-010).
**Given** required fields are missing, **when** the seller opens the quality check, **then** every missing field is listed before submission, with message Cat.MandatoryFieldMissing.

**Given** a user with Misc.Catalogue.Schema.CreateEditDelete changes a schema, **when** the change is saved, **then** it is stored as a draft version with message Cat.SchemaChangePending and has no effect until a different user with Misc.Catalogue.Schema.Approve approves it (SM-CAT-10).

**Given** a schema version is approved, **when** listings already published in the category miss a new required field, **then** they stay published and are listed in a "schema gaps" view for their owners; they must meet the new schema at their next submission.
**Given** a schema version is approved or rejected, **when** the decision is saved, **then** who, when and the old and new required sets are audited (AUD-CAT-003).

**Given** a product has attribute "Pack size" with three values, **when** staff run "generate all combinations", **then** one attribute combination per value is created (native GenerateAllAttributeCombinations).

**Given** a combination has its own SKU, GTIN, overridden price, stock quantity and picture, **when** a shopper selects that combination, **then** the product page shows that SKU, price, stock availability and picture.
**Given** a combination has stock 0 and backorders are not allowed, **when** a shopper adds it to the cart, **then** the native out-of-stock warning is shown and the item is not added.
**Given** a combination SKU duplicates another SKU, **when** it is saved, **then** it is refused with message Cat.SkuDuplicate (BR-CAT-004).

**Given** a seller creates a bundle in the CAT bundle editor with components and quantities, **when** it is saved, **then** a bundle product is created whose price is the bundle price, and each component is stored as a required product attribute with one preselected value of type AssociatedToProduct (AssociatedProductId, Quantity, PriceAdjustment 0) (BR-CAT-016).

**Given** a bundle is ordered, **when** stock is adjusted, **then** the stock of each component is reduced by bundle quantity times component quantity (native AdjustInventoryAsync handles AssociatedToProduct values).

**Given** a component is unpublished or out of stock, **when** a shopper adds the bundle to the cart, **then** the item is refused with the native associated-product warning and message Cat.BundleComponentUnavailable.
**Given** a seller selects a component that belongs to another seller, **when** the bundle is saved, **then** it is refused; a seller bundles only own products.
**Given** a published bundle, **when** a shopper opens its page, **then** the components with names, quantities and pictures are listed instead of attribute drop-downs (view override).

**Given** a user copies a product with "copy images" selected (native CopyProduct), **when** the copy is created, **then** the copy holds the source values and pictures, its listing state is Draft and Published is false whatever "published" option was chosen (BR-CAT-005).
**Given** a vendor copies a product of another vendor, **when** the request is posted, **then** it is refused (native vendor ownership check).

**Given** a seller saves product P as template "T", **when** the template is saved, **then** template T stores the field set of P (Proposed set: descriptions, category, attributes, tax category, dimensions, shipping flags; not SKU, stock or pictures) and is visible only to that seller (or to all staff for a staff template).
**Given** template T exists, **when** a user creates a new listing from T, **then** a new Draft product is created with the template values and an empty SKU (generated by CAT-003).

**Given** a file in the standard template (Excel) passes CAT-010 validation, **when** the import runs, **then** new products are created in state Draft and existing products (matched by SKU) are updated; columns are matched by header name (native).

**Given** a CSV or XML file in the standard template is uploaded, **when** the import runs, **then** it is converted to the same row model as the Excel import and processed by the same validation and import rules.

**Given** an import updates a Published listing, **when** the update is saved, **then** the re-approval rule BR-CAT-008 applies to imported changes as to form changes, and Published is never set by the file (BR-CAT-005).
**Given** a file has another format, **when** it is uploaded, **then** it is refused with message Cat.ImportFormatNotSupported.
**Given** vendorsettings.allowvendorstoimportproducts is off, **when** a seller posts an import, **then** access is denied (native).

**Given** a seller imports, **when** the file holds products of another vendor or more products than vendorsettings.maximumproductnumber allows, **then** those rows are refused in the validation report; the vendor of every imported product is the seller.

**Given** a user holds Catalog.ProductsImportExport, **when** they export all or the filtered products to Excel or XML, or download the PDF catalogue, **then** the file is produced; a vendor gets only own products (native).

**Given** catalogsettings.exportimportsplitproductsfile is on, **when** a large Excel file is imported, **then** it is processed in parts of catalogsettings.exportimportproductscountinonefile rows (native).

**Given** a file is uploaded, **when** validation runs, **then** every row is checked (required columns, data types, existence of categories, manufacturers, stores, attributes, SKU uniqueness, category schema CAT-005, prohibited terms CAT-021) and a report lists row number, column and error message for each error.
**Given** the report has at least one error, **when** the user tries to commit, **then** nothing is imported and message Cat.ImportHasErrors is shown with a link to download the report (BR-CAT-012).

**Given** the report has no errors, **when** the user commits, **then** the import runs and the result (created, updated, unchanged counts) is stored with the job (SM-CAT-08) and audited (AUD-CAT-012).

**Given** a file is larger than the configured row or size threshold, **when** it is uploaded, **then** message Cat.ImportLargeFile asks for confirmation before validation starts; the user can cancel.
basis: D; FIT (PG ADM-03 is an AFR feature on 4.70.5; AFR port rebuilt for nopCommerce 5.00 / .NET 10, or a CAT build; a 5.00 AFR build cannot be verified from source, VER-500)

criterion: **Given** an API client registered in INT-001 holds a token (OAuth 2.0, decision API-GW) with the catalogue read scope (scope name Proposed: products.read) and is limited to store S, **when** it requests products changed since a date, **then** published products of store S with their prices, stock availability, categories and attributes are returned; unpublished listings are returned only to clients that also hold the scope products.read.unpublished (BR-INT-006).

**Given** a request has no valid token, or the client lacks the scope or the store, **when** it is received, **then** it is refused with 401 or 403 and the refusal is logged (BR-INT-002); no data is returned.

**Given** a rate limit is set for the API client (value not stated), **when** the client exceeds it on a catalogue endpoint, **then** further catalogue requests in that window get 429 and other clients are not affected (BR-INT-004).

**Given** catalogue endpoints are published as version v1 on the API-01 base, **when** an incompatible change to a catalogue resource is needed, **then** it is released only in a new major version; v1 keeps answering for the deprecation window and announces its retirement date (BR-INT-003).

**Given** an API client with scope products.write (INT-001) creates or updates a product, **when** the request is processed, **then** the product goes through IProductService and therefore the same SKU, mandatory-field, policy and lifecycle rules as the admin form: a new product is Draft; Published is never set by the API (BR-CAT-005, BR-INT-001).

**Given** tier prices exist for a bulk-buyer role (name configured per client) at quantity 1 and 100 with start and end dates, **when** a customer in that role adds 100 units within the dates, **then** the 100-unit tier price is used in the product page price table and the cart (native GetPreferredTierPriceAsync).
basis: D; Inference from REQ-KTDA-PRJ-002 (retail and bulk pricing tiers); FIT (TierPrice.CustomerRoleId, Quantity, StartDateTimeUtc, EndDateTimeUtc)

criterion: **Given** a tier price has an end date in the past, **when** a customer adds the product, **then** the tier price is not used.
**Given** a tier price is limited to store S, **when** a customer buys in store T, **then** it is not used.

**Given** a seller edits own product, **when** they change the base price or add a dated tier price, **then** the new values apply from the stated dates; the change is in the version history (CAT-023).
**Given** a seller tries to change the price of another seller's product, **when** the request is posted, **then** it is refused (native vendor ownership check).

**Given** a product has CallForPrice set, **when** a shopper opens its page or listing card, **then** no price is shown, add to cart is not offered (native warning Products.CallForPrice blocks it) and button Cat.RequestQuote is shown in widget zone productdetails_add_info.

**Given** Misc.RFQ is installed and rfqsettings.enabled is on and the buyer holds Misc.RFQ.AccessRFQ.PublicStore.AccessRFQ, **when** the buyer submits quantity, attributes and notes from the product page, **then** CAT calls the ORD request service IC-ORD-08 (customer, store, product, quantity, attributes XML, notes); ORD creates the Misc.RFQ request quote in status Submitted and sends the native new-request message; CAT shows message Cat.QuoteRequested; CAT writes no Misc.RFQ table and does not read or change the cart (BR-CAT-017).
basis: D; see ORD-012 (IC-ORD-08); FIT (Misc.RFQ RequestQuote, RequestQuoteStatus)

criterion: **Given** IC-ORD-08 refuses the request (Misc.RFQ not installed, access denied or product not quotable), **when** the buyer submits, **then** no request is created and message Cat.QuoteRequestRefused is shown; the product page is unchanged.

**Given** the store owner converts the request to a quote and the buyer accepts it, **when** the quote is moved to the cart (native RfqService.CreateShoppingCartAsync), **then** the call-for-price warning is not raised for that cart item because it is linked to a quote item, and the quoted price is used (BR-CAT-017).
**Given** a product is not call for price, **when** a shopper opens its page, **then** button Cat.RequestQuote is not shown; the native cart-level "request a quote" of Misc.RFQ is unchanged.
**Given** a guest without the RFQ public-store permission, **when** opens a call-for-price product, **then** the button asks the guest to sign in.
**Given** tax categories exist and taxsettings.defaulttaxcategoryid is set, **when** a product is created without a tax category, **then** the default tax category is pre-selected on the form.
**Given** a product has tax category T, **when** the tax provider calculates an order line, **then** the rate configured for T applies (PAY-020).
**Given** a product is marked tax exempt, **when** it is sold, **then** no tax is charged on it (native IsTaxExemptAsync).

**Given** the cross-border fields are enabled for the store, **when** staff save an HS code, a country of origin and a duty note on a product, **then** the values are stored in the CAT trade-fields table and printed on the export documents of DOC-006.
basis: D; REQ-KTDA-LEG-001; Inference from REQ-KTDA-CUS-002 (international buyers)

criterion: **Given** an HS code does not match the configured format, **when** the product is saved, **then** it is refused with message Cat.HsCodeInvalid.
**Given** country of origin is entered, **when** it is saved, **then** it must be a country from the native Country list.

**Given** a product is offered for international delivery (seller setting), **when** the seller submits it without the required cross-border fields, **then** submission is refused with message Cat.MandatoryFieldMissing (BR-CAT-002).

**Given** the CAT token provider is registered with DOC through IC-DOC-02 (entity type Product; tokens %Product.HsCode%, %Product.CountryOfOrigin%, %Product.DutyNote%, names Proposed), **when** a commercial invoice template of DOC-006 using these tokens is generated for an order, **then** each order line shows the HS code, country of origin name and duty note of its product from ProductTradeFields; a product without a value gives an empty token, and DOC stops generation only if the template marks the token required (BR-DOC-002).

**Given** a product has several pictures and a video, **when** a shopper opens the page, **then** the pictures are shown in display order with thumbnails and the video is embedded with the mediasettings.videoiframe* values (native).
**Given** mediasettings.defaultpicturezoomenabled is on, **when** a shopper opens a picture, **then** the full-size picture opens over the page (native picture zoom).

**Given** a 360-degree image set is attached to a product, **when** a shopper opens the 360 view, **then** the images rotate in sequence in a viewer below the main picture (widget zone productdetails_after_pictures).
**Given** a PDF brochure is attached to a product, **when** a shopper opens the page, **then** a download link with the brochure title is shown.

**Given** mediasettings.maximumimagesize is set, **when** an image larger than that pixel size is uploaded, **then** it is resized to the maximum (native ValidatePictureAsync); file type and byte size limits are the ADM-008 policy (BR-CAT-003).

**Given** a brochure file is not in the allowed types or is above the size limit of the ADM-008 context admin download, **when** it is uploaded, **then** it is refused with message Adm.UploadTypeNotAllowed or Adm.UploadTooLarge and no Download record is created (BR-CAT-003).

**Given** a 3D model file (.glb only, up to MediaSettings.Object3dUploadSizeLimit MB) is uploaded on the product edit page by a user holding Catalog.ProductsCreateEditDelete, with a preview picture and alt text, **when** a shopper opens the product page, **then** the native 3D viewer shows the model with the camera control, zoom, auto-rotate and lazy-loading options set in MediaSettings.Object3dCameraControlEnabled, Object3dZoomEnabled, Object3dAutoRotateEnabled and Object3dLazyLoadingEnabled; one 3D object per product.

**Given** a seller is signed in to the admin area as a vendor, **when** the seller uploads a 3D model for a product, **then** the upload is accepted only when VendorSettings.AllowVendorsToUpload3dObjects is on and the product belongs to the seller (native); the ADM-008 upload policy also applies to this upload action (context admin 3D object, BR-CAT-003), which the native .glb and size checks do not replace.

**Given** the languages Kiswahili, English, French, Arabic, Russian and Mandarin are installed and published (PLT-009), **when** staff open a product, **then** a localized tab for name, short description, full description and SEO fields exists for each of the six languages.
**Given** a localized value exists for the shopper's language, **when** a shopper views the product, **then** the localized value is shown; if empty the default-language value is shown.

**Given** translationsettings.allowpretranslate is on and a translation service key is entered, **when** staff request pre-translation, **then** the empty localized fields are filled from the source language and the listing is marked for review before publication (AI-001 owns review).

**Given** artificialintelligencesettings.allowproductdescriptiongeneration is on, **when** staff request a description, **then** a generated text is offered for editing and is saved only when staff save the product.

**Given** Q&A is enabled and the shopper is registered, **when** the shopper submits a question, **then** it is stored as Submitted and message Cat.QuestionSubmitted is shown; it is not public yet (SM-CAT-07).
**Given** a question on the seller's product is published, **when** the seller writes an answer, **then** the answer is stored as Submitted and goes to moderation.

**Given** a question or answer is Submitted, **when** a user with Misc.Catalogue.Questions.CreateEditDelete approves or rejects it, **then** approved items become Published and visible to all shoppers under the product; rejected items are hidden and the author is told; the decision is audited (AUD-CAT-015).
**Given** an answer is published, **when** the question author has an email address, **then** the author is notified.
**Given** a guest tries to ask a question, **when** they submit, **then** they are asked to sign in.

**Given** category C is marked regulated with required regulatory fields, **when** a listing in C is submitted without those fields or without a valid certificate, **then** submission is refused with message Cat.MandatoryFieldMissing (BR-CAT-002).
**Given** a certificate is attached, **when** it is saved, **then** type, number, issuer, valid-from, valid-to and the file (Download) are stored; valid-to before valid-from is refused.
**Given** a certificate valid-to date is within the configured warning period, **when** the daily task runs, **then** the seller and compliance staff are notified once per certificate (SM-CAT-09).

**Given** a certificate has expired and auto-hide is on for the category, **when** the daily task runs, **then** the listing moves to Paused with reason CertificateExpired and Published becomes false (SM-CAT-01); audited (AUD-CAT-008).

**Given** a listing is regulated, **when** compliance staff set status Pending, Validated, Flagged, Escalated or Barred, **then** the status follows SM-CAT-03; a Barred listing cannot be submitted or published.

**Given** a producer record (native Manufacturer) with description and picture exists and is mapped to a product, **when** a shopper opens the product, **then** the producer name links to the producer page with its description, picture and products.
**Given** a content page (native Topic) for a factory or farmer story exists, **when** it is linked from the producer record, **then** the shopper can open it from the product page.

**Given** a proof-of-origin document is attached to a product or producer, **when** a shopper opens the product, **then** the document title is listed with a download link; documents marked internal are not shown.
**Given** a document is attached, **when** it is saved, **then** the BR-CAT-003 file checks apply.

**Given** a prohibited-term rule with action Block exists, **when** a listing whose name or descriptions (any language) contain the term is submitted, imported or sent through the API, **then** the submission is refused with message Cat.ProhibitedContent naming the term (BR-CAT-011).
**Given** a rule with action Flag exists, **when** a matching listing is submitted, **then** it enters review with the flag reason shown to the approver.
**Given** a category is marked prohibited, **when** anyone maps a product to it, **then** the listing cannot be submitted (message Cat.ProhibitedContent).
**Given** a rule is created, changed or disabled, **when** it is saved, **then** who, when, old and new values are audited (AUD-CAT-004).

**Given** a shopper is on a product page or a search result, **when** they choose "report this listing", pick a reason and add text, **then** a listing report is created as Open (SM-CAT-04), message Cat.ReportReceived is shown and compliance staff are notified.
**Given** the same reporter already has an Open report on the product, **when** they report again, **then** the new text is added to the existing report.

**Given** a takedown request is received with evidence files, **when** compliance staff record it, **then** the request, requester, basis and evidence (Download records) are stored against the product.

**Given** a report or takedown is Upheld, **when** the decision is recorded with a reason, **then** the listing moves to Withdrawn with that reason (SM-CAT-01), the seller is notified, the evidence is kept and the decision is audited (AUD-CAT-005).
**Given** a report is Dismissed, **when** the decision is recorded with a reason, **then** the listing is unchanged and the reporter, if registered, is told the outcome.

**Given** a listing is Draft, **when** its owner submits it and BR-CAT-002, BR-CAT-011 and the submission guard (IC-CAT-04: SEL CheckEligibility, IC-SEL-01) pass, **then** it moves to InReview and is placed in the queue chosen by the assignment rules (SM-CAT-01).

**Given** a listing is Draft or Rejected and SEL CheckEligibility returns Fail, **when** its owner submits it by any path (form, wizard, bulk edit, import, API), **then** the submission is refused with message Sel.ListingNotEligible naming each failed rule; the listing keeps its state; no queue item is created.

**Given** a listing is in any state other than Published, **when** anyone saves the product form with Published ticked, **then** the save is refused with message Cat.PublishNotAllowed through a ModelReceivedEvent veto on Admin ProductController Create / Edit [POST] (both check ModelState.IsValid) (BR-CAT-005).

**Given** a listing is not Published, **when** a path without ModelState sets Published (bulk edit, copy, Excel import, low-stock re-publish), **then** the CAT-002 IProductService host calls the CAT-022 publish-gate provider (IC-CAT-04), which makes it save Published false (BR-CAT-005).

**Given** a listing is Approved, its vendor has no pause reason and the publish guard passes (IC-CAT-04: SEL CheckEligibility, IC-SEL-01), **when** a user with Misc.Catalogue.Listings.Manage publishes it, or auto-publish on approval is on, **then** it moves to Published and Product.Published becomes true.

**Given** a listing is Approved and SEL CheckEligibility returns Fail, **when** anyone publishes it (lifecycle action or auto-publish), **then** the transition is refused with message Sel.ListingNotEligible naming each failed rule; the listing stays Approved and Published stays false.
