**Given** a listing is Published and was unpublished by the native low-stock rule (LowStockActivity Unpublish), **when** stock returns and ApplyLowStockActivityAsync sets Published true and calls UpdateProductAsync, **then** the CAT-002 IProductService host calls the CAT-022 publish-gate provider, which runs the publish guard: on Pass Published true is saved; on Fail Published is saved false, the listing moves to Paused with reason NotEligible (SM-CAT-01) and the owner is notified.

**Given** a listing is Published, **when** a user with Misc.Catalogue.Listings.Manage pauses it, resumes it or archives it, **then** the state changes per SM-CAT-01; Published is true only in Published; each change is audited (AUD-CAT-001).

**Given** a queue has two steps (step 1 role A, step 2 role B), **when** step 1 approves, **then** the listing stays InReview and step 2 becomes the current step; when the last step approves the listing becomes Approved.

**Given** a step rejects or requests changes, **when** the approver records the decision, **then** a reason is mandatory (message Cat.ReasonRequired if empty); reject → Rejected, request changes → Draft; the owner is notified with the reason.
**Given** the approver is the user who submitted the listing, **when** they try to decide it, **then** the decision is refused with message Cat.ApproveOwnListing (BR-CAT-006).

**Given** a seller edits a listing that is InReview, **when** the edit is saved, **then** the submission is withdrawn: the listing returns to Draft, the open step is closed and message Cat.SubmissionWithdrawn is shown (BR-CAT-008).

**Given** assignment rules exist by category, seller, seller tier (SEL-010) and store, each with a priority and a target queue, **when** a listing is submitted, **then** it goes to the queue of the first active rule that matches, in priority order; with no match it goes to the default queue (BR-CAT-007).

**Given** a user with Misc.Catalogue.Moderation.CreateEditDelete changes a queue, its steps or a rule, **when** it is saved, **then** listings already in review keep their current queue; the change is audited (AUD-CAT-003).

**Given** WF-ENG selects the ADM-006 approval queues for listing moderation, **when** a listing is submitted, **then** CAT calls IC-ADM-03 Submit (object type Listing, object ID ProductId, requester, summary) and ADM-006 assigns it by its rules; the CAT OnApproved / OnRejected callback applies the decision through IC-CAT-03 Decide, so BR-CAT-006 and SM-CAT-02 still apply; a callback refused by CAT leaves the item decided in ADM and raises an exception to ADM-009.

**Given** vendor V has Published, Approved and Draft listings, **when** SEL calls PauseListings(V, SellerSuspended) (IC-CAT-03), **then** under ILocker key 'cat-vendor-listings-{V}' the vendor pause reason SellerSuspended is stored; every Published listing of V moves to Paused with listing reason VendorPause and Published false; the number of listings paused is returned; audited (AUD-CAT-016) (BR-CAT-030).

**Given** vendor V has pause reasons SellerSuspended and Vacation, **when** SEL calls ResumeListings(V, Vacation), **then** Vacation is removed; no listing resumes because SellerSuspended remains; the number resumed (0) is returned.

**Given** the last vendor pause reason of V is removed, **when** ResumeListings runs, **then** reason VendorPause is removed from the listings of V; each listing with no other pause reason (Manual, Stale, CertificateExpired, NotEligible) and a passing publish guard returns to Published with Published true; the others stay Paused; the number resumed is returned.

**Given** vendor V has a pause reason, **when** anyone publishes or resumes a listing of V by a lifecycle action, or a form, bulk edit, import, API call or low-stock re-publish tries to set Published, **then** lifecycle actions are refused with message Cat.SellerListingsPaused; the other paths save Published false (BR-CAT-005, BR-CAT-030).
basis: Proposed (BR-SEL-005); FIT (BulkEditSave, ImportManager, ApplyLowStockActivityAsync all reach IProductService)

criterion: **Given** a reason code outside Vacation, SellerSuspended, SellerBlacklisted, DocumentExpired, CommissionOverdue, PerformanceIntervention, **when** PauseListings or ResumeListings is called, **then** it is refused with error Unknown reason and nothing changes.

**Given** a product is saved by any path, **when** the IProductService update or insert override runs, **then** a version is written with version number, user, time, source (form, import, API, restore) and a snapshot of product fields, localized values, category mappings, specification attribute mappings, tier prices and picture references (BR-CAT-014).
**Given** two versions exist, **when** staff choose compare, **then** the changed fields are listed with old and new values.

**Given** staff restore version N, **when** the restore is confirmed, **then** a new version is created with the values of N; the lifecycle rules BR-CAT-005 and BR-CAT-008 apply; the restore is audited (AUD-CAT-007).

**Given** a user edits the product form without saving, **when** the autosave interval passes, **then** the form values are saved to a draft buffer for that user and product; the live product is not changed.
**Given** a draft buffer exists, **when** the user reopens the product, **then** they are offered to restore or discard the draft.

**Given** another user saved the product after this user opened the form, **when** this user saves, **then** the save is refused with message Cat.EditConflict through the ModelReceivedEvent veto on Edit [POST] (BR-CAT-019).

**Given** AvailableStartDateTimeUtc and AvailableEndDateTimeUtc are set, **when** a shopper tries to buy outside the window, **then** the native warning ShoppingCart.NotAvailable is shown and the item is not added.

**Given** AvailableForPreOrder is on with a pre-order start date, **when** a shopper opens the product before that date, **then** the pre-order button and start date are shown and the order can be placed (native).

**Given** a listing is Published or Paused, **when** a user with Misc.Catalogue.Listings.Manage withdraws it, **then** a reason is mandatory (message Cat.ReasonRequired), the state becomes Withdrawn, Published becomes false and the CAT event Listing.Withdrawn is raised (BR-CAT-015); audited (AUD-CAT-006).

**Given** a listing is withdrawn, **when** back-in-stock subscribers and customers with it in a wishlist exist, **then** each is notified once with message template Catalogue.ListingWithdrawn.CustomerNotification.
basis: D; Proposed (watchers = back-in-stock subscribers and wishlist holders)

criterion: **Given** a withdrawn product is in a cart, **when** the shopper goes to checkout, **then** the native warning ShoppingCart.ProductUnpublished blocks checkout of that item.

**Given** Listing.Withdrawn is raised, **when** consumers in INV, PAY and RET receive it, **then** each only enqueues work for its owner (INV-004 releases cart holds; PAY-007 escrow orders and RET-007 open cases are listed for staff); CAT does not change orders or payments.

**Given** category C has a stale period setting, **when** a Published listing in C has UpdatedOnUtc older than that period, **then** the daily task flags it Stale and the seller is reminded once (BR-CAT-026).
**Given** a listing is flagged Stale, **when** the seller re-confirms it without changes or edits it, **then** the flag is cleared and the re-confirmation is recorded.

**Given** a listing stays Stale beyond the grace period and auto-pause is on, **when** the daily task runs, **then** it moves to Paused with reason Stale (SM-CAT-01), Published becomes false and the seller is notified.

**Given** service listings are enabled for the store (feature state productfeature.<prd-id> read through IC-PLT-02, PLT-022), **when** a seller creates a listing from the service template, **then** the product is saved with IsShipEnabled false, NotReturnable true and a CAT service record (service type, delivery method, coverage areas, qualifications).
basis: D; REQ-MPC-FR-074; FIT (Product.IsShipEnabled, Product.NotReturnable); Proposed (NotReturnable default, SVC-005)

criterion: **Given** service listings are disabled for the store (IC-PLT-02 returns false), **when** a seller opens the listing wizard, **then** the service template is not offered (BR-CAT-027).

**Given** a service product is NotReturnable, **when** the shopper opens the return request page for the order, **then** the service line is not offered for return; a failed service follows the SVC-005 NotDelivered path.
basis: Proposed; FIT (ReturnRequestController uses isNotReturnable: false); see SVC-005 (REQ-MPC-FR-074)

criterion: **Given** a service covers districts D1 and D2, **when** a shopper whose delivery or service address is in D3 adds it to the cart, **then** the item is refused with message Cat.ServiceAreaNotCovered.
**Given** a service is ordered, **when** the order is placed, **then** completion confirmation follows SVC-005; CAT records no fulfilment state.

**Given** a service listing of the client, **when** a shopper opens it, **then** the service description, delivery method, coverage and price are shown; the price model of SVC-001 (price on request, payment plans) is shown only when SVC-001 (P2) is delivered, otherwise the native fixed product price applies.

**Given** a service listing has slots with capacity, **when** a shopper opens the listing, **then** the free slots of the coming period are shown by day with remaining places; full slots are not selectable.

**Given** the cart holds only services, so checkout skips the native shipping step, **when** the shopper reaches the CAT booking step, **then** the free slots of the listing defined by staff (product, start, end, capacity, optional outlet) are offered with no location or resource step; only when the Services pack features are installed (SVC-006 location capture and SVC-002 eligible resources through IC-SVC-01, P2 extension points) is the location step shown first and the slots limited to the eligible resources.
basis: D; FIT (CheckoutController skips shipping when ShoppingCartRequiresShippingAsync is false); Proposed (P1 path without SVC)

criterion: **Given** a shopper selects a slot and adds the service to the cart, **when** the hold is created, **then** a booking hold is stored for the cart item (SM-CAT-05 Held) and counts against capacity until the hold expires.

**Given** one place is left in a slot, **when** two shoppers try to hold it at the same moment, **then** both requests run under ILocker key 'cat-slot-{SlotId}'; one gets the hold, the other gets message Cat.SlotFull.

**Given** an order with a held slot is placed, **when** the order is placed, **then** the hold becomes Confirmed for the order item (ShoppingCartItemMovedToOrderItemEvent consumer links it; the hold already reserved the place).
**Given** a hold expires before the order is placed, **when** the shopper continues to checkout, **then** the item is refused with message Cat.SlotHoldExpired and the shopper chooses again.

**Given** an order with a Confirmed booking is cancelled, **when** OrderStatusChangedEvent reports Cancelled, **then** the consumer enqueues release; the release task frees the place (Released); a nightly task recounts capacity from bookings.

**Given** SVC-002 is installed (P2) and generates slots for a resource (IC-SVC-01 GenerateSlots through IC-CAT-07 WriteSlots), **when** a generated capacity is below the Confirmed bookings of a slot, **then** the capacity is not reduced and the slot is listed for staff; other slots are written.

**Given** slots for service S exist at outlets O1 and O2 (BookingSlot.StorePickupPointId, LOG-003 outlets), **when** EGV-003 asks for free slots of S, **then** the free slots of each outlet are returned with remaining places; outlets with no free slot return none.

**Given** a slot has a free place, **when** EGV-003 calls Book for a citizen and the slot (IC-CAT-07), **then** under ILocker key 'cat-slot-{SlotId}' a booking is created directly in state Confirmed with no cart item or order item, and its BookingId is returned for EGV to store on the application; a full slot is refused with message Cat.SlotFull.

**Given** a Confirmed booking and a slot T with a free place, **when** a caller of IC-CAT-07 Move (SVC-003 when the Services pack is installed; in P1 no feature calls it) moves the booking to T, **then** both slot locks are taken in ascending SlotId order; the booking moves to T and the old place is freed; if T is full the move is refused with message Cat.SlotFull and nothing changes.

**Given** a Confirmed booking, **when** a caller of IC-CAT-07 RecordOutcome (SVC-003 when installed) records outcome CancelledByCustomer or CancelledByProvider, **then** the booking becomes Released and its place is freed; the SVC outcome is stored on the booking (SVC extension columns).

**Given** a Confirmed booking, **when** a caller of IC-CAT-07 RecordOutcome (SVC-003 when installed) records outcome Attended, NoShowCustomer or NoShowProvider, **then** the booking becomes Completed and its place is not freed.
**Given** a booking is not Confirmed, **when** a caller (SVC-003 when installed) calls Move or RecordOutcome, **then** the call is refused with error Transition not allowed and nothing changes.

**Given** a user with Misc.Catalogue.Bookings.CreateEditDelete opens a service listing with no Services pack installed, **when** they add slots (start, end, capacity, optional outlet) and save, **then** the slots are written through IC-CAT-07 WriteSlots under the slot locks and are offered on the listing; a slot whose end is not after its start, or whose capacity is below its Confirmed bookings, is refused and nothing is saved.

**Given** geo-location is enabled, **when** staff save latitude and longitude on a listing, **then** values outside -90..90 or -180..180 are refused with message Cat.CoordinatesInvalid; valid values are stored.
**Given** a polygon is drawn for a listing, **when** it is saved, **then** it is stored as a closed polygon; an unclosed or self-crossing shape is refused with message Cat.CoordinatesInvalid.
**Given** a listing has a location and a map provider is configured, **when** a shopper opens the page, **then** a map shows the point or shape.

**Given** catalogsettings.productreviewpossibleonlyafterpurchasing is on, **when** a customer without a completed order for the product tries to review, **then** the review is refused with the native message Reviews.ProductReviewPossibleOnlyAfterPurchasing.
**Given** a customer with a completed order writes a review with title, text and rating, **when** it is submitted, **then** it is stored with the rating and text (comments) and shown after approval.
**Given** catalogsettings.onereviewperproductfromcustomer is on, **when** the customer tries a second review of the same product, **then** it is refused (native).
**Given** captchasettings.showonproductreviewpage and captchasettings.enabled are on, **when** a review is submitted without a valid captcha, **then** it is refused (native).
**Given** a review is published, **when** another customer marks it helpful or not helpful, **then** HelpfulYesTotal or HelpfulNoTotal increases (native).

**Given** catalogsettings.productreviewsmustbeapproved is on, **when** a review is submitted, **then** it is not shown until a user with Catalog.ProductReviewsCreateEditDelete approves it; approval raises ProductReviewApprovedEvent.
**Given** staff write a reply, **when** it is saved, **then** the reply is shown under the review and, if catalogsettings.notifycustomeraboutproductreviewreply is on, the reviewer is notified.

**Given** a seller sets NotReturnable on a product, **when** a shopper opens the return request page for an order holding it, **then** the item is not offered for return (native ReturnRequestController uses isNotReturnable: false).
**Given** a product is not returnable, **when** a shopper opens its page, **then** the label Cat.NotReturnable is shown near the price.
**Given** the platform returns policy marks a category as not returnable (setting), **when** a seller creates a product in it, **then** NotReturnable is pre-set and the seller cannot clear it.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-067 ("consistent with platform returns policy"); Proposed (mechanism)

criterion: **Given** vendorsettings.showvendoronproductdetailspage is on, **when** a shopper opens a seller's product, **then** the price and the seller name with a link to the seller page are shown.

**Given** shippingsettings.estimateshippingproductpageenabled is on, **when** a shopper enters or has a delivery location, **then** the available delivery options with their fees are listed (native estimate).

**Given** LOG-005 returns an estimated delivery window for the product and the shopper location, **when** a shopper opens the page, **then** the window is shown with label Cat.DeliveryPromise; without a location the native DeliveryDate of the product is shown.
**Given** pickup in store is active (shippingsettings.allowpickupinstore) and the product ships, **when** a shopper opens the page, **then** label Cat.PickupAvailable is shown.

**Given** the returns-policy topic and the dispute-process topic are published and their system names are set in the RET settings (RET-001, RET-007; per language through the native Topic), **when** a shopper opens a product page or an order details page, **then** CAT shows a summary of both topics with links to the full topics (widget zones productdetails_overview_bottom and orderdetails_page_bottom); RET does not render them on these pages.
**Given** a topic system name is not set in the RET settings or the topic is not published, **when** a shopper opens a product page, **then** that summary is not shown and no broken link is rendered.
**Given** the product is not returnable, **when** the summary is shown, **then** it states that this item cannot be returned (Cat.NotReturnable).

**Given** SEC-004 records changes with old and new values, **when** a user with Misc.Catalogue.Audit.View opens a listing's audit tab, **then** all changes, state changes and approval decisions for that product are listed with time, user, IP address, field, old and new value.

**Given** a staff user opens the product edit page in admin, **when** the page is served, **then** a view entry with user, time and IP address is written (CAT action filter on Admin ProductController.Edit GET) (AUD-CAT-011).
**Given** a user lacks Misc.Catalogue.Audit.View, **when** they open the audit tab, **then** access is denied.

**Given** placement types (home page, category featured, search boost, banner) with fees per period are configured, **when** a seller requests a placement for a published product and dates, **then** a request is stored as Requested with the fee for the period (SM-CAT-06).

**Given** a request is Requested, **when** marketing staff approve it, **then** it becomes Approved; on the start date the task sets the native flag (ShowOnHomepage or ProductCategory.IsFeaturedProduct) and it becomes Active; on the end date the flag is cleared and it becomes Ended.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-070; FIT (vendors cannot set ShowOnHomepage natively: ProductController Create/Edit)

criterion: **Given** a placement type has a maximum number of slots, **when** approving a request would exceed it for any day of the period, **then** approval is refused with message Cat.PlacementFull (check under ILocker key 'cat-placement-{PlacementTypeId}').
**Given** an Active placement's product leaves state Published, **when** the change is saved, **then** the placement becomes Suspended and the native flag is cleared.
**Given** a placement is approved, **when** the fee is due, **then** the fee is recorded as a charge to the seller for SEL settlement.

**Given** a user holds Misc.Catalogue.Analytics.View, **when** they open catalogue analytics for a period, **then** they see counts of listings by state and category, the out-of-stock rate (published listings with stock 0 over published listings), and rejection counts by reason from CAT-043.

**Given** product pages are viewed, **when** the ProductDetailsModel is prepared (ModelPreparedEvent<BaseNopModel>), **then** a CAT consumer adds one view to the daily counter of the product; cart and wishlist additions are counted from EntityInsertedEvent<ShoppingCartItem>.
basis: D; FIT (ModelPreparedEvent; Misc.RFQ uses the same event)

criterion: **Given** counters and orders exist for a period, **when** the report runs, **then** views, cart additions, wishlist additions, orders and conversion (orders over views) are shown per product and per category.

**Given** Widgets.GoogleAnalytics is configured, **when** the report shows filter use and bounce rate, **then** these values are read from the web analytics feed of SRC-021; without it the columns show "not available".

**Given** a category page or a search results page is shown with products (ModelPreparedEvent<BaseNopModel> with CategoryModel, SearchModel or CatalogProductsModel), **when** the model is prepared, **then** a CAT consumer adds one list impression per listed product to the daily list counter of that product and source (Category with CategoryId, or Search).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-091; FIT (PublishModelEventsAttribute publishes ViewData.Model for CatalogController.Category, GetCategoryProducts, Search, SearchProducts)

criterion: **Given** a product page request carries a Referer of a category page or the search page of the same store, **when** the ProductDetailsModel is prepared, **then** one list click is added for that product and source; requests without such a Referer count as views only.

**Given** list impressions, list clicks, views, cart additions and orders exist for a period, **when** a user with Misc.Catalogue.Analytics.View runs the report by category or by search, **then** click-through (list clicks over list impressions) and conversion (orders over views) are shown per category and for search results.

**Given** a feed target with format, product filter and schedule is configured, **when** the feed task runs, **then** a feed file with published, in-stock-or-backorderable products matching the filter is generated through the target adapter and published to the target location (IC-CAT-02).
**Given** a product in the feed is withdrawn or paused, **when** the next run happens, **then** it is removed from the feed.
**Given** a run fails, **when** the adapter reports an error, **then** the run is marked Failed with the error and staff are notified.
**Given** bulk teas and packaged teas are in separate top-level categories, **when** a shopper browses, **then** the two ranges are listed separately in navigation and category pages.

**Given** the bulk category and its products are limited to a trader role (name configured per client) (ACL) and catalogsettings.ignoreacl is false, **when** a customer without that role browses or searches, **then** bulk products and the bulk category are not shown.
**Given** a separate storefront exists for a business model (store mapping), **when** a product is mapped only to that store, **then** it is shown only in that store.
basis: Inference from REQ-KTDA-PRJ-002 (retail and bulk business models); FIT (StoreMapping)

criterion: **Given** OrderMinimumQuantity and OrderMaximumQuantity are set, **when** a shopper enters a quantity outside them, **then** the native warnings ShoppingCart.MinimumQuantity / ShoppingCart.MaximumQuantity are shown (unless BR-CAT-023 approval applies).

**Given** a multiple of 12 is set, **when** a shopper enters 30, **then** the item is refused with message Cat.QuantityNotMultiple; 24 or 36 are accepted (CAT cart rule provider IC-CHK-01 of the CHK-003 IShoppingCartService host, BR-CAT-032).

**Given** over-maximum approval is on for the product, **when** a buyer enters a quantity above the maximum, **then** message Cat.QuantityAboveMaximum offers "send for approval"; choosing it calls IC-ADM-03 Submit (object type OverMaxRequest) and the line is not added to the cart until approved.

**Given** the approval is granted, **when** ADM-006 calls the CAT OnApproved callback (IC-ADM-03) and the buyer adds the line, **then** the OverMaxRequest becomes Approved and the line can be added once with the approved quantity; the native ShoppingCart.MaximumQuantity warning is dropped for that line by the CAT replacer registered with the CHK-003 host (BR-CAT-023).

**Given** a seller starts a new listing in the wizard, **when** they choose a category, **then** the following steps (identification, attributes, pricing, media, compliance, tax) show the fields of the category schema (CAT-005), required ones marked.
**Given** a step has a missing required field, **when** the seller presses next, **then** the step is not left and message Cat.MandatoryFieldMissing names the field.
**Given** the seller leaves the wizard part way, **when** they come back, **then** the listing is a Draft product with the entered values and the wizard resumes at the first incomplete step.
**Given** the last step is complete, **when** the seller presses submit, **then** the listing is submitted for review (CAT-022) with the same checks as the product form.

**Given** price list L for company K (IAM-022) holds product P at a price with validity dates and is active, **when** a buyer of company K views or buys P within the dates, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500, PRICE-500): now native — nopCommerce 5.00.1 applies customer and customer-role price lists inside PriceCalculationService.GetFinalPriceAsync (GetPriceListPriceAsync, PriceCalculationService.cs:77-140, 454-456), verified by AC-CAT-039-01-07; company binding is AC-CAT-039-01-11. Superseded text: the list price replaces the standard price and tier prices (precedence per BR-CAT-020), on the product page and in the cart.

**Given** a buyer belongs to company K and to role R with a tier price, **when** both apply, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500, PRICE-500): now native — natively a tier price that applies replaces the price-list price and there is no precedence setting (PriceCalculationService.cs:454-462); the configuration rule BR-CAT-034 and AC-CAT-039-01-09 replace this criterion. Superseded text: the price-list price wins unless the precedence setting says lowest price wins (B2B pack setting, default not stated).

**Given** catalogsettings.cacheproductprices is on, **when** two customers with the same roles but different companies view P, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500, PRICE-500): now native — the price-list price is computed natively inside the cached block, whose key holds roles but not the customer (NopCatalogDefaults.ProductPriceCacheKey; PriceCalculationService.cs:426-438); the configuration rule BR-CAT-034 and AC-CAT-039-01-10 replace the custom out-of-cache application. Superseded text: each sees the price of their own company: the price-list price is applied outside the native cached block, whose key holds roles but not the customer (BR-CAT-020).

**Given** a price list is changed, **when** it is saved, **then** the change is audited (AUD-CAT-009): the native admin writes the activity-log entries AddNewPriceList, EditPriceList and DeletePriceList, and the SEC-004 repository decorator records old and new values of PriceList, PriceListItem, PriceListCustomer and PriceListCustomerRole rows; CAT writes no audit call of its own.

**Given** a quote item from Misc.RFQ is in the cart, **when** the cart price is computed, **then** the quoted price wins over the price list (GetShoppingCartItemUnitPriceEvent stops processing before GetFinalPriceAsync is called).

**Given** the price-list provider is registered with the CAT-042 IPriceCalculationService host (IC-CAT-05), **when** GetFinalPriceAsync runs for a buyer of company K, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500, PRICE-500): now native — the native base method applies price lists, so CAT-039 registers no IC-CAT-05 provider and the CAT-042 host never applies a price list a second time (BR-CAT-020). Superseded text: the host computes the native result first and then asks the price providers in precedence order; the first provider that returns a price sets it (BR-CAT-020).

**Given** a user holding Catalog.PriceListsCreateEditDelete creates price list L in Catalog > Price lists (name, active, start and end date, calculation type PercentageDecrease, PercentageIncrease, AmountDecrease, AmountIncrease or FixedPrice with its value, priority), adds product P (optionally with a manual price) and assigns customer C or customer role R, **when** C, or a member of R, views or buys P while L is active and within its dates, **then** the price-list price (the manual price of P, else the product price adjusted by the calculation type and value) replaces the product price on the product page, in the cart and in the order; outside the dates, or with L inactive, the product price applies.
basis: D; Inference from REQ-KTDA-PRJ-002 (contract prices); FIT (Libraries/Nop.Core/Domain/PriceLists/PriceList.cs, PriceListItem.cs, PriceListCustomer.cs, PriceListCustomerRole.cs; Libraries/Nop.Services/PriceLists/PriceListService.cs:325-341; PriceCalculationService.cs:77-140; Presentation/Nop.Web/Areas/Admin/Controllers/PriceListController.cs:97-430; StandardPermission.cs:76-78); VER-500; PRICE-500

criterion: **Given** more than one active price list of the buyer contains P, **when** the price is computed, **then** with CatalogSettings.PriceListStrategy MinimalPrice (installation default) the lowest of the list prices applies; with UseByPriority the list with the lowest Priority number applies; the strategy is a client setting (BR-CAT-034).

**Given** product P is in a price list of buyer B and a tier price of P also applies to B (role, store and quantity), **when** the price is computed, **then** the tier price is charged (native: the tier price replaces the price-list price); configuration rule BR-CAT-034: a product in a contract price list carries no tier price for the same buyers, and the CAT pricing-conflicts list in Catalog > Price lists shows every product where both apply so that sales staff remove the tier price or accept it.

**Given** any price list is assigned to individual customers (PriceListCustomer), **when** the client configuration is applied or validated (PLT-003), **then** catalogsettings.cacheproductprices must be off (installation default off); a pack that switches it on while customer-level price lists exist fails validation, because the cached price is keyed by customer roles and store, not by customer, and one customer's contract price would be shown to another customer with the same roles (BR-CAT-034); role-level price lists are safe with the cache on.
basis: FIT (NopCatalogDefaults.ProductPriceCacheKey; PriceCalculationService.cs:426-456; InstallRequiredData.cs:1523); PRICE-500; Proposed (pack validation); see PLT-003

criterion: **Given** company K exists in IAM-022, **when** sales staff give K a contract price list, **then** the list is assigned to the system customer role of company K (the CompanyAssortment-{CompanyId} role created by CAT-040, BR-IAM-050) so that every member of K gets it and loses it with membership; until CAT-040 is delivered the list is assigned to each member customer (and BR-CAT-034 cache rule applies).

**Given** a user holds Catalog.PriceListsImportExport, **when** they export price lists to Excel or import a price-list workbook, **then** the native export and import run; an import that names a product that does not exist stops with the native message Admin.PriceLists.Import.ProductsDontExist and imports nothing from that file.

**Given** a client runs several stores (PLT-013) or several currencies (PLT-010), **when** a price list applies to a buyer, **then** it applies in every store of the instance (PriceList has no store field) and its price is a primary-store-currency amount converted at display; a store-only or fixed foreign-currency contract price needs a store-specific role or the CAT-042 fixed currency price.
basis: FIT (Libraries/Nop.Core/Domain/PriceLists/PriceList.cs: no StoreId or CurrencyId); PRICE-500

criterion: **Given** an assortment for company K lists products P1 and P2 (allow-list), **when** a buyer of K browses, **then** P1 and P2 are shown; products limited to other companies are not.

**Given** the assortment is saved, **when** the CAT plugin applies it, **then** a system customer role per company (created by CAT, linked to IAM-022; system name pattern Proposed: CompanyAssortment-{CompanyId}, as BR-IAM-050 leaves the pattern to CAT) is added to the ACL of the listed products (SubjectToAcl true); the native ACL then filters catalogue, search and product pages.
**Given** a product is in no company assortment, **when** any buyer browses, **then** its visibility follows the normal ACL rules.

**Given** CAT-040 is registered as a membership provider with IAM (IC-IAM-07 OnMembershipChanged) and company K has an assortment role, **when** a customer is added to or removed from company K in IAM-022, **then** inside the same save CAT adds or removes the customer's mapping to the assortment role of K through ICustomerService; if CAT fails, IAM does not save the membership change.

**Given** UOM-01 is decided "integer base units", product P has base unit 100 g and a price per base unit, and pack sizes 1 kg and chest are defined with their base-unit counts, **when** a buyer selects the chest pack, **then** quantity is held as an integer number of packs, the price is pack base-unit count times the price per base unit, and the base price per kg is shown (Product.BasepriceEnabled, BasepriceUnitId) — held by UOM-01.

**Given** UOM-01 is decided "fractional quantities", **when** a buyer enters 2.5 kg, **then** the quantity is accepted and stored as a decimal through cart, order, shipment and stock — held by UOM-01; this needs the core modification registered in L1 §6.3.
**Given** a unit of measure is defined, **when** it is saved, **then** it has a code, a name, a base unit and a conversion factor; a factor of zero or below is refused.

**Given** product P has a fixed price F in currency C and the shopper works in C, **when** the product page, cart and order total are shown, **then** the shopper sees and is charged exactly F per unit (IPriceCalculationService, Nop.Web IProductModelFactory / IShoppingCartModelFactory and IOrderTotalCalculationService overrides) (BR-CAT-025).
basis: D; Inference from REQ-KTDA-LOC-002 (fixed prices in non-base currencies); FIT (Product.Price single; Currency.Rate)

criterion: **Given** an order in currency C with fixed prices is placed, **when** the order is saved, **then** line amounts are stored in the primary store currency as F divided by Order.CurrencyRate, so that the native conversion on display gives back F; the order also records that fixed prices were used.
basis: D; FIT (OrderProcessingService sets CurrencyRate = customer rate / primary rate)

criterion: **Given** P has no fixed price in currency C, **when** the shopper works in C, **then** the native converted price is shown.

**Given** catalogsettings.cacheproductprices is on, **when** shoppers in two currencies view P, **then** each sees the price of their currency: the fixed price is applied outside the native cached block, whose key does not hold the currency (BR-CAT-020).
**Given** a fixed price is changed, **when** it is saved, **then** the change is audited (AUD-CAT-014).

**Given** order-total adjustment providers are registered with the CAT IOrderTotalCalculationService host (IC-CAT-06 Adjust): PAY-009 of kind Deduction (only under WAL-01 option (b)) and, if confirmed, FIN-003 of kind Charge, **when** GetShoppingCartTotalAsync runs for a cart with total T after native discounts, gift cards and reward points, **then** the host calls each provider in its declared order with the running total; a Deduction (zero to the running total) is subtracted and a Charge (zero or more) is added; the result is never below zero; each applied adjustment is kept with provider, kind, amount, label and reference for the current request (BR-CAT-033).
basis: OVR-REG; WAL-01; FIT (OrderTotalCalculationService.GetShoppingCartTotalAsync is public virtual and applies gift cards and reward points last, OrderTotalCalculationService.cs:1327-1416)

criterion: **Given** a provider returns a Deduction above the running total or a negative amount, **when** the total is computed, **then** a Deduction is clamped to the running total, a negative amount is ignored, and the case is logged.
**Given** no provider is registered, or the provider's pack feature is off for the store (BR-CAT-027), **when** the total is computed, **then** the native result is returned unchanged.

**Given** an applied adjustment exists for the cart, **when** the cart or checkout order totals are shown, **then** each adjustment is shown as its own line with the provider label and amount (CAT override of Nop.Web IShoppingCartModelFactory.PrepareOrderTotalsModelAsync).
basis: Proposed; FIT (ShoppingCartModelFactory.PrepareOrderTotalsModelAsync is public virtual and calls GetShoppingCartTotalAsync)

criterion: **Given** the cart total included adjustments and the CHK-003 override places the order, **when** the IC-CHK-06 Reserve phase runs, **then** the CAT-042 placement participant calls IC-CAT-06 Reserve on each provider with exactly the amount used in the order total (from the same request); if a provider refuses (for example the PAY-009 wallet balance is now lower), the placement is refused with the provider message and earlier reservations are released (BR-CHK-020).

**Given** all reservations succeeded and the sub-order is saved, **when** the IC-CHK-06 Confirm phase runs for that sub-order, **then** CAT writes one OrderTotalAdjustment row per adjustment (order, provider, kind, amount, label, reference) and calls IC-CAT-06 Confirm on the provider with the order ID, so that PAY-009 debits the wallet and writes its ledger entry against the order; this happens before OrderPlacedEvent (BR-CAT-033).
basis: OVR-REG; see PAY-009; FIT (native records gift card use after the order is saved, OrderProcessingService.cs:1616-1627)

criterion: **Given** payment or a later step of placement fails after a provider reserved, **when** the IC-CHK-06 Release phase runs, **then** CAT calls IC-CAT-06 Release on each provider that reserved; no OrderTotalAdjustment row is written.

**Given** an order has confirmed adjustments, **when** staff edit an order item in admin and the native UpdateOrderTotalsAsync recalculates the order, **then** the CAT override of the protected UpdateTotalAsync re-applies the stored amounts after the native total is set (a Deduction capped at the new total); providers are not called again and no wallet or premium amount changes (BR-CAT-033).
basis: Proposed; FIT (OrderTotalCalculationService.UpdateTotalAsync is protected virtual and sets OrderTotal, OrderTotalCalculationService.cs:236-296; Admin OrderController.cs:1311, 1378, 1703)

criterion: **Given** an order has confirmed adjustments, **when** DOC, RPT or PAY asks for them (IC-CAT-06 GetOrderAdjustments), or a DOC template uses token %Order.TotalAdjustments% (registered by CAT through IC-DOC-02, name Proposed), **then** the stored rows are returned with provider, kind, amount, label and reference; the token renders one line per adjustment.

**Given** buyer B has a native price list (CAT-039) that contains product P within its dates and P also has a fixed price in currency C, **when** B works in C, **then** the price-list price applies, converted to C at the current rate; the CAT-042 fixed-price provider checks the customer's applicable price lists through IPriceListService with the same filter as the native method and does not replace a contract price (BR-CAT-020).

**Given** a seller listing is InReview in a queue the approver is assigned to, **when** the approver opens the queue, **then** the listing is shown with seller, category, submission time, quality-check result (CAT-005) and policy flags (CAT-021).

**Given** the approver approves, rejects or requests changes, **when** the decision is saved, **then** reject and request changes need a reason from the configured reason list or free text (message Cat.ReasonRequired if empty); the state follows SM-CAT-01 and SM-CAT-02; audited (AUD-CAT-002).

**Given** a decision is saved, **when** the seller opens the listing, **then** the decision, reason and decision time are shown and the seller is notified by message template Catalogue.ListingDecision.VendorNotification.
**Given** a rule sends listings of seller tier T to queue Q, **when** a seller of tier T submits, **then** the listing is in queue Q (BR-CAT-007).
**Given** listings submitted by staff (no vendor), **when** are submitted, **then** they follow the staff queue rules of CAT-022, not the seller queue.

**Given** a product is published, in stock and ShoppingCartSettings.AllowCartItemEditing is on, **when** the shopper adds it, changes its quantity or removes it, **then** the cart shows the change and the totals are recalculated from server-side prices; quantity limits (minimum, maximum, allowed quantities) give the native cart warnings.
**Given** ShoppingCartSettings.MiniShoppingCartEnabled is on, **when** an item is added, **then** the mini cart shows the number of items and the subtotal.

**Given** a registered shopper has items in the cart, **when** the shopper signs out and later signs in on another device, **then** the same items and quantities are in the cart (ShoppingCartItem is stored per customer).
**Given** a guest has items in the cart, **when** the guest signs in or registers, **then** the guest cart is merged into the account cart (native MigrateShoppingCartAsync).

**Given** save for later is enabled for the client (requires ShoppingCartSettings.AllowMultipleWishlist), **when** the shopper selects Save for later on a cart line, **then** the line leaves the cart and appears in the shopper's saved-for-later list (a native CustomWishlist named by locale key Chk.SavedForLater); the cart totals are recalculated.

**Given** an item is in the saved-for-later list, **when** the shopper selects Move to cart, **then** the item is added through AddToCartAsync with stock and price checks; if a warning is returned the item stays in the list and the warning is shown.

**Given** OrderSettings.OnePageCheckoutEnabled is set for the store, **when** the shopper starts checkout, **then** the steps billing address, shipping address (if any item is shippable), shipping method, payment method, payment information and confirm are shown in that order, on separate pages or on one page; DisableBillingAddressCheckoutStep is honoured.

**Given** OrderSettings.AnonymousCheckoutAllowed is on (KTDA configuration), **when** a guest starts checkout, **then** the guest completes checkout without creating an account, giving an email address on the billing address step.

**Given** OrderSettings.AnonymousCheckoutAllowed is off (Malawi Post configuration), **when** a guest who has browsed and filled a cart selects Checkout, **then** the sign-in / registration page is shown; no address, shipping or payment step is reachable; after sign-in or registration the cart is kept and checkout continues.

**Given** OrderSettings.AnonymousCheckoutAllowed is off, **when** a guest posts directly to any checkout action, including ConfirmOrder, **then** the request is challenged; no order is created and no payment is executed.

**Given** the shopper is on the confirm step, **when** the page is shown, **then** it lists every item with quantity and unit price, the subtotal, discounts, tax, payment fee, delivery or pickup fee and the order total, before payment is executed; the returns-policy acknowledgement is shown by CHK-009.

**Given** checkout is used, **when** any checkout page is requested or posted, **then** the request is served over HTTPS and every checkout POST must carry a valid antiforgery token, otherwise it is rejected.

**Given** a client sends a changed price or total with the confirm request, **when** the order is placed, **then** line prices and the order total are recalculated on the server from the cart and catalogue and the sent value is ignored (PrepareAndValidateTotalsAsync sets ProcessPaymentRequest.OrderTotal) (BR-CHK-003).

**Given** OrderSettings.TermsOfServiceOnOrderConfirmPage or TermsOfServiceOnShoppingCartPage is on, **when** the shopper confirms without ticking the terms box, **then** the order is not placed and message Chk.TermsRequired is shown; the check is made on the server by the CHK-009 action filter, because the native check is in the browser only; when the box is ticked and the order is placed, the acceptance of the terms topic is recorded through IAM IC-IAM-05 RecordAcceptance (channel checkout) and linked to the order (BR-CHK-014).
basis: D; FIT (Confirm.cshtml client-side check; ConfirmOrder has no server check); ONE-RECORD (Proposed)

criterion: **Given** a registered shopper has a default delivery address set in IAM-014 (CustomerPreference.DefaultAddressId) that is still in the address book and allowed for the store's countries, **when** the shopper reaches the billing and shipping address steps, **then** that address is pre-selected on both steps (the native page pre-selects only Customer.BillingAddressId); the shopper can still choose another address.
basis: see IAM-014 (REQ-MPC-FR-005); FIT (CheckoutModelFactory pre-selects BillingAddressId); Proposed

criterion: **Given** the shopper is on any step of the multi-page checkout, **when** the step is shown and the shopper submits it with a required field empty or invalid, **then** the checkout progress indicator shows the current step and the steps still to come (native CheckoutProgress component); the step is shown again with the values already entered kept and a message next to each failed field (server-side ModelState validation, asp-validation-for); no step already completed has to be entered again.
basis: Inference from REQ-KTDA-CHK-003 (easy-to-use checkout: the requirement states no measure; these observable behaviours are Proposed); FIT (CheckoutProgressViewComponent; CheckoutController ModelState checks; _CreateOrUpdateAddress.cshtml)

criterion: **Given** the stock of an item is below the cart quantity at placement, **when** the shopper confirms the order, **then** the order is not placed, the native stock warning is shown and no payment is initiated (cart warnings run before GetProcessPaymentResultAsync).

**Given** the price of an item changed after the confirm page was shown, **when** the shopper confirms the order, **then** the order is not placed, the confirm page is shown again with the new total and message Chk.PriceChanged; the shopper can confirm again at the new total (BR-CHK-004).

**Given** an item was unpublished, deleted, removed from the store or is no longer allowed by ACL for the customer, **when** the shopper confirms the order, **then** the order is not placed and the native cart warning is shown.

**Given** the selected payment method is inactive or no longer allowed by the PAY routing rules (BR-PAY-001), **when** the shopper confirms the order, **then** the order is not placed and the shopper is returned to the payment method step: an inactive method gives message Chk.PaymentMethodInvalid; a method no longer allowed is refused by the PAY routing validator (IC-PAY-03, consumed as IC-CHK-02) with message Pay.MethodNotAllowed; native placement checks only that the method is active.
basis: D; FC-M03-004; FIT (GetProcessPaymentResultAsync checks IsPluginActive only)

criterion: **Given** a PAY-018 risk rule with action Block matches the placement, **when** the shopper confirms the order, **then** the order is not placed and message Pay.CheckoutRestricted is shown; with action Flag the order is placed and the flag is recorded (and an ORD-010 hold is created if the rule says so).

**Given** several checks fail at once, **when** the order is validated, **then** checks run in the order stock and availability, price, buyer eligibility (ACL, restrictions, CHK-011 rules, CHK-018 approval), payment method, fraud signals; the first failure stops placement and its message key is shown.

**Given** cart check providers are registered through IC-CHK-01 (CAT quantity, call-for-price, over-maximum, slot-hold and service-area checks; INV-004 holds; ADM-005 eligibility and quota; SVC rental availability; EGV-001 workflow check; CHK-011 cart rules; ORD-027 sample limits), **when** GetShoppingCartItemWarningsAsync or GetShoppingCartWarningsAsync runs (add to cart, cart page, checkout steps, and the re-validation inside PlaceOrderAsync), **then** the single CHK-003 override runs the native checks first and then every provider in its registered order, and returns all warnings; the item or cart is refused if any warning remains.
basis: OVR-REG; FIT (ShoppingCartService.GetShoppingCartItemWarningsAsync, GetShoppingCartWarningsAsync are public virtual; PreparePlaceOrderDetailsAsync re-runs them); Proposed

criterion: **Given** a provider is registered as the replacer of a named native warning (CAT: Products.CallForPrice for a cart line created from an accepted Misc.RFQ quote, and ShoppingCart.MaximumQuantity for a line with an approved over-maximum request; INV-004: ShoppingCart.OutOfStock and ShoppingCart.QuantityExceedsStock recalculated with other customers' holds), **when** the standard warnings are produced, **then** the CHK-003 override of the protected GetStandardWarningsAsync produces the native warnings with their resource keys, so the registered replacer can drop or replace exactly that warning by key; every other provider can only add warnings; no warning is matched on its text (BR-CHK-015).
basis: OVR-REG; FIT (GetStandardWarningsAsync is protected virtual and returns plain strings; Products.CallForPrice 378-381, ShoppingCart.MaximumQuantity 406-408, stock 427-497 in 5.00.1); Proposed

criterion: **Given** a provider throws an error while it checks an item, **when** the warnings are collected, **then** the item is refused with message Chk.CartCheckUnavailable and the error is logged; the check fails closed so no unchecked item can be ordered.

**Given** MKT-002 is registered as the line subtotal adjuster (IC-CHK-05), **when** GetSubTotalAsync runs for a cart line (cart page, order totals, order placement), **then** the override calls the native method and then the adjuster, and the same adjusted subtotal and discount amount are used on all three paths; at most one adjuster is registered for the product (BR-CHK-015).
basis: OVR-REG; FIT (OrderTotalCalculationService and OrderProcessingService call IShoppingCartService.GetSubTotalAsync)

criterion: **Given** the shipping address changed after the delivery step, or a seller's coverage (LOG-004) no longer includes it, **when** the shopper confirms the order, **then** the LOG-004 placement validator (IC-CHK-02) refuses the order with message Log.SellerAreaNotCovered and no payment is initiated.

**Given** placement participants are registered through IC-CHK-06 (ADM-005 quota under ILocker key 'adm-quota-{quotaId}'; MKT-001 limited-use discounts under 'mkt-discount-{DiscountId}' (IC-MKT-04); CHK-006 delivery window; CHK-016 credit; CAT-042 order-total adjustments, which reserves through its IC-CAT-06 providers (PAY-009 wallet under WAL-01 option (b)); FIN-004 subsidy budget under 'fin-scheme-{SchemeId}'), **when** the shopper confirms, **then** after the IC-CHK-02 validators and before payment, each participant reserves what it needs under its own lock key; if any reservation fails, the earlier reservations are released, the order is not placed and the participant's message is shown (BR-CHK-020).

**Given** participants hold reservations and payment succeeds, **when** each sub-order is saved, **then** each participant confirms its reservation for that sub-order before OrderPlacedEvent is published (ADM-005 records quota use; MKT-001 ends its reservation, because native placement already writes the DiscountUsageHistory row; CAT-042 writes its OrderTotalAdjustment rows and calls its providers' Confirm; FIN-004 consumes the subsidy; PAY-011 links the sub-order to the group transaction; ORD-005 creates the SellerTask in state New); if payment fails, every reservation is released.

**Given** an order-action guard is registered through IC-CHK-07 (ORD-010 hold) and a hold is Active on the order, **when** anyone calls ShipAsync, ReadyForPickupAsync or DeliverAsync for a shipment of that order (admin, seller endpoint, TRK-002 tracking, LOG-012 handover, API), **then** the CHK-003 override calls the guards before the native method; the refusal raises an error carrying the guard message (Ord.OrderOnHold), the native method is not run and the admin page shows the message through its error notification.
basis: OVR-REG; FIT (IOrderProcessingService.ShipAsync / ReadyForPickupAsync / DeliverAsync; Admin OrderController.SetAsShipped catches the exception and calls ErrorNotificationAsync)

criterion: **Given** cancellation participants are registered through IC-CHK-08 (CHK-006 window release, CHK-012 code revocation), **when** an order is cancelled through CancelOrderAsync by any path (ORD-004, INV-004 timeout, admin), **then** the native method runs first; then each participant runs; a participant error is logged and listed in the checkout exceptions list, and the cancellation stands.

**Given** no order splitter is registered (the Marketplace pack is off, or CHK-004 is not installed), **when** the shopper confirms a cart, **then** the CHK-003 placement host places exactly one order with the native sequence of BR-CHK-006 (lock and interval check, validators, Reserve, one payment, save, Confirm, OrderPlacedEvent); no behaviour of the host depends on an optional pack.

**Given** the Marketplace pack is on and the cart holds items from N sellers (Product.VendorId; VendorId 0 = the client's own items, counted as one seller), **when** the order is placed, **then** the CHK-004 order splitter (IC-CHK-11) returns one group per seller and the CHK-003 placement host creates N native orders, one per seller, each with its own OrderGuid and custom order number, all linked to one CheckoutSession (CHK-008); the confirmation page shows the checkout reference and every sub-order.

**Given** N sub-orders are being placed, **when** payment is processed, **then** one payment is initiated once, before any sub-order is saved (BR-CHK-006), for the checkout total with the CheckoutSession reference as merchant reference and the share of each seller (IC-CHK-04 = IC-PAY-02); the one payment result is applied by native placement to every sub-order saved; after each sub-order is saved the PAY placement participant Confirm (IC-CHK-06) links it to the group transaction; on failure all sub-orders stay with PaymentStatus Pending and retry applies to the whole checkout (BR-PAY-014).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-110; Proposed; see PAY-011 (group payment, BR-PAY-014 Proposed)

criterion: **Given** order-level amounts exist (delivery fee, payment fee, order discount, checkout-attribute fee, reward points, gift cards), **when** sub-orders are created, **then** each amount is allocated to sub-orders by BR-CHK-007, and the sub-order totals add up exactly to the total shown on the confirm page.

**Given** OrderSettings.PlaceOrderWithLock is on, **when** the split placement runs, **then** the native per-customer mutex is taken once for the whole checkout and the MinimumOrderPlacementInterval cache key is set once after all sub-orders are saved, so the second sub-order is not refused by the interval check.

**Given** payment succeeded and saving a later sub-order fails, **when** the error occurs, **then** sub-orders already saved are kept, the CheckoutSession becomes PlacementException, an exception appears for Checkout.Core.Exceptions.View holders and is audited (AUD-CHK-007), and the shopper sees message Chk.SplitPlacementFailed with the checkout reference; any refund decided by staff for the share of a sub-order that was not saved is raised through RET-005 (IC-RET-04, source type PlacementFailure, with the CheckoutSession reference, the payment transaction and the share), never directly to PAY.

**Given** a vendor user signs in to the admin area, **when** the vendor opens the order list, **then** only sub-orders that contain the vendor's products are listed (native HasAccessToOrderAsync), and each has a seller task list in state New (ORD-005, created by the split).
**Given** a sub-order is created for a seller, **when** placement completes, **then** the native OrderPlaced.VendorNotification is sent to that seller for that sub-order only.
**Given** the cart holds items from one seller only, **when** the order is placed, **then** one order is created and linked to the CheckoutSession; no allocation is needed.

**Given** an allocation leaves a rounding remainder, **when** sub-order amounts are calculated, **then** the remainder in the currency's minor unit goes to the sub-order with the largest subtotal, so the parts sum exactly (BR-CHK-007).

**Given** the Marketplace pack is on, the cart holds items from more than one seller and no active payment method of the store declares group support (IC-CHK-04, provided by PAY as IC-PAY-02), **when** the shopper opens the cart or checkout, **then** the CHK-003 cart override returns message Chk.MultiSellerNotSupported, checkout cannot be confirmed, and the shopper can remove items until one seller remains; when some methods declare group support, only those are offered for that checkout (BR-CHK-022).

**Given** the Marketplace pack is on (decision CART-500), **when** a configuration pack is applied to a store or a store is set up, **then** ShoppingCartSettings.VendorEnabled and ShoppingCartSettings.VendorRequired are off for every store: both keys are in the CHK key catalogue with the fixed value off, so pack validation refuses another value; with them on, the native warning ShoppingCart.SelectVendorToCheckout would block a mixed-seller cart before the CHK-004 splitter runs and the items of other sellers would be moved to the Stash cart type (BR-CHK-023).
basis: CART-500; FIT (ShoppingCartSettings.cs:131,136; ShoppingCartService.cs:1221-1227, 1980-2009; install default off, InstallRequiredData.cs:1856-1857)

criterion: **Given** VendorEnabled is off, **when** a shopper with items of several sellers opens the cart and goes to checkout, **then** no vendor selector is shown, no item is moved to the Stash cart type and the one cart reaches the CHK-004 split placement (or, while BR-CHK-022 applies, the Chk.MultiSellerNotSupported warning).
basis: CART-500; FIT (ShoppingCartModelFactory.cs:997-1001 and ShoppingCartService.cs:604, 1617 act only with VendorEnabled)

criterion: **Given** ShippingSettings.AllowPickupInStore is on, outlets exist (LOG-003) and an item can be picked up, **when** the shopper is on the shipping step, **then** each cart line offers Delivery or Pickup at a selected outlet; the choice is stored per line (CartLineFulfilment).

**Given** lines have different fulfilment choices, **when** the shipping step and totals are calculated, **then** delivery options and fees are calculated for the delivery lines and pickup fees for each outlet group; the confirm page shows each group separately.

**Given** the order is placed, **when** sub-orders are created, **then** lines are grouped by seller and fulfilment choice and each group becomes its own sub-order (CHK-004), so native Order.PickupInStore and PickupAddressId remain per order.

**Given** an outlet does not serve an item or is closed on the expected collection date (LOG-003, LOG-004), **when** the shopper chooses pickup for that line, **then** the outlet is not offered for that line ("where available").
**Given** an item is pickup-only (CHK-011), **when** the shopper chooses fulfilment for its line, **then** Delivery is not offered for that line.

**Given** the shopper has a preferred pickup point in IAM-015 (CustomerPreference.PreferredPickupPointId) that is open and serves the line, **when** the shopper chooses Pickup for a line, **then** that outlet is pre-selected (the native page pre-selects only the last selected pickup point attribute); if it does not serve the line, no outlet is pre-selected.

**Given** the administrator defines windows (day, start, end, capacity) for a delivery service and area, **when** the definition is saved, **then** the windows become available for that service and area; the change is audited (AUD-CHK-001).

**Given** windows exist for the chosen delivery service and the shipping address area, **when** the shopper is on the shipping method step, **then** the windows with remaining capacity are listed and the shopper selects one; the selection is reserved at placement (SM-CHK-02).
**Given** no windows are defined for the chosen service, **when** the shopper is on the shipping method step, **then** no window selection is shown and checkout continues ("where supported").

**Given** the last place in a window is taken by another order first, **when** the shopper confirms, **then** the order is not placed, message Chk.SlotFull is shown and the shopper chooses another window (capacity is reserved under lock by the CHK-006 placement participant, IC-CHK-06, BR-CHK-010).

**Given** a checkout attribute "Delivery instructions" (text box) is configured, **when** the shopper enters instructions, **then** the text is stored on the order (Order.CheckoutAttributeDescription) and shown on the order details used by staff, seller and courier.
**Given** an order with a reserved window is cancelled, **when** the cancellation completes, **then** the window place is released by the CHK-006 cancellation participant (IC-CHK-08).

**Given** ShippingSettings.AllowCustomerToChooseDeliveryDate is on (install and 5.00 upgrade default on) and the chosen shipping option has TransitDays, **when** the shopper is on the shipping method step, **then** the native desired-date list offers DeliveryDateRangeDays dates starting at today plus the transit days; the chosen date is stored as Order.DesiredDeliveryDateUtc and shown on the order details and the admin order page.

**Given** windows exist for the chosen delivery service and area and the native date list is shown, **when** the shopper picks a date, **then** the CHK-006 window list shows only the windows of that date with remaining capacity, and the booking date (DeliverySlotBooking.Date) is the native desired date; CHK builds no date picker of its own.

**Given** a checkout is split into several sub-orders (CHK-004) and the shopper chose a date, **when** the sub-orders are saved, **then** the CHK-003 placement host reads the desired date once and sets it on every sub-order, because native SaveOrderDetailsAsync copies it only to the first order saved and then clears the customer attribute (BR-CHK-006).

**Given** the client offers no choice of delivery date for a store, **when** the configuration pack is applied, **then** ShippingSettings.AllowCustomerToChooseDeliveryDate is set off explicitly, because its install default is on and any shipping option with TransitDays would otherwise show the date list.

**Given** address attributes Landmark (text) and Address name (text) are configured and marked required or optional per client, **when** the shopper saves an address, **then** the values are validated and stored in Address.CustomAttributes and appear on the order addresses.

**Given** map pin is enabled for the client, **when** the shopper places a pin on the map, **then** latitude and longitude are passed to LOG-015 and stored in its AddressGeo table keyed by AddressId with source "pin" (BR-LOG-140); CHK stores no coordinates of its own.

**Given** the client rule requires at least one locator (street address, landmark or pin), **when** the shopper saves an address with none of them, **then** the address is not saved and message Chk.AddressLocatorRequired is shown.
**Given** a PO box attribute (with a virtual post box option) is enabled, **when** the shopper edits an address, **then** the field is shown and saved; when disabled it is not shown.

**Given** AddressSettings.CountyEnabled / CountyRequired and the state/province list are configured per country, **when** the shopper selects a country, **then** the county and region fields follow the settings (Kenya counties, Malawi districts as configured).

**Given** an order has a delivery address with a pin (LOG-015 AddressGeo), **when** staff, the seller or the courier open the order, **then** the pin is shown with a link to the map and the landmark is shown beside the address.

**Given** the shopper starts checkout, **when** the first checkout step loads, **then** a CheckoutSession with a unique reference is created, or the open session of the same customer and store is reused; the reference is shown on the payment and confirm steps (SM-CHK-01).

**Given** the order is placed, **when** placement completes, **then** the reference is stored on every sub-order (OrderCheckoutLink), passed to PAY as merchant reference, shown on the order details, invoice and tracking pages, and searchable in admin; the native custom order number is still generated at order insert.

**Given** the order was placed but payment was interrupted (order PaymentStatus Pending), **when** the shopper returns to the order, **then** the order details offer to complete payment through the PAY retry path (native RePostPayment for Redirection methods).

**Given** checkout was interrupted before the order was placed, **when** the shopper signs in again and opens checkout, **then** the cart, addresses, chosen shipping option and payment method are kept and the same CheckoutSession reference is shown.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-114; FIT (checkout data kept until IShoppingCartService.ResetCheckoutDataAsync after placement, OrderProcessingService.cs:1636-1637; moved from ICustomerService in 5.00)

criterion: **Given** OrderSettings.PlaceOrderWithLock is on, **when** two confirm requests from the same customer reach the same web node, **then** only one order is created; the second request receives the native message Checkout.MinOrderPlacementInterval.

**Given** PLT-027 (P2) is delivered and the shop runs on more than one web node, **when** the same confirm request is sent twice to different nodes, **then** the PLT-027 idempotency key (CheckoutSession reference + cart hash) returns the existing order to the second request; no second order or charge is created.

**Given** checkout is retried within PaymentSettings.RegenerateOrderGuidInterval, **when** the payment request is prepared, **then** the same OrderGuid is reused (native) and the provider sees the same merchant reference.
**Given** two requests update the same CheckoutSession at once, **when** the second write is saved, **then** it fails on the row version of the plugin table and is retried after re-reading.

**Given** PLT-027 is not delivered (P1), **when** the go-live checklist of an instance (BR-PLT-004) records more than one web node serving checkout, **then** the checklist item fails and the instance is not set Active; in P1 duplicate-order protection is the native per-host placement lock and minimum interval plus the CheckoutSession reference, which hold on a single web node (L1 §6.4).
basis: Proposed (P1 single-node deployment until PLT-027); FIT (OrderProcessingService named mutex per host)

criterion: **Given** the e-transactions part of the store country's profile (CountryPrivacyProfile, owned by SEC-012; read through IC-SEC-03 GetProfile) defines a notice for a checkout point (cart, shipping, payment, confirm, completed), **when** the shopper reaches that point, **then** the notice topic is shown; for a policy topic under MKT-008 versioning the text is its Effective version (IC-MKT-03 GetEffectivePolicyVersion); CHK keeps no notice versions of its own.

**Given** an item, its category or the service type requires a returns or refund policy acknowledgement, **when** the shopper is on the confirm step, **then** a checkbox with a link to the policy is shown; if it is not ticked the order is not placed and message Chk.AcknowledgementRequired is shown (server-side action filter on CheckoutController.ConfirmOrder and OpcConfirmOrder [POST]).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-117; REQ-MPC-FR-107; FIT (ConfirmOrder takes no model, so a ModelReceivedEvent veto cannot be used)

criterion: **Given** the shopper ticks the acknowledgement, **when** the order is placed, **then** the acceptance is recorded through IAM IC-IAM-05 RecordAcceptance (customer, policy system name, version from IC-MKT-03 or "unversioned", decision, channel checkout, IP, agent in an acting session); CHK stores only a NoticeAcknowledgement link of order, notice and the returned acceptance id (AUD-CHK-002); CHK keeps no acceptance record of its own.
**Given** no item in the cart requires an acknowledgement, **when** the shopper is on the confirm step, **then** no acknowledgement is shown ("where applicable").

**Given** the country profile (e-transactions part, CHK-009 field) sets a confirmation time limit, **when** an order is placed, **then** the order confirmation is queued at placement; if QueuedEmail.SentOnUtc is still empty when the limit passes, the order appears in the checkout exceptions list and staff are alerted.

**Given** the store country's profile holds data-protection consent texts (SEC-012 part) and e-commerce notices (CHK-009 part), read through IC-SEC-03, **when** a shopper checks out, **then** those notices are shown at their configured checkout points and consents are recorded through SEC-012.

**Given** OrderSettings.MinOrderSubtotalAmount (or MinOrderTotalAmount) is set, **when** the cart is below it, **then** checkout cannot be completed and the native warning Checkout.MinOrderSubtotalAmount (or Checkout.MinOrderTotalAmount) shows the minimum.

**Given** ShippingSettings.FreeShippingOverXEnabled is on with FreeShippingOverXValue, **when** the cart subtotal reaches the value, **then** the delivery fee and the pickup fee are zero (native: one threshold applies to both).
**Given** different values are set per store, **when** a shopper checks out in a store, **then** the store's values apply (settings are store-overridable).

**Given** an active rule says items of product or category A cannot be in the same cart as B, **when** the shopper adds B while A is in the cart, **then** the item is not added and message Chk.CartRuleViolation shows the rule text.
**Given** a rule becomes active after items were added, **when** the shopper starts checkout or confirms, **then** the cart warnings list the violation and the order is not placed.

**Given** an item is flagged pickup-only, **when** the shopper chooses delivery for the order or the line, **then** delivery is not offered; a placement with delivery is refused with message Chk.PickupOnly.

**Given** an item cannot be delivered to the shipping address area (LOG-004 serviceability), **when** the shopper reaches the shipping step, **then** the item gets message Chk.CartRuleViolation with the rule text and the shopper may choose pickup or remove the item.

**Given** PAY-018 sets an account restriction on the customer after checkout started, **when** the shopper confirms, **then** the placement override re-checks restrictions and refuses the order with message Pay.CheckoutRestricted.
**Given** a rule is created, changed, enabled or disabled, **when** it is saved, **then** who, when and old and new values are audited (AUD-CHK-001).
**Given** pickup is chosen and the client has enabled code and QR, **when** the shopper is on the confirm step, **then** the shopper selects Order code or QR code; only enabled methods are offered.
**Given** a pickup sub-order is placed, **when** placement completes, **then** a pickup code is generated (not guessable; stored as a hash), state Issued (SM-CHK-03).

**Given** the shipment is marked ready for pickup (native ReadyForPickupAsync), **when** ShipmentReadyForPickupEvent is raised, **then** the code or QR is sent by TRK-005 on the configured channels (SMS through CHN-005, email): by default inside the native ShipmentReadyForPickup.CustomerNotification, to which CHK-012 supplies the code token (TRK-012), or, where the client enables it, as the separate CHK event code Chk.PickupCode raised through IC-TRK-04; the code is shown in My account order details; state Sent.

**Given** the order is ready for pickup at outlet O and its code is Sent, **when** LOG-012 calls IC-CHK-09 Verify with the shipment, outlet O and the entered or scanned code, **then** CHK answers Valid; after its own checks (holding charge, proof of collection) LOG-012 calls DeliverAsync once and then IC-CHK-09 MarkUsed, and the code becomes Used (AUD-CHK-004).

**Given** a wrong code is checked, **when** IC-CHK-09 Verify runs, **then** CHK answers Invalid with message Chk.PickupCodeInvalid and adds one failed attempt; when the failures reach the configured limit (setting, default not stated) the code becomes Locked and CHK answers Locked with message Chk.PickupCodeLocked, which tells staff to check identity manually; LOG-012 shows the CHK message and nothing is handed over.
**Given** a code is already Used, **when** IC-CHK-09 Verify runs for it again, **then** CHK answers Used with message Chk.PickupCodeUsed and nothing is handed over.
**Given** the code is checked at a different outlet, **when** IC-CHK-09 Verify runs, **then** CHK answers Invalid with message Chk.PickupCodeInvalid (the code is bound to one outlet).

**Given** a user in role Agent with Customers.CustomersImpersonation, Security.AccessAdminPanel and Identity.Core.AssistedService.Access and an assigned outlet (IAM-026), **when** the agent finds or registers the customer and starts Place order for customer (Admin CustomerController.Impersonate), **then** the single impersonation filter owned by IAM-026 (BR-IAM-130) allows the agent only for a non-staff customer of the agent's own outlet, with the customer code where the setting requires it; then native impersonation starts, IAM writes the session record (AssistedServiceRecord, act) and the agent shops as that customer.

**Given** an agent is impersonating a customer, **when** the order is placed, **then** inside the CHK-003 placement override an AssistedOrder record stores OrderId, agent (IWorkContext.OriginalCustomerIfImpersonated) and outlet; this is the only order-to-agent record (IAM stores the session only); the native order note also names the agent (AUD-CHK-003).

**Given** the agent reaches the payment step, **when** methods are listed, **then** only methods allowed for assisted orders by the PAY routing rules are offered, and the payment taken is recorded by PAY-034 with the agent identity (AC-PAY-034-01-01).

**Given** the agent has no assigned outlet, **when** the agent tries to start an acting session, **then** IAM-026 refuses it with message Iam.AgentNotAssigned and no checkout is possible for the customer.

**Given** assisted orders exist, **when** a user with Checkout.Core.AssistedOrders.View filters by agent, outlet and date, **then** the matching AssistedOrder records are listed; agents see only their own outlet (IAM-008 scope "outlet").

**Given** another module needs the agent and outlet of an order (CHN-009 network commission, IAM-008 outlet scope, RPT), **when** it calls IC-CHK-10 GetAssistedOrder with the order ID, or ListAssistedOrders with agent, outlet and period, **then** CHK returns agent, outlet and placement time from AssistedOrder, or "not assisted"; no other module keeps an order-to-agent link.
basis: D; Proposed (one record per assisted order, BR-IAM-130)

criterion: **Given** LOG-005 returns an estimate for each shipping option and the shipping address (IC-CHK-03), **when** the shopper is on the shipping method step, **then** each option shows the earliest and latest date with message Log.EdtRange, calculated by LOG-005 (BR-LOG-030); CHK calculates no date.
**Given** the shopper chooses pickup at an outlet, **when** pickup points are listed, **then** each outlet shows the date from which the order can be collected.

**Given** LOG-005 has no estimate for an option, **when** the step is shown, **then** the native transit-days estimate is shown if available (StorePickupPoint.TransitDays, rate transit days); otherwise no date is shown and checkout continues.
**Given** an estimate was shown for the chosen option, **when** the order is placed, **then** the estimate is stored with the order and shown on the confirm step and in tracking (TRK-001).

**Given** the native desired-date list is on for a shipping option (CHK-006), **when** the shipping method step is shown, **then** the LOG-005 estimate (Log.EdtRange) is the expected delivery shown to the shopper; the native list is labelled as a choice of preferred date and its first date (today plus TransitDays) is not presented as the estimate.

**Given** a checkout attribute "Purchase order number" (text box, required for the B2B store) with length validation is configured, **when** a business buyer checks out, **then** the value is required, validated (ValidationMinLength / MaxLength) and stored on the order and invoice.
**Given** a checkout attribute with a price adjustment and a tax category is configured, **when** the shopper selects it, **then** the fee is added to the order total with its tax.
**Given** an attribute has a condition on another attribute, **when** the shopper changes the first attribute, **then** the conditional attribute is shown or hidden accordingly.

**Given** a company account (IAM-022) applies for credit, **when** finance staff set the limit, currency and payment terms and approve, **then** the credit account becomes Approved (SM-CHK-04) and the change is audited (AUD-CHK-005).

**Given** the buyer's company has an Approved credit account and enough available credit, **when** the buyer reaches the payment step, **then** payment method "On account" is offered; the order is placed with PaymentStatus Pending, and on invoice issue PAY-033 creates a receivable due after the payment terms.

**Given** the order total exceeds available credit (limit minus open receivables minus unpaid on-account orders), **when** the buyer reaches the payment step or confirms, **then** On account is hidden (HidePaymentMethodAsync) and, if posted, ProcessPaymentAsync returns error message Chk.CreditLimitExceeded; no order is placed; open receivables are read from PAY-033 through IC-PAY-08 GetOpenReceivables.

**Given** two buyers of the same company confirm on-account orders at the same time, **when** credit is checked, **then** the check runs under ILocker key 'chk-credit-{CreditAccountId}'; the second order is refused if the limit would be exceeded.
**Given** a credit account is Suspended, **when** a buyer of that company checks out, **then** On account is not offered; existing receivables are unchanged.

**Given** the company has receivables overdue beyond the configured grace (setting, default not stated), **when** a buyer checks out, **then** On account is not offered when the client setting "block when overdue" is on.

**Given** the buyer enters lines of SKU and quantity, **when** the buyer adds them to the cart, **then** each valid line is added through AddToCartAsync with stock and price checks; unknown SKUs are listed with message Chk.QuickOrderSkuNotFound and native warnings are listed per line.

**Given** the buyer uploads a file with columns SKU and Quantity (format Proposed), **when** the file is processed, **then** the same per-line rules apply and a result list shows added and refused lines.
