**Given** ShoppingCartSettings.AllowMultipleWishlist is on and the buyer has named lists, **when** the buyer selects Add all to cart on a list, **then** all items are added through AddToCartAsync and any warnings are shown per item.

**Given** a company administrator sets a threshold for the buyer role (IAM-022), **when** it is saved, **then** orders by users in that role above the threshold need approval; the change is audited (AUD-CHK-001).

**Given** the cart total is above the buyer's threshold, **when** the buyer submits it for approval, **then** a PurchaseApprovalRequest with the cart snapshot and total is created in state Pending (SM-CHK-05) and the approvers of the company are notified (ADM-006 queue).
**Given** approval is required and no Approved request matches the current cart, **when** the buyer confirms the order, **then** the placement override refuses it with message Chk.ApprovalRequired.

**Given** a request is Pending, **when** an approver of the same company approves it, **then** it becomes Approved; the buyer can place the order while the cart matches the snapshot; the approver cannot be the requester.
**Given** an approver rejects a request, **when** the rejection is submitted, **then** a reason is mandatory, the request becomes Rejected and the buyer is notified with the reason.
**Given** the cart changes after approval, **when** the buyer confirms, **then** the approval becomes Void and approval is required again.

**Given** OrderSettings.DisableOrderCompletedPage is off, **when** the order is placed, **then** the completed page shows the custom order number, the checkout reference (CHK-008) and, for a split checkout, every sub-order with its seller.

**Given** an order is placed, **when** placement completes, **then** the native OrderPlaced.CustomerNotification email with the order number is queued, with the PDF invoice attached when AttachPdfInvoiceToOrderPlacedEmail is on, and an SMS is sent when TRK-005 is configured for this event.

**Given** a checkout produced several sub-orders (CHK-004), **when** placement completes, **then** the buyer receives one confirmation (message template Chk.OrderPlacedGroup.CustomerNotification, new) listing all sub-orders instead of one native email per sub-order, sent by TRK-005 (owner of the IWorkflowMessageService override, IC-TRK-04 SendEvent); seller notifications are unchanged.
basis: Proposed; FIT (SendNotificationsAndSaveNotesAsync is protected virtual inside the CHK-003 override); OVR-REG

criterion: **Given** the CHK plugin is installed, **when** installation runs, **then** CHK registers its product event codes with TRK-005 through IC-TRK-04 RegisterEventCode, with default channels and localised default content: Chk.OrderPlacedGroup (active) and Chk.PickupCode (inactive by default, because ShipmentReadyForPickup.CustomerNotification carries the code, TRK-012); a send with an unregistered code is refused by TRK.

**Given** the licensed nopCommerce Mobile App is configured for the client store and published in the app stores (publishing is a project service), **when** a shopper signs in, browses, adds to cart and places an order in the app, **then** the order is created in the same store through native order placement, with the same prices, discounts and tax as on the website.
**Given** a shopper placed an order in the app, **when** they sign in to the website with the same account, **then** the order appears in My account with the same status.

**Given** a payment method is active on the website, **when** the shopper reaches payment in the app, **then** only methods whose plugins support the app flow are offered; which PAY adapters support it is checked under V-01 and listed per client before release.

**Given** the app home content is managed in admin (capability stated by the vendor; verification V-01), **when** an administrator changes a slider, carousel or menu and the shopper reopens the app, **then** the change appears without a new app release.

**Given** the app is configured, **when** it exchanges data with the shop, **then** every call goes through the official Web API plugin endpoints (stated as included in the stub text) under an INT-001 API client; the app has no direct database access.

**Given** the PWA settings of the store are filled (name, short name, start address, display mode, theme colour, icons), **when** a supported mobile browser loads the store, **then** the store serves a complete web app manifest for that store and the browser offers installation; the installed app opens the start address in standalone display.
basis: D; FIT (5.00.1 still ships Presentation/Nop.Web/wwwroot/icons/icons_0/site.webmanifest with icons and colours only — empty name, no start_url or display — linked from CommonSettings.FaviconAndAppIconsHeadCode; no service worker in the 5.00.1 source)

criterion: **Given** two stores run in one installation, **when** each is loaded, **then** each serves its own manifest (name, icons, start address); the shared static file is not used.

**Given** feature PRD-CHN-002 is off for store S (productfeature.PRD-CHN-002 read through IC-PLT-02), **when** a page of store S loads, **then** no CHN manifest link and no service-worker registration are output for store S; the native head code (CommonSettings.FaviconAndAppIconsHeadCode) is unchanged (BR-CHN-003).

**Given** light mode is on for the store (setting), **when** a catalogue page loads, **then** pictures use the light-mode picture size (setting, default not stated) and pictures below the first screen load only when scrolled into view.

**Given** the native WebOptimizer settings are at their defaults, **when** a page loads, **then** scripts and styles are served bundled (WebOptimizerConfig.EnableJavaScriptBundling and EnableCssBundling, default true).

**Given** a page-weight and load-time target is stated (NFR-X-006), **when** the home, category, product and checkout pages are measured on the agreed connection profile, **then** each page is within the target value of NFR-X-006 (value Not stated in source; tested once the value is set).

**Given** the service worker is installed, **when** the connection drops and the shopper opens a page viewed before, **then** the cached copy is shown with banner Chn.OfflineBanner; a page never viewed shows the offline page Chn.OfflinePage.

**Given** the shopper is offline, **when** they try to add to cart, sign in or place an order, **then** the action is not sent and message Chn.OfflineActionBlocked is shown; nothing is queued for later sending (BR-CHN-002).

**Given** the service worker caches pages, **when** any page is cached, **then** only public catalogue pages, topics and static files are cached; account, cart, checkout and order pages are never cached (BR-CHN-002).

**Given** the USSD gateway (operator or aggregator, not named, MG-10) is connected to the CHN USSD endpoint (IC-CHN-02), **when** a session request arrives with session id, phone number and input, **then** the endpoint verifies the gateway (BR-CHN-012) and returns the next menu text and a continue-or-end flag.

**Given** the caller's phone number belongs to one customer account (IAM-002), **when** the caller chooses My orders, **then** the most recent orders (count a setting, default not stated) are listed with number and status.
**Given** the caller's phone number belongs to no customer account, **when** the caller chooses My orders, **then** the reply is Chn.UssdNotRegistered and no order data is shown.
**Given** the caller enters an order number, **when** the order does not exist or belongs to another customer, **then** the same reply Chn.UssdOrderNotFound is given in both cases (BR-CHN-011).

**Given** a simple-order menu lists configured products, **when** the caller picks a product and quantity, picks pickup or delivery to the saved address, and confirms, **then** an order is placed through IOrderProcessingService.PlaceOrderAsync (CHK-003 override, OVR-REG) for the caller's account with payment Pending, and the order number is returned.
**Given** the gateway ends the session before confirmation, **when** the session closes, **then** no order is placed.

**Given** an order was placed through USSD and mobile money is available (PAY-004), **when** the caller confirms payment, **then** the PAY-004 payment request is sent to the caller's phone number; payment status follows PAY-004.

**Given** a user with Channels.Core.Voice.CreateEditDelete edits the menu tree, **when** they save it, **then** the new menu is used by new sessions in each configured language; open sessions finish on the old menu.

**Given** the IVR platform (not named) is connected to the CHN IVR endpoint (IC-CHN-03), **when** a caller selects a language and the order-status option and keys an order number, **then** the status of that order is read out if the calling number belongs to the order's customer; otherwise the not-found prompt is played (BR-CHN-011).

**Given** TRK-005 sends a notification on the voice channel to a customer whose preference is voice (TRK-006), **when** the call is placed, **then** the voice adapter receives it through IC-TRK-02 Send with the message id as idempotency key, the message is played in the customer's language, and the call result (answered, not answered, failed) is returned through IC-TRK-02 DeliveryReceipt; TRK-005 applies its fallback.
**Given** no recorded or synthesised prompt exists for the customer's language, **when** a voice notification is due, **then** the voice channel is skipped and TRK-005 uses the next channel.

**Given** an SMS provider adapter is active, **when** TRK-005 sends an SMS notification through IC-TRK-02 Send (idempotency key = TRK message id), or IAM-002 sends a one-time code through IC-IAM-01 SendCode, **then** the message is queued as QueuedSms (SM-CHN-01), sent through the adapter, and the provider's delivery receipt sets it Delivered or Failed; for TRK-005 messages the status is reported through IC-TRK-02 DeliveryReceipt.

**Given** the provider returns a transient error, **when** sending is attempted, **then** it is retried per the retry setting (default not stated); if a secondary provider is configured it is used after the retries; otherwise the message becomes Failed and the failure is logged.

**Given** a client instance is configured, **when** the configuration check runs, **then** the bundled Misc.Brevo plugin is not installed (not in App_Data/plugins.json), because it replaces IWorkflowMessageService (NopStartup Order 3000), which OVR-REG gives to TRK-005; CHN registers no IWorkflowMessageService override (BR-CHN-010, BR-TRK-021).

**Given** the command keyword for order status is set (Proposed default STATUS; catalog example FC-M25-007), **when** an SMS "STATUS <order number>" arrives from the phone number of that order's customer or billing address, **then** the reply gives the order number and status.

**Given** an order-status command arrives from a number that does not belong to the order, or names an unknown order, **when** it is processed, **then** the reply is Chn.SmsCommandNotFound in both cases (BR-CHN-011).
**Given** an SMS with an unknown keyword arrives, **when** it is processed, **then** the reply is Chn.SmsCommandHelp listing the available commands.

**Given** an inbound SMS callback arrives, **when** it fails provider verification (signature, token or source address as the provider supports), **then** it is rejected and logged; no reply is sent (BR-CHN-012).

**Given** a new provider adapter implements IC-CHN-01 (Send, ParseDeliveryReceipt, ParseInbound) and, since nopCommerce 5.00, the core ISmsProvider plugin type (SendSmsAsync) in the same plugin, **when** it is installed and configured, **then** SMS can be sent through it with no change to TRK-005 or IAM-002, and it is listed as an SMS provider in the native admin SMS provider list.

**Given** TRK-005 repeats IC-TRK-02 Send with a message id the SMS channel has already accepted, **when** the request is received, **then** no second SMS is queued and the first provider message id is returned.

**Given** a reply to an inbound SMS command is to be sent by CHN-005 outside TRK-005 (decision MSG-ROUTE), **when** before sending, CHN-005 calls IC-TRK-06 CheckAllowed with the phone number, channel SMS, category Conversation replies and sender CHN, and TRK answers Blocked (for example a ContactOptOut record OptedOut, BR-TRK-033), **then** the reply is not sent and the QueuedSms becomes Suppressed (SM-CHN-01); with Allowed it is sent; one-time codes are not checked again by CHN-005, because IAM-002 checks the opt-out before it calls IC-IAM-01 (BR-IAM-150, BR-TRK-026).

**Given** the client's aggregator adapter is selected as the primary SMS provider (MessagesSettings.ActiveSmsProviderSystemName) and IAM uses the native 5.00 phone one-time-code flow, **when** nopCommerce sends a code through ISmsService.SendSmsAsync, **then** the adapter calls IC-TRK-06 CheckAllowed (channel SMS, category Security codes), queues the message as QueuedSms (SM-CHN-01), sends it and returns true only when the provider accepted it; the delivery receipt later updates QueuedSms; the bundled Sms.Twilio is not the primary provider unless the client has confirmed it (open item).

**Given** a WhatsApp Business Platform account is connected and the notification templates are approved by the provider, **when** TRK-005 sends a notification on the WhatsApp channel to a customer who opted in (TRK-006), **then** the WhatsApp adapter receives it through IC-TRK-02 Send (idempotency key = message id), the template message is sent through the provider API in the customer's language, and its delivery status is returned through IC-TRK-02 DeliveryReceipt.
**Given** the customer has not opted in to WhatsApp, **when** a notification is due, **then** nothing is sent on WhatsApp and TRK-005 uses the next channel.

**Given** WhatsApp chat routing is on, **when** a customer sends a WhatsApp message to the business number, **then** the inbound handler stores it as an inbound ChannelMessage, publishes the module event Channel.MessageReceived (channel, channel message ID, sender, text, attachments) and routes it: to the AI-003 chatbot first when it is enabled for WhatsApp, otherwise to the live chat console (CRM-008) or, when routing is set to tickets, to CRM intake through IC-CRM-04 ReceiveInbound (BR-CHN-014).

**Given** a conversation or ticket exists for a WhatsApp sender, **when** an agent replies in CRM-008 or on the CRM ticket, or the chatbot answers, **then** the reply is delivered to the sender on WhatsApp through IC-CHN-04 SendReply, outside TRK-005, after SendReply has called IC-TRK-06 CheckAllowed for that sender and channel (decision MSG-ROUTE, BR-TRK-026); when TRK answers Blocked nothing is sent and the reply is Refused with reason opted out, which CRM shows to the agent, and its delivery status is stored on the ChannelMessage.
**Given** a conversation is open, **when** the customer sends an image or a document, **then** it is attached to the conversation in the live chat console.

**Given** the provider refuses a message for the conversation (provider policy), **when** an agent sends it, **then** the agent sees Chn.MessageRefusedByProvider with the provider reason, and the message is not shown as sent.

**Given** an administrator enters the account credentials, **when** they are saved, **then** they are stored encrypted per client instance and never exported in a configuration pack (CFG-01); inbound callbacks are accepted only after provider verification (BR-CHN-012).

**Given** CHN has registered the upload context "channel inbound media" (own endpoint) with ADM-008 through IC-ADM-08 RegisterUploadContext at installation, **when** an inbound WhatsApp or WeChat message carries an image or a document, **then** the inbound handler calls IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload with that context before it stores the file; a refused file is not stored or passed on, the message is routed without it and the refusal reason is stored on the ChannelMessage; CHN keeps no file-type or size check of its own (BR-ADM-060).

**Given** a WeChat official account is connected (account type and registration not stated, KG-24), **when** a buyer sends a message to the account, **then** it is stored and published as Channel.MessageReceived and routed as in AC-CHN-006-02-01 (live chat console CRM-008, or CRM intake through IC-CRM-04); the agent's replies are delivered to the buyer on WeChat through IC-CHN-04 SendReply (BR-CHN-014).
**Given** WeChat refuses a message (provider policy), **when** an agent sends it, **then** the agent sees Chn.MessageRefusedByProvider with the reason.

**Given** an administrator enters the account credentials, **when** they are saved, **then** they are stored encrypted and never exported in a configuration pack; inbound callbacks are accepted only after WeChat signature verification (BR-CHN-012).

**Given** the Telegram bot is connected and the shopper has linked the account with a one-time code shown in My account, **when** the shopper asks the bot for order status, **then** the bot replies with the status of that shopper's recent orders; an unlinked chat gets the link instructions.

**Given** the shopper has linked Telegram and opted in (TRK-006), **when** TRK-005 sends a notification on the Telegram channel through IC-TRK-02 Send, **then** the message is delivered through the bot and its status returned through IC-TRK-02 DeliveryReceipt.

**Given** an agent of outlet O places an order for a customer in an IAM-026 acting session (assisted checkout, CHK-013), **when** the order is placed, **then** CHK-013 records order, agent and outlet once in its AssistedOrder record (IAM-026 keeps only the session in AssistedServiceRecord, BR-IAM-130); CHN-009 reads it through the CHK read contract IC-CHK-10 (GetAssistedOrder, ListAssistedOrders) to attribute the order to the agent's network and keeps no order link of its own.

**Given** an administrator holding Channels.Core.Agents.CreateEditDelete selects a customer account that holds the Agent role and has outlets assigned in IAM-026, **when** they add it to a network, **then** an Active network membership (SM-CHN-03) is saved; outlet assignment and the customers the agent may serve stay with IAM-026 and IAM-008.

**Given** an agent's network membership is Deactivated (SM-CHN-03), **when** an order is later placed in that agent's acting session, **then** no commission accrues for it; past commissions and attributions are kept; the agent's login and assisted access are controlled by IAM-026, not by CHN.

**Given** a commission rule is set for the agent's network (basis and value not stated), **when** an agent-attributed order is paid (OrderPaidEvent), **then** the consumer only enqueues the accrual; the commission task records an Accrued commission with the rule version used.

**Given** an agent-attributed order is refunded in full or in part (OrderRefundedEvent, after the RET-005 / PAY-016 refund completes), **when** the refund is recorded, **then** the commission is reversed in proportion to the refunded amount.

**Given** an external agent or correspondent network sends agent transactions through the API (INT-001), **when** they arrive, **then** each is matched to a network member by external code; unmatched records are listed as exceptions.

**Given** the field app (external) holds records captured offline, each with a client-generated id, **when** connectivity returns and the app syncs through INT-001, **then** each record is applied once (PLT-027 idempotency key); a record changed on the server since the agent downloaded it is refused with 409 and shown to the agent as a conflict.
**Given** the agent has allowed device location access, **when** a record is captured, **then** it carries latitude, longitude and capture time.
**Given** the agent has refused location access, **when** a record is captured, **then** it is saved without coordinates and marked "no location".
**Given** a record has photos, **when** it is synced, **then** the photos are stored and linked to the record; the record shows which verification steps are complete.

**Given** CHN has registered the upload context "field record photo" (own endpoint) with ADM-008 through IC-ADM-08 RegisterUploadContext at installation, **when** a synced record carries a photo, **then** the sync endpoint calls IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload with that context before storing the photo through IPictureService; a refused photo is not stored, the record is applied without it and the ADM refusal reason is returned to the app for that photo; CHN keeps no file-type or size check of its own (BR-ADM-060).

**Given** the bundled ExternalAuth.Facebook plugin is active and configured with the client's Facebook app credentials, **when** a shopper chooses Facebook on the sign-in page and consents, **then** the shopper is signed in to the account linked to that Facebook identity, or a new account is registered and linked.

**Given** the Facebook app secret is entered in the plugin configuration, **when** a configuration pack is exported or applied, **then** facebookexternalauthsettings.clientsecret is not exported and a pack that contains it is refused (BR-CHN-003).

**Given** a sender ID is set for the client on the provider adapter, **when** any SMS is sent, **then** it carries that sender ID; if the provider rejects the sender ID the message becomes Failed with the reason and administrators are alerted.

**Given** opt-out keywords are set (Proposed default STOP), **when** a customer texts an opt-out keyword from a phone number that belongs to a customer account, **then** CHN-012 records the keyword (InboundSms) and calls IC-TRK-06 UpdatePreference (customer, channel SMS, all non-mandatory categories, opted out, source keyword), which sets that customer's SMS preference to off (AC-TRK-006-01-05); a confirmation Chn.SmsOptOutConfirmed is sent once through TRK-005; later non-mandatory SMS are not sent because TRK-005 applies the preference (BR-CHN-020, BR-TRK-031).

**Given** the customer has opted out by SMS, **when** the customer texts the opt-in keyword (Proposed default START), **then** CHN-012 calls IC-TRK-06 UpdatePreference with opted in; the TRK-006 SMS preference (and any ContactOptOut record of that number) is set back on and Chn.SmsOptInConfirmed is sent through TRK-005.

**Given** an opt-out keyword arrives from a phone number that belongs to no customer account, **when** it is processed, **then** CHN-012 calls IC-TRK-06 UpdatePreference with the number in international format, channel SMS, opted out and source keyword; TRK-006 keeps the ContactOptOut record (SM-TRK-09, BR-TRK-033); CHN keeps no consent record of its own; later non-mandatory SMS to that number are not sent: notifications by TRK-005, command replies by AC-CHN-005-01-04, one-time codes by the IAM-002 check.

**Given** quiet hours are set in TRK-006 (customer or client default), **when** a non-urgent SMS notification falls inside them, **then** TRK-005 holds it and releases it when quiet hours end (BR-TRK-032); CHN-005 receives it only when released; CHN-012 holds no quiet-hours setting of its own (BR-CHN-021).
**Given** IAM-002 requests a one-time code through IC-IAM-01 inside quiet hours, **when** the request is received, **then** the code is sent at once (BR-CHN-021).

**Given** the shopper grants notification permission in the app or the installed website, **when** permission is granted, **then** a PushSubscription (platform, token or endpoint, customer) is stored and the push opt-in is recorded in TRK-006 through IC-TRK-06 UpdatePreference (channel push, source channel opt-in); no subscription is stored without permission.

**Given** TRK-005 sends a notification on the push channel through IC-TRK-02 Send to a customer with a PushSubscription, **when** the push adapter sends it (FCM, APNs or Web Push), **then** it is delivered to each of the customer's devices, the result is returned through IC-TRK-02 DeliveryReceipt, and a token the service reports as invalid is removed.
**Given** the shopper signs out on a device, **when** sign-out completes, **then** that device's subscription is unlinked from the customer.
**Given** a notification refers to an order, **when** the shopper taps it, **then** the app or website opens that order's page; if not signed in, the sign-in page opens first.

**Given** the help desk is installed and the ticket form is published, **when** a shopper submits category, subject, description and optionally an order, **then** a ticket is created with a unique number and status New (SM-CRM-01), routed by CRM-014, and the acknowledgement is sent through TRK-005 as the CRM event code Ticket.Created (IC-TRK-04 SendEvent) with the ticket number, the expected response time from the SLA policy and how to follow up; message Crm.TicketCreated is shown.

**Given** an acknowledgement time window is configured (value not stated), **when** a ticket is created through any intake channel (CRM-002), **then** the acknowledgement is queued at creation and sent within the window; a send failure is retried and logged through TRK-007.
**Given** a ticket is New, **when** support staff assign it to an agent or a department, **then** the assignment is stored, the assignee is notified and the change is audited (AUD-CRM-001).
**Given** a ticket exists, **when** its status changes, **then** only the transitions of SM-CRM-01 are allowed; the adapter maps each product status to the status of the licensed plugin.

**Given** SLA policies exist for first response and resolution by category and priority (values not stated), **when** a ticket is created, **then** timers start in the SLA component (CRM-014); the due times are shown on the ticket and in the queue; a missed due time marks the ticket Breached and escalates it (BR-CRM-010).
**Given** a ticket is Resolved and the customer does not reply within the auto-close period (setting, default not stated), **when** the close task runs, **then** the ticket becomes Closed.
**Given** a registered shopper has tickets, **when** they open My account, My tickets, **then** each ticket shows number, subject, status, last update and the conversation without internal notes.
**Given** a shopper calls the ticket page of another customer, **when** the request is processed, **then** access is denied and nothing is shown.
**Given** a ticket is AwaitingCustomer, **when** the shopper replies, **then** the ticket becomes Open and the resolution timer resumes.

**Given** the ADM-008 upload policy for the upload context "ticket attachment" (registered by the CRM plugin with ADM-008) sets allowed file types and maximum size (values not stated), **when** a shopper or agent uploads a file of a type or size outside that policy, **then** ADM-008 refuses it with message Adm.UploadTypeNotAllowed or Adm.UploadTooLarge before anything is stored; CRM keeps no file-type or size check of its own (BR-CRM-005).

**Given** the maximum number of files per ticket is configured (CRM setting, value not stated), **when** a shopper or agent adds a file above that number, **then** the file is refused with message Crm.AttachmentLimit and nothing is stored.

**Given** the V-01 test finds that the help desk stores attachments as native Download records served through Nop.Web DownloadController.GetFileUpload or Admin DownloadController.DownloadFile, **when** anyone requests a ticket attachment by its GUID, **then** the single SEC-002 ownership filter (BR-SEC-005) asks the CRM rule provider, which allows the ticket customer and staff holding Support.Core.Tickets.View; anyone else is refused by the SEC-002 filter and nothing is served (BR-CRM-005).
basis: SINGLE-FILTER; Proposed; FIT (GetFileUpload and Admin DownloadFile serve any Download by GUID)

criterion: **Given** support service-level standards and their escalation actions are configured, **when** a ticket misses a standard, **then** the configured action runs (notify, raise priority, move to the next level) and is written to the ticket history.

**Given** the licensed help desk (or its alternative) is installed with its adapter, **when** CRM-002, CRM-003, CRM-006 or CRM-014 create, read, update or link tickets, **then** they call only the adapter operations of IC-CRM-01; replacing the plugin requires a new adapter and no change to those features.

**Given** RPT-003 configures the help-desk datasets, **when** the RPT export task reads them, **then** it reads only the read-only extract views of IC-CRM-05 (tickets with TicketExt, message metadata, status history, ratings, fraud referrals, call logs), never the licensed plugin tables directly; replacing the plugin keeps the view columns unchanged.

**Given** the nopCommerce 5.00 build of the chosen plugin is installed on release-5.00.1 for the V-01 test, **when** the V-01 checklist runs (departments, assignment, statuses, attachments with limits, customer ticket list, e-mails, auto-close, IPermissionConfigManager permission names, writes through the async IRepository<> members — the synchronous Insert, Update, Delete, GetById and GetAll were removed in 5.00, Libraries/Nop.Data/IRepository.cs), **then** each item passes or is listed as a build item of the CRM extension.

**Given** a support mailbox is configured (connection and credentials entered per client instance, encrypted, never in packs), **when** the mailbox task reads a new e-mail, **then** a ticket is created with channel E-mail, the sender matched to a customer by e-mail address, and attachments stored within the CRM-001 limits, each file first checked through IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload with the ticket attachment context (BR-CRM-005, BR-ADM-060); e-mails whose subject carries an existing ticket number are added to that ticket.
**Given** an incoming e-mail is an automatic reply or a delivery failure (by its headers), **when** the mailbox task reads it, **then** no ticket is created and the message is logged.
**Given** the same e-mail is read twice (same Message-ID), **when** the mailbox task runs on any node, **then** only one ticket or message results (BR-CRM-003).

**Given** an agent takes a call, **when** the agent fills the call form (caller, phone, category, notes, duration) and chooses new or existing ticket, **then** the call is stored as a ticket entry with channel Phone, actor and time.

**Given** WhatsApp Business is connected through CHN-006, **when** a customer message arrives, **then** it creates a ticket with channel WhatsApp or is added to the customer's open WhatsApp ticket; agent replies on the ticket are conversational replies sent back through IC-CHN-04 SendReply, outside TRK-005, only after the TRK-006 opt-out record for that number and channel is checked (BR-CRM-004).

**Given** the customer's number is opted out of WhatsApp in TRK-006 (including a number without an account), **when** an agent sends a reply on the WhatsApp ticket, **then** no message is sent, the reply stays on the ticket as not delivered and the agent sees message Crm.RecipientOptedOut (BR-CRM-004).
**Given** an agent works at an outlet (IAM-026), **when** the agent records a walk-in question for a customer, **then** a ticket is created with channel Outlet and the outlet and agent recorded.

**Given** two tickets belong to the same request, **when** an agent merges the source into the target, **then** the target keeps all messages, attachments and history of both, the source becomes Merged with a link to the target, and the merge is audited (AUD-CRM-002).

**Given** a new ticket has the same customer, order and category as an open ticket created within the duplicate window (setting, default not stated), **when** the ticket is created, **then** both tickets are flagged with message Crm.PossibleDuplicate for an agent to decide; nothing is merged automatically.

**Given** a ticket exists, **when** any inbound or outbound message, call log, chat transcript (CRM-008), outlet note or notification e-mail about it is created, **then** it is stored in the ticket history with channel, time and author, and is shown in time order.

**Given** contact-to-ticket is on and the help desk is active, **when** a shopper submits the native contact-us form successfully (ContactUsModel.SuccessfullySent), **then** a CRM action filter on CommonController.ContactUsSend [POST] creates a ticket with channel Web form through IC-CRM-01; the native Service.ContactUs e-mail is still sent.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-253; FIT (5.00.1: CommonController.ContactUsSend(model, captchaValid, IFormCollection form), Presentation/Nop.Web/Controllers/CommonController.cs:276-300; the filter reads the model after the action and needs no form parameter of its own)

criterion: **Given** the client defines contact-form attributes on the contact-us form (native since 5.00: ContactFormAttribute and its values, admin Contact form attributes page under Configuration.ManageSettings), for example order number and issue category, **when** a shopper submits the contact-us form with them, **then** required attributes are validated by the native action, their values are added to the native Service.ContactUs e-mail, and the CRM contact-to-ticket filter copies each attribute name and value into the ticket fields mapped in the CRM settings (unmapped attributes go into the ticket description).

**Given** a user has Support.Core.Customer360.View, **when** they search by name, e-mail, phone, order number or ticket number and open a customer, **then** the view shows profile (name, contact, roles, registration date, active flag), orders with order, payment and shipping status, PAY transactions and refunds, the tracking timeline (TRK-002), the notification log (TRK-007), tickets (IC-CRM-01), returns and dispute cases (IC-RET-01) on one page.

**Given** a support query is about one order, **when** the agent opens that order from the view, **then** the order status, the payment status with the latest PAY transaction status and the latest tracking event are shown together.

**Given** the view is open, **when** the agent wants to refund, cancel or edit, **then** the view offers links to the owning screens, which apply their own permissions; the view itself changes nothing.

**Given** a field is classed sensitive in the CRM masking list (setting; list not stated) and the user lacks Support.Core.Customer360.ViewSensitive, **when** the view is shown, **then** the value is masked; when SEC-014 is live its masking rule is used.
**Given** a user with Support.Core.Customer360.ViewSensitive reveals a masked field, **when** the field is revealed, **then** the reveal is audited with user, customer, field and time (AUD-CRM-003).

**Given** an agent role has Support.Core.Customer360.View but not the native Customers.CustomersView, **when** the agent calls the native admin customer edit page, **then** access is denied, so masking cannot be bypassed (BR-CRM-030).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-263; FIT (native CustomerController.Edit shows all fields)

criterion: **Given** the customer has consent records (native GdprLog ConsentAgree / ConsentDisagree) and terms-acceptance records per policy version (IAM-016), and the agent role holds Identity.Core.ConsentTrail.View (IAM), **when** the agent opens the consent tab, **then** the entries are read through IC-IAM-05 GetConsentTrail (IAM is the single owner of acceptance and consent records, decision ONE-RECORD) and listed read-only with date, consent or policy version and action; CRM stores no copy.
**Given** an order has shipments, **when** the agent opens its tracking from the view, **then** the tracking timeline (TRK-002 events, carrier, proof of delivery) linked to each shipment is shown.
basis: Inference from REQ-MPC-ORD-001 (support staff read as stakeholders)

criterion: **Given** the complaint form fields and steps of the client policy are configured, **when** a shopper submits a complaint, **then** a ticket of type Complaint is created with a complaint reference, acknowledged as in CRM-001 and routed to the complaints queue; for Malawi Post the fields and steps follow its Complaints and ADR Policy — held by T-MISS (policy not provided).

**Given** a complaint ticket is open, **when** staff try to close it, **then** closing needs a recorded outcome and a customer notification; otherwise it is refused with message Crm.ComplaintOutcomeRequired.

**Given** matrix levels are configured per complaint category (level, target team or external body, trigger by time or by hand), **when** a complaint is escalated, **then** it moves to the next level, the target is notified and the escalation is audited (AUD-CRM-005).

**Given** the next level of a complaint is an external regulator, **when** the complaint is escalated to it, **then** the submission goes through INT-009 with second-person approval (BR-INT-040) and its reference is stored on the ticket.
**Given** the matrix is changed, **when** it is saved, **then** who, when, old and new values are audited (AUD-CRM-004).

**Given** a complaint names a seller, **when** the complaint ticket is created, **then** the seller is stored on the ticket and the module event Complaint.Created (ticket, seller, category) is published once after the ticket is saved; SEL-020 notifies the seller from it (the consumer only enqueues); SEL-011 reads complaint counts per seller and period through IC-CRM-05 GetComplaintCounts.
**Given** a complaint concerns a transaction remedy, **when** staff open a dispute case from it, **then** a RET-007 case is opened through IC-RET-01 and linked to the complaint both ways (CRM-006).

**Given** a ticket becomes Resolved, **when** the resolution notification is sent, **then** it carries a rating link; the shopper picks a rating on the configured scale (setting; scale not stated) and may add a comment; one rating is stored per ticket with ticket, agent and department.
**Given** a ticket already has a rating, **when** the shopper opens the rating link again, **then** message Crm.AlreadyRated is shown and nothing is stored.
**Given** the rating link is older than the rating window (setting, default not stated), **when** the shopper opens it, **then** message Crm.RatingExpired is shown and nothing is stored.

**Given** a user has Support.Core.Analytics.View, **when** they open the support dashboard for a period, **then** it shows tickets created and resolved, first-response and resolution times, SLA breaches (count and share) and average rating, each by queue and by agent, with filters for channel and category, and an Excel export.
**Given** complaint tickets exist, **when** the manager opens the complaint trend view, **then** complaints by category are shown over time for the period chosen.

**Given** an early-warning rule "complaints in category C within period P above T" is active (values configured; not stated), **when** the daily task finds T exceeded, **then** support managers are notified with the category, count and period.

**Given** a ticket exists, **when** an agent adds an internal note, **then** the note is visible to staff only, and never appears on the customer pages, in customer e-mails or in data returned to the customer.
**Given** a ticket has internal notes, **when** the customer opens it in My account, **then** the page and its data contain no internal note.

**Given** a ticket concerns an order, **when** an agent chooses Create case, **then** a RET-007 case is opened through IC-RET-01 with the ticket ID; the case shows the ticket link and the ticket shows the case link and status.
**Given** a return request or a case already exists (for example opened by PAY), **when** an agent links it to a ticket, **then** the link is shown on both records.

**Given** any change is made to a ticket (status, assignment, priority, category, fields, notes, merge), **when** it is saved, **then** an audit record with actor, time, old and new values is written through the SEC-004 audit trail (AUD-CRM-001); if the licensed plugin writes without IRepository<>, the adapter writes the audit record itself (V-01 check).
**Given** a user with Support.Core.Tickets.View opens a ticket, **when** they open its history, **then** all audit entries of the ticket are listed in time order.

**Given** topics marked as knowledge-base articles are published, **when** a shopper opens the help centre, **then** articles are listed by knowledge-base category; each opens as a native Topic page (localised, ACL and store limits applied).

**Given** an editor submits a new or changed knowledge-base article, **when** it is submitted, **then** a ContentRevision of type Topic is created through the MKT-008 revision handler (IC-MKT-02) and the article is not visible to shoppers until the revision is Approved (SM-MKT-01) by an approver other than the author; CRM keeps no approval flow of its own for articles.
**Given** an approver rejects an article, **when** the rejection is saved, **then** the article stays unpublished and the reason is shown to the author.

**Given** a ready-made answer is written, **when** the author saves it, **then** a new version is stored as Draft (SM-CRM-04); a user with Support.Core.Knowledge.Approve who is not the author approves it, and only the latest Approved version can be used.

**Given** an approved answer exists, **when** an agent inserts it into a ticket reply, **then** placeholders (for example customer name and order number) are filled from the ticket, and the version used is recorded on the message.

**Given** approved answers exist, **when** CRM-008 chat, CHN-006 WhatsApp replies or the AI-003 chatbot request answers through IC-CRM-02, **then** only Approved versions in the requested language are returned.

**Given** a question appears in the AI-003 unanswered list, **when** a user with Support.Core.Knowledge.CreateEditDelete follows its link, **then** a new ready-made answer, or a new Draft version of the linked answer, opens with the question text filled in; it follows SM-CRM-04 and is returned to the chatbot only after approval.
**Given** an answer has several versions, **when** a user opens its history, **then** all versions with author, approver and dates are shown.

**Given** articles are published in the shopper's language, **when** the shopper searches the help centre by keyword, **then** matching published articles are listed; articles limited by ACL or store are not.

**Given** the chat plugin (Tawk.to through Nop-Plus, V-01) is configured with the client's chat account, **when** a shopper opens a storefront page, **then** the chat widget is shown; a message reaches online staff; when no staff are online the message is stored and creates a ticket (CRM-002).

**Given** the licensed chat plugin is not available for nopCommerce 5.00 (V-01), **when** the client still wants web chat, **then** the chat provider script is inserted through SeoSettings.CustomHeadTags without a plugin and the widget behaves as above, except that tickets are created from the provider's e-mail transcripts (CRM-002).

**Given** a registered shopper is signed in and has consented where the data-protection profile requires it (SEC-012), **when** the widget loads, **then** the shopper's name and e-mail are passed to the chat provider.

**Given** WhatsApp Business is connected (CHN-006) and the chat plugin offers an integration interface (V-01), **when** a KTDA customer writes on WhatsApp, **then** the conversation arrives from the CHN-006 adapter (IC-CHN-04) in the live chat console, and agent replies, including images and documents, go back through IC-CHN-04 SendReply as conversational replies outside TRK-005, respecting the TRK-006 opt-out record (BR-CRM-004); if the chat plugin has no such interface, the conversation is handled as a ticket conversation (CRM-002) and the live-chat choice is reviewed.
**Given** WeChat is connected (CHN-007), **when** a KTDA customer writes on WeChat, **then** the conversation is handled in the same way through the CHN-007 adapter (IC-CHN-04).

**Given** the AI-003 chatbot hands a conversation to staff, **when** the hand-off happens, **then** the transcript is passed to the live chat console; when no agent is available a ticket with the transcript is created through IC-CRM-04; the hand-off interface of the licensed chat and help-desk plugins is confirmed under V-01.
**Given** a chat ends, **when** the transcript is received, **then** it is attached to an open ticket of that customer or to a new ticket with channel Chat.

**Given** the contact-us page is available, **when** a shopper submits name, e-mail and enquiry (and subject if CommonSettings.SubjectFieldOnContactUsForm is on), passing CAPTCHA if CaptchaSettings.Enabled and CaptchaSettings.ShowOnContactUsPage are on, **then** the native template Service.ContactUs is sent to the store, the native text ContactUs.YourEnquiryHasBeenSent is shown and activity PublicStore.ContactUs is logged.
**Given** the CAPTCHA answer is wrong, **when** the form is submitted, **then** nothing is sent and the native error Common.WrongCaptchaMessage is shown.
**Given** contact-to-ticket is on, **when** the form is sent successfully, **then** a ticket is also created (see CRM-002 (REQ-MPC-FR-253)).
**Given** VendorSettings.AllowCustomersToContactVendors is on, **when** a shopper sends the contact-vendor form, **then** the native template Service.ContactVendor is sent to the seller.
**Given** VendorSettings.AllowCustomersToContactVendors is off, **when** a shopper calls the contact-vendor page, **then** the page is not available (native redirect).

**Given** the help desk is active, **when** a registered shopper opens My account, My tickets, **then** every exchange with the shop is shown as a conversation thread (CRM-001); native private messages (PrivateMessageSettings.AllowPrivateMessages, moved from ForumSettings to the customer domain in 5.00: Libraries/Nop.Core/Domain/Customers/PrivateMessageSettings.cs:13) are not used for shop conversations.

**Given** a user has Customers.CustomersCreateEditDelete, **when** they use Send e-mail or Send private message on the admin customer page, **then** the native e-mail is queued or the private message is stored.
basis: FIT (5.00.1: Admin CustomerController.SendEmail, SendPm, Presentation/Nop.Web/Areas/Admin/Controllers/CustomerController.cs:1018, 1066; private messages need PrivateMessageSettings.AllowPrivateMessages)

criterion: **Given** an indicator rule "N complaints against seller V within period P" is active (values not stated), **when** the daily task finds the rule met, **then** a FraudReferral (SM-CRM-03, Open) is created for V with the linked tickets, and fraud staff are notified.

**Given** PAY-018 raises Risk.Flagged for a customer or transaction, **when** the event is received, **then** the consumer only enqueues; the CRM task creates a referral unless one is open for the same subject.
**Given** a user has Support.Core.Fraud.Refer, **when** they refer a ticket, case or customer with a reason, **then** a referral is created with the reason and links, and routed to the fraud queue.

**Given** a referral is Open, **when** fraud staff review it and record Confirmed or Unfounded with notes and actions taken, **then** the referral moves per SM-CRM-03, the outcome is stored and audited (AUD-CRM-008); actions such as blocking are taken in SEL-013 or IAM, not here.
**Given** a user without Support.Core.Fraud.CreateEditDelete opens a referral, **when** the request is processed, **then** access is denied.

**Given** an order is Complete and feedback invitations are on (timing setting, default not stated), **when** the invitation is sent, **then** the shopper can rate the overall experience and the service with an optional comment; the feedback is stored with type Order and the order reference.
**Given** the general feedback form is published, **when** a registered shopper submits it, **then** the feedback is stored with type General.

**Given** the shopper wants to give product feedback, **when** they follow the product link of the invitation, **then** the native product review form opens (CAT-029); product feedback is not duplicated in CRM.
**Given** a ticket is resolved, **when** the shopper is asked to rate it, **then** that rating is the CRM-005 rating (see CRM-005 (REQ-MPC-FR-261)).

**Given** a user has Support.Core.Feedback.CreateEditDelete, **when** they open the feedback list, **then** feedback is listed with filters (type, rating, period); the user records an action note and moves it through SM-CRM-05; the action is audited (AUD-CRM-009).
basis: Inference from REQ-KTDA-REV-003 (user read as staff)

criterion: **Given** KTDA confirms that "user" means the customer, **when** a shopper opens My account, My feedback, **then** their feedback and the staff response are shown.
basis: Inference from REQ-KTDA-REV-003 (user read as customer)

criterion: **Given** support channels are configured (phone numbers, chat, e-mail, WhatsApp, outlets) with opening hours, **when** a shopper opens the help page, **then** the channels are listed with their hours.

**Given** help-desk and chat data exist, **when** the directory is shown, **then** the expected waiting time for chat and tickets is the median first-response time over the trailing window (setting, default not stated); without data message Crm.WaitTimeUnknown is shown.
**Given** a channel is outside its opening hours, **when** the directory is shown, **then** the channel is shown closed with its next opening time (message Crm.ChannelClosed).

**Given** the bundled Misc.Forums plugin is installed, its ForumSettings.ForumsEnabled is on and forums are set up, **when** a registered shopper posts a topic or reply, **then** it is published as the forum settings allow.
basis: FIT (5.00.1: Plugins/Nop.Plugin.Misc.Forums, plugin.json SupportedVersions 5.00; ForumSettings.cs:14; Domain/Forum.cs, ForumTopic.cs, ForumPost.cs)

criterion: **Given** a user is in the ForumModerators role, **when** they edit or delete a post or topic, **then** the change is applied.
basis: FIT (5.00.1: ForumDefaults.ForumModeratorsRoleName, Plugins/Nop.Plugin.Misc.Forums/ForumDefaults.cs:23; ForumService.cs:1215; the role is created by the plugin installation, ForumInstallService.cs:564)

criterion: **Given** a user has Forums.Manage, **when** they manage forum groups and forums in admin, **then** the changes are saved.

**Given** an order is in the shopper's account, **when** the shopper chooses Report a problem on the order page (widget zone orderdetails_page_overview), **then** the issue form opens with order number, date, items, order, payment and shipping status and tracking numbers filled in read-only, and the issue types (missing parcel, delayed delivery, payment issue and any configured type).
**Given** the issue form is submitted, **when** the ticket is created, **then** the ticket stores the order link and a snapshot of the order details, and its category comes from the issue type.

**Given** the issue type is one that needs an item remedy (missing, damaged or wrong item; IssueType.NeedsItemRemedy), **when** the form is submitted, **then** a RET-007 case of type OrderIssue is also opened through IC-RET-01 with the ticket ID and the link is stored on both records (TicketLink, CRM-006).
**Given** the issue type is a delivery or payment problem (NeedsItemRemedy off), **when** the form is submitted, **then** only the ticket is created; no RET case is opened.
**Given** a shopper calls the issue form for an order that is not theirs, **when** the request is processed, **then** access is denied.

**Given** routing rules "category C, service type S, order status O, region R gives department D" are active, **when** a ticket matching them is created, **then** it is assigned to D and the rule applied is written to the ticket history.
**Given** rules are ordered, **when** a ticket matches more than one rule, or none, **then** the first match in order applies; with no match the default department applies.
**Given** a ticket has an order, **when** geography is evaluated, **then** it is taken from the shipping address (country, state or province, county, and district where a list is configured).

**Given** a ticket is at first-line level, **when** an agent escalates it to a specialised team with a reason, **then** the department changes, the escalation level increases, the team is notified and the escalation is audited (AUD-CRM-005).
**Given** an escalation level is set to trigger on an SLA breach, **when** the timer of a ticket at that level breaches, **then** the ticket is escalated automatically to the next level.

**Given** an SLA policy exists for a subject type (Ticket, ReturnRequest, DisputeCase), category, priority and metric, **when** a subject enters the start state, **then** a timer starts with a due time computed from the policy and its calendar (round the clock or business hours, setting, default not stated); it pauses and resumes on the configured states and stops on the end state (SM-CRM-02).
**Given** a running timer passes its due time, **when** the SLA task runs, **then** the timer becomes Breached and the module event Sla.Breached is published once for that timer.

**Given** a business customer exists (IAM-022), **when** an administrator assigns an account manager, **then** the assignment is stored and audited (AUD-CRM-010), and the buyer sees the manager's name and contact details in My account.

**Given** an assigned manager has Customers.CustomersImpersonation, **when** they choose Place order on behalf on the customer page, **then** the native impersonation starts and the order placed is recorded with an order note naming the manager.

**Given** a user in the AccountManager role (and not an Administrator, and not an Agent acting for a customer of the agent's own outlet, IAM-026) holds Customers.CustomersImpersonation and is not the assigned manager of the customer, **when** they post the impersonation action (Admin CustomerController.Impersonate, route action name Edit), **then** the single IAM-026 impersonation filter (BR-IAM-130) asks the CRM-015 rule provider (IC-IAM-09 EvaluateImpersonation), which answers refuse with message Crm.NotAssignedManager; the impersonation does not start and the refusal is audited (AUD-CRM-010); CRM registers no filter of its own on the action.
basis: SINGLE-FILTER; FIT (Impersonate takes only the customer ID); Proposed

criterion: **Given** an Administrator, or an Agent for a customer of the agent's own outlet (IAM-026), starts impersonation of a business customer that has an assigned account manager, **when** the IAM-026 filter evaluates the request, **then** the CRM-015 rule provider does not refuse it: the assignment rule applies only to users in the AccountManager role (BR-CRM-070).
**Given** impersonation starts and finishes, **when** the native activity log runs, **then** activities Impersonation.Started and Impersonation.Finished are recorded.

**Given** a template for a document type, language and store with tokens (for example %Order.OrderNumber%), **when** it is saved, **then** every token must be known to a token provider — native IMessageTokenProvider groups (store, order, shipment, customer, vendor, product, gift card, return request) or a module provider registered through IC-DOC-02; an unknown token refuses the save with message Doc.TemplateTokenUnknown.
basis: D; FC-M02-035; FIT (5.00.1: IMessageTokenProvider — GetListOfAllowedTokensAsync(messageTemplate, tokenGroups) and AddReturnRequestTokensAsync(tokens, returnRequest, order, orderItem, languageId) changed signature in 5.00, Libraries/Nop.Services/Messages/IMessageTokenProvider.cs:91, 211; the forum and news token groups left core; ITokenizer.Replace; EntityTokensAddedEvent)

criterion: **Given** an active template and a source record, **when** a document is generated (IC-DOC-01), **then** tokens are replaced with the record values (ITokenizer.Replace) and line tables are filled from the record lines; if a token marked required has no value, generation fails with message Doc.GenerationDataMissing naming it and no document is stored.
**Given** a document is generated, **when** generation completes, **then** the result is stored in DOC-002 as a new document or a new version, linked to the source record.
**Given** a template allows PDF, DOCX, image (PNG) and HTML outputs, **when** the user requests each format, **then** each is produced from the same template and data; PDF is always available.

**Given** the template exists in the customer's language, **when** a document is generated for that customer, **then** it is produced in that language; if not, in the store default language; for a language with Language.Rtl true the layout is right to left and uses PdfSettings.RtlFontName.

**Given** branding is set for the store, **when** a document is generated, **then** it carries the logo (template logo, else PdfSettings.LogoPictureId), the seal image and signing officer's designation set on the template, and footer texts (PdfSettings.InvoiceFooterTextColumn1 and 2 for invoices).
**Given** a watermark rule applies to the document type or state (DOC-003), **when** a document is rendered, **then** the watermark text is drawn on every page.
**Given** QR codes are enabled for the document type, **when** a document is generated, **then** it carries a QR code encoding the verification URL of that document (DOC-003).

**Given** an active invoice template exists for the store, **when** an invoice PDF is requested from the admin order page, the storefront order page (GetPdfInvoice) or attached to an order e-mail (OrderSettings.AttachPdfInvoiceTo...Email via SaveOrderPdfToDiskAsync), **then** the PDF is rendered from the template through the DOC override of IPdfService (PrintOrderToPdfAsync, PrintOrdersToPdfAsync, SaveOrderPdfToDiskAsync), with the invoice data supplied by the ORD-009 token provider (IC-ORD-07, registered through IC-DOC-02); the vendor parameter still limits the lines to that vendor's items.
basis: D; FIT (5.00.1: IPdfService unchanged, Libraries/Nop.Services/Common/IPdfService.cs:26-73; Admin and storefront OrderController; OrderProcessingService.SaveOrderPdfToDiskAsync calls); OVR-REG

criterion: **Given** ORD-009 has registered its document token provider (IC-ORD-07) through IC-DOC-02 and supplied the Invoice and ConsolidatedReceipt template content, **when** an invoice or consolidated receipt is rendered, **then** the sub-order list, seller name and tax number, company tax fields and fee lines come from the ORD tokens and the layout from the active DOC-001 template; ORD registers no IPdfService implementation (BR-DOC-001).

**Given** an active packing-slip template exists, **when** a packaging slip is printed from admin (PrintPackagingSlipToPdfAsync, PrintPackagingSlipsToPdfAsync), **then** it is rendered from the template.
**Given** no active template exists for a document type and store, **when** that document is requested, **then** the native nopCommerce rendering is used unchanged.

**Given** PAY-025 returns a fiscal number and QR payload for an invoice, **when** the invoice is rendered, **then** they are printed through the PAY token provider registered with DOC (IC-DOC-02); PAY does not override IPdfService (BR-DOC-001).

**Given** an AI-009 or AI-004 draft (contract, letter) is created from an active DOC-001 template, **when** the draft is saved, **then** it is stored in DOC-002 as a Draft document labelled as AI-generated; it becomes Final and can be issued or sent only after a person edits or approves it (DOC-004 review where the type requires review, otherwise the issuing staff member's explicit approval), and the approver is audited (AUD-DOC-002, BR-DOC-003).

**Given** an order carries order-total adjustments recorded by the CAT-042 order-total host (OrderTotalAdjustment rows, BR-CAT-033; for example the PAY-009 wallet deduction under WAL-01 option (b)), **when** its invoice or consolidated receipt is rendered, **then** the template token %Order.TotalAdjustments%, registered by CAT through IC-DOC-02 and read from IC-CAT-06 GetOrderAdjustments, prints one line per adjustment with its label and amount, so the printed total equals the order total; DOC stores no adjustment data and calls no PAY or CAT service itself — held by WAL-01 (option (b) only).

**Given** a document is stored (generated, uploaded or received), **when** it is saved, **then** a DocumentRecord holds type, number, owner (customer, vendor), source entity, language, retention class and status, and a DocumentVersion holds the binary as a native Download (DownloadId), format, SHA-256 hash (DOC-003), created by and created on; uploads pass ADM-008 checks first.
**Given** a document is regenerated, edited or superseded, **when** the new content is saved, **then** a new version is added and becomes current; earlier versions remain listable and downloadable.

**Given** documents exist, **when** a user with Documents.Core.Documents.View searches by type, number, owner, source entity, language or date range, **then** matching documents are listed with their current version.

**Given** text was extracted when a PDF, DOCX or text document was stored, **when** a user searches for a word in the content, **then** documents containing it are listed; scanned images are searchable only after OCR (DOC-005, AI-005).

**Given** a document type has a retention class registered as a PLT-020 record type (IC-PLT-08, hold check = legal hold), **when** the PLT-020 retention task runs, **then** documents past their period are disposed of by the rule action unless under legal hold (BR-DOC-010).

**Given** a legal hold is placed on a document, on all documents of an entity (for example a customer or order) or on a document type, with a reason, **when** anyone tries to delete a held document or the retention task reaches it, **then** deletion is refused with message Doc.LegalHoldActive and the retention task skips it (BR-DOC-010).

**Given** a legal hold is released by a user with Documents.Core.LegalHold.CreateEditDelete, **when** the release is saved, **then** the documents become subject to normal retention again; placing and releasing are audited (AUD-DOC-003).

**Given** a registered buyer or a seller, **when** they upload a document to their vault with type and expiry date, **then** the file is checked by ADM-008 under the DOC context document vault (IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload) and stored as their document, and can be attached to later processes (DOC-005) without uploading again; another customer or vendor cannot open it, also not through the native download actions (BR-DOC-011).
**Given** a vault document has an expiry date, **when** the date passes, **then** it is marked expired and is no longer accepted by DOC-005 requirements that need a valid document.
**Given** a document version is stored, **when** storage completes, **then** its SHA-256 hash is stored with the version and written to the audit trail (AUD-DOC-001).

**Given** a stored version, **when** a user or the scheduled integrity check verifies it, **then** the hash is recomputed; Match or Mismatch is recorded; a mismatch raises an alert and an ADM-009 exception.

**Given** a QR code on a document is scanned, **when** the verification page opens, **then** it shows document type, number, issue date, version and whether the stored hash matches, with no personal data.

**Given** organisational signing is configured with the external signing service (IC-DOC-04), **when** a document type marked "sign" is generated, **then** the PDF is signed by the service, the signature details (signer, time, certificate reference) are stored and the signed file becomes the current version.
**Given** a signed document, **when** its signature is verified, **then** the result (valid, invalid, expired certificate) is shown and stored.

**Given** a watermark rule (for example "DRAFT" while a document is in review, "COPY" when staff download a final document again), **when** a document matching the rule is rendered or downloaded, **then** the watermark is applied by DOC-001 at render or download; the stored original is unchanged.

**Given** a document type requires review, **when** a draft is created, **then** it is submitted as an ADM-006 approval item (IC-ADM-03 Submit, object type Document) to the review chain; reviewers add comments; the DOC review service implements the IC-ADM-03 OnApproved and OnRejected callbacks; it becomes Final only when the last reviewer approves, and the Final version is locked (SM-DOC-01).
**Given** a reviewer rejects, **when** they give a reason, **then** the document returns to Draft with the reason shown to the author; every reviewer action is audited (AUD-DOC-002).

**Given** a user with Documents.Core.Export.Create selects documents by filter (type, owner, entity, date range), **when** they run the export, **then** a background job produces a ZIP with the current versions, a manifest (metadata per file), the SHA-256 hash of each file and the access and change log of each document (chain of custody); the package hash is recorded and the export is audited (AUD-DOC-004).
**Given** an export package is ready, **when** its download period ends (setting, default not stated), **then** the package is deleted and the export shows Expired.

**Given** a requirement set for a process (ADM-004 transaction type, SEL-002 seller onboarding, EGV-002 service application) lists document types as mandatory or optional with allowed formats, maximum size and whether a valid expiry date is needed, **when** an applicant submits without a mandatory document, **then** submission is refused with message Doc.DocumentMissing naming it; the allowed formats and maximum size of each requirement are held as an ADM-008 upload context that DOC registers (IC-ADM-08 RegisterUploadContext), not as a DOC check.

**Given** a document is uploaded for a requirement, **when** it is received, **then** the DOC upload endpoint calls IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload with the requirement's context, so file type, size and scanning are decided by ADM-008 (Adm.UploadTypeNotAllowed, Adm.UploadTooLarge) and DOC keeps no type or size check of its own; a document that needs an expiry date is refused when expired (message Doc.DocumentExpired).

**Given** OCR is configured (AI-005, IC-DOC-06), **when** a scanned document is uploaded, **then** the service extracts the fields of that document type; each field is compared with the profile and marked Match, Mismatch or Unreadable; any Mismatch or Unreadable sends the document to manual review (ADM-006) instead of rejecting it; the extracted fields and any identity-document check result (AI-005) are shown to the reviewer as suggestions and the reviewer decides (BR-DOC-040).

**Given** the document carries a digital signature, **when** it is validated through the signing service (IC-DOC-04), **then** the signature result is stored with the document and an invalid signature sends it to manual review.
**Given** a vault document of the applicant (DOC-002) matches a required type and is valid, **when** the applicant attaches it, **then** it satisfies the requirement without a new upload.

**Given** no IC-DOC-06 provider is registered (AI pack not installed) or the provider answers service unavailable, **when** a document is uploaded for a requirement, **then** the document passes the requirement checks of stories 01 and 02 and is placed in manual review (ADM-006) with no extracted fields; the reviewer records Accepted or Rejected with a reason; no step of DOC-005 waits for or fails because of AI-005 (BR-DOC-040).

**Given** an export order with cross-border fields (CAT-015: origin, HS code) and Incoterms (ORD-026), **when** export staff generate the commercial invoice, **then** it is produced from the commercial-invoice template (DOC-001) with seller and buyer, Incoterm code and named place (ORD token provider IC-ORD-07, ORD-026 data), currency, lines with HS code, country of origin and duty note (CAT-015 token provider registered through IC-DOC-02), quantity and value, and is stored in DOC-002.
basis: D; REQ-KTDA-LEG-001 (trade-regulation documents); Inference from REQ-KTDA-CUS-002 (international buyers)

criterion: **Given** a shipment exists for the export order, **when** export staff generate the packing list, **then** it is produced from the shipment (Shipment, ShipmentItem) with packages, quantities, net and gross weights and dimensions where recorded.

**Given** the certificate of origin is required for the order, **when** export staff produce it, **then** a certificate-of-origin document is generated from the client template, or, where an authority issues it, its number, issuing body and date are recorded and the scanned certificate is attached (DOC-002).

**Given** a phytosanitary certificate has been issued by the competent authority, **when** export staff record it, **then** its reference number, issuing authority and issue date are recorded on the export set and the scan attached; the product does not issue the certificate.
**Given** an export set is incomplete, **when** export staff open the order, **then** the set shows which of the four documents are missing (message Doc.ExportSetIncomplete).

**Given** an agency administrator creates a service, **when** it is saved, **then** it is a native product of the agency vendor with: name and short description (definition), price = fee, full description = process, shipping disabled unless the service has a physical output (EGV-004), and one required FileUpload product attribute per required document with allowed file types and maximum size.
**Given** a service exists, **when** the agency administrator changes its fee, **then** new applications use the new fee; existing orders keep the fee stored on their order items.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-307; FIT (OrderItem prices stored at placement)

criterion: **Given** a service exists, **when** the agency administrator adds or removes a required document, **then** new applications require the changed set; submitted applications keep the documents they were submitted with.

**Given** published e-Government services exist, **when** a citizen searches with a word in the service name or description, **then** matching services are returned by the active search provider (SRC module) and can be filtered by the agency category.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-089; FIT (search; Search.Lucene is still a stub in 5.00.1, Plugins/Nop.Plugin.Search.Lucene/LuceneSearchProvider.cs:10, PAID-STUB)

criterion: **Given** a citizen opens a service, **when** the page is shown, **then** it shows the fee, the list of required documents with allowed file types, the process text, the agency, and the delivery options configured for the service (delivery, collection at an outlet, or none).

**Given** an agency vendor and its category exist, **when** a service is created by a user of that agency, **then** the service is assigned to that vendor automatically and placed in the agency category; users of other agencies cannot see it in admin.
**Given** a service is unpublished, **when** a citizen searches or opens its address, **then** it is not listed and cannot be applied for (native Published).

**Given** a published service has no Published ADM-002 workflow definition and version assigned (EgvServiceConfig, EGV-006), **when** a citizen adds it to the cart, **then** the EGV cart check provider (IC-CHK-01, called by the single IShoppingCartService override owned by CHK-003 under OVR-REG) returns message Egv.WorkflowRequired and the item is not added — held by WF-ENG.

**Given** the feature state productfeature.<prd-id> of PRD-EGV-001 is off for store S (IC-PLT-02), **when** a citizen of S opens My account or an agency user opens the EGV admin pages for S, **then** the EGV pages, widgets and actions are not shown for S and the EGV scheduled tasks skip S; e-Government service products are native and stay governed by Published and store mapping (BR-EGV-014).

**Given** a registered citizen opens a service and every required FileUpload attribute has a file, **when** the citizen adds it to the cart and places the order, **then** one ServiceApplication is created per order line of an e-Government service with status AwaitingFee and one ApplicationDocument per uploaded file (SM-EGV-01, SM-EGV-02).

**Given** a ServiceApplication is created, **when** the creation is saved, **then** the module event ServiceRequest.Submitted (application, service, agency, citizen, time) is raised once for INT-003 and other consumers.
**Given** a required document is missing, **when** the citizen adds the service to the cart, **then** the native required-attribute warning is shown and the item is not added.

**Given** an application is AwaitingFee, **when** the order becomes Paid (through PAY), **then** the application becomes UnderReview; an OrderPaidEvent consumer starts this and a reconciliation task moves any application whose order is Paid but still AwaitingFee (BR-EGV-003).
**Given** an application is AwaitingFee, **when** the order is cancelled (INV-004 timeout or the citizen), **then** the application becomes Cancelled.

**Given** a FileUpload attribute of an e-Government service allows only some file types and EGV has registered its upload context (e-Government application document) with ADM-008, **when** a file of another type, or over the size limit, is uploaded on the product page or on the application page, **then** the ADM-008 upload policy refuses it on the server before anything is stored, with message Adm.UploadTypeNotAllowed or Adm.UploadTooLarge, applying the stricter of the attribute limits (ValidationFileAllowedExtensions, ValidationFileMaximumSize) and the context policy (BR-ADM-060); EGV has no upload filter of its own.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-333; decision SINGLE-FILTER; FIT (native upload checks size only; extensions are checked only in the browser)

criterion: **Given** a file is accepted, **when** it is stored, **then** the file is stored as a native Download record, SEC-002 records its UploadOwnership (download GUID, uploading customer, product; BR-SEC-005) and EGV links the Download to the ApplicationDocument.

**Given** a Download linked to an ApplicationDocument exists, **when** anyone other than the uploading customer, a user of the owning agency or an administrator requests it through DownloadController.GetFileUpload or Admin DownloadController.DownloadFile, **then** the single SEC-002 download ownership filter, applying the EGV rule provider for e-Government files, refuses it with message Sec.FileAccessDenied and SEC logs the attempt (BR-SEC-005, BR-EGV-004).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-333; decision SINGLE-FILTER; FIT (native GetFileUpload has no ownership check)

criterion: **Given** an application is UnderReview, **when** the officer marks a document Rejected with a reason and requests resubmission, **then** the application becomes ResubmissionRequested, the citizen is notified with the reason and message Egv.ResubmissionRequested, and the rejected document stays stored with its status.

**Given** an application is ResubmissionRequested, **when** the citizen uploads a replacement on the application page, **then** a new ApplicationDocument version is stored after the same ADM-008 checks and the application returns to UnderReview.

**Given** an application is UnderReview and every required document is Accepted, **when** the officer approves, **then** the application becomes Approved; approval with any document not Accepted is refused with message Egv.DocumentsNotAccepted (BR-EGV-005).

**Given** an application is UnderReview, **when** the officer rejects it with a reason, **then** the application becomes Rejected, the citizen is notified, and if EgvServiceConfig.RefundOnRejection is on for the service EGV calls IC-RET-04 RaiseRefundTrigger with source type ApplicationRejected, the order line and the amount EGV computes (the amount paid for that service line); RET-005 sends the refund to PAY-016.

**Given** an application is Approved, **when** the officer records the issued document reference, **then** the application becomes Issued; without a physical output it then becomes Closed; with one, EGV-004 applies.

**Given** an application exists, **when** the citizen opens My account, Applications, **then** the status, the date of each change, the reason of any rejection or resubmission request, and any appointment (EGV-003) or shipment tracking (EGV-004) are shown.
**Given** the application status changes, **when** the change is saved, **then** the citizen receives a notification on the channels configured in TRK-005 for that status (message keys Egv.Status.*).

**Given** a Published ADM-002 workflow definition and version are assigned to the service (EGV-006), **when** an application of that service is created, **then** EGV requests a case of that definition version through IC-ADM-01 StartCase (business key ServiceApplication and its Id, idempotency key the application Id) and stores the case Id on the application; the application runs as that case: EGV signals the case (IC-ADM-01 CompleteTask / Signal) on fee paid, document decisions and issue, and Approved can be set only after the case has completed the steps before approval (BR-EGV-005) — held by WF-ENG.
**Given** two officers act on the same application at once, **when** the second saves, **then** the change is refused because the application was changed (row version), and the officer reloads it.

**Given** the TRK-005 engine asks the EGV order-kind provider (IC-TRK-05) about an order before sending OrderCompleted.CustomerNotification, **when** the order lines are all e-Government service lines, or the order holds any other line, **then** the provider returns order kind e-Government in the first case and none in the second; it sends no message itself, and TRK-005 applies the action configured for the kind (BR-TRK-024).

**Given** a service has an in-person step and CAT-027 slots are configured for the outlets that handle it, **when** the application reaches the step that needs a visit, **then** the citizen is offered the free slots of those outlets and books one through IC-CAT-07 Book (a direct booking, Confirmed with no cart or order item, SM-CAT-05); the returned BookingId is stored on the application and shown on the application page; a full slot is refused with message Cat.SlotFull.
**Given** no slot is free at any outlet for the service, **when** the citizen opens the booking step, **then** message Egv.NoSlotAvailable is shown and the application stays at its step.

**Given** a citizen cancels or changes an appointment before it starts, **when** the change is confirmed, **then** EGV calls IC-CAT-07 Release for the booking (SM-CAT-05 Released); for a change it then books the new slot with IC-CAT-07 Book and stores the new BookingId.

**Given** an appointment is booked, changed or cancelled, **when** the change is saved, **then** the citizen receives a confirmation through TRK-005 with the date, time, outlet address and application reference.
**Given** an appointment is booked, **when** the reminder lead time before it is reached, **then** a reminder is sent through TRK-005 (lead time is a setting, default not stated).

**Given** a citizen arrives for a booked appointment, **when** outlet staff check in the appointment, **then** the check-in time and staff member are recorded on the application history; audited (AUD-EGV-001).

**Given** a service with a physical output is set with shipping enabled and the delivery methods and pickup points allowed for it, **when** the citizen checks out, **then** the native shipping step offers the allowed delivery methods (fee from LOG-002) and collection at the allowed pickup points (Pickup.PickupInStore).
