**Given** an application is Issued, **when** the officer selects Hand over for delivery, **then** a native shipment is created for the order line with the tracking number from LOG (S10 or carrier, LOG-020 / LOG-021) and the application history records the hand-over.

**Given** an application is not Issued, **when** anyone submits shipment creation for its order line (admin AddShipment or any code calling IShipmentService.InsertShipmentAsync), **then** the EGV shipment-guard provider (IC-ORD-11) registered with the ORD-010 shipment-guard host refuses it: the host action filter on Admin OrderController.AddShipment [POST] shows message Egv.ShipmentNotAllowed before the call, and the host InsertShipmentAsync override refuses the insert for other callers; no shipment is saved (BR-EGV-008).
**Given** a shipment exists, **when** the citizen opens the application or the order, **then** the tracking number and shipment status are shown (native shipment details) with events from TRK-002.

**Given** collection was chosen and the document reaches the outlet, **when** outlet staff mark it ready, **then** native ReadyForPickupAsync runs and the native ShipmentReadyForPickup.CustomerNotification is sent.

**Given** the citizen collects or the courier delivers, **when** staff confirm with the recipient identity check required by the service, **then** native DeliverAsync runs, the application becomes Closed and the identity check is recorded.

**Given** an order line of an agency service becomes Paid, **when** the payment is recorded, **then** a RemittanceLine is created with status Due for the fee amount of the line (excluding delivery fees) for that agency (SM-EGV-03, BR-EGV-009).

**Given** the agency has an active connector, **when** a RemittanceLine becomes Due, **then** a fee notification (agency, service, application reference, amount, paid date) is queued and sent through IC-EGV-01 NotifyFeePaid; failures are retried by the scheduled task and listed for finance staff.

**Given** Due lines exist for an agency, **when** finance staff create a remittance batch for a period, **then** the lines move to Batched and the batch total equals the sum of its lines; audited (AUD-EGV-003).

**Given** a batch is Batched, **when** finance staff record the payment reference and date, **then** the lines become Remitted; when the agency confirms (connector or manual entry) they become Confirmed.
**Given** a Due line is refunded before batching (PAY-016), **when** the refund completes, **then** the line becomes Reversed and is not batched.

**Given** a Remitted or Confirmed line is refunded, **when** the refund completes, **then** a recovery line with the negative amount is created as Due for that agency and appears in the next batch (BR-EGV-009).

**Given** an agency report format is configured (columns, file type), **when** the report is run for a period, **then** it lists collected, refunded, remitted and outstanding amounts per service and application reference in that format and can be sent through IC-EGV-01 RemittanceReport.
**Given** an agency administrator runs the report, **when** the report is shown, **then** only lines of the own agency are included.

**Given** the client administrator creates a vendor for the agency and an agency administrator user, **when** both are saved, **then** the user has Customer.VendorId = the agency vendor and the AgencyAdmin role; the agency category is created for its services.

**Given** an agency administrator adds a user on the EGV agency-users page, **when** the user is saved, **then** the user VendorId is forced to the administrator agency and only the roles AgencyOfficer or AgencyAdmin can be assigned; audited (AUD-EGV-002).

**Given** an agency administrator tries to edit a user of another agency or assign any other role, **when** the request is posted, **then** it is refused with message Egv.NotYourAgency and nothing changes.
**Given** an agency user is deactivated, **when** they try to sign in, **then** sign-in is refused (native Customer.Active).
**Given** an agency officer without Catalog.ProductsCreateEditDelete, **when** opens the native product edit page, **then** access is denied natively; the officer can view services only.

**Given** ADM-002 workflow definitions exist for the agency, **when** the agency administrator assigns a definition and version to a service, **then** new applications of the service follow that version; applications already submitted keep the version they started with; audited (AUD-EGV-002) — held by WF-ENG.

**Given** the service is defined as an EGV-001 service with its required documents and an ADM-002 workflow definition, **when** it is published, **then** citizens can apply and the application follows the workflow; no code specific to the service exists (BR-EGV-012) — held by WF-ENG.
**Given** an identity-document service is published, **when** a citizen applies, **then** the EGV-002 flow applies unchanged: documents, fee, review, decision, issue and delivery.

**Given** an External check step of the ADM-002 workflow definition names the EGV identity adapter operation VerifyOrRegister (IC-EGV-02; AC-ADM-002-07-03), **when** the step runs, **then** the request is sent through IC-EGV-02 VerifyOrRegister; the result (IC-IAM-02 values Verified, NotVerified, Inconclusive or Unavailable) and the external reference are stored on the application history and in the case variables; any result other than Verified stops the step and alerts the officer.
**Given** the identity service is not in the priority list received from Malawi Post, **when** the list is applied, **then** no identity service is configured (REQ-MPC-FR-350 "if included").

**Given** a partner lender is created with at least one loan product, target audience (sellers or buyers), and the list of data categories it may receive, **when** the partner is saved and activated, **then** it appears in the partner list with status Active; credentials are stored encrypted, flagged secret in the key catalogue of the partner adapter, refused by the pack loader and omitted from exports (BR-FIN-010, BR-PLT-013).

**Given** an Active partner has an Active loan product for sellers, **when** a seller opens the Finance page in the seller portal, **then** the product is listed with the partner name, the product name and the description supplied by the partner; the platform shows no rate, limit or decision of its own (BR-FIN-001).

**Given** the feature state productfeature.<prd-id> of PRD-FIN-001 is off for store S (IC-PLT-02), **when** a seller of S opens the seller portal or a buyer of S views a product with a linked loan product, **then** the Finance page and the offer link are not shown, and the FIN scheduled tasks skip S (BR-FIN-011).

**Given** an Active partner has an Active loan product for buyers linked to a product category, **when** a buyer views a product in that category, **then** an offer link for the loan product is shown on the product page; selecting it starts the referral flow of story 01 for the buyer.

**Given** the seller selects Apply on a loan product, **when** the consent step opens, **then** it lists the partner, the data categories of that product and the purpose, using the consent text of the country profile (SEC-012, read through IC-SEC-03 GetProfile); nothing is sent until the seller agrees.
**Given** the seller does not agree, **when** they leave or decline the consent step, **then** no data is sent, no referral is created and message Fin.ConsentRequired is shown.

**Given** the seller agrees, **when** the referral is submitted, **then** the consent is recorded through IAM IC-IAM-05 RecordAcceptance (customer, policy FinancePartnerDataSharing with the country-profile text version or "unversioned", decision accepted, partner, purpose, data categories) and FIN keeps only the returned acceptance id on the referral; a FinanceReferral is created with status Referred, the consented data set is sent through IC-FIN-01 SubmitApplication and the referral becomes Submitted (SM-FIN-01); audited (AUD-FIN-001).

**Given** a consent exists, **when** the seller withdraws it in My account, **then** FIN records the withdrawal through IC-IAM-05 RecordAcceptance (decision withdrawn, same partner and purpose); before every later send FIN reads IC-IAM-05 GetActiveConsent and sends nothing to that partner; the partner is notified through IC-FIN-01 WithdrawConsent; audited (AUD-FIN-001).
**Given** a data category is not in the loan product scope, **when** the data set is built, **then** that category is not included; only categories in the consented scope are sent (BR-FIN-002).

**Given** a referral is Submitted, **when** the lender posts a status (Approved, Declined, Disbursed, Closed) to the FIN callback route, **then** the callback signature or token is verified, the status is recorded with the lender reference following SM-FIN-01, and the seller is notified; an invalid callback is rejected and audited (AUD-FIN-005).

**Given** a loan is Disbursed and the lender sent a repayment instruction (fixed amount or share per settlement, outstanding balance), **when** SEL-017 calculates the next settlement for that seller, **then** FIN has supplied the charge through IC-SEL-05 AddSellerCharge (source type RepaymentDeduction, instructed amount or, for basis Share, the instructed share of the batch net, outstanding balance as cap, lender and loan reference); SEL-017 adds one deduction line capped at the lowest of the instructed amount, the outstanding balance and the batch net (BR-SEL-012, BR-FIN-003); it appears on the seller statement with the lender reference.

**Given** a repayment deduction is included in a paid settlement, **when** the settlement is paid, **then** the SEL event Seller.SettlementPaid (IC-SEL-07) is consumed (the consumer only enqueues a job), the deduction is reported to the lender through IC-FIN-01 ReportRepayment with the settlement reference, and the outstanding balance on the RepaymentInstruction is reduced by the deducted amount.

**Given** a member of finance staff suspends a repayment instruction with a reason, **when** the next settlement is calculated, **then** FIN supplies no charge through IC-SEL-05 for that loan while it is Suspended, so no deduction is made; audited (AUD-FIN-002).
**Given** the lender reports the loan Closed, **when** the status is received, **then** the repayment instruction ends and no further deductions are made.

**Given** an on-account invoice has a receivable in PAY-033 state Open (SM-PAY-09) payable to the seller, is not disputed and is not Offered or Assigned, **when** the seller opens Invoice discounting, **then** the invoice is listed as eligible with amount, due date and buyer name; invoices outside these conditions are not listed (BR-FIN-004).

**Given** the seller selects an eligible invoice and an Active discounting partner, and agrees to the consent step, **when** the request is submitted, **then** FIN calls IC-PAY-08 LockForOffer and the receivable becomes Offered (SM-PAY-09); an InvoiceFinancing record is created with status Offered and the invoice data and PDF (ORD-009) are sent through IC-FIN-01 ShareInvoice (SM-FIN-02); if LockForOffer is refused (not open, already offered or assigned, disputed) no record is created and nothing is sent.

**Given** an invoice is Offered, **when** the lender reports acceptance with the advance amount, the discount and its remit-to details, **then** the record becomes Financed; FIN calls IC-PAY-08 Assign with the lender and its remit-to details and the receivable becomes Assigned with the lender as payee (SM-PAY-09); the early payment to the seller is made by the lender outside the platform; audited (AUD-FIN-003).
**Given** an invoice is Offered, **when** the lender declines, **then** the record becomes Declined and FIN calls IC-PAY-08 ReleaseLock, so the receivable is Open again (SM-PAY-09).

**Given** a receivable is Assigned, **when** the buyer opens the statement (PAY-033), **then** the invoice shows the lender as the party to pay and its remit-to details instead of the seller (PAY-033 statement, payee on the receivable).

**Given** a payment for an Assigned receivable is received by the client instead of the lender, **when** it is allocated (PAY-033), **then** the allocation is flagged "assigned — not for seller payout" by PAY (BR-PAY-131) and listed for finance staff to forward to the lender; it is not paid out to the seller (BR-FIN-004).

**Given** the lender reports that the buyer paid, **when** the status is received, **then** the InvoiceFinancing record becomes Settled with the lender reference and FIN calls IC-PAY-08 AllocateExternal with the reported amount and the lender reference, so the PAY-033 receivable becomes Settled when allocations reach its full amount (SM-PAY-09).

**Given** transit insurance is configured as a checkout attribute linked to a partner insurer, with the premium rule supplied by the insurer, **when** the buyer reaches the confirm step, **then** the option is shown with its premium and the insurer name; when selected the premium is added to the order total (native CheckoutAttribute price adjustment).

**Given** transit insurance is configured with a fixed premium per option value, **when** the buyer selects an option and places the order, **then** the order total includes exactly that premium and the order records the selected option in its checkout attributes.

**Given** an order with transit insurance becomes Paid (OrderPaidEvent), **when** the event is handled, **then** the consumer only enqueues an issue job; the scheduled task calls IC-FIN-02 IssuePolicy and stores the policy number on an InsurancePolicy record linked to the order (SM-FIN-03); the buyer receives it by the order notification channels (TRK-005).

**Given** policy issuance fails after the configured retries, **when** the last retry fails, **then** the policy becomes Failed, finance staff are alerted, and FIN calls IC-RET-04 RaiseRefundTrigger with source type PolicyIssueFailed, the order line or checkout-attribute share that carried the premium and the amount FIN computes (the premium paid for that policy) (BR-FIN-005).

**Given** an insured order is cancelled or fully refunded before dispatch, **when** the refund completes (PAY-016), **then** the policy is cancelled through IC-FIN-02 CancelPolicy and the premium is part of the refund.

**Given** a partner insurance product (equipment or crop) is listed in the partner services catalogue (FIN-005), **when** a seller or farmer selects it, **then** the FIN-005 hand-off or integrated mode applies; for integrated mode the policy request is sent through IC-FIN-02 IssuePolicy and the result stored as in story 04.

**Given** an Issued policy exists, **when** the policy holder opens a claim with a description and at least one evidence file, **then** an InsuranceClaim is created with status Submitted, files are stored as Download records, and the claim is sent through IC-FIN-02 SubmitClaim (SM-FIN-04).

**Given** a claim is Submitted, **when** the insurer posts a status (UnderReview, Approved with amount, Rejected with reason, Settled), **then** the verified status is recorded and shown to the policy holder in My account; settlement money moves outside the platform.
**Given** a user who is not the policy holder, **when** opens the claim page or its evidence files, **then** access is denied (BR-FIN-006).

**Given** programme staff create a scheme with eligible customer role, eligible products or categories, fixed or percentage subsidy, start and end dates and a budget amount, **when** the scheme is saved, **then** a native discount is created with the FIN subsidy requirement rule (an IDiscountRequirementRule plugin) and the native customer-role requirement; the budget is stored on the SubsidyScheme; audited (AUD-FIN-004).

**Given** a buyer is in the eligible role and the scheme has budget left, **when** the buyer views an eligible product and adds it to the cart, **then** the subsidy is shown as a separate line labelled with the scheme name and deducted from the price; the order records the scheme and the subsidy amount.

**Given** granting the subsidy would exceed the remaining budget, **when** the cart is calculated, **then** the FIN requirement rule fails, no subsidy is applied and message Fin.SubsidyBudgetExhausted is shown (BR-FIN-007).

**Given** two buyers place orders that together would exceed the remaining budget, **when** both orders are placed at the same time, **then** the FIN placement participant (IC-CHK-06 Reserve, called by the CHK-003 PlaceOrderAsync override) reserves the subsidy under ILocker key 'fin-scheme-{SchemeId}'; the second Reserve is refused with message Fin.SubsidyBudgetExhausted and that placement is refused; Confirm consumes the reserved amount and Release returns it (BR-FIN-007).

**Given** a customer applies for eligibility (through ORD-024 or the scheme page) with the identifiers the registry needs, **when** the registry check returns Eligible through IC-FIN-04 CheckEligibility, **then** the customer is added to the scheme role with the expiry date returned or configured; Not eligible leaves the roles unchanged and shows message Fin.NotEligible.
**Given** an eligibility expires, **when** the daily FIN task runs, **then** the customer is removed from the scheme role and no subsidy applies from then on.

**Given** orders with subsidies exist, **when** programme staff run the claim report for a scheme and period, **then** each subsidised order line is listed with customer, product, subsidy amount and order status; refunded lines are shown as reversals; the report exports to file.

**Given** an order with a subsidy is refunded in part or in full (PAY-016), **when** the refund completes, **then** the subsidy amount for the refunded share is returned to the scheme budget (BR-FIN-007); a cancelled order returns its whole subsidy.

**Given** partner services are set up as products with shipping disabled (IsShipEnabled off) in a partner-services category, each linked to a partner, **when** a customer opens the category or searches, **then** each service is shown with name, partner, description, and fee or price where one applies.
**Given** a service is in mode Information only, **when** the customer opens it, **then** the description and partner contact are shown and the buy button is disabled (native DisableBuyButton).

**Given** a service is in mode Hand-off, **when** the customer selects Continue with partner, **then** the partner URL opens with the referral reference and the referral is recorded (partner, service, customer if signed in, time).

**Given** a service is in mode Integrated with a required account-reference text attribute and, where the partner allows, a customer-entered amount (native CustomerEntersPrice), **when** the customer enters the reference, **then** the reference is validated through IC-FIN-03 ValidateAccount before add to cart; an invalid reference shows message Fin.AccountInvalid.

**Given** an order line of an Integrated service becomes Paid (OrderPaidEvent), **when** the event is handled, **then** the consumer only enqueues a fulfilment job; the task calls IC-FIN-03 Fulfil; on success the PartnerFulfilment becomes Fulfilled, the partner receipt reference is stored on the order line, added as an order note and shown to the customer (SM-FIN-05).

**Given** fulfilment fails after the configured retries, **when** the last retry fails, **then** the fulfilment becomes Failed, finance staff are alerted and FIN calls IC-RET-04 RaiseRefundTrigger with source type PartnerFulfilmentFailed, the order line and the amount FIN computes (the amount paid for that line) (BR-FIN-005).

**Given** a partner service is unpublished, or not mapped to a store, **when** a customer browses that store, **then** the service is not shown and cannot be bought there (native Published and StoreMapping).

**Given** the service is ticketing, **when** the customer pays, **then** when SVC-009 (P2) is delivered the e-ticket is issued by SVC-009 (see SVC-009 (REQ-MPC-FR-336)); until then (P1) ticketing services are not offered for sale, because no e-ticket can be issued.

**Given** registration type is Standard, **when** a visitor submits a unique email address and a password that meets the policy (IAM-003), **then** a customer record is created in the Registered role, it is active, the visitor is signed in and the native Customer.WelcomeMessage email is sent.

**Given** an account with email E exists, **when** someone registers with email E, **then** registration is refused with the native message Account.Register.Errors.EmailAlreadyExists and no second record is created (BR-IAM-002).

**Given** a registered customer has saved addresses and placed orders, **when** the customer logs in again later, **then** the saved addresses are offered and the earlier orders are listed in My account.

**Given** the email, phone or request IP address matches an Active Block entry of the SEL-013 list with scope registration or all, **when** the registration POST is made (native CustomerController.Register or the IAM mobile registration), **then** no account is created and the SEL-013 block message is shown; the check is the Platform core action filter owned by SEL-013, not an IAM filter (BR-IAM-003).

**Given** a registered, active customer without MFA, **when** the correct email and password are entered, **then** the customer is signed in and LastLoginDateUtc is set; with MFA the second step of IAM-004 follows.

**Given** a registered customer, **when** a wrong password is entered, **then** login is refused with the native message Account.Login.WrongCredentials and FailedLoginAttempts increases (lockout per IAM-003).

**Given** a guest has items in the basket, **when** the guest registers in the same browser session, **then** the guest customer record itself becomes Registered, so its basket and any guest order stay on the account.
basis: D; FIT (RegisterCustomerAsync converts the current customer record)

criterion: **Given** registration type is EmailValidation, **when** a visitor registers, **then** the account stays inactive until the link in the native Customer.EmailValidationMessage email is opened; a login before that is refused with Account.Login.WrongCredentials.NotActive.
**Given** registration type is AdminApproval, **when** a visitor registers, **then** the account stays inactive until an administrator activates it in the user administration console (IAM-010).
**Given** registration type is Disabled, **when** a visitor opens the registration page, **then** registration is not possible and the native registration-disabled result page is shown.

**Given** the retail store uses registration type Standard or EmailValidation and CustomerSettings.CompanyRequired is off, **when** a member of the public registers with name, email and password only, **then** the account is created without any organisation or company field.

**Given** mobile registration is enabled, **when** a visitor enters a mobile number, **then** the number is normalised to international format (BR-IAM-010), checked against existing PhoneIdentity records, and a one-time code is sent through the SMS gateway (IC-IAM-01) with message Iam.Otp.Sent.

**Given** a code was sent, **when** the visitor enters the correct code within its validity, **then** a customer record is created in the Registered role with the mobile number as identifier and no email, terms acceptance is recorded (IAM-016) and the visitor is signed in.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-001; FIT (native RegisterCustomerAsync still rejects an empty email and an empty password in 5.00.1, Libraries/Nop.Services/Customers/CustomerRegistrationService.cs:264-281, so the IAM override applies, BR-IAM-011)

criterion: **Given** the number already belongs to an account, **when** a visitor tries to register it, **then** no account is created and message Iam.PhoneInUse is shown with the link to log in.

**Given** a code was sent, **when** the visitor enters a wrong code more times than the configured maximum, **then** the code is invalidated, message Iam.Otp.TooManyAttempts is shown and a new code can be requested only after the resend interval (BR-IAM-012).
**Given** a code was sent, **when** the visitor enters it after its validity ended, **then** it is refused with message Iam.Otp.Expired.
**Given** the SMS gateway is unavailable, **when** a code is requested, **then** message Iam.Otp.Unavailable is shown, no account is created and the failure is logged.

**Given** IAM calls IC-TRK-06 CheckAllowed (recipient = the number, channel SMS, category Security codes, sender IAM) before each IC-IAM-01 SendCode, and TRK answers Blocked (the number is opted out and the client has not marked Security codes mandatory, BR-TRK-031), **when** a code is requested for that number, **then** no code is sent, message Iam.Otp.Unavailable is shown and the OtpChallenge is not issued; when TRK answers Allowed the code is sent (BR-IAM-150).
basis: Proposed (owner decision: messages outside TRK respect TRK-006 opt-outs; BR-TRK-026)

criterion: **Given** an account is created or a mobile number is changed (IAM registration, native registration, My account), **when** the number is saved, **then** Customer.Phone is saved in E.164 format and kept equal to PhoneIdentity.NormalisedPhone, so the native lookup (ICustomerService.GetCustomerByPhoneAsync: active, not deleted, verified number first) finds the account; a number typed in local format is converted by BR-IAM-010 before the native login or registration action runs, because the native parser expects the international prefix and returns no number otherwise.
basis: D; REQ-MPC-FR-001; FIT (Libraries/Nop.Services/Customers/CustomerService.cs:578-594; Presentation/Nop.Web/Controllers/CustomerController.cs:206-223; Presentation/Nop.Web.Framework/Validators/PhoneNumberPropertyValidator.cs:41-61); Proposed (local-format conversion); VER-500

criterion: **Given** the client has chosen an SMS provider, **when** an administrator holding Configuration.ManageSmsSettings opens Configuration > SMS providers, **then** the provider plugin is installed and marked primary (MessagesSettings.ActiveSmsProviderSystemName); native login codes and the IAM codes sent through IC-IAM-01 use that provider; the bundled Sms.Twilio plugin is used only if the client accepts Twilio, otherwise the local aggregator adapter of CHN-005 is registered as an ISmsProvider plugin.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-001; FIT (Libraries/Nop.Services/Messages/ISmsProvider.cs; Libraries/Nop.Core/Domain/Messages/MessagesSettings.cs:25; Presentation/Nop.Web/Areas/Admin/Controllers/SmsController.cs:46-65; StandardPermission.Configuration.MANAGE_SMS_SETTINGS; Plugins/Nop.Plugin.Sms.Twilio); see CHN-005; VER-500

criterion: **Given** OtpSettings.LoginByPhoneEnabled is on and a visitor registers on the native page with email, password and mobile number, **when** registration succeeds, **then** the native flow sends a code and verifies the number (PhoneVerificationFlowEnum RegisterStandard, RegisterEmailValidation or RegisterAdminApproval) before the result page; a number already verified on another account is refused with Account.IsAlreadyExistsVerifiedPhoneNumber.

**Given** a customer with a registered mobile number, **when** the customer requests a login code and enters it correctly, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500): now native — nopCommerce 5.00.1 signs in by mobile number and one-time code (OtpSettings.LoginByPhoneEnabled; CustomerController.Login, SendOtp and CommonVerificationOtp; CustomerRegistrationService.ValidateCustomerByPhoneAsync), verified by AC-IAM-002-02-04; resolution of customers without an email address stays an IAM override and is specified in AC-IAM-002-02-06. Superseded text: the customer is signed in through ICustomerRegistrationService.SignInCustomerAsync and later requests resolve the customer through the IAM IAuthenticationService override (BR-IAM-011).

**Given** a customer has both an email address and a mobile number, **when** the customer logs in with email and password, or with mobile number and code, **then** both routes sign in the same customer record.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-001; FIT (native in 5.00.1: CustomerController.Login with LoginByPhone, CustomerController.cs:478-483)

criterion: **Given** a customer enters wrong login codes, **when** the native lockout threshold is reached, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500): now native — nopCommerce 5.00.1 locks the login code itself after OtpSettings.OtpFailedAllowedAttempts wrong entries (CustomerController.IsLockedOtpCode, CommonVerificationOtp), verified by AC-IAM-002-02-05; the password lockout (CannotLoginUntilDateUtc) is applied to code login by AC-IAM-002-02-07. Superseded text: the account is locked out exactly as for wrong passwords (CannotLoginUntilDateUtc, IAM-003).

**Given** OtpSettings.LoginByPhoneEnabled is on, an SMS provider is active and a registered, active customer has Customer.Phone stored in international (E.164) format, **when** the customer chooses login by phone on the native login page, requests a code and enters it correctly, **then** the native flow signs the customer in: the code (OtpSettings.OtpLength digits) is sent through ISmsService to the active ISmsProvider, ValidateCustomerByPhoneAsync sets LastLoginDateUtc and Customer.PhoneSmsVerified, and the customer is signed in; a number with no account gets the generic Account.Login.WrongCredentials.

**Given** the native code settings are set per client (OtpSettings.OtpTimeLife in seconds, OtpLength, OtpFailedAllowedAttempts, OtpCountAttemptsToSendCode, OtpTimeToRepeat in minutes; defaults not stated in source), **when** a customer enters an expired code, enters wrong codes up to the allowed number, or requests codes beyond the send limit, **then** the native messages PhoneVerification.OtpCode.Error.Expired, PhoneVerification.OtpCode.Error.Locked and PhoneVerification.OtpCode.Error.AttemptLimit are shown and no sign-in happens; the one-time codes IAM sends itself (registration, recovery, second factor, BR-IAM-012) use the same OtpSettings values, so a client sets code rules once.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-002; FIT (Presentation/Nop.Web/Controllers/CustomerController.cs:595-618, 675-700); Proposed (one set of code settings); VER-500

criterion: **Given** a customer who registered by mobile number has no email address, **when** the customer signs in by mobile number and code and makes later requests, **then** the IAM IAuthenticationService override resolves the customer from the sign-in claims (BR-IAM-011), because the native cookie service adds a mobile-phone claim at sign-in but resolves customers only by the username or email claim and then reads the current password record.

**Given** a customer is locked out after wrong passwords (CannotLoginUntilDateUtc in the future), or holds a role listed in the MFA-required roles setting (IAM-004) or a role listed as sensitive (IAM-003), **when** the customer completes a native login by mobile number and code, **then** the IAM filter on the native code verification refuses the sign-in with the native message Account.Login.WrongCredentials.LockedOut for a locked-out customer, and for an MFA-required or sensitive role requires the password step and the second factor instead; reason: ValidateCustomerByPhoneAsync checks neither the lockout nor MFA (BR-IAM-013).

**Given** a customer with a registered mobile number cannot log in, **when** the customer chooses recovery by SMS and enters the code correctly, **then** the customer can set a new password (where passwords are used) or is signed in, and AUD-IAM-002 is written.
**Given** the customer is in a sensitive role (IAM-003), **when** recovery by SMS is requested, **then** an SMS code alone does not restore access; the extra checks of BR-IAM-020 apply.

**Given** the buyer login factor setting is "password" or "SMS code" or "either", **when** a buyer opens the login page, **then** only the configured factors are offered: "either" is the native OtpSettings.LoginByPhoneEnabled on (the login page offers email and password, and mobile number and code); "password" is LoginByPhoneEnabled off; "SMS code" is LoginByPhoneEnabled on with the email and password fields hidden by the IAM login view override.

**Given** CustomerSettings.PasswordMinLength, PasswordMaxLength and PasswordRequireLowercase / Uppercase / Digit / NonAlphanumeric are set, **when** a user submits a password that breaks one of them at registration, change or reset, **then** the password is refused with the native validation message for that rule.
**Given** CustomerSettings.UnduplicatedPasswordsNumber is greater than 0, **when** a user sets one of that many previous passwords, **then** the password is refused.

**Given** CustomerSettings.PasswordLifetime is set and the user role has EnablePasswordLifetime on, **when** the password is older than the lifetime, **then** every request redirects the user to change the password (native ValidatePasswordAttribute).

**Given** CustomerSettings.FailedPasswordAllowedAttempts is greater than 0, **when** a user enters a wrong password that many times, **then** CannotLoginUntilDateUtc is set to now plus FailedPasswordLockoutMinutes and further logins return the native LockedOut message until then.

**Given** CustomerSettings.NotifyFailedLoginAttempt is on, **when** a wrong password is entered for an existing account, **then** the native Customer.FailedLoginAttempt email is sent to the account owner.

**Given** an active account, **when** the owner requests a reset with the account email, **then** the native Customer.PasswordRecovery email with a one-time link is sent; the link expires after PasswordRecoveryLinkDaysValid days and cannot be used twice.
**Given** CustomerSettings.RequiredReLoginAfterPasswordChange is on, **when** a password is changed, **then** sessions signed in before the change are signed out at their next request.

**Given** the account holds a role listed as sensitive, **when** password recovery is requested for it, **then** no native recovery link is issued (IAM action filter on CustomerController.PasswordRecoverySend [POST]), a recovery request is opened and the same neutral message Iam.RecoveryRequestReceived is shown as for other accounts (BR-IAM-020).
**Given** a recovery request with security questions, **when** the user answers all questions correctly, **then** a one-time reset link is issued; a wrong answer counts as a failed attempt.

**Given** a recovery request needing manager confirmation, **when** another user holding Customers.CustomersCreateEditDelete confirms it, **then** a one-time reset link is issued; the requester cannot confirm their own request; the decision is audited (AUD-IAM-003).

**Given** role R is listed in the MFA-required roles setting, **when** a member of R without a configured MFA provider is signed in, **then** every request is redirected to the native MFA settings page (route MultiFactorAuthenticationSettings) with message Iam.MfaRequired until a provider is configured (BR-IAM-030).

**Given** a member of R has a configured provider, **when** the correct password is entered, **then** ValidateCustomerAsync returns MultiFactorAuthenticationRequired and the login completes only after the provider verification succeeds.

**Given** the product is configured, **when** MultiFactorAuthenticationSettings.ForceMultifactorAuthentication is inspected, **then** it is off, because the native filter would force every holder of Security.EnableMultiFactorAuthentication, including the Registered role; MFA by role is enforced by the IAM filter only.

**Given** an administrator removes the MFA binding of a member of R (native RemoveBindMFA), **when** the member next makes a request, **then** the member must configure a provider again before continuing, and the removal is audited (AUD-IAM-004).

**Given** the email-code provider is active, **when** a user who selected it passes the password step, **then** a code is sent to the account email and the login completes only with the correct code within its validity.

**Given** the SMS-code provider is active, **when** a user who selected it passes the password step, **then** a code is sent through IC-IAM-01 to the verified mobile number and the login completes only with the correct code.

**Given** the hardware-key (FIDO2 / WebAuthn) provider is active and the user registered a key, **when** the user passes the password step, **then** the login completes only after a valid key assertion for that user.
**Given** the bundled MultiFactorAuth.GoogleAuthenticator plugin is active, **when** a user selects it, **then** time-based codes from an authenticator app are accepted as the second check.

**Given** the buyer holds Security.EnableMultiFactorAuthentication (native default for Registered), **when** the buyer opens the MFA page in My account and selects one of the active providers, **then** later logins of that buyer require the selected factor.
**Given** a buyer is not in an MFA-required role, **when** the buyer switches MFA off, **then** it is switched off; a member of an MFA-required role cannot switch it off.

**Given** an OpenID Connect or SAML 2.0 provider plugin (IExternalAuthenticationMethod with IExternalAuthenticationRegistrar) is active, **when** a member of staff signs in at the provider, **then** the user is matched to the existing customer through ExternalAuthenticationRecord or verified email and signed in; staff accounts are not created by sign-in alone (Proposed).

**Given** the provider returns an error, **when** the callback is processed, **then** the native external-authentication error flow runs and the error is logged when ExternalAuthenticationSettings.LogErrors is on.

**Given** the user is in an MFA-required role (IAM-004), **when** the user signs in through the provider, **then** the sign-in is accepted only if the provider asserts a multi-factor authentication method; otherwise the IAM second factor is requested.

**Given** a provisioning message "deactivate user" arrives from the identity provider, **when** it is processed, **then** the customer is set inactive and RequireReLogin is set, so open sessions end (AUD-IAM-008).

**Given** a provisioning message "create user" with group membership arrives, **when** it is processed, **then** the customer is created with the roles mapped from the groups (mapping is configuration).
**Given** a company account (IAM-022) has its own provider configured, **when** a member signs in through it, **then** the member is signed in and linked to that company.

**Given** an idle timeout is set for the user class (staff or buyer), **when** no request arrives in a session for that time, **then** the next request is treated as signed out, the session record becomes Expired and the login page shows message Iam.SessionExpired.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-013; FIT (the native auth cookie has no configurable idle timeout)

criterion: **Given** an idle timeout is set, **when** the user keeps making requests, **then** the session stays valid and its last-activity time moves forward with each request.

**Given** the user ticked "remember me" (native persistent cookie), **when** the idle timeout passes, **then** the session still ends, because the check is made on the server session record, not on the cookie lifetime (BR-IAM-040).

**Given** a concurrent-session limit is set and the user already has that many sessions, **when** the user signs in again, **then** the oldest session is revoked, or the new login is refused with message Iam.SessionLimitReached, as the setting says.

**Given** the security officer holds Identity.Core.Sessions.CreateEditDelete, **when** the officer forces user U off, **then** all session records of U are revoked, Customer.RequireReLogin is set so every open cookie of U is rejected, and AUD-IAM-005 is written.
**Given** the officer ends one session of U, **when** the action is confirmed, **then** only that session is revoked; other sessions of U continue.

**Given** a user changes password, MFA settings or is given a new role, **when** the change is saved, **then** the user is signed in again with a new session identifier and the old session record is revoked.

**Given** a user holds Customers.CustomerRolesCreateEditDelete and Configuration.ManageACL, **when** the user creates a role with a name and system name and ticks permissions for it in the native permission pages (SecurityController.PermissionEditPopup), **then** members of the new role get exactly those permissions and no others.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-302; FIT (CustomerRoleController.Create [POST] and SecurityController.PermissionEditPopup [POST] require Configuration.ManageACL)

criterion: **Given** a user holds Customers.CustomerRolesCreateEditDelete but not Configuration.ManageACL, **when** the user saves a role or a permission mapping, **then** the save is denied by the native CheckPermission filter and nothing changes.
**Given** a user whose roles do not include Orders.OrdersView, **when** the user opens the admin order list, **then** access is denied by the native CheckPermission filter.

**Given** a role holds only view permissions for an area (5.00 view / create-edit-delete split, unchanged from 4.90), **when** a member tries to save a change in that area, **then** the save is denied and nothing changes.
**Given** a product has SubjectToAcl on and only role R is allowed, **when** a customer outside R browses or searches, **then** the product is not shown.
basis: FIT (IAclSupported: Product, Category, Manufacturer, Topic, Menu, MenuItem)

criterion: **Given** the product plugins are installed, **when** the application starts, **then** every role of BR-IAM-050 exists with exactly its system name and is listed in the admin role list, including roles that hold only native permissions and roles deleted before (the IAM plugin creates them; PermissionService creates a role only when it installs a new permission).
**Given** an administrator changes the display name of a product role, **when** the role is saved, **then** the system name is unchanged and the permissions of the modules still apply.

**Given** a role of BR-IAM-050 is not a native system role (IsSystemRole false, so native code allows changing its system name or deleting it), **when** an administrator changes its system name or deletes it, **then** the IAM action filter on Admin CustomerRoleController.Edit and Delete [POST] refuses the change with message Iam.ProductRoleProtected and nothing changes.
basis: Proposed; FIT (CustomerRoleController.Edit checks the system name only for IsSystemRole)

criterion: **Given** a module chapter declares native permissions for one of its product roles (for example EGV: Orders.OrdersView to AgencyOfficer), **when** the role pack is applied (PLT-003, IC-PLT-01), **then** the native permission is mapped to that role; the native default mappings of other roles are unchanged (BR-IAM-053).

**Given** an exclusion of BR-IAM-054 exists (for example Vendors never hold Orders.ReturnRequestsView), **when** a pack or an administrator in SecurityController.PermissionEditPopup maps the excluded permission to that role, **then** the pack fails validation, or the IAM action filter refuses the save with message Iam.PermissionExcluded; nothing changes.

**Given** a role pack lists permission system names, **when** the pack is applied (PLT-003), **then** every name must exist as a 5.00 permission; an unknown name, for example the 4.70 name ManageProducts or a 4.90 name removed in 5.00 such as ContentManagement.NewsView, is reported as an error and grants nothing (BR-IAM-052).
**Given** a user holds roles A and B, **when** the user opens a function permitted to B only, **then** access is granted: effective permissions are the union of the roles (BR-IAM-051).
**Given** KTDA has confirmed its stakeholder types (KG-16), **when** an administrator creates one role per type with its permission set, **then** each stakeholder user gets the access of its type.
basis: Inference from REQ-KTDA-CUS-001 (stakeholder types undefined, KG-16)

criterion: **Given** user U has a scope "store S" on Orders.OrdersView, **when** U opens the admin order list, **then** only orders of store S are listed (admin query filtering, registered core modification L1 §6.3).
basis: D; FIT (only vendor scoping is native: Customer.VendorId)

criterion: **Given** user U has a scope "store S", **when** U opens an order of another store by its address, **then** access is denied with message Iam.ScopeDenied and the attempt is audited (AUD-IAM-006).
**Given** user U has a value-band scope "up to value V" on an approval permission, **when** U approves an item above V, **then** the approval is refused with message Iam.ScopeDenied.
**Given** user U has a category scope on product editing, **when** U edits a product outside the category, **then** the save is refused and the product list shows only products in the category.
**Given** user U has a time-window scope, **when** U uses the permission outside the window, **then** access is denied.

**Given** agent A has the scope "outlet O" (from the IAM-026 outlet assignment) on Orders.OrdersView, **when** A opens the admin order list or the assisted orders list, **then** only orders whose CHK-013 assisted-order record or pickup point is outlet O are listed.

**Given** user U has a value-band scope "up to value V" on an approval permission (the authority limit), **when** ADM-006 builds the approval queue of U, **then** ADM-006 reads the limit and the active delegations of U through IC-IAM-06 and lists only items within the limit or delegated to U (BR-ADM-030).
**Given** a region list is configured and records carry a region, **when** user U has a scope "region R", **then** U sees and changes only records of region R.
basis: Inference from REQ-KTDA-PRJ-001 (region definition not stated, G-ORG)

criterion: **Given** user U holds permission P and P is marked delegable, **when** U delegates P to user V from a start date to an end date, **then** between those dates the permission check for P succeeds for V (IAM IPermissionService override, BR-IAM-070), and outside them it fails.
**Given** U does not hold P, or P is not delegable, **when** U tries to delegate P, **then** the delegation is refused with message Iam.DelegationNotAllowed.
**Given** the end date of a delegation passes, **when** V next uses P, **then** access is denied without any manual step and the delegation becomes Ended (SM-IAM-08).
**Given** V raised a request that needs approval, **when** V tries to approve it under a delegation, **then** the approval is refused, because segregation of duties still applies.

**Given** approver U delegated the approval permission of an ADM-006 queue to V for a period, **when** V opens the approval queue inside the period, **then** ADM-006 lists the items of U for V, read through IC-IAM-06 GetApprovalAuthority, and V cannot decide an item that V requested (BR-ADM-030).

**Given** V acts under a delegation, **when** the action is saved, **then** the audit record (AUD-IAM-007 for the delegation; the audit event of the action itself) names V as actor and U as the person on whose behalf V acted.
**Given** a delegation is created, revoked or ends, **when** the change happens, **then** AUD-IAM-007 is written with delegator, delegate, permission and dates.

**Given** a user holds Customers.CustomersView, **when** the user searches by email, name, phone, company, role, registration date or last activity, **then** matching customers are listed and each record can be opened (native admin customer list).

**Given** a user holds Customers.CustomersCreateEditDelete, **when** the user clears the Active flag of customer C, **then** C cannot log in (native NotActive result), open sessions of C end at their next request, and AUD-IAM-008 is written.
**Given** customer C was deactivated by staff, **when** staff set Active again, **then** C can log in again and AUD-IAM-008 is written.

**Given** a member of Administrators holds Customers.CustomersImpersonation, **when** the user starts impersonation of an active customer, **then** the IAM impersonation filter allows it (BR-IAM-130), the storefront is shown as that customer and the native activity Impersonation.Started is written for both people.

**Given** a user holds Customers.CustomersImpersonation, is not in Administrators, and no registered rule provider (IAM-026 agent rule, CRM-015 account-manager rule) allows the request, **when** the user posts the impersonation action, **then** the IAM impersonation filter refuses it with message Iam.ImpersonationNotAllowed (or the refusing provider message), no impersonation starts and AUD-IAM-019 is written.
basis: Proposed (owner decision: one impersonation filter, IAM-026)

criterion: **Given** a user who is not an administrator is allowed by a rule provider for a customer who is an administrator, **when** the request reaches the native action, **then** the native action refuses it (Admin.Customers.Customers.NonAdminNotImpersonateAsAdminError); the IAM filter does not relax native checks.

**Given** a signed-in shopper, **when** the shopper chooses "Deactivate my account" and confirms with the password or a one-time code, **then** the account becomes inactive, all sessions end, message Iam.AccountDeactivated is shown, no data is deleted and marketing messages stop (BR-IAM-081).

**Given** the account was deactivated by its owner, **when** the owner requests reactivation and confirms a code sent to the verified email or mobile number, **then** the account becomes active again and message Iam.AccountReactivated is shown.
**Given** the account was deactivated by staff, **when** the owner requests reactivation, **then** self-reactivation is refused and message Iam.ContactSupport is shown.

**Given** staff change a customer record, its roles or its addresses, **when** the change is saved, **then** the platform audit trail (SEC-004) stores old and new values and the native activity EditCustomer is written.
**Given** staff open a customer record, an order or an address of a customer in admin, **when** the page is shown, **then** a read-access event AUD-IAM-010 is written (BR-IAM-080).

**Given** a user holds Identity.Core.AccessGovernance.CreateEditDelete, **when** the user invites email E with chosen roles, **then** an invitation email with a single-use link is sent (message template Iam.Invitation.Email, default text Iam.Invitation); the link is valid for the configured days and no customer record exists yet.

**Given** a valid invitation link, **when** the invitee opens it, sets a password that meets IAM-003, sets up MFA where a role requires it (IAM-004) and accepts the current terms (IAM-016), **then** the account is created as Registered with the invited roles and the invitation becomes Accepted (AUD-IAM-017).
**Given** an expired, revoked or already used link, **when** someone opens it, **then** no account is created and message Iam.InvitationExpired is shown.

**Given** an access-review campaign is started for a set of roles with a reviewer for each role, **when** the campaign opens, **then** each reviewer sees the members of their roles and records Keep or Revoke for each; Revoke removes the role mapping through ICustomerService; every decision is audited (AUD-IAM-009).

**Given** the campaign deadline passes with items undecided, **when** the deadline task runs, **then** the undecided items become Overdue and are listed to administrators; no role is removed automatically.

**Given** a user holds Identity.Core.AccessReports.View, **when** the user runs the access audit report, **then** one row per user shows: roles, whether the user is privileged (holds Security.AccessAdminPanel or a permission in the privileged list), MFA status (provider selected, none, or required but not set up — from the SelectedMultiFactorAuthenticationProvider attribute), last login and Active; the report can be exported to CSV and XLSX.
**Given** the report is filtered to privileged accounts, **when** it runs, **then** only users that meet the privileged definition are listed.

**Given** the IAM plugin is installed, **when** the configuration is applied, **then** the native activity types PublicStore.SuccessfulLogin, PublicStore.FailedLogin and PublicStore.Logout are enabled (they are disabled at native install) and CustomerSettings.StoreIpAddresses is on.

**Given** any of these happens: login success or failure (password, code, single sign-on), logout, MFA challenge result, password change or reset, MFA enrolment or removal, role mapping change, access denied by a permission check, **when** the event completes, **then** an AuthEvent is written with UTC time, customer (or the identifier tried), IP address, user agent, channel and outcome, and is copied to the platform audit trail (AUD-IAM-018).

**Given** AuthEvent records exist, **when** any user, including an administrator, tries to edit or delete one, **then** no screen or service offers edit or delete; the native activity log can be deleted (Customers.ActivityLogDelete) but the copy in SEC-004 cannot.

**Given** a failed-login rule (more than N failures in M minutes for one account or one IP address) is active, **when** the rule is exceeded, **then** a suspicious-login flag is raised, the security officer is notified and the flag appears in the console (SM-IAM-12).

**Given** the new-country rule is active, **when** a customer logs in from a country (IGeoLookupService with the bundled GeoLite2-Country database) not seen for that customer in the look-back period, **then** a flag is raised and, if the setting is on, the customer receives message template Iam.NewCountryLogin.CustomerNotification.
basis: D; FIT (IGeoLookupService.LookupCountryIsoCodeAsync; 5.00.1 removed the synchronous lookups, Libraries/Nop.Services/Directory/IGeoLookupService.cs:16)

criterion: **Given** a flag is open, **when** the security officer confirms it, **then** the officer can force the user off (IAM-006) and the flag becomes Confirmed; dismissing needs a reason (AUD-IAM-016).
**Given** a user holds Identity.Core.AuthEvents.View, **when** the user filters by date, customer, IP address and outcome, **then** matching events are listed and can be exported to CSV.
**Given** the security-monitoring export is configured (SEC-005), **when** authentication events are written, **then** they are sent through IC-SEC-02 in the agreed format.

**Given** a signed-in user on a device that supports passkeys, **when** the user registers a passkey, **then** the public key credential is stored for the user and listed under My account, where it can be removed.

**Given** a user with a registered passkey, **when** the user chooses "log in with passkey" and the device verifies the user, **then** the user is signed in through SignInCustomerAsync without a password.
**Given** the device or browser does not support passkeys, **when** the login page is shown, **then** password and one-time code login remain available.

**Given** the user is in an MFA-required role, **when** the user logs in with a passkey that verified the user on the device, **then** the login completes and no second-factor prompt is shown, because the passkey user verification counts as the second factor required by IAM-004.

**Given** a signed-in shopper on the My account information page, **when** the shopper changes name, phone or email and saves, **then** the values are saved; an email change follows the native revalidation when registration type is EmailValidation; with GdprSettings.LogUserProfileChanges on, the change is written to the GDPR log.

**Given** the account uses the mobile number as identifier (IAM-002), **when** the shopper changes the number, **then** the new number replaces the identifier only after a code sent to it is entered correctly.
basis: Proposed; FIT (5.00.1 native My account information saves the new number at once, clears Customer.PhoneSmsVerified and then runs the ChangePhoneNumber code verification, CustomerController.cs:1631-1636, 1704-1707; PhoneIdentity keeps the old identifier until the code is entered)

criterion: **Given** a signed-in shopper in My account Addresses, **when** the shopper adds, edits or deletes addresses, **then** each change is saved and the list shows all saved addresses.
**Given** a shopper has several addresses, **when** the shopper marks one as default, **then** that address is shown first and marked as default; checkout pre-selects it (CHK, carried).
**Given** a shopper with saved addresses buys again, **when** the shopper reaches the address step, **then** the saved addresses are offered without retyping.

**Given** pickup points exist (PRD-LOG-003, StorePickupPoint), **when** the shopper selects one as preferred in My account, **then** it is saved; the checkout pickup option pre-selects it (CHK, carried).

**Given** the preferred pickup point is closed or removed, **when** the shopper next opens checkout or My account, **then** the preference is cleared and the shopper is asked to choose another with message Iam.PickupPointUnavailable.

**Given** the channels configured in the notification engine (TRK-005) are listed, **when** the shopper selects a preferred channel, **then** it is saved and TRK-006 uses it for every event that has no event-level preference.
**Given** the app channel is not enabled for the store (CHN-001 / CHN-013 not active), **when** the shopper opens the channel choice, **then** the app channel is not offered.

**Given** current versions of the terms of use and the privacy policy are published, **when** a person registers by web, mobile number or through an agent, **then** registration cannot complete without acceptance, and a PolicyAcceptance row records policy, version, time, channel, IP address and agent (if any).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-006; FIT (native AcceptPrivacyPolicyEnabled covers the privacy policy only, without version)

criterion: **Given** a policy topic is under MKT-008 versioning, **when** an acceptance is recorded, **then** the version number stored is the Effective version returned by IC-MKT-03 GetEffectivePolicyVersion at that time; IAM stores no policy text and creates no version (BR-IAM-091).

**Given** IC-MKT-03 returns "no version" for a policy (not under versioning, or MKT-008 not yet available), **when** an acceptance is recorded, **then** it is stored with version "unversioned" and the topic and time, and no re-acceptance prompt can be raised for that policy.

**Given** IC-MKT-03 GetEffectivePolicyVersion returns a new Effective version of a policy with the MKT-008 flag "re-acceptance required" set, **when** a registered user who accepted an older version makes a request, **then** the user is redirected to the acceptance page with message Iam.TermsUpdated until the new version is accepted; logout and the policy pages stay reachable (BR-IAM-091).

**Given** the user declines the new version, **when** the decline is saved, **then** the decline is recorded, the user is signed out with message Iam.TermsDeclined and can only sign in again by accepting.

**Given** IC-MKT-03 returns a new Effective version with the "re-acceptance required" flag not set, **when** users make requests, **then** no prompt is shown; later acceptances (for example at registration) record the new version; IAM keeps no re-acceptance flag of its own.

**Given** the seller terms (topic VendorTermsOfService) have a new Effective version, the client setting requires re-acceptance and SEL-006 records seller acceptances through IC-IAM-05 with the vendor, **when** the owner user of an approved seller makes a request in the seller portal, **then** the IAM re-acceptance filter redirects the owner to the acceptance page until the new version is accepted; the acceptance is stored with customer, vendor and version.

**Given** a user holds Identity.Core.ConsentTrail.View, **when** the user opens the consent trail of a customer, **then** PolicyAcceptance rows and the native GDPR log consent entries (ConsentAgree, ConsentDisagree) are listed in time order, read-only.

**Given** a CRM-003 agent holds Identity.Core.ConsentTrail.View, **when** the 360-degree view calls IC-IAM-05 GetConsentTrail for the customer, **then** the same entries are returned (policy, version, decision, channel, time; consent agree or disagree with time), read-only; without the permission the call is refused.

**Given** consents (GdprConsent) are configured with DisplayOnCustomerInfoPage, **when** the shopper ticks or clears a consent on the My account information page and saves, **then** the GDPR log records ConsentAgree or ConsentDisagree with time; a withdrawn marketing consent stops marketing messages from the next send.

**Given** cookie categories are configured (SEC-007), **when** the shopper changes cookie choices from the footer link, **then** the new choice applies from the next page (see SEC-007 (REQ-MPC-FR-010)).

**Given** a customer withdraws a consent that a module uses (for example personalisation), **when** the withdrawal is saved, **then** the modules registered for that consent are told through IC-IAM-08 ConsentWithdrawn and stop the processing from the next request; the module decides whether stored data is deleted.

**Given** GdprSettings.GdprEnabled is on, **when** the shopper chooses "Export my data" on the GDPR tools page, **then** the native XLSX export is downloaded, the GDPR log records ExportData, and a second file lists the personal data held in product plugin tables (Proposed).

**Given** a signed-in shopper, **when** the shopper submits a correction request naming the field, the current value, the requested value and a reason, **then** a PrivacyRequest of type Correction is created as Received, its due date is set from the country profile (SEC-012) and message Iam.CorrectionRequestReceived is shown.

**Given** a correction request is Received, **when** a user holding Customers.GDPRManage approves it, **then** the customer field or saved address is updated, the shopper is notified, the GDPR log records ProfileChanged and AUD-IAM-011 is written; addresses already copied to placed orders are not changed by this flow.
**Given** a correction request is Received, **when** the reviewer rejects it with a reason, **then** the request becomes Rejected and the shopper is told the reason.

**Given** GdprSettings.GdprEnabled is on, **when** the shopper chooses "Delete account" on the GDPR tools page, **then** the native flow logs DeleteCustomer in the GDPR log and sends Customer.Gdpr.DeleteRequest to the store owner, and a PrivacyRequest of type Deletion is opened with its due date.

**Given** a deletion request is approved, **when** a user holding Customers.GDPRManage runs the native GDPR delete, **then** the IAM override of IGdprService.PermanentDeleteCustomerAsync also clears the personal fields that native code leaves (BR-IAM-092) and personal data in IAM plugin tables; orders and invoices are kept under the retention rules (PLT-020, SEC-012); AUD-IAM-011 is written.
basis: FIT (GdprService.PermanentDeleteCustomerAsync clears only Email, EmailToRevalidate and Username, Libraries/Nop.Services/Gdpr/GdprService.cs:258-351)

criterion: **Given** modules that hold personal data in their own tables or send it to external services (for example SRC search history and the recommendation service, SRC-012, SRC-009) have registered an erasure provider (IC-IAM-08), **when** the IAM override of IGdprService.PermanentDeleteCustomerAsync runs, **then** each provider is called inside the same operation and reports Erased or Failed; a Failed provider leaves the PrivacyRequest InProgress with the provider named, and the request is not Completed (BR-IAM-092).
**Given** a privacy request is open, **when** its due date (from the country profile, SEC-012) is reached without completion, **then** it is marked Overdue and the privacy officer is notified.
basis: Inference from REQ-KTDA-LEG-001 (law names inference, DP-01)

criterion: **Given** a user holds Identity.Core.ConsentTrail.View, **when** the user opens the privacy trail of a customer, **then** consent changes, exports, correction and deletion requests are listed with dates and outcomes.

**Given** a visitor has not accepted the analytics cookie category, **when** pages are shown, **then** no analytics widget is rendered for that visitor and no analytics profile is built (SEC-007 gating).

**Given** a signed-in shopper, **when** the shopper opens Account activity in My account, **then** the page lists, newest first and for the configured look-back period: logins and failed logins (AuthEvent), changes to name, email, phone, password, MFA and addresses (field names, not values), and payment attempts with time, method and status (PAY PaymentTransaction).

**Given** activity entries contain an IP address, **when** they are shown to the shopper, **then** the IP address is partly masked: when SEC-014 is delivered its masking rule applies; until then (P1) the last octet of an IPv4 address, or the last 80 bits of an IPv6 address, are replaced by zeros (Proposed).

**Given** staff opened or changed the customer record, an order or an address of the customer (AUD-IAM-010, SEC-004), **when** the shopper opens Account activity, **then** a "staff access" entry is shown with date and, as the setting says, the staff member name or role.
**Given** a user holds Customers.CustomersView, **when** the user opens the customer in admin, **then** an Account activity tab shows the same entries.

**Given** synchronisation is enabled for a set of fields, **when** a customer is registered, updated, deactivated or deleted, **then** an IntegrationMessage with channel "account sync" is written to the INT-004 outbox through IC-INT-09 Enqueue (the IAM event consumer for CustomerRegisteredEvent and EntityInsertedEvent / EntityUpdatedEvent of Customer only enqueues, BR-INT-010) and the INT delivery task sends it to the Integration Layer adapter (IC-IAM-03 PublishAccountChange).

**Given** sending fails, **when** the INT-004 retry policy applies, **then** the message is retried (SM-INT-01); after the last retry it becomes DeadLettered and appears in the INT dead-letter list (Integrations.Core.Messages.View); IAM keeps no outbox of its own (BR-IAM-100).

**Given** an inbound change arrives from a core system, **when** it is processed, **then** only the configured fields are updated; if the platform value changed after the core-system version, the configured system of record wins and the conflict is logged.
**Given** a customer is deleted under IAM-017, **when** the deletion completes, **then** the core system receives an erasure notice for that customer.

**Given** a process is configured to require KYC, **when** a person submits an identity type and number, **then** the framework calls the adapter for the country (IC-IAM-02) and records the result Verified, NotVerified, Inconclusive or Unavailable with the adapter reference and time; identity document images are not stored by the framework (BR-IAM-110).

**Given** a mobile-money KYC adapter is available, **when** a person chooses to verify with the mobile number, **then** the adapter returns the match result from the mobile-money registration and it is recorded as above.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-344 ("leveraging existing mobile-money KYC where feasible")

criterion: **Given** the adapter returns Unavailable or Inconclusive, **when** the result is recorded, **then** the case goes to the manual review queue; a user holding Identity.Core.Verification.CreateEditDelete decides it with a reason (AUD-IAM-015).

**Given** SEL-004 calls IC-IAM-02 Verify for a seller (check type, country, identifier, name), **when** the adapter answers, **then** the result is returned as Verified, NotVerified, Inconclusive or Unavailable with the adapter reference (the product standard values, owner decision); SEL stores its own copy and handles Inconclusive as manual review under its own maker-checker rule (BR-SEL-007); IAM opens no manual review case for checks requested by SEL.

**Given** OCR or an ID-document check of AI-005 has produced extracted fields or a match score for a case, **when** the case is decided, **then** the AI output is shown to the reviewer as a suggestion only; the result Verified or NotVerified is set by the adapter or by a reviewer holding Identity.Core.Verification.CreateEditDelete, never by the AI output alone (BR-AI-002, BR-IAM-110).
**Given** a new adapter implements IC-IAM-02, **when** it is installed and configured for a country, **then** it is used for that country without change to the framework.

**Given** a customer has orders, **when** the customer opens Orders in My account, **then** each order is listed with number, date, status and total; the details page shows items, totals and shipments with tracking numbers.
**Given** an order details page, **when** the customer chooses the PDF invoice, **then** the native PDF invoice is downloaded.

**Given** the bundled Misc.RFQ plugin is active and the customer has quotes or return requests, **when** the customer opens My account, **then** quotes and return requests are listed in their own pages.
**Given** the customer filters the history by type, date range, status and value, **when** the customer chooses Export, **then** a CSV or XLSX file of the filtered list is downloaded.

**Given** the bundled Misc.RFQ plugin is active with RfqSettings.AllowCustomerGenerateQuotePdf on, **when** the customer opens a quote in My account and chooses the PDF, **then** the native quote PDF is downloaded; with the setting off no PDF is offered (setting default off).
**Given** OrderSettings.IsReOrderAllowed is on, **when** the customer chooses Re-order on a past order, **then** the items of that order are added to the basket.
**Given** company C has members, **when** a member places an order, **then** the order is linked to C and visible to members with the view right; the shared company addresses are offered at checkout.
**Given** a customer is not a member of C, **when** the customer opens an order of C by its address, **then** access is denied.

**Given** another module needs the company of a customer (for example CAT-040 assortments, CHK-016 credit, CHK-018 approvals), **when** it calls IC-IAM-07 GetCompanyOfCustomer, **then** it receives the CompanyId, the company status and the company role of the customer, or "no company".

**Given** a company administrator, **when** the administrator adds a member by email invitation and gives a company role, **then** the member gets the rights of that role in C: buyer orders, approver approves (CHK-018), company administrator manages members (BR-IAM-120).
**Given** a member is removed from C, **when** the change is saved, **then** the member loses access to C data; orders the member placed stay with C.

**Given** CAT-040 (P2) is delivered, has registered a membership provider and created the per-company system customer role of C (before CAT-040 no provider is registered and membership changes call none), **when** a member is added to or removed from C, **then** IAM calls the provider (IC-IAM-07 OnMembershipChanged) inside the same save, so CAT adds or removes the mapping of the member to that role through ICustomerService; if the provider fails the membership change is not saved.

**Given** approval thresholds are set per company role (CHK-018), **when** a buyer of C submits a cart above the threshold of the buyer role, **then** CHK-018 reads the company role of the buyer through IC-IAM-07; thresholds are stored by CHK-018, not by IAM (BR-IAM-120).

**Given** the trade application form is configured, **when** a business submits company name, registration number, tax or VAT number and the required documents, **then** a TradeApplication is created as Received with the files stored as Download records (native customer attributes do not support file upload) and message Iam.TradeApplicationReceived is shown.
basis: D; FIT (CustomerAttribute excludes FileUpload); Inference from REQ-KTDA-CUS-002 (PH-INF)

criterion: **Given** a document attached to the application has a file type or size outside the ADM-008 upload policy of the context "trade application document" (registered by IAM at installation through IC-ADM-08 RegisterUploadContext; IAM checks each file through IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload before storing it), **when** the form is posted, **then** the file is refused by the ADM-008 policy before anything is stored (BR-ADM-060); IAM adds no type or size check of its own.
basis: Proposed (owner decision: ADM-008 single owner of upload policy)

criterion: **Given** a user holds Identity.Core.TradeAccounts.CreateEditDelete, **when** the user approves an application, **then** the customer gets the TradeBuyer role, a company account is created (IAM-022), trade prices limited to that role (tier prices by CustomerRoleId, ACL) become visible and the applicant receives message template Iam.TradeApplicationApproved.CustomerNotification (AUD-IAM-013).
**Given** an application is rejected with a reason or more information is requested, **when** the decision is saved, **then** the applicant is told the reason; no role is given (SM-IAM-07).
**Given** an application is still Received, **when** the applicant browses, **then** trade prices are not shown.
**Given** Customer.IsTaxExempt or the TaxExempt flag of one of the customer roles is on, **when** an order is calculated, **then** no tax is added to the lines (native tax calculation).

**Given** a trade buyer is approved as tax-exempt on evidence (IAM-023), **when** the exemption flag is set on the customer, **then** the exemption applies from the next calculation and the change is audited (SEC-004) — held by PH-INF (KTDA B2B by inference).

**Given** TaxSettings.EuVatEnabled is switched on so that the VAT number field is shown, **when** the configuration is checked, **then** EuVatUseWebService and EuVatAllowVatExemption are off and Country.SubjectToVat is reviewed for every country, because the native EU logic exempts addresses in countries not subject to VAT (BR-IAM-121).
**Given** a buyer enters a VAT number, **when** staff review it, **then** staff mark it valid or invalid with the native actions (MarkVatNumberAsValid / Invalid).

**Given** a signed-in customer, **when** the customer opens the home dashboard, **then** it shows open orders, open quotes, items that wait for the customer (for example quotes to answer or deliveries to confirm, from the modules that own them) and the latest messages.
**Given** a signed-in customer, **when** any storefront page is shown, **then** the quick-action menu offers the configured actions and each opens its target page.
**Given** a signed-in customer, **when** the customer opens the figures panel, **then** orders and spending per month for the chosen period are shown.

**Given** a person is set up as an agent (role Agent, assigned outlet), **when** the person logs in, **then** the login is to a personal account; MFA applies if Agent is an MFA-required role (IAM-004); one account is never shared (BR-IAM-130).

**Given** an agent holds Identity.Core.AssistedService.Access and has an assigned outlet, **when** the agent registers a customer with a mobile number (IAM-002) or email and the customer gives the code received on their phone or email, **then** the account is created, terms acceptance is recorded with channel Assisted and the agent (IAM-016), the customer record is stamped with agent and outlet, and AUD-IAM-014 is written.

**Given** the mobile number already belongs to an account, **when** the agent tries to register it, **then** no account is created; message Iam.PhoneInUse is shown; the agent can start an acting session for that customer only if the customer is registered at one of the agent's outlets (BR-IAM-130).

**Given** an agent (role Agent with Customers.CustomersImpersonation and Security.AccessAdminPanel, an assigned outlet) starts an acting session through the native Place order for customer action (Admin CustomerController.Impersonate, as CHK-013) and, where the setting requires it, the customer gives the code sent to them, **when** the session starts, **then** the single IAM impersonation filter (BR-IAM-130) has allowed it through the IAM-026 agent rule, native impersonation starts, Impersonation.Started is written, an AssistedServiceRecord (act) with agent and outlet is written (AUD-IAM-014), and orders placed in the session get the native order note naming the agent; the order-to-agent and outlet link is the CHK-013 AssistedOrder record.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-025; FIT (CustomerController.Impersonate; WebWorkContext; OrderProcessingService order note)

criterion: **Given** an agent tries to act for an administrator or another staff account, **when** the request is made, **then** the IAM-026 agent rule denies it and the IAM impersonation filter refuses it with message Iam.ScopeDenied (native code refuses only administrators); AUD-IAM-019 is written.

**Given** a customer is registered at another outlet or has no outlet stamp, and no other rule provider allows the agent, **when** an agent tries to act for that customer, **then** the IAM-026 agent rule denies it (agents act only for their own outlet's customers), the filter refuses it with message Iam.ScopeDenied and AUD-IAM-019 is written.
basis: Proposed (owner decision: one impersonation filter, IAM-026)

criterion: **Given** an acting session is open, **when** the agent ends it or logs out, **then** impersonation ends and Impersonation.Finished is written.
**Given** an agent has no assigned outlet, **when** the agent tries to register a customer or start an acting session, **then** it is refused with message Iam.AgentNotAssigned.

**Given** a user holds Identity.Core.Agents.CreateEditDelete, **when** the user assigns an agent to an outlet (PRD-LOG-003), **then** the assignment is saved, used for every later stamp and turned into the IAM-008 scope "outlet" of that agent.

**Given** the assisted service feature is off for the store (IC-PLT-02 IsEnabled false for PRD-IAM-026), **when** an agent opens the agent pages or posts Place order for customer, **then** the agent pages are not shown and the IAM-026 agent rule returns not applicable, so the IAM impersonation filter refuses the acting session of an agent (BR-IAM-141).

**Given** company C has cost centres with budgets for a period, **when** a member places an order charged to a cost centre, **then** the order is linked to the cost centre and its spent amount increases by the order total.

**Given** an order would exceed the remaining budget, **when** the member tries to place it, **then** the configured action applies: refuse with message Iam.BudgetExceeded, or send the order for approval (CHK-018).
**Given** an order linked to a cost centre is cancelled or refunded, **when** the change completes, **then** the spent amount is reduced by the cancelled or refunded amount.

**Given** an API client holds scope orders.read and is limited to store S, **when** it lists orders changed since a given time, **then** it receives, as JSON, only orders of store S changed since that time, in pages (page size a setting, default not stated).

**Given** an API client holds scope products.write, **when** it changes the price or the stock quantity of a product, **then** the price change is applied through IProductService, and so through the CAT-002 override that owns IProductService (OVR-REG); the stock change is posted through IC-INV-01 PostMovement (INV owns stock changes, BR-INV-001), which calls AdjustInventoryAsync for a single-warehouse product or UpdateProductWarehouseInventoryAsync with AddStockQuantityHistoryEntryAsync for a multi-warehouse product (BR-INV-034), so stock history is kept; nothing is written to a table directly; the change is audited by SEC-004 (BR-INT-001).
