**Given** each product has a shelf location per warehouse (zone, aisle, rack, shelf, bin), **when** a pick list is generated for selected orders, **then** each line shows product, quantity and shelf location, sorted by zone, aisle, rack, shelf and bin.
**Given** a product has no shelf location in the picking warehouse, **when** the pick list is generated, **then** the line is listed last with the location shown as missing.

**Given** items are picked, **when** the packer scans or ticks each item, **then** the package can be confirmed only when every order item and quantity matches; otherwise message Log.PackMismatch is shown and the task stays Picked (BR-LOG-070).
**Given** MPC fulfilment is enabled and a package is Packed, **when** staff move it to a staging location, **then** the task becomes Staged with the location recorded (SM-LOG-01).

**Given** a package is Staged and a carrier or route is assigned, **when** staff confirm dispatch with the waybill or tracking number, **then** a native shipment exists with the tracking number, IOrderProcessingService.ShipAsync is called once (ShipmentSentEvent, ShippedDateUtc, order ShippingStatus) and the task becomes Dispatched.

**Given** a package holds a lot-tracked or serial-tracked product (INV-009, INV-010), **when** LOG creates the native shipment for it, **then** LOG first calls IC-INV-07 Capture for the packed quantities (BR-INV-070, BR-INV-080), then inserts the shipment through IShipmentService.InsertShipmentAsync and its items, then calls IC-INV-07 Confirm with the saved shipment items (BR-LOG-003); if Capture is refused nothing is saved, the INV message key is shown and the task stays Packed or Staged.

**Given** a shipment guard provider registered with the ORD-010 host (IC-ORD-11: PAY letter of credit not Verified, ORD-010 order hold, EGV application not Issued) refuses the insert, **when** LOG creates the shipment, **then** no shipment is saved, any open IC-INV-07 capture is cancelled (Cancel with the refusal reason), the message key returned by the provider is shown and the task stays in its state (BR-LOG-003).
basis: FIT (IShipmentService.InsertShipmentAsync is the single host, OVR-REG); see PAY-006 (REQ-KTDA-PAY-009)

criterion: **Given** the order is a pickup order, **when** staff confirm the parcel reached the outlet, **then** ReadyForPickupAsync is called instead, because native ShipAsync refuses pickup orders.

**Given** parcels were dispatched today to transport operator T, **when** the manifest is generated, **then** it lists each parcel (tracking number, order, destination, weight) for T with totals, and is printable and exportable.
**Given** the seller selects several of their orders, **when** they print, **then** one combined pick list and one packing list are produced for those orders, containing only the seller's items.
**Given** the client has the pick, pack, stage and dispatch steps enabled, **when** a task skips a step, **then** the skipped transition is refused (SM-LOG-01).

**Given** a KTDA shipping workflow (ADM-002) is bound to the native shipment events and its step asks LOG to stage or dispatch a package, **when** the step runs, **then** the LOG fulfilment service (IC-LOG-07) performs the transition with the same checks as the staff screen; the workflow only starts from queued requests and never sets shipment dates or status (BR-LOG-190).

**Given** an order has items not yet in a shipment, **when** staff create a shipment for some items, **then** a native Shipment with ShipmentItems is created; the order ShippingStatus becomes PartiallyShipped when that shipment is shipped and other items remain.

**Given** a shipment is created through the admin AddShipment page or the LOG fulfilment flow, **when** it is shipped, made ready for pickup or delivered, **then** the change is made only through IOrderProcessingService.ShipAsync / ReadyForPickupAsync / DeliverAsync (BR-LOG-001), which set the dates, send the native template through the TRK-005 engine and raise the native event.

**Given** a user edits a shipped, ready-for-pickup or delivered date on the admin shipment page, **when** the POST is sent, **then** the LOG action filter requires a reason (message Log.DateEditReasonRequired), records a correction event in TRK-002 and audits it (AUD-LOG-001), because the native edit actions update the date without any event.

**Given** an order has two shipments, **when** the shopper opens the order, **then** both are listed with tracking number and status (shipped, ready for pickup, delivered) and a link to the shipment details.
**Given** a shipment exists, **when** staff print its packing slip, **then** the native packaging slip PDF is produced for that shipment.

**Given** an order line is allocated to client fulfilment through the postal network (LOG-008), **when** the order is released for fulfilment, **then** tasks of types collect (if the parcel is at the seller), sort, dispatch and deliver or collection-at-outlet are created for the shipment leg with status Created (SM-LOG-04).
**Given** a task is completed, **when** the corresponding scan or confirmation is recorded (TRK-002 event), **then** the task becomes Completed and the next task becomes due.

**Given** a seller has parcels ready (ORD-005 hand-over) at a registered SellerLocation with preference pickup (SEL-018), **when** operations staff schedule a pickup with a date and time window, **then** a seller pickup request is Scheduled with that SellerLocation address as the collection address and the seller is notified through TRK-005 (event code Log.SellerPickupScheduled, IC-TRK-04 SendEvent).

**Given** a pickup is Scheduled, **when** the collector records the parcels collected (scan or list), **then** the request becomes Collected, each parcel gets a pickup event in TRK-002 and the confirmation is audited (AUD-LOG-012).
**Given** the collector finds no parcel or the seller is closed, **when** the visit is recorded, **then** the request becomes Missed with a reason and can be rescheduled.

**Given** a return parcel (RET-003 ReturnShipment) is handed in at an outlet that is not its destination and the Postal and logistics pack is active, **when** RET requests an onward task, **then** a logistics task of type onward (outlet to seller, warehouse or outlet) is created with the ReturnShipment reference instead of a shipment id, and completes on the matching TRK-002 event for the return reference.

**Given** an operator opens the ADM-007 operational order view, **when** LOG supplies the stage of each open shipment (IC-LOG-07 GetOperationalStage), **then** each shipment is placed in awaiting pickup, awaiting sorting, awaiting dispatch or out for last-mile delivery by BR-LOG-170, or in none of them.

**Given** a delivery or collection is confirmed by a carrier event, a courier app (LOG-032), or outlet staff, **when** the confirmation is received, **then** a proof-of-delivery record is stored with method, time, location if provided, recipient name, collector or courier identity and any media; it is linked to the shipment and order and an order note with the media DownloadId is added (native OrderNote, DisplayToCustomer false).

**Given** a proof-of-delivery record is stored, **when** the save completes, **then** the module event ProofOfDeliveryRecorded (OrderId, ShipmentId, RecordId; IC-LOG-05) is published; consumers (RET-007 evidence link) only enqueue work.

**Given** service level S requires OTP, **when** a delivery of level S is confirmed without a matching OTP record, **then** DeliverAsync is not called and the shipment stays undelivered; staff see message Log.PodRequired (BR-LOG-080).

**Given** service level S requires a proof method, **when** a user presses the native admin Set as delivered (single or selected), **then** the LOG action filter refuses it with message Log.PodRequired unless a POD record of a required method exists (BR-LOG-160).
**Given** a proof-method configuration is changed, **when** it is saved, **then** it is audited (AUD-LOG-002) and applies to shipments created after the change.

**Given** a buyer presents the pickup code or QR issued by CHK-012 and IC-CHK-09 Verify answers Valid for this shipment and outlet, **when** outlet staff confirm the hand-over, **then** under ILocker key 'shipment-{ShipmentId}' (BR-LOG-001; IC-CHK-09 runs inside this lock) the step re-reads the parcel, requires any holding charge (LOG-017) to be recorded as paid or waived, stores the POD record with method Code or QR, calls DeliverAsync once and then calls IC-CHK-09 MarkUsed; if DeliverAsync is refused (for example an ORD-010 hold through the CHK-003 override), MarkUsed is not called and the code stays Sent.

**Given** IC-CHK-09 Verify answers Invalid, Used or Locked, **when** outlet staff try to hand over, **then** nothing is handed over, no POD record is stored and the CHK message key returned (Chk.PickupCodeInvalid, Chk.PickupCodeUsed, Chk.PickupCodeLocked) is shown; code attempts and locking are CHK-012 rules (BR-CHK-016), not LOG rules.

**Given** service level S requires a home-delivery OTP and the courier enters a wrong OTP, **when** the configured number of wrong attempts is reached (setting, default not stated), **then** the shipment is locked for OTP entry, message Log.CodeInvalid is shown, the failed attempts are audited (AUD-LOG-005) and operations staff are alerted (BR-LOG-081).

**Given** a user without Logistics.Core.ProofOfDelivery.View opens the order, **when** the order page loads, **then** the POD summary (method, time) is visible but signature, photo and coordinates are hidden.

**Given** media (photo, signature image, video) arrive with a proof-of-delivery confirmation from the outlet or courier page, a carrier, or IC-LOG-04, **when** they are stored, **then** each file is first checked through IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload for the LOG upload context "proof-of-delivery media" (BR-LOG-082); a refused file is not stored and the ADM message key is shown or returned; on admin DownloadFile the SEC-002 filter asks the LOG download-access provider (IC-SEC-05), which claims the file and allows it only to holders of Logistics.Core.ProofOfDelivery.View.
basis: SINGLE-FILTER; NFR-X-002; FIT (Admin DownloadController.DownloadFile checks only admin access; admin order notes link DownloadGuid)

criterion: **Given** a delivery attempt fails (courier, carrier or route list LOG-024), **when** the attempt is recorded with a reason code from the configured list (initial codes from source: unreachable, not at home, address issue), **then** a delivery exception is opened with status Open (SM-LOG-03), a TRK-002 attempt-failed event is recorded and TRK-012 notifies the buyer with the reason.

**Given** the number of failed attempts reaches the configured maximum (setting, default not stated), **when** another attempt fails, **then** no further redelivery is offered and the exception action becomes return to sender (BR-LOG-090).

**Given** an exception is Open, **when** the buyer opens the rescheduling link from the notification or the order page, **then** they can choose a new delivery date from the offered dates or change the address (subject to LOG-004 serviceability); the choice creates a redelivery task and the exception becomes InProgress.

**Given** the address is corrected, **when** it is saved, **then** the order address copy is updated through IAddressService, the fee is re-checked (BR-LOG-110) and the change is audited (AUD-LOG-008).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-193; FIT (order address is a cloned Address row)

criterion: **Given** return to sender is chosen, **when** staff confirm it, **then** a return leg is created to the origin, the exception becomes Resolved with outcome ReturnedToSender and the module event DeliveryOutcomeRecorded (OrderId, ShipmentId, Outcome; IC-LOG-05) is published; RET-007 opens an OrderIssue case; LOG raises no refund itself (refunds are owned by RET-005 and executed by PAY-016).

**Given** staff record an incident of type lost, damaged or delayed, **when** it is saved, **then** an exception of that type is Open with evidence attachments, each checked through IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload for the LOG upload context "delivery exception evidence" before it is stored (BR-LOG-082), and is visible in the operations queue.

**Given** an exception stays Open beyond the escalation threshold for its type (setting, default not stated), or TRK-002 flags a long-stuck shipment, **when** the escalation task runs, **then** the exception becomes Escalated, the escalation contact for that type is notified (event code Log.ExceptionEscalated, IC-TRK-04 SendEvent) and, where configured, the buyer is informed (AUD-LOG-006).

**Given** an Escalated exception is resolved, **when** staff record the outcome (redelivered, returned, lost, damaged), **then** the exception becomes Resolved and the outcome is audited (AUD-LOG-006); for Lost, Damaged and ReturnedToSender the DeliveryOutcomeRecorded event is published once per shipment and outcome, so compensation is handled by RET-007 and RET-005.

**Given** a COD delivery is confirmed with the collected amount (POD record, LOG-012), **when** the confirmation is stored, **then** the amount is added to the courier's open remittance for that delivery run with status Expected (SM-LOG-05); PAY-008 marks the order paid from the same collected amount (AC-PAY-008-01-02).

**Given** a courier hands over cash at the depot, **when** the cashier records the remitted amount for the run, **then** expected (sum of collected amounts of the run) and remitted are compared: equal → Reconciled; different → Discrepancy and finance staff are alerted (event code Log.CodDiscrepancy, IC-TRK-04 SendEvent; BR-LOG-100).
**Given** a Discrepancy exists, **when** finance staff resolve it with a note, **then** the remittance becomes Resolved, locked, and audited (AUD-LOG-007).
**Given** delivery runs (LOG-024) are not in use, **when** a COD delivery is confirmed, **then** the run is the courier and the delivery date (Proposed).

**Given** a delivery partner collects COD, **when** the partner remittance file is imported, **then** its lines are matched by tracking number to collected amounts; unmatched lines are listed as exceptions.

**Given** a validation and geocoding provider is configured (IC-LOG-03), **when** an address is saved at checkout or in My account, **then** the provider's result is shown (valid, suggested correction, not found) and the shopper can accept the suggestion or keep the entry.

**Given** the provider returns coordinates or the shopper placed a map pin (CHK-007), **when** the address is saved, **then** latitude, longitude and source (pin, provider, manual) are stored in a plugin table keyed by AddressId, because the native Address has no coordinates (BR-LOG-140).

**Given** an order is placed, **when** the order is inserted, **then** the coordinates of the chosen address are copied to the order's cloned shipping address; if none exist, a geocoding job is enqueued for it.

**Given** no provider is configured or the provider is unavailable, **when** an address is saved, **then** it is saved without validation and the order is not blocked; the address is flagged "not validated" for operations.

**Given** a digital postcode adapter is configured, **when** an address is saved, **then** the digital postcode or alias is resolved and stored, and is printed on labels (LOG-007) and shown on the tracking page (TRK-001).

**Given** an order line ships internationally by post, **when** the shipment is created, **then** a customs declaration is drafted from the order (items, quantities, values, origin and customs fields from product data) with status Draft (SM-LOG-06).

**Given** a declaration is complete and CDS is integrated, **when** staff submit it, **then** it is sent through the CDS interface; the response sets Accepted or Rejected with reasons, and the result is audited (AUD-LOG-013).
**Given** the declaration is not Accepted, **when** staff try to dispatch the parcel, **then** dispatch is refused with message Log.CustomsNotAccepted (BR-LOG-150).
**Given** IPS is integrated, **when** IPS sends events for an item's S10 identifier, **then** the events go into TRK-002 and appear on the buyer's tracking timeline.

**Given** an IPS event code is received, **when** it is processed, **then** it is translated to the common event code through the IPS mapping table; an unmapped code is rejected to the TRK-002 review queue.
**Given** GMS is integrated, **when** the exchange runs, **then** the data set defined by the GMS interface specification is sent or received and the run is logged with its result.

**Given** duties are returned by an integrated system for the destination, **when** the shopper views the order or tracking page, **then** the duty amount and its source are shown; if none is available nothing is shown.

**Given** no shipment of the order is dispatched, no carrier booking is Booked, and the change window set by the client is open, **when** the shopper submits a new address or new instructions, **then** the change is checked for serviceability (LOG-004) and fee (LOG-002); if the fee is unchanged it is applied to the order address copy and audited (AUD-LOG-008) (BR-LOG-110).
**Given** a shipment is dispatched or the change window is closed, **when** the shopper opens the change form, **then** the form is not offered and message Log.AddressChangeNotAllowed is shown.
**Given** the new address gives a different delivery fee, **when** the change is submitted, **then** it is refused with message Log.AddressChangeFeeDiffers (Proposed).

**Given** an administrator edits the shipping address of an order with an active carrier booking (native AddressEdit POST), **when** the POST is sent, **then** the LOG action filter refuses it with message Log.ShipmentLocked until the booking is cancelled (BR-LOG-160).

**Given** a parcel is ready for pickup (ReadyForPickupDateUtc set), **when** the free storage days for the outlet pass, **then** the daily charge starts accruing (SM-LOG-08) and the buyer sees the amount due with message Log.HoldingCharge on the order page and in TRK-012 reminders (BR-LOG-111).

**Given** a chargeable parcel is collected, **when** outlet staff hand it over, **then** the accrued charge is shown to staff; the hand-over is allowed only after staff record the charge on the OutletParcel as paid (with the receipt reference) or waived (AUD-LOG-009); accrual stops at that moment. LOG records the status only and moves no money.
**Given** a user with Logistics.Core.Exceptions.CreateEditDelete waives a charge, **when** they save with a reason, **then** the charge is set to zero and the waiver audited (AUD-LOG-009).

**Given** the pickup deadline of the service level (ORD-011 ServiceLevel.PickupDeadline, counted from ReadyForPickupDateUtc) passes and the parcel is not collected, **when** the daily task runs, **then** the parcel is flagged Uncollected, TRK-012 sends the uncollected notice and, after the configured return delay, a return-to-sender exception is opened (LOG-013); the order-level flag and role escalation are ORD-011's.

**Given** shipments with promised ranges (LOG-005) were delivered in the period, **when** the dashboard is opened by a user with Logistics.Core.Reports.View, **then** the on-time rate is computed by the active RPT-002 KPI catalogue definition (BR-RPT-010, BR-LOG-120) and shown by service level, carrier and area; RPT-010 shows the same figure for the same filters.
**Given** shipments in the period ended delivered, returned to sender or lost, **when** the dashboard is opened, **then** delivery success rate per BR-LOG-120 is shown with the same filters.

**Given** shipments were shipped and delivered in the period, **when** the dashboard is opened, **then** average transit time = average of DeliveryDateUtc − ShippedDateUtc is shown in days with the same filters.
**Given** a user lacks Logistics.Core.Reports.View, **when** they open the dashboard, **then** access is denied (standard permission criterion).

**Given** the Logistics and postal pack is applied, **when** the KPI catalogue is loaded, **then** the BR-LOG-120 definitions are present as Draft entries with code, formula and owner LOG-018 (loaded by RPT-002, AC-RPT-002-02-01); the dashboard shows a KPI only while its catalogue entry is active.
**Given** a product carries the cold-chain specification attribute, **when** it is allocated and booked, **then** only carriers flagged cold-chain capable are eligible (carrier rule, BR-LOG-040).

**Given** a telemetry provider is integrated, **when** an out-of-range reading is received for a shipment, **then** a TRK-002 exception event is recorded and a LOG-013 incident of type delayed or damaged is opened for review.

**Given** a product carries the hazardous specification attribute, **when** a shipment is booked, **then** only carriers flagged as certified for that class are eligible, and dispatch is refused until the required documents are attached to the shipment.

**Given** an S10 series (service indicator, serial range, country code) is configured in the Postal pack, **when** an identifier is requested for an international postal shipment, **then** the next unused serial in the range is taken under ILocker key 'log-s10-{series}', its check digit computed per UPU S10, and the identifier (format of the baseline example RR123456789MW) set as Shipment.TrackingNumber through IShipmentService with ShipmentTrackingNumberSetEvent; it is audited (AUD-LOG-010) (BR-LOG-050).
**Given** a series is exhausted, **when** another identifier is requested, **then** none is issued and operations staff are alerted to configure a new range.

**Given** a user enters a tracking number on an international postal shipment (admin SetTrackingNumber or AddShipment POST), **when** the POST is sent, **then** the LOG action filter validates format and check digit; an invalid number is refused with message Log.S10Invalid (BR-LOG-160).

**Given** a shipment carries an S10 identifier and a partner or carrier reference, **when** either reference is searched, **then** the shipment, its ShipmentItems and their order lines are found; references are unique per type (ShipmentReference).

**Given** an adapter implements the connector (IC-LOG-01), **when** it is installed, **then** it declares a capability flag for GetRates, Book, GetLabel, Track, HandleCallback and Cancel, its supported service levels and label formats; carriers offering checkout rates also implement IShippingRateComputationMethod.

**Given** an adapter does not support an operation, **when** that operation is requested, **then** the framework returns NotSupported and the screen offers the manual path (enter waybill, upload label; an uploaded label is checked through IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload for the LOG upload context "carrier label", BR-LOG-082).

**Given** a booking request is retried after a timeout, **when** the adapter is called again, **then** the same idempotency key (ShipmentId + attempt) is sent and no second active booking exists (BR-LOG-041).

**Given** the adapter is a carrier rate method, or the order uses the LOG fee engine or the LOG outlet provider (including the postal service levels), **when** GetShipmentTrackerAsync is called, **then** it returns the TRK-002 hub tracker, so the native shipment pages show the common event timeline including PostGlobal events received through INT-007; LOG does not override IShipmentService.GetShipmentTrackerAsync (BR-LOG-042).
basis: FIT (ShipmentService.GetShipmentTrackerAsync loads the tracker from the order's rate method or pickup provider); OVR-REG

criterion: **Given** an adapter declares the reverse-booking capability and RET-003 requests a return pickup (IC-RET-03), **when** IC-LOG-01 BookReturn is called with the pickup address or drop-off outlet, destination (seller, warehouse or outlet), parcel data and return reference, **then** a CarrierBooking linked to the ReturnShipment (not to a native Shipment) is Requested and becomes Booked with booking and tracking references and a label if the carrier supplies one; the tracking reference is returned to RET-003, which registers it with TRK-002 (IC-TRK-01 RegisterExternalReference), so carrier events for it are applied; cancellation uses IC-LOG-01 Cancel; an adapter without the capability returns NotSupported.

**Given** assignment rules exist by destination area, service level, weight band, seller and fulfilment model, with priorities, **when** a shipment needs a partner, **then** the first matching rule by priority assigns the partner; with no match the default partner applies; the assignment is shown on the shipment (BR-LOG-040).

**Given** staff override the assigned partner, **when** they save with a reason, **then** the shipment is reassigned, any active booking with the old partner is cancelled first, and the change is audited (AUD-LOG-004).

**Given** rate shopping is enabled for a rule and two adapters return quotes for the service level, **when** the shipment is assigned, **then** the cheapest quote is selected and both quotes are stored with the shipment.

**Given** an adapter supports push callbacks, **when** a carrier calls the adapter route, **then** the callback is authenticated (signature, token or IP allow-list), then passed to TRK-002; a failed check is rejected and audited (AUD-LOG-003).

**Given** an adapter supports only polling, **when** the tracking poll task runs, **then** undelivered shipments of that carrier are polled at the configured interval (setting, default not stated) and new events passed to TRK-002.

**Given** a parcel label belongs to a shipment awaiting drop-off, **when** outlet staff scan it (TRK-003 app or the admin acceptance page with a barcode reader), **then** the shipment gets an accepted event in TRK-002 with outlet, staff and time; the seller receives an acceptance receipt (event code Log.DropOffAccepted, IC-TRK-04 SendEvent) and the event is audited (AUD-LOG-012).
**Given** the scanned code matches no shipment awaiting drop-off, **when** the scan is submitted, **then** acceptance is refused with message Log.UnknownParcel and the attempt logged.
**Given** the seller chose drop-off (SEL-018), **when** the order is released for fulfilment, **then** the seller sees the parcels to drop off and the outlets that accept drop-offs.
**Given** weight capture is enabled at the outlet, **when** the parcel is accepted, **then** the weight is recorded and differences against the declared weight are flagged.

**Given** the postal sorting system (external, not named) sends hand-over scan events, **when** they are received through the TRK-002 ingestion interface, **then** each scan is stored with hub, time and event code and appears in the timeline.
**Given** a hub route is configured with the expected sequence of hubs, **when** a parcel misses an expected hand-over scan, **then** TRK-002 flags it for operations review (missed-scan rule).
**Given** hubs are configured (Postal pack settings), **when** a scan names an unknown hub, **then** the event is rejected to the TRK-002 review queue.

**Given** shipments for an area are ready for last-mile delivery, **when** operations staff create the day's route list for a courier, **then** the list holds the shipments in the planned sequence (manual order, or by postal code and street when no routing provider exists) and each item becomes Assigned (SM-LOG-09).

**Given** the courier starts the round, **when** they open the list (mobile-friendly page or app), **then** items become OutForDelivery and TRK-002 records an out-for-delivery event per shipment, which triggers the TRK-012 notification.
**Given** an item is OutForDelivery, **when** the courier records Delivered with proof (LOG-012 / LOG-032), **then** the item becomes Delivered and DeliverAsync is called once.
**Given** an item is OutForDelivery, **when** the courier records Failed with a reason code, **then** the item becomes Failed and a LOG-013 exception opens.
**Given** a route list exists, **when** a courier opens a list that is not theirs, **then** access is denied.

**Given** the FedEx adapter is built on LOG-021 and configured with KTDA's account, **when** it is installed, **then** its capability record (IC-LOG-01) lists the operations the FedEx system supports; unsupported operations return NotSupported.

**Given** a shipment is assigned to FedEx and FedEx offers tracking by API, **when** FedEx reports an event (push or poll), **then** the event is passed to TRK-002, mapped to the common event list and shown on the timeline.

**Given** FedEx offers no tracking API, **when** a shipment is assigned to it, **then** staff record the waybill number and hand-over manually; the timeline shows only platform events and the shipment is marked "carrier updates not available".

**Given** the G4S (Kenya) adapter is built on LOG-021 and configured with KTDA's account, **when** it is installed, **then** its capability record (IC-LOG-01) lists the operations the G4S (Kenya) system supports; unsupported operations return NotSupported.

**Given** a shipment is assigned to G4S (Kenya) and G4S (Kenya) offers tracking by API, **when** G4S (Kenya) reports an event (push or poll), **then** the event is passed to TRK-002, mapped to the common event list and shown on the timeline.

**Given** G4S (Kenya) offers no tracking API, **when** a shipment is assigned to it, **then** staff record the waybill number and hand-over manually; the timeline shows only platform events and the shipment is marked "carrier updates not available".

**Given** the Skynet adapter is built on LOG-021 and configured with KTDA's account, **when** it is installed, **then** its capability record (IC-LOG-01) lists the operations the Skynet system supports; unsupported operations return NotSupported.

**Given** a shipment is assigned to Skynet and Skynet offers tracking by API, **when** Skynet reports an event (push or poll), **then** the event is passed to TRK-002, mapped to the common event list and shown on the timeline.

**Given** Skynet offers no tracking API, **when** a shipment is assigned to it, **then** staff record the waybill number and hand-over manually; the timeline shows only platform events and the shipment is marked "carrier updates not available".

**Given** the Wells Fargo (Kenya) adapter is built on LOG-021 and configured with KTDA's account, **when** it is installed, **then** its capability record (IC-LOG-01) lists the operations the Wells Fargo (Kenya) system supports; unsupported operations return NotSupported.

**Given** a shipment is assigned to Wells Fargo (Kenya) and Wells Fargo (Kenya) offers tracking by API, **when** Wells Fargo (Kenya) reports an event (push or poll), **then** the event is passed to TRK-002, mapped to the common event list and shown on the timeline.

**Given** Wells Fargo (Kenya) offers no tracking API, **when** a shipment is assigned to it, **then** staff record the waybill number and hand-over manually; the timeline shows only platform events and the shipment is marked "carrier updates not available".

**Given** the Aramex adapter is built on LOG-021 and configured with KTDA's account, **when** it is installed, **then** its capability record (IC-LOG-01) lists the operations the Aramex system supports; unsupported operations return NotSupported.

**Given** a shipment is assigned to Aramex and Aramex offers tracking by API, **when** Aramex reports an event (push or poll), **then** the event is passed to TRK-002, mapped to the common event list and shown on the timeline.

**Given** Aramex offers no tracking API, **when** a shipment is assigned to it, **then** staff record the waybill number and hand-over manually; the timeline shows only platform events and the shipment is marked "carrier updates not available".

**Given** an adapter for a named shipping line or agent is built on LOG-021, **when** it is installed, **then** its capability record lists the operations the line supports (for example booking reference and container or bill-of-lading tracking).

**Given** a sea-freight shipment has a bill-of-lading or container reference, **when** the line reports a milestone (push or poll), **then** the milestone is passed to TRK-002, mapped to the common event list and shown on the timeline.
**Given** the line offers no API, **when** a sea-freight shipment is created, **then** staff enter milestones manually in TRK-002 with the source "manual".

**Given** Malawi Post names a delivery partner and its adapter is built on LOG-021, **when** a shipment matches an assignment rule for that partner, **then** the shipment is assigned to it and the partner's supported operations (IC-LOG-01) are used.
**Given** a partner has no API, **when** a shipment is assigned to it, **then** the partner works from a printable or exported job list and its hand-over and delivery are recorded manually.

**Given** the own-fleet app (external) is registered as a device of an authorised courier (TRK-003 device register), **when** it posts a POD with time, coordinates, recipient acknowledgement method (signature, OTP, QR or scan), recipient name and media, **then** the POD intake API (IC-LOG-04) authenticates it, checks each media file through IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload (context "proof-of-delivery media", BR-LOG-082), stores it as a LOG-012 proof-of-delivery record with the media as downloads, and calls DeliverAsync once.
**Given** the app captured a POD while offline, **when** it syncs later, **then** the original capture time is kept and the late arrival is shown on the record.
**Given** a POD arrives for a shipment already delivered, **when** it is received, **then** it is stored as additional evidence and DeliverAsync is not called again.
**Given** location capture is used, **when** the courier captures a POD, **then** coordinates are taken from the device location service with the consent recorded by the app.

**Given** a discount "Assigned to categories" of a stated percentage with start and end dates and IsActive on is mapped to category C, **when** a shopper views a product of C between the dates, **then** the discounted price is shown; before the start or after the end the product shows its normal price.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-062 (category campaign); FC-M01-016; FIT (Discount.StartDateUtc / EndDateUtc / IsActive)

criterion: **Given** a discount "Assigned to order subtotal" with no coupon is active for the store, **when** any cart in the store meets its requirements, **then** the discount is applied to the subtotal of every such cart (sitewide campaign).

**Given** a discount has a requirement "customer role = R" (bundled DiscountRules.CustomerRoles), **when** a customer outside R reaches the cart, **then** the discount is not applied; a customer in R gets it.
**Given** a percentage discount has MaximumDiscountAmount M, **when** the computed discount exceeds M, **then** the discount applied equals M.

**Given** two non-cumulative discounts apply to the same item, **when** prices are calculated, **then** only one is applied, chosen by the native preferred-discount rule; cumulative discounts (IsCumulative on) are added together.

**Given** a discount requires coupon code K, is active and within its dates, **when** the shopper enters K in the cart discount box (ShoppingCartSettings.ShowDiscountBox on), **then** the code is accepted, the discount line appears in the order totals and is stored on the order.
**Given** a code is unknown, expired, inactive or its requirements are not met, **when** the shopper enters it, **then** it is not applied and the native coupon error message is shown.

**Given** a code has limitation "N times only" and N orders already used it, **when** another shopper enters it, **then** it is refused (DiscountService limitation check against DiscountUsageHistory).
**Given** a code has limitation "N times per customer", **when** a customer who used it N times enters it again, **then** it is refused; other customers can still use it.

**Given** an order with a discount is placed, **when** the order is saved, **then** a DiscountUsageHistory row records discount and order; creating, editing or deleting a discount writes the native activity log entries AddNewDiscount, EditDiscount, DeleteDiscount and the platform audit event AUD-MKT-001.

**Given** a code has limitation "N times only", N − 1 uses are recorded and two different customers confirm checkouts with it at the same time, **when** the CHK-003 placement override calls the MKT-001 placement participant (IC-MKT-04, registered through IC-CHK-06), **then** Reserve runs under ILocker key 'mkt-discount-{DiscountId}' and counts DiscountUsageHistory rows plus open DiscountReservation rows: the first checkout gets a reservation; the second is refused with message Mkt.DiscountLimitReached and its order is not placed; when the first sub-order is saved, Confirm ends the reservation (the native placement writes the DiscountUsageHistory row, so MKT writes no second usage row); if payment or placement fails, Release ends it (SM-MKT-08).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-109; Proposed (BR-CHK-020, IC-CHK-06); FIT (DiscountService NTimesOnly counts DiscountUsageHistory; OrderProcessingService inserts one DiscountUsageHistory row per applied discount)

criterion: **Given** a buy-X-get-Y rule "buy 1, get 1 free" is active on product P and linked to its discount, **when** a shopper has 2 units of P in the cart, **then** one unit is priced at zero; the line subtotal equals the price of one unit and the saving is shown as the line discount.
**Given** the same rule, **when** the shopper has 1 unit or 3 units of P, **then** with 1 unit no unit is free; with 3 units one unit is free (free units = floor(quantity / (X + Y)) × Y).

**Given** a buy-X-get-Y saving applies to a line, **when** the order is placed, **then** the order line stores the discounted subtotal and discount amount, because cart display, order totals and order placement all use IShoppingCartService.GetSubTotalAsync, whose single override (owner CHK-003, decision OVR-REG) calls the MKT buy-X-get-Y provider (BR-MKT-003).
basis: FIT (OrderProcessingService and OrderTotalCalculationService call GetSubTotalAsync); OVR-REG

criterion: **Given** a buy-X-get-Y saving and another non-cumulative discount both apply to the line, **when** prices are calculated, **then** only the larger saving applies.

**Given** three non-cumulative "order subtotal" discounts exist, each with a spend-band requirement rule [lower, upper), **when** the cart subtotal falls inside band 2, **then** only the band-2 discount applies.
basis: Inference from REQ-KTDA-MKT-002 (banding = spend bands, KG-11); Proposed (BR-MKT-004)

criterion: **Given** the cart subtotal equals the lower bound of band 2, **when** the cart is calculated, **then** band 2 applies (lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive).

**Given** a bundle requirement rule "all of products A, B, C in the cart" is attached to a discount assigned to A, B and C, **when** the cart holds A, B and C, **then** the discount applies to the three lines; removing any of them removes the discount from all.

**Given** RewardPointsSettings.Enabled is on with PointsForPurchases_Amount and PointsForPurchases_Points set, and the order total is at least MinOrderTotalToAwardPoints, **when** the order status becomes Complete, **then** points are added to the customer's RewardPointsHistory, valid until the date given by PurchasesPointsValidity and usable after ActivationDelay.
basis: REQ-KTDA-MKT-002; FIT (OrderProcessingService awards points when the order becomes Complete)

criterion: **Given** points were awarded for an order, **when** the order is cancelled, **then** the awarded points are reduced (native ReduceRewardPointsAsync).

**Given** the customer has a usable balance of at least MinimumRewardPointsToUse, **when** the customer chooses to use points at checkout, **then** points up to MaximumRewardPointsToUsePerOrder and within MaximumRedeemedRate are applied at ExchangeRate as an amount off the order total.
**Given** points have passed their end date, **when** the customer checks out, **then** they are not usable and do not count in the balance.
**Given** the customer opens My account, **when** reward points are enabled, **then** the balance and history with dates and messages are shown.

**Given** an administrator changes the reward points settings, **when** the change is saved, **then** new awards and redemptions follow the new values; existing history is unchanged; the change is audited (AUD-MKT-002).

**Given** a product is a gift card (Product.IsGiftCard, GiftCardType Virtual), **when** an order for it is placed, **then** a GiftCard with a unique coupon code and the amount is created per unit; it is activated when the order is Complete if OrderSettings.ActivateGiftCardsAfterCompletingOrder is on, otherwise by staff; the recipient receives GiftCard.Notification.
**Given** a physical gift card is ordered, **when** the order is shipped, **then** the card is activated per the same setting.

**Given** an activated gift card with a remaining amount, **when** the shopper enters its code (ShoppingCartSettings.ShowGiftCardBox on), **then** the remaining amount, up to the order total, is deducted; after the order is placed a GiftCardUsageHistory row records the used amount.
**Given** a gift card is not activated or has no remaining amount, **when** the shopper enters its code, **then** it is not applied and the native gift card error message is shown.

**Given** an order paid partly by gift card is cancelled and OrderSettings.DeleteGiftCardUsageHistory is on, **when** the cancellation completes, **then** the usage history row is deleted and the amount is available again.

**Given** a user with Orders.GiftCardsCreateEditDelete, **when** creates a voucher (gift card) with amount and code in admin, **then** it is usable once activated, and its usage history lists each order and amount; changes are audited (AUD-MKT-001).

**Given** CustomerSettings.NewsletterEnabled is on, **when** a visitor subscribes with an email, **then** an inactive subscription is created and the activation email NewsLetterSubscription.ActivationMessage is sent; the subscription becomes Active only after the link is followed (SM-MKT-07).
**Given** several subscription types exist (NewsLetterSubscriptionType), **when** the visitor subscribes, **then** the visitor can choose the types; types marked TickedByDefault are pre-selected.

**Given** an active subscriber with NewsletterBlockAllowToUnsubscribe on, **when** asks to unsubscribe from the newsletter block and follows the link in the deactivation email (NewsLetterSubscription.DeactivationMessage), **then** the subscription is removed and no further campaigns are sent to that email.

**Given** a campaign has subject, body, store, customer role, subscription type and DontSendBeforeDateUtc, **when** marketing staff send it, **then** one queued email per active subscriber matching store, role and type is created and is not sent before the date.
**Given** a campaign is drafted, **when** staff send a test email to an address, **then** only that address receives it.

**Given** Misc.Omnisend is configured with the client's API key (OmnisendSettings.ApiKey), **when** a visitor subscribes or unsubscribes, or staff run the contact synchronisation from the configuration page, **then** the Omnisend event consumer (EmailSubscribedEvent, EmailUnsubscribedEvent) creates or updates the contact with its status, and the configuration-page action SyncContacts sends all contacts in batches.

**Given** a client instance with TRK-005 installed, **when** the plugin list is checked, **then** Misc.Brevo is not installed, because its BrevoMessageService replaces IWorkflowMessageService (NopStartup Order 3000), which TRK-005 owns (BR-TRK-021).

**Given** a user without Configuration.ManagePlugins (for example a vendor, who has admin panel access), **when** opens the Omnisend configuration page, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500): now native — every Configure action of OmnisendAdminController (GET, save, sync-contacts, sync-products) carries [CheckPermission(Configuration.ManagePlugins)] in 5.00.1 (Plugins/Nop.Plugin.Misc.Omnisend/Controllers/OmnisendAdminController.cs:73, 89, 124, 137); no MKT action filter is built; verified by AC-MKT-005-03-04.

**Given** a vendor user (Vendors hold admin-panel access) without Configuration.ManagePlugins, **when** they open or post any Omnisend configuration action (configure, save, contact synchronisation, product synchronisation), **then** access is denied natively by [CheckPermission(Configuration.ManagePlugins)] and nothing changes (BR-MKT-013).

**Given** a pop-up is Active with schedule S and page rule "home page and category pages", **when** a shopper opens a matching page within S, **then** the pop-up is rendered by the MKT widget in zone body_end_html_tag_before; it is not rendered on other pages or outside S.
**Given** a pop-up is limited to customer role R, **when** a customer outside R opens a matching page, **then** it is not shown.
**Given** a pop-up has frequency "once per N days per visitor" (N is a setting), **when** the visitor closes it, **then** it is not shown to that visitor again until N days have passed.
**Given** a pop-up has content in the default language only, **when** a shopper using another language opens a matching page, **then** the default-language content is shown (Proposed fallback).
**Given** a pop-up is shown, **when** the shopper uses the keyboard, **then** the pop-up can be closed with the Escape key and its close button is reachable by Tab (NFR-X-005).

**Given** the MKT pop-up widget is mapped in the SEC-007 widget-category map to a cookie category the visitor has not accepted, **when** a matching page is rendered, **then** the pop-up is not rendered, because the SEC-007 IWidgetPluginManager override does not load the widget (BR-SEC-020).

**Given** a pop-up contains a newsletter form, **when** the shopper submits an email, **then** the native subscription flow runs (inactive subscription and activation email); message Mkt.PopupSubscribed is shown.

**Given** a user with ContentManagement.TopicsCreateEditDelete, **when** creates a topic with rich text, pictures uploaded through the editor, an embedded video, a URL name and Published on, **then** the page is available at its URL in the stores and roles it is limited to; with Published off it is not found.
**Given** a topic has AvailableStartDateTimeUtc and AvailableEndDateTimeUtc, **when** a shopper opens it outside that window, **then** it is not shown.
**Given** a blog post (for example a farmer story or factory information) with pictures and start and end dates, **when** a shopper opens the blog, **then** the post is listed only between its dates.

**Given** a news item (announcement) with Published on and start and end dates, **when** a shopper opens the news list, **then** it is listed only while published and between its dates; with Published off it is hidden.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-313 (announcements); FIT (5.00.1: news is the bundled plugin Misc.News, installed only if a client uses news; NewsItem.Published, Plugins/Nop.Plugin.Misc.News/Domain/NewsItem.cs:36)

criterion: **Given** a customer service charter is created as a topic and linked from a menu (native menus), **when** a shopper opens the menu, **then** the charter page opens.
**Given** the bundled Misc.Polls plugin is installed and a poll is published, **when** a registered shopper votes, **then** the vote is counted once per customer.
basis: D; FIT (5.00.1: polls are the bundled plugin Misc.Polls, Plugins/Nop.Plugin.Misc.Polls/Domain/Poll.cs, PollVotingRecord.cs)

criterion: **Given** the bundled Widgets.Swiper is active, **when** content staff add a slide with picture, title, alternative text and link, **then** the slide appears in the home-page slider; deleting it removes it.

**Given** topics PrivacyInfo, ConditionsOfUse and ShippingInfo exist natively, and topics for returns and complaints are created per client, **when** the footer and checkout are shown, **then** links to each policy page are shown; the conditions-of-use acceptance in checkout opens the ConditionsOfUse topic.
**Given** FAQ topics are published and grouped in a help menu with IncludeInSitemap on, **when** a shopper opens the help menu, **then** each FAQ page opens and is listed in the sitemap.
**Given** onboarding topics are published with ACL for the Registered role, **when** a newly registered customer opens My account, **then** links to the onboarding content are shown.

**Given** approval is enabled for content type Topic and a user without Marketing.Core.Content.Approve, **when** saves an edit of a published topic (Admin TopicController.Edit [POST]), **then** the MKT action filter stores the posted content (all languages) as a ContentRevision PendingApproval and does not change the live topic; message Mkt.ContentSubmitted is shown.

**Given** a revision is PendingApproval, **when** an approver who is not its author approves, **then** the revision is applied through ITopicService.UpdateTopicAsync and the localized values through ILocalizedEntityService; the revision becomes Approved; audited (AUD-MKT-003).
**Given** a revision is PendingApproval, **when** the approver rejects it with a reason, **then** it becomes Rejected; the author sees the reason and can edit and resubmit.
**Given** the author of a revision, **when** tries to approve it, **then** approval is refused with message Mkt.SelfApprovalNotAllowed (BR-MKT-007).

**Given** approval is enabled and a user without approval rights creates a topic, news item or blog post, **when** the create form is saved, **then** no live item is created; the content is held as a PendingApproval revision and the item is created through the native service (InsertTopicAsync, the Misc.News plugin NewsService.InsertNewsAsync, InsertBlogPostAsync) only on approval, because BlogPost has no published flag.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-313; FIT (BlogPost has StartDateUtc / EndDateUtc only); Proposed

criterion: **Given** a topic is flagged as a policy (for example PrivacyInfo, ConditionsOfUse, ShippingInfo, returns, complaints, VendorTermsOfService), **when** a revision of it is approved with an effective date, **then** a PolicyVersion is created with the policy system name, the next version number, effective date, the "re-acceptance required" flag set by the approver, full content in every language and approver; it becomes Effective on that date and the previous version Superseded (SM-MKT-02).

**Given** a PolicyVersion becomes Effective, **when** the status is saved, **then** MKT publishes the event Policy.VersionPublished (policy system name, version number, effective date, re-acceptance required); IAM-016 reads the version and the flag through IC-MKT-03 and runs the re-acceptance prompt, for seller terms (SEL-006) as well, only when the flag is set; no other module keeps a re-acceptance flag (decision ONE-RECORD).

**Given** approval is enabled for topics and a topic is flagged as a knowledge-base article (CRM-007), **when** an editor without Marketing.Core.Content.Approve saves a new or changed article, **then** it is held as a PendingApproval revision, is not visible to shoppers until approved, and the approver cannot be its author (BR-MKT-007).

**Given** policy versions exist, **when** a user with Marketing.Core.PolicyVersions.View opens the history, **then** all versions are listed with number, effective date, approver, and each can be read in full.
**Given** a PolicyVersion exists, **when** anyone tries to edit or delete it, **then** it cannot be changed; corrections are new versions (BR-MKT-008).

**Given** a policy version becomes Effective, **when** an acceptance is recorded (IAM-016 for customers, SEL-006 for seller terms, both through IC-IAM-05), **then** the IAM acceptance record stores that version number read through IC-MKT-03; MKT keeps no acceptance records (decision ONE-RECORD).

**Given** a product, category, manufacturer, topic, blog post or news item has a URL name (UrlRecord) and meta title, description and keywords, **when** its page is requested, **then** the URL uses the name and the page head contains the meta title (with SeoSettings.PageTitleSeparator) and description.

**Given** SeoSettings.GenerateProductMetaDescription is on and a product has no meta description, **when** the product page is requested, **then** a meta description generated from the product short description is used.

**Given** ArtificialIntelligenceSettings.Enabled and AllowMetaTitleGeneration / AllowMetaDescriptionGeneration are on (AI provider per AI module), **when** staff ask for generated meta text in admin, **then** the text is generated for review and saved only when staff save.

**Given** SitemapXmlSettings.SitemapXmlEnabled is on with the entity types to include, **when** /sitemap.xml is requested, **then** it lists the URLs of the included types; robots.txt is served from RobotsTxtSettings.

**Given** SeoSettings.CanonicalUrlsEnabled is on and WwwRequirement is set, **when** a page is requested with or without www, **then** the canonical link tag is present and the request is redirected to the required host form.
**Given** SeoSettings.MicrodataEnabled is on, **when** a product page is requested, **then** structured product data is included.

**Given** several languages are active and LocalizationSettings.SeoFriendlyUrlsForLanguagesEnabled is on, **when** a page is requested in a language, **then** the URL carries the language code and each language version is indexable.
**Given** SeoSettings.OpenGraphMetaTags and TwitterMetaTags are on, **when** a product page is shared, **then** Open Graph and Twitter tags with title, description and picture are present.

**Given** the bundled Widgets.GoogleAnalytics is active with GoogleId and EnableEcommerce on, **when** a shopper browses and completes an order, **then** the Google tag is on every storefront page and ecommerce events are sent as the bundled plugin defines.
**Given** the bundled Widgets.FacebookPixel is configured, **when** a shopper browses, **then** the pixel and its configured events are rendered.

**Given** another advertising tag (for example a Google Ads tag) is entered in SeoSettings.CustomHeadTags, **when** any storefront page is requested, **then** the tag is in the page head on every page, whatever the visitor's cookie choice, because CustomHeadTags is rendered by _Root.Head.cshtml and not through a widget (BR-MKT-012 allows it only where the country profile needs no consent for it).

**Given** Widgets.GoogleAnalytics, Widgets.FacebookPixel and the Misc.Omnisend tracking widget are mapped in the SEC-007 widget-category map to the analytics or marketing category, and the profile requires consent (SEC-012), **when** a visitor who has not accepted that category opens a page, **then** the tag widgets are not rendered until consent is given, because the SEC-007 IWidgetPluginManager override does not load them (BR-SEC-020, BR-MKT-012).
**Given** CatalogSettings.ShowShareButton is on with PageShareCode, **when** a shopper opens a product page, **then** share buttons are shown.
**Given** StoreInformationSettings FacebookLink, TwitterLink, YoutubeLink and InstagramLink are set, **when** any storefront page is shown, **then** the footer shows the social links.

**Given** Google Analytics ecommerce is on and campaign links carry UTM parameters, **when** an order results from a campaign link, **then** the order revenue is attributed to the campaign in Google Analytics, available to the RPT-011 dashboard.

**Given** CustomerSettings.GenderEnabled and DateOfBirthEnabled are on, **when** a customer registers or edits the profile, **then** gender and date of birth are captured (age is derived from date of birth).

**Given** customer attributes "location type" (rural / urban) and "buyer type" are configured as drop-downs, **when** a customer registers, **then** the values are captured and stored with the customer (native custom customer attributes).
**Given** a vendor attribute "seller size" (for example SME) is configured, **when** a seller applies or edits the profile, **then** the value is stored with the vendor.

**Given** a segment rule "location type = rural and buyer type = farmer" is saved with target role "Segment: rural farmers", **when** the segment task runs, **then** customers matching the rule are in that customer role and customers no longer matching are removed (BR-MKT-009).
**Given** a segment role exists, **when** a campaign or a discount requirement (DiscountRules.CustomerRoles) uses it, **then** only customers of the segment receive the campaign or the discount.

**Given** Misc.Omnisend is configured with tracking on, **when** a shopper with a known email leaves a cart, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500): now native — abandoned-cart e-mail reminders are sent by the core reminder task (ReminderSettings.AbandonedCartEnabled, Libraries/Nop.Core/Domain/Reminders/ReminderSettings.cs:13; ProcessAbandonedCartsTask, Libraries/Nop.Services/Reminders/ProcessAbandonedCartsTask.cs:48-156); Omnisend is no longer needed for MKT-012; verified by AC-MKT-012-01-04 to AC-MKT-012-01-06.

**Given** the shopper has not given marketing consent where the data-protection profile requires it, **when** the shopper leaves a cart, **then** no reminder is sent to that shopper (BR-MKT-012): the native reminder task has no consent check, so the TRK-005 engine, which every reminder template reaches (BR-TRK-020), suppresses it under the marketing category of the Reminders.AbandonedCartFollowUp1 to 3 definitions and logs it Suppressed.
basis: Proposed; FIT (5.00.1: ProcessAbandonedCartsTask selects on cart dates and e-mail only, Libraries/Nop.Services/Reminders/ProcessAbandonedCartsTask.cs:74-85)

criterion: **Given** a client instance, **when** the abandoned-cart set-up is checked, **then** Misc.Brevo is not installed and no Brevo marketing automation or Brevo SMS is used, because Brevo replaces IWorkflowMessageService, which TRK-005 owns (BR-TRK-021).

**Given** ReminderSettings.AbandonedCartEnabled is on and the templates Reminders.AbandonedCartFollowUp1, 2 and 3 are active with a DelayBeforeSend, **when** a registered customer with an e-mail address has shopping-cart or saved-for-later items and has not changed the cart for longer than the first delay, **then** the native reminder task sends follow-up 1, then follow-up 2 and 3 after their delays counted from the previous follow-up, with no reminder for a cart changed before ReminderSettings.ProcessingStartDateUtc; an inactive template stops the sequence at that step.

**Given** a follow-up template is triggered by the reminder task, **when** it is sent, **then** it passes through the TRK-005 engine like any native template (SendNotificationAsync), so TRK-006 preferences, the BR-MKT-012 consent rule and any SMS variant of its definition apply, and it is logged in TRK-007.

**Given** a user with Promotions.ManageReminders (native since 5.00), **when** they open the admin Reminders page and change the abandoned-cart switch or a follow-up template, **then** the change is saved for the store; a user without the permission is refused.

**Given** an affiliate is Active with FriendlyUrlName, **when** a visitor arrives with ?affiliate=<name> or ?affiliateid=<id>, **then** the visitor's Customer.AffiliateId is set; orders placed carry Order.AffiliateId and appear in the affiliate's order list; OrderPlaced.AffiliateNotification and OrderPaid.AffiliateNotification are sent if active.
**Given** referrals are enabled and customer A has a referral link, **when** a new customer B registers through it (CustomerRegisteredEvent), **then** a referral A → B is Registered (SM-MKT-04).

**Given** a referral is Registered, **when** B's first order reaches Complete, **then** the referral becomes Qualified and A receives the configured points through IRewardPointService.AddRewardPointsHistoryEntryAsync; the referral becomes Rewarded.
**Given** B uses the same email, phone or device identifier as A, **when** B registers through A's link, **then** the referral is Void and no points are awarded (BR-MKT-010).

**Given** an affiliate commission rule (percentage of order subtotal) exists, **when** an affiliate order is paid, **then** a commission is Accrued; it becomes Payable when the hold period passes without refund, and Reversed if the order is refunded first (SM-MKT-05).
**Given** commissions are Payable, **when** finance staff pay them (through PAY-024 Payout or offline), **then** they become Paid with the payment reference.

**Given** a seller user has the native vendor product rights, **when** the seller edits the price of an own product, **then** the price is saved; products of other sellers are not visible or editable (native vendor scoping).
**Given** the seller adds a tier price with StartDateTimeUtc and EndDateTimeUtc, **when** a shopper buys within the window, **then** the tier price applies; outside the window the base price applies.

**Given** a seller user creates a discount, **when** it is saved, **then** VendorId is set to the seller (native Create POST), the type is "Assigned to SKUs", and it applies to the seller's mapped products between its start and end dates.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-061; FIT (5.00.1: Discount.VendorId; Admin DiscountController.Create sets VendorId and DiscountType.AssignedToSkus for vendor users, Presentation/Nop.Web/Areas/Admin/Controllers/DiscountController.cs:114-123)

criterion: **Given** a seller user posts a discount with another type, or adds a product of another seller to a discount, **when** the POST is made (Admin DiscountController Create / Edit / ProductAddPopup), **then** Withdrawn (VER-500): now native — in 5.00.1 the Create and Edit POST actions force DiscountType.AssignedToSkus for vendor users (DiscountController.cs:118-123, 182-183) and ProductAddPopup refuses another vendor's discount and skips other vendors' products (DiscountController.cs:495-506); no MKT action filter is built (BR-MKT-011); verified by AC-MKT-014-02-04.
**Given** a discount of seller V, **when** another seller opens or edits it, **then** access is refused (native GetCurrentVendorAsync check in DiscountController).
**Given** a seller changes a price or discount, **when** it is saved, **then** the change is recorded in the platform audit trail (AUD-MKT-004).

**Given** a seller user posts a discount with another type, adds a product of another seller to an own discount, or posts products to another seller's discount, **when** the POST is made (Admin DiscountController Create / Edit / ProductAddPopup), **then** the native action saves the discount as "Assigned to SKUs" with the seller's VendorId, skips the other seller's product, and refuses the other seller's discount ("This is not your discount"); nothing outside the seller's scope changes (BR-MKT-011).

**Given** the user has Orders.OrdersView, **when** the user opens the order list, **then** orders can be filtered by created date, order status, stage (ORD-002), payment status, shipping status, store, seller, payment method, product, billing email, phone and country, and order number; each row opens the order.
**Given** the user has Orders.OrdersCreateEditDelete, **when** the user makes any edit on the order page, **then** the edit needs a reason code (ORD-003) before it is saved.
**Given** an order is open, **when** the user prints, **then** the PDF invoice (ORD-009) and the packing slips of its shipments are produced.

**Given** the user has Orders.OrdersImportExport and has filtered the list by date, status and seller, **when** the user exports all to Excel or XML, **then** the file contains exactly the filtered orders.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-174; FIT (ExportExcelAll / ExportXmlAll take the search model)

criterion: **Given** the user lacks Orders.OrdersImportExport, **when** the user tries to export, **then** access is denied and no file is produced.
**Given** the user has Orders.CurrentCartsManage, **when** the user opens Current shopping carts, **then** each customer's cart and wishlist items are listed.

**Given** an order is opened, **when** the order page loads, **then** it shows the current stage and stage history, notes, intervention and audit entries, payment transactions (link to PAY-019), shipments, holds and generated documents.
**Given** the order list is shown, **when** it loads, **then** each row shows stage and service-level due time (ORD-011) so overdue orders can be sorted first.

**Given** the administrator defines stages, each mapped to the native OrderStatus values it may coexist with (Pending, Processing, Complete, Cancelled), and the allowed transitions, **when** the model is saved, **then** it is accepted only if every stage maps to at least one native value and every transition is between defined stages; the OrderStatus enum is not changed (BR-ORD-010).

**Given** the Malawi Post stage set (Created, Awaiting Payment, Paid, Processing, Shipped, Ready for Pickup, Delivered, Completed, Cancelled, Returned, Refunded) is loaded from the configuration pack, **when** orders progress, **then** orders show these stages with the native status they map to.

**Given** auto-advance rules link stages to native events (order placed, payment pending, OrderPaidEvent, ShipmentSentEvent, ShipmentReadyForPickupEvent, ShipmentDeliveredEvent, OrderStatusChangedEvent to Complete or Cancelled, OrderRefundedEvent, RET Return.Completed (BR-RET-064)), **when** the native or module event occurs, **then** the stage moves to the linked stage if that transition is declared; otherwise the order goes to the stage exceptions list (BR-ORD-012).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-153; FIT (events published by OrderProcessingService and Shipping EventPublisherExtensions)

criterion: **Given** a manual stage change requests a transition that is not declared, **when** the user submits it, **then** it is refused with message Ord.TransitionNotAllowed, the stage is unchanged and the attempt is logged with user, order, from, to and time (AUD-ORD-002).

**Given** a manual stage change targets a stage mapped to a different native status, **when** the user submits it, **then** the change is made only through the native service (CancelOrderAsync for Cancelled); other native status changes come only from payment and shipping actions, so the stage change is refused with message Ord.TransitionNotAllowed (BR-ORD-011).

**Given** a user posts the native admin order-status change (Admin OrderController.ChangeOrderStatus, which sets OrderStatusId directly), **when** the request arrives, **then** the ORD action filter allows it only with Orders.Core.Status.Override and a reason, re-aligns the stage to a stage mapped to the new status, and audits it (AUD-ORD-001); otherwise it is refused with message Ord.ReasonRequired.
basis: FIT (ChangeOrderStatus, OrderController.cs:891 in 5.00.1; no ModelState check)

criterion: **Given** a stage is marked visible to customers, **when** the stage changes, **then** My account order details show the localised stage name and date, and ORD raises the stage event code through IC-TRK-04 SendEvent so that TRK-005 sends the stage message on the configured channels (status changes of the native templates already pass through the TRK-005 engine).

**Given** the ORD plugin is installed, or an administrator saves a stage that is visible to customers and set to notify, **when** installation runs or the stage is saved, **then** ORD registers each of its product event codes (names Proposed, listed in BR-TRK-023: Ord.Core.StageChanged, Ord.Core.Cancelled, Ord.Core.SellerDeadlineReminder, Ord.Core.PartialSupplyProposed, Ord.Core.SlaEscalation, Ord.Core.RfqInvitation, Ord.Core.RfqAnswered, Ord.Core.QuoteReceived, Ord.Core.CounterOffer, Ord.Core.QuoteDeclined, Ord.Core.QuoteExpired, Ord.Core.RequisitionDecided, Ord.Core.ContractForReview, Ord.Core.ContractForSigning, Ord.Core.LetterIssued, Ord.Core.SecurityExpiring, Ord.Core.GroupDealOutcome) through IC-TRK-04 RegisterEventCode with default channels and localised default content, and stores the code in OrderStageDefinition.TrkEventCode; a stage cannot be set to notify without a registered code.

**Given** acceptance is enabled for the order and the order is in the stage mapped to delivery, **when** the buyer selects Accept order in My account, **then** the stage moves to Accepted, OrderAcceptedEvent (new, BR-ORD-013) is published and the action is audited (AUD-ORD-003).

**Given** an acceptance window is configured (setting, default not stated) and a delivered order has no acceptance and no open dispute, **when** the window passes, **then** the ORD scheduled task records deemed acceptance and publishes OrderAcceptedEvent with Deemed = true; if no window is configured there is no deemed acceptance.

**Given** a dispute case is open for the order (RET-007), **when** the buyer or the task tries to record acceptance, **then** ORD calls IC-RET-01 HasOpenCase inside the order lock; acceptance is refused with message Ord.AcceptanceBlockedByDispute until the case is resolved.

**Given** the client configures the confirmation rule (at placement, at payment, or after seller or staff acceptance), **when** the condition is met, **then** the order moves to stage Confirmed and the confirmation notification is sent.

**Given** a stage definition carries an operational stage code for ADM-007 (AwaitingPickup, AwaitingSorting, AwaitingDispatch, OutForLastMileDelivery), **when** ADM-007 builds its operational order view, **then** each order is placed in the operational stage of its current stage; where the stage alone does not decide it, the rule BR-ORD-015 uses shipment data (no shipment; shipment created and not shipped; Shipment.ShippedDateUtc set and DeliveryDateUtc empty); the Malawi Post mapping values are configuration and are not stated in source (MG-06).
basis: see ADM-007 (REQ-MPC-FR-162); FIT (Shipment dates; Order.ShippingStatus); Proposed

criterion: **Given** a line stage set is configured for a product type (the service stage set SM-SVC-01 of SVC-005 is the default for service lines), **when** an order with such a line is placed, **then** the line module starts its line stage at the first stage of the configured set (for service lines SVC-005 ServiceOrderStage) and asks ORD (IC-ORD-10 ValidateLineTransition) before every change; an undeclared transition is refused; the per-line state, its history and its event (Service.StageChanged) stay with the line module (BR-ORD-014).

**Given** an order has no shippable item (ShippingStatus ShippingNotRequired), **when** its payment is completed and native CheckOrderStatusAsync sets OrderStatus Complete, **then** the order stage moves only as far as the stage mapped to native Complete for that order type allows, and progress of its lines is carried by the line stages of the line module (SVC-005 for services); what happens to the native OrderCompleted.CustomerNotification for such orders (send, suppress or substitute) is the per-client action of TRK-005 for the order kind (BR-TRK-024, order-kind providers IC-TRK-05 of EGV and SVC); ORD sends, suppresses and rewords nothing.

**Given** a user posts a native admin order edit (ChangeOrderStatus, CancelOrder, EditOrderTotals, EditOrderItem, DeleteOrderItem, EditShippingMethod, AddressEdit, AddProductToOrderDetails, OrderNoteDelete, Delete), **when** the request arrives without a reason code, **then** the ORD global action filter refuses it with message Ord.ReasonRequired and nothing changes.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-156; FIT (these actions take ids or forms; a ModelReceivedEvent veto would not run)

criterion: **Given** the request carries a reason code from the configured list (and a comment where the code requires one), **when** the edit is applied, **then** the reason is stored as an OrderIntervention linked to the audit entry (AUD-ORD-001); payment actions are not handled here but by PAY (BR-PAY-082).

**Given** any order state changes (OrderStatus, PaymentStatus, ShippingStatus, stage) or a key field changes (totals, items, addresses, shipping method), **when** the change is saved, **then** the SEC-004 audit trail records user, time, before and after values, and the ORD reason code; audit entries cannot be edited or deleted by any role.
**Given** an order note is deleted, **when** the deletion is posted, **then** a reason is required and the deleted note text is kept in the audit entry (AUD-ORD-001).

**Given** an intervention type is configured as needing approval (for example order total edit or status override), **when** a user submits it, **then** it is held as a Pending intervention (SM-ORD-11) with message Ord.ApprovalPending; it is applied only when a different user with Orders.Core.Interventions.Approve approves it; rejection needs a reason.

**Given** two users act on the same order at the same time, **when** both actions run, **then** each runs under ILocker key 'pay-order-{OrderId}' (the shared order key of BR-PAY-013); the second re-reads the order and is refused with message Ord.OrderBusy if the lock is held or its expected state no longer holds.
basis: FC-M03-022; FIT (ILocker.PerformActionWithLockAsync returns false when the lock is held)

criterion: **Given** the order reaches a stage configured for snapshots (for example Paid, Completed, Cancelled), **when** the stage is set, **then** a read-only JSON snapshot of the order, items, totals, addresses, stage, payment and shipping status is stored (OrderSnapshot).

**Given** native OrderSettings.AllowCustomersCancelOrders is off, ORD buyer cancellation is on, the order has no shipment and its seller task is not Packed or HandedOver, and the cancellation window (setting, default not stated) has not passed, **when** the buyer selects Cancel order and chooses a reason, **then** under the order lock the platform calls CancelOrderAsync(order, notifyCustomer: true) and stores the reason (AUD-ORD-001); if the order was paid, the refund follows from RET-005 (its consumer of the native OrderStatusChangedEvent raises a Cancellation refund trigger and PAY-016 moves the money); ORD raises no refund itself.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-154; FIT (native self-cancel takes no reason and only checks status != Cancelled)

criterion: **Given** fulfilment has started or the window has passed, **when** the buyer opens the order or posts a cancellation, **then** the Cancel button is not shown and a posted cancellation is refused with message Ord.CancelNotAllowed.

**Given** a seller with Orders.Core.SellerOrders.Process owns the sub-order, **when** the seller rejects it with a reason code (for example out of stock), **then** the platform cancels it through CancelOrderAsync, the buyer is notified, any penalty rule is applied, and a paid sub-order is refunded through RET-005 (Cancellation trigger) as in criterion 01-01.
**Given** a seller rejects without a reason code, **when** the request is posted, **then** it is refused with message Ord.ReasonRequired.

**Given** a seller acceptance deadline is configured (hours after payment or placement, default not stated), **when** a seller task is still New when the deadline passes, **then** the ORD scheduled task re-checks the state under the order lock and cancels the sub-order with reason "Seller deadline missed"; the buyer is notified and a paid sub-order is refunded through RET-005 (Cancellation trigger).

**Given** a penalty rule is configured (type and amount, default not stated), **when** a sub-order is cancelled for a missed deadline or a seller rejection, **then** a SellerPenalty record is created and passed to SEL through IC-SEL-05 AddSellerCharge (source type Penalty); SEL-017 deducts it in the next settlement.
**Given** a seller cannot supply only some lines, **when** the seller reports them, **then** the partial-supply flow of ORD-006 applies instead of a full rejection.

**Given** the native automatic cancellation of unpaid orders (OrderSettings.AutoCancelEnabled, new in 5.00, install default off) is considered for a client, **when** the cancellation rules are configured, **then** it is used for no ORD-004 rule: it cancels only orders with PaymentStatus Pending (OrderStatus Pending or Processing) after one delay, through CancelOrderAsync; seller-deadline cancellation, reasons, windows and penalties stay ORD-004 builds, and the setting stays off under BR-PAY-170 while INV-004 owns the unpaid-order timeout.

**Given** a vendor user with Orders.Core.SellerOrders.Process, **when** the seller opens the dashboard, **then** own sub-orders are listed with task status (New, Accepted, Packed, HandedOver), stage, due time (ORD-011) and holds.

**Given** a task is New and the order is paid or authorised, or its payment method is in the "fulfil before payment" list (for example COD, on account), **when** the seller selects Accept, **then** the task becomes Accepted (SM-ORD-02).
**Given** a task is Accepted, **when** the seller selects Packed, **then** the task becomes Packed.

**Given** a task is Packed and a shipment exists for its items (native AddShipment, allowed to vendors for their own items), **when** the seller selects Hand over, **then** the task becomes HandedOver and each step is audited (AUD-ORD-004); for a seller that ships with its own carrier the platform calls IOrderProcessingService.ShipAsync for the shipment; for a seller fulfilled through the postal network (LOG-008 allocation) hand-over starts a LOG-011 seller pickup request or a LOG-022 drop-off, and the shipment status then changes only through TRK-002 tracking events, not through ORD.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-152; FIT (vendors can add shipments; ShipAsync); Proposed

criterion: **Given** the order has an active hold, **when** the seller selects Hand over, **then** it is refused with message Ord.OrderOnHold (ORD-010 guard: IC-CHK-07 for ShipAsync, ORD-010 shipment-guard host for shipment creation).

**Given** an order or payment event occurs for a seller's sub-order, **when** the event is raised, **then** the native OrderPlaced.VendorNotification and OrderPaid.VendorNotification are sent; when the acceptance or SLA deadline is within the configured lead time a reminder is sent through TRK-005.

**Given** the seller selects several Accepted or Packed sub-orders on the dashboard, **when** the seller selects Print, **then** the batch pick list and packing list are produced by LOG-009 for those sub-orders with only the seller's items; ORD-005 only passes the selection.

**Given** partial supply is enabled for the client and a task is Accepted, **when** the seller reports unavailable quantities per line, **then** a PartialSupplyProposal is created (SM-ORD-03) and the buyer is notified with the lines and the amount affected.

**Given** a proposal is open, **when** the buyer accepts, **then** under the order lock the ORD partial-supply service reduces the quantities itself, never through the native admin EditOrderItem action (which returns stock through AdjustInventoryAsync): with AutoUpdateOrderTotalsOnEditingOrder on it calls IOrderProcessingService.UpdateOrderTotalsAsync with UpdateOrderParameters carrying the new quantity, otherwise it updates the item quantity and amounts through IOrderService.UpdateOrderItemAsync and adjusts the order totals itself; IProductService.AdjustInventoryAsync is not called, so stock is not returned (BR-ORD-033); if paid, ORD raises a refund trigger for those lines through RET-005 (IC-RET-04, source type PartialSupply, lines with quantity and amount) before any line change; the change is audited (AUD-ORD-001).
**Given** a proposal is open, **when** the buyer rejects, **then** the sub-order is cancelled as in ORD-004; a paid sub-order is refunded through RET-005 (Cancellation trigger).
