**Given** the buyer does not answer within the configured time (setting, default not stated), **when** the time passes, **then** the configured default action (accept or reject; default not stated) is applied.
**Given** partial supply is disabled for the client, **when** the seller cannot supply some lines, **then** the seller can only fulfil all lines or reject the sub-order (ORD-004).
**Given** OrderSettings.CustomOrderNumberMask is MP-{YYYY}-{ID}, **when** an order is placed, **then** its custom order number is for example MP-2026-123 (native).

**Given** the mask uses the padded token {ID:6} (Proposed syntax), **when** an order is placed, **then** the number is for example MP-2026-000123; the padding is applied by the ORD ICustomNumberFormatter override registered through DI, because the native padding code is commented out.

**Given** different masks are set per store, **when** orders are placed in each store, **then** each store's orders use its own mask (store-overridable setting), separating for example trade and retail orders.
**Given** masks per order type are configured (goods, service, quote, recurring) (Proposed), **when** an order of that type is placed, **then** the type mask is used instead of the store mask.
**Given** a mask contains an unknown token, **when** the administrator saves it, **then** it is refused with message Ord.MaskInvalid.

**Given** OrderSettings.IsReOrderAllowed is on, **when** the buyer selects Re-order on a past order, **then** each item is added to the cart through AddToCartAsync, so current prices and stock apply; items that cannot be added are skipped and the native ShoppingCart.ReorderWarning is shown.
**Given** the past order came from a split checkout (CHK-004), **when** the buyer re-orders one sub-order, **then** only that sub-order's items are added.

**Given** the client has chosen the issue point (order placed, paid or completed; AttachPdfInvoiceTo* settings), **when** that event occurs, **then** an InvoiceDocument with its number is recorded, the PDF is rendered by DOC-001 from the invoice template (IC-DOC-01) and attached to the matching native email, and Invoice.Issued is published for PAY-025, without manual action (issue job enqueued by a consumer and executed by a scheduled task).

**Given** a checkout produced sub-orders per seller (CHK-004), **when** invoices are issued, **then** each sub-order has its own invoice naming its seller; for an order holding several sellers' items (Marketplace split off) a per-seller PDF is produced through PrintOrderToPdfAsync(vendor), whose vendor parameter the DOC-001 IPdfService override keeps.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-120; FIT (IPdfService vendor parameter); see DOC-001

criterion: **Given** a checkout produced more than one sub-order, **when** the buyer opens the checkout or the confirmation, **then** a consolidated receipt (ORD document type ConsolidatedReceipt, rendered by DOC-001 through IC-DOC-01) lists every sub-order, seller and amount and the total paid ("when applicable").

**Given** company legal name, address and tax registration number, and seller name and tax number are configured, **when** an invoice is generated, **then** it shows them, the platform service fees charged on the order (payment fee, delivery fee, service fee lines) and the tax per rate (Order.TaxRates); fields that native order tokens do not hold (checkout reference, sub-order list, seller name and tax number, company tax fields, fee lines) are supplied by the ORD token provider registered with DOC (IC-ORD-07 through IC-DOC-02).

**Given** a mandatory company field is empty, **when** an invoice would be issued, **then** it is not issued, the order is listed with message Ord.InvoiceSettingsMissing for administrators, and issuing resumes when the field is filled.

**Given** PAY-025 has returned a fiscal number and QR for the invoice, **when** the PDF is generated, **then** they are printed on it through the PAY-025 token provider registered with DOC (IC-DOC-02); ORD does not read or print fiscal data itself.

**Given** a user with Orders.Core.Holds.CreateEditDelete, **when** the user places a hold with a reason, **then** the hold is Active (SM-ORD-04), the order and the seller dashboard show it, and it is audited (AUD-ORD-005).

**Given** a hold is Active, **when** anyone creates a shipment, marks a shipment shipped, ready for pickup or delivered, or a seller hands over, **then** the action is refused with message Ord.OrderOnHold: shipment insert by the ORD-010 guard registered with the ORD-010 shipment-guard host (IShipmentService.InsertShipmentAsync, IC-ORD-11; ORD side IC-ORD-02); the status actions by the ORD-010 guard registered with the CHK-003 IOrderProcessingService override of ShipAsync, ReadyForPickupAsync and DeliverAsync (IC-CHK-07).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-169; FIT (Admin SetAsShipped / SetAsReadyForPickup / SetAsDelivered call these methods); OVR-REG

criterion: **Given** a hold is Active, **when** a permitted user releases it with a reason, **then** the hold becomes Released, fulfilment actions are allowed again and the release is audited (AUD-ORD-005).
**Given** a PAY-018 rule with action Flag has option "hold order", **when** it matches at placement, **then** a hold with reason "risk rule {name}" is created automatically.
**Given** an order is on hold, **when** staff or the buyer cancel it, **then** cancellation is still allowed (ORD-004) and the hold is closed.

**Given** shipment guard providers are registered with the ORD-010 host (IC-ORD-11): the ORD-010 hold check and, where their packs are installed, the PAY-006 LC check and the EGV-004 issue check, **when** anyone creates a shipment through the admin page, a seller page, the API or code that calls IShipmentService.InsertShipmentAsync, **then** every provider is called in registration order; the first refusal stops the insert, nothing is saved, the refusal is audited (AUD-ORD-008) and the admin AddShipment action filter shows the message key returned by that provider (for example Ord.OrderOnHold, Pay.LcNotVerified, Egv.ShipmentNotAllowed); if all providers allow, the native insert runs (BR-ORD-055).
basis: Proposed; OVR-REG; FIT (IShipmentService.InsertShipmentAsync; Admin OrderController.AddShipment does not check ModelState)

criterion: **Given** a provider throws an error instead of answering, **when** the guard runs, **then** the insert is refused (fail closed), the error is logged and the refusal is audited (AUD-ORD-008); no shipment is saved.

**Given** only the core modules are installed (no B2B trade pack, no e-Government pack), **when** a shipment is created for an order without an Active hold, **then** the host runs with the ORD-010 hold guard only and the native insert runs; the host does not depend on PAY-006 or EGV-004.

**Given** service level S has cut-off time T in the store time zone and a working-day calendar, **when** an order for S is placed after T, **then** its service-level clock starts on the next working day; LOG-005 uses the same cut-off for the delivery estimate.

**Given** service level S has a handling time, **when** a sub-order with S is placed or paid (start event is a setting), **then** its due time is calculated and stored and shown in the console and seller dashboard.

**Given** an order is not handed over by its due time, **when** the ORD scheduled task runs, **then** the order is flagged overdue and escalated to the roles configured for that level, through TRK-005 (escalation levels Proposed).

**Given** a pickup deadline is configured for the pickup service, **when** an order ready for pickup is not collected by the deadline, **then** it is flagged and escalated in the same way; what happens to the parcel afterwards is LOG's.

**Given** service levels and their handling times are published, **when** a seller opens the dashboard or the seller terms, **then** the levels and times are shown; missed seller deadlines drive ORD-004 automatic cancellation and penalties; the stored due time and the hand-over time of each sub-order are the measure SEL-011 uses for the on-time delivery indicator.

**Given** the bundled Misc.RFQ plugin is installed and the buyer has Misc.RFQ.AccessRFQ.PublicStore.AccessRFQ, **when** the buyer turns the cart into a request with requested quantities, unit prices and notes, **then** a native RequestQuote with its items is created (status Submitted).

**Given** the buyer adds a custom (not listed) item with description, quantity, unit and attachment, **when** the request is submitted, **then** the line is stored in RfqCustomLine linked to the request, because native request items require a ProductId; the attachment is stored as a native Download only after it passes the ADM-008 upload policy for the ORD upload context "RFQ attachment" (BR-ADM-060), and it is served only through the SEC-002 download ownership filter, to which ORD supplies the rule "the requesting buyer, invited sellers and staff with Misc.RFQ admin access" (decision SINGLE-FILTER).

**Given** the Marketplace pack is on, **when** a request is submitted, **then** an RfqInvitation is created for each eligible seller (sellers of the listed products; for custom lines, sellers mapped to the chosen categories) and each is notified through TRK-005; where an approved supplier panel exists for the category (SEL-014), only its Approved, unexpired members are invited (BR-SEL-019).
**Given** the Marketplace pack is off, **when** a request is submitted, **then** the native store-owner flow applies: the store owner creates the quote in admin.
basis: D; FIT (Misc.RFQ is buyer to store owner only)

criterion: **Given** a seller with Orders.Core.SellerOrders.Process has an invitation, **when** the seller submits a quote with, per line, offered quantity and unit price, plus validity date, payment terms, delivery commitment, warranty and attachments, **then** a native Quote and QuoteItems are created with ExpirationDateUtc = validity date and status Submitted; terms are stored in QuoteTerms and the seller in QuoteVendor; the seller can quote only own products for listed lines.

**Given** an invited seller asks a question on a request, **when** the buyer answers it, **then** the question and answer are visible to all sellers invited to that request; the asking seller's identity is not shown to other sellers.

**Given** a quote from a request is accepted and the order is placed (ORD-013), **when** the order is created, **then** the order, the quote and the request reference each other and the chain is shown on all three.

**Given** a product is call-for-price (CAT-013) or a price-on-request service (SVC-001), Misc.RFQ is installed and the buyer has Misc.RFQ.AccessRFQ.PublicStore.AccessRFQ, **when** the buyer selects Request a quote on the product page with quantity, attributes and notes, **then** the ORD request service (IC-ORD-08) creates a native RequestQuote in status Submitted through IRepository<RequestQuote>, adds the item through RfqService.InsertRequestQuoteItemAsync and sends the native new-request message (RfqMessageService.CustomerSentNewRequestQuoteAsync); the buyer's cart is not read or changed; CAT and SVC call IC-ORD-08 and write no Misc.RFQ table themselves.
basis: D; FIT (RfqService has no public request insert without the cart; InsertRequestQuoteItemAsync and CustomerSentNewRequestQuoteAsync are public)

criterion: **Given** the bundled Misc.RFQ plugin (5.00.18) is used for a client, **when** the configuration pack is applied, **then** RfqSettings.Enabled is on (install default on; with it off the customer RFQ menu, pages and the cart-to-request flow are hidden), and the 5.00 settings ShowCaptchaOnRequestPage and AllowCustomerGenerateQuotePdf (install default off) are set per client.

**Given** a request has two or more Submitted quotes, **when** the buyer opens the comparison, **then** a table shows per seller the total, unit price per line in the request's unit, validity, payment terms and delivery commitment; the lowest total and lines that differ from the request are highlighted.

**Given** a quote is Submitted and the negotiation limits (number of rounds, total time; settings, defaults not stated) are not reached, **when** the buyer proposes new unit prices, **then** the seller sees the counter-offer and can accept it (the quote is updated), counter, or decline; every round is kept in NegotiationRound.
**Given** the round or time limit is reached, **when** either party tries another counter-offer, **then** it is refused with message Ord.NegotiationLimitReached.

**Given** KTDA "buyer bids" are treated as counter-offers on a quote, **when** a KTDA buyer submits one, **then** it follows the counter-offer criteria above — held by K-01 (bids are excluded by D-02).

**Given** the buyer accepts a Submitted quote, **when** the acceptance is confirmed after message Ord.CartWillBeReplaced (the native conversion clears the cart), **then** native CreateShoppingCartAsync fills the cart with the quote items at the offered prices (GetShoppingCartItemUnitPriceEvent), the other quotes for the request become Declined and their sellers are notified; at placement the quote becomes OrderCreated with Quote.OrderId and the terms are copied to OrderQuoteTerms.
**Given** an order is created from an accepted quote, **when** the order is shown, **then** it links to the quote and its request.

**Given** a quote's ExpirationDateUtc has passed, **when** the buyer opens or accepts it, **then** the native lazy check sets it Expired and acceptance is refused with message Ord.QuoteExpired; the seller may issue a new quote for the same request.
**Given** quotes reach their expiry date, **when** the ORD scheduled task runs, **then** they are set Expired and the buyer and seller are notified (Misc.RFQ has no expiry task or notification).

**Given** a user with Orders.Core.SellerOrders.Process or Orders.Core.Contracts.CreateEditDelete, **when** the user creates an offer (lot or product, quantity, minimum order quantity, indicative price or price on request, validity, terms), **then** the offer is saved as Draft (SM-ORD-05).

**Given** an offer is submitted for review, **when** a user with Orders.Core.Offers.Approve approves it with a publish date and time, **then** it becomes Scheduled and is published at that time by the ORD scheduled task (Published); rejection returns it to Draft with a reason.

**Given** an offer is Published, **when** a buyer submits a response with requested quantity and price, **then** the response is recorded and turned into an RFQ request to the offer owner (ORD-012); responses are not ranked and no auction runs (D-02).

**Given** a response led to a quote that the buyer accepts, **when** the order is placed, **then** the offer's remaining quantity is reduced and the order links to the offer, response and quote; at zero remaining quantity the offer closes.
**Given** the validity of an offer passes, **when** the task runs, **then** the offer becomes Closed and is no longer shown.

**Given** a request type "Custom blend" with its form fields and attachments is configured, **when** a buyer submits the form, **then** a Requisition is created (SM-ORD-06 Submitted) and a workflow instance starts on the ADM-002 engine.
**Given** a request type "Contract packaging" is configured, **when** a buyer submits the form, **then** a Requisition of that type is created and its workflow starts.

**Given** a request type "Forward contract" is configured, **when** a buyer submits the form, **then** a Requisition of that type is created and its workflow starts; on approval a draft contract is created (ORD-016).

**Given** a requisition is at an approval step, **when** the assigned approver decides in the ADM-006 queue, **then** approve moves it to the next step; reject needs a reason and ends it as Rejected; the buyer sees the status and reason.

**Given** a new request type is needed, **when** the administrator configures its form and workflow, **then** the new request type appears in the request-type list of buyers in My account, a request of that type can be submitted with the configured form and is routed through the configured workflow, and no code deployment was made.

**Given** an approved template (DOC-001) exists for the transaction type, **when** a user drafts a contract from a quote or requisition, **then** parties, value, scope, deliverables, schedule and terms are filled from the source; terms negotiated in the source override the template defaults; the draft is version 1.

**Given** a draft is ready, **when** it is sent for review, **then** it appears in the review queue; the reviewer approves (status Approved) or returns it with comments; only Approved contracts can be issued.
**Given** templates exist per transaction type and language, **when** a user drafts a contract, **then** only templates for that type are offered.
**Given** a forward-contract requisition is approved (ORD-015), **when** the approval completes, **then** a draft contract is created from the forward-contract template.
**Given** several business models are configured (retail, bulk, contract packaging, forward contracts), **when** contracts are drafted, **then** each model uses its own template set.

**Given** an e-signature adapter is configured (provider not named), **when** an Approved contract is sent for signing in the configured order (sequential or parallel), **then** each signer receives the signing request from the provider and the contract becomes AwaitingSignatures.

**Given** the provider reports a signature, **when** the callback is verified, **then** signer, time, IP address and certificate result as returned by the provider are stored and the event is audited (AUD-ORD-006); when the provider returns the signed PDF, its signature is checked through DOC-003 VerifySignature (IC-DOC-04) and the file is stored as a new version of the contract document (IC-DOC-03).
**Given** a party's quorum is set (for example 3 of 5), **when** signatures arrive, **then** the contract becomes Signed only when every party's quorum is met; a decline sets it Declined.
**Given** a contract is Signed, **when** either party proposes an amendment, **then** the counter-party can accept or reject it; accepted amendments go to signing (ORD-017).
**Given** an amendment is accepted, **when** it is saved, **then** a new contract version is created and every earlier version stays readable.

**Given** an amendment changes value, scope or duration beyond the configured limits (settings, defaults not stated), **when** it is proposed, **then** it goes through the approval chain on ADM-002 / ADM-006 before counter-party signing.
**Given** two versions exist, **when** a user opens the comparison, **then** added, deleted and changed text is shown side by side.
**Given** the user has Orders.Core.Contracts.View, **when** the user searches by party, value range, dates, terms text, status and type, **then** matching contracts are listed.
**Given** a contract is selected, **when** the user exports it, **then** a ZIP holds the signed PDF, the signature audit trail, supporting documents and the amendment history.

**Given** a quote is accepted or a requisition approved and the type requires a letter, **when** the user generates the letter, **then** it is rendered by DOC-001 from the letter template with branding and statutory clauses (IC-DOC-01) and sent through the configured channels (TRK-005); ORD keeps the letter record, its deadline and status; delivery status is tracked.

**Given** a letter has an acceptance deadline (setting, default not stated), **when** the recipient acknowledges and accepts it, **then** it is marked Accepted with time; otherwise at the deadline it becomes Lapsed and staff are notified (SM-ORD-10).
**Given** templates exist per type, vertical and language, **when** a letter is generated, **then** the matching template is used.

**Given** a contract requires a guarantee, **when** finance staff record issuer bank, number, amount, currency and expiry date, **then** the guarantee is Active and linked to the contract (SM-ORD-09).
**Given** the expiry date is within the configured alert lead time (setting, default not stated), **when** the task runs, **then** finance staff are alerted and a renewal request can be sent.
**Given** the contract is completed, **when** finance staff release the guarantee, **then** it becomes Released.

**Given** the supplier defaults, **when** finance staff start invocation, **then** it needs approval and documents; on approval a bank notification letter is generated and the guarantee becomes Invoked.

**Given** a Signed contract has a delivery schedule (dates, items, quantities), **when** a scheduled date arrives, **then** an order is created for the buyer with the contract prices (CAT-039 price list) and the contract payment method, through the placement path the tech lead decides (decision CALLOFF-PLACE; not designed here), is linked to the contract line, and LOG fulfils it — held by CALLOFF-PLACE.

**Given** a framework contract has remaining quantity, **when** the buyer submits a drawdown, **then** an order is created within the remaining quantity; a drawdown above it is refused with message Ord.ContractQuantityExceeded.
**Given** a milestone is marked complete by authorised staff, **when** the milestone is saved, **then** the next phase becomes a tracked order.
**Given** a forward contract from a requisition is Signed, **when** its schedule dates arrive, **then** its orders are created as in criterion 01 — held by CALLOFF-PLACE.
**Given** orders are created for several business models, **when** they are listed, **then** each shows its contract and business model.
**Given** an administrator creates a group deal (product, target quantity, group price, deadline), **when** it is published, **then** buyers see the deal and the quantity pledged so far.
**Given** a deal is open, **when** a buyer pledges a quantity, **then** the pledge is recorded without payment (Proposed) and the pledged total is updated.

**Given** the pledged total reaches the target before the deadline, **when** the task runs, **then** each participant is notified and can buy the pledged quantity at the group price within the purchase window (price applied in the cart through the price event).
**Given** the deadline passes below target, **when** the task runs, **then** the deal closes and participants are notified; no order is created.
**Given** a scheme with form, documents and declarations is configured, **when** a beneficiary submits an application, **then** it is validated and created with a reference.

**Given** eligibility rules on application data are configured, **when** the application is submitted, **then** rules are evaluated; failing or flagged applications go to the review queue with all documents.

**Given** the scheme is linked to a FIN-004 subsidy scheme and a programme registry is configured (registry not named), **when** the application is submitted, **then** the registry check runs through IC-FIN-04 CheckEligibility (shared connector); on Eligible FIN-004 adds the customer to the scheme role with the expiry returned or configured; on Not eligible the application goes to the review queue.

**Given** the scheme budget has room and targeting rules (district, age, income band) pass, **when** an officer approves, **then** a sanction with reference and disbursement instruction is created for PAY-022.
**Given** the budget is exhausted, **when** an officer approves, **then** approval is blocked and the application is queued for the next allocation.

**Given** a buyer has a cart or an accepted quote, **when** the buyer or export staff generate a proforma, **then** ORD records the proforma with its number (mask setting), date and validity date, and DOC-001 renders the PDF from the proforma template (IC-DOC-01) with ORD tokens (IC-ORD-07): seller and client details, items, prices, taxes, Incoterm (ORD-026) and payment instructions; no order is created and no stock is reserved.
**Given** an LC record is opened for an order (PAY-006), **when** export staff link the proforma, **then** the LC record stores the proforma number and the order shows it.
**Given** a proforma's validity has passed, **when** someone tries to use it for an order, **then** the prices are recalculated and a new proforma is needed (message Ord.ProformaExpired).

**Given** a Misc.RFQ quote exists and RfqSettings.AllowCustomerGenerateQuotePdf is on (new in 5.00), **when** the buyer opens the quote in My account, **then** the buyer can download the native quote PDF (quote number = quote id, date, customer, expiry date, order number once ordered); it is not the ORD proforma, which is still produced for carts and accepted quotes as in criterion 01-01, because the quote PDF has no proforma number mask, seller details, Incoterm (ORD-026) or payment instructions.

**Given** an Incoterm list is configured (edition not stated) with a named-place field, **when** a buyer selects an Incoterm on a quote or at B2B checkout, **then** it is stored on the quote, order, invoice and proforma; the named place is required; Incoterm code and named place are exposed as document tokens by the ORD token provider (IC-ORD-07 through IC-DOC-02) for the commercial invoice and proforma templates (origin and HS code tokens are CAT-015's).

**Given** each Incoterm is configured with "seller arranges main carriage" yes or no, **when** the buyer selects one with no, **then** the delivery fee is not charged and the shipping option shown is "Buyer-arranged collection".
**Given** a product or variant is flagged as a sample with its price, **when** a buyer adds it, **then** it is ordered like any product.

**Given** a limit per buyer per period is set (settings, defaults not stated), **when** a buyer adds a sample beyond the limit across orders, **then** the ORD-027 cart check provider registered with the CHK-003 IShoppingCartService override (IC-CHK-01) refuses it with message Ord.SampleLimitReached.
basis: D; FIT (Product.OrderMaximumQuantity is per order only)

criterion: **Given** a product is recurring (Product.IsRecurring, cycle length, period, total cycles) and the payment method supports recurring payments, **when** the buyer orders it, **then** the native RecurringPayment is created with the first order.

**Given** a recurring payment is active, its method is RecurringPaymentType.Manual and its next payment date has come, **when** the ORD scheduled task runs, **then** under ILocker key 'ord-recurring-{RecurringPaymentId}' it checks that the cycle is not yet in RecurringPaymentHistory and calls ProcessNextRecurringPaymentAsync, which creates the next order (Pending for asynchronous methods; PAY completes it).
basis: D; FIT (no recurring-payment task in the default task list, InstallRequiredData.cs:3488-3587)

criterion: **Given** processing fails, **when** the native method returns errors, **then** the native RecurringPaymentFailed notification is sent, or the recurring payment is cancelled when PaymentSettings.CancelRecurringPaymentsAfterFailedPayment is on.
**Given** the method is RecurringPaymentType.Automatic, **when** the date comes, **then** the task does nothing; the gateway charges and its callback creates the order.
**Given** the selected method does not support recurring payments, **when** the buyer confirms, **then** the order is not placed (native error) and the method is not offered for recurring carts.

**Given** OrderSettings.NextRecurringPaymentNotificationDays is above 0 (new in 5.00; install and upgrade default 1), **when** a recurring payment is created or a cycle is processed, **then** the native NextRecurringPaymentNotification.CustomerNotification email is queued to be sent that many days before the next payment date; it is sent through IWorkflowMessageService, whose single override is TRK-005, and the client sets the number of days or 0 to turn it off.
**Given** a payment method plugin is installed, **when** the administrator deactivates it, **then** it is not offered at checkout in any store, and existing orders paid with it keep their records.
**Given** a routing rule "method X only for location type = rural" is active, **when** an urban shopper reaches the payment step, **then** method X is not listed; a rural shopper sees it.
**Given** a rule limits a method to service type S, **when** the cart holds a service of another type, **then** the method is not listed.
**Given** a rule limits a method to pickup orders, **when** the shopper chose home delivery, **then** the method is not listed.
**Given** two rules apply to the same method, **when** checkout evaluates them, **then** the method is shown only if every applicable rule allows it (BR-PAY-001).
**Given** at least one method is available, **when** the shopper reaches the payment step, **then** all available methods are listed with name, logo and any fee (PAY-015).

**Given** no method is available for the cart, **when** the shopper reaches the payment step, **then** checkout stops showing message Pay.NoMethodAvailable with the support contact, and no order is placed.
**Given** a client has several gateways, **when** the administrator activates them, **then** each is an independent payment method under the same routing rules.

**Given** the delivery address or pickup point falls in a LOG-004 coverage area, **when** the location type of a routing rule is evaluated, **then** the value is read from that coverage area (ServiceArea.LocationType, LOG-004); PAY keeps no location-type data of its own; an address in no coverage area matches no rural or urban rule.

**Given** the shopper confirms the order, **when** the CHK-003 placement override calls the PAY placement validators (IC-PAY-03, consumed as IC-CHK-02) before payment, **then** the routing check BR-PAY-001 is evaluated again on the final cart; if the chosen method is no longer allowed, placement stops with message Pay.MethodNotAllowed and no order is placed.

**Given** card payment is active, **when** the shopper confirms the order, **then** the shopper is redirected to the gateway's hosted page (PaymentMethodType Redirection); the shop never receives or stores the card number, expiry or CVV.

**Given** the gateway returns success, **when** the callback is received and its signature verified, **then** the transaction becomes Successful and the platform calls IOrderProcessingService.MarkOrderAsPaidAsync once (BR-PAY-010, BR-PAY-012).

**Given** the gateway authorises without capture, **when** the callback is received, **then** the transaction becomes Authorized and the platform calls MarkAsAuthorizedAsync; capture follows per gateway configuration.

**Given** the gateway returns failure or the shopper cancels, **when** the result is received, **then** the transaction becomes Failed, the order PaymentStatus stays Pending and the shopper sees the retry page (see PAY-011 (REQ-MPC-FR-150)).
**Given** the gateway supports 3-D Secure and tokenisation, **when** the shopper pays, **then** the adapter passes the 3-D Secure flow and only a gateway token, if any, is stored.

**Given** the adapter receives the gateway's transaction identifiers, **when** the payment completes, **then** it sets ProcessPaymentResult.AuthorizationTransactionId / CaptureTransactionId so native capture, refund and void work.
**Given** a card payment is Successful, **when** finance staff refund all or part of it, **then** the refund is sent through the same gateway and recorded with the gateway reference (PAY-016).
**Given** a new card adapter is built, **when** it is installed, **then** it registers through the connector SDK (PAY-024) and needs no change to checkout code.

**Given** a card adapter built on nopCommerce 5.00.1 processes a payment or a callback, **when** the order is saved, **then** no value is written to the obsolete Order card fields (AllowStoringCreditCardNumber, CardType, CardName, CardNumber, MaskedCreditCardNumber, CardCvv2, CardExpirationMonth, CardExpirationYear), which 5.00 keeps only for the upgrade and will remove in 5.10; ProcessPaymentRequest carries no card properties, so the adapter receives none from checkout (T-PAY-05).
basis: VER-500; FIT (Order.cs:313-387 obsolete region; ProcessPaymentRequest.cs; ProcessPaymentResult has no AllowStoringCreditCardNumber)

criterion: **Given** PayPal Commerce is configured with the client's merchant credentials, **when** the shopper selects PayPal, **then** the bundled PayPal Commerce flow runs and the order is marked paid through IOrderProcessingService on success.
**Given** a PayPal payment is Paid, **when** finance staff refund all or part, **then** the refund is processed through PayPal (full and partial supported).

**Given** mobile money is available for the cart, **when** the shopper enters a mobile number and confirms, **then** the order is placed (native stock decrement at placement), a payment request is sent through the provider adapter, and the transaction becomes Pending.
basis: D; REQ-KTDA-PAY-004; FIT; depends on PRD-INV-004 (workbook)

criterion: **Given** a payment is Pending, **when** the provider callback reports success, **then** the callback controller verifies it, matches the transaction by reference, checks the transaction is not already Successful, sets it Successful and calls MarkOrderAsPaidAsync exactly once (BR-PAY-012).

**Given** a payment is Pending, **when** no callback arrives within the configured wait time, **then** the status-query task asks the provider; if still unknown the transaction stays Pending and appears in the console exceptions list (see PAY-019 (REQ-MPC-FR-144)).

**Given** a payment is Pending, **when** the provider reports failure or the shopper rejects, **then** the transaction becomes Failed; within the payment window the shopper can retry (PAY-011); when the window expires and the configured action for mobile money is cancel, INV-004 (owner of the unpaid-order timeout) cancels the order through CancelOrderAsync, which returns the stock (BR-PAY-013).

**Given** the configured action is cancel and INV-004 cancelled the order after the payment window, **when** a verified success callback arrives, **then** the transaction becomes SuccessfulAfterCancel: MarkOrderAsPaidAsync is not called, the order stays Cancelled, a console exception is raised, a provider-side refund is opened through PAY-016, and on completion the shopper receives message template Pay.RefundAfterCancel.CustomerNotification; audited (AUD-PAY-001).
**Given** the provider supports QR payments, **when** the shopper chooses QR, **then** a QR code with the payment reference is shown and the result is handled as in story 01.

**Given** a payment is Successful, **when** the provider reports a reversal, **then** the transaction becomes Reversed and the order is refunded offline through RefundOfflineAsync (or PartiallyRefundOfflineAsync if a refund already exists); finance staff are notified and the event is audited (AUD-PAY-004).

**Given** the provider supports refunds to wallet, **when** finance staff refund, **then** the refund is sent through the adapter, the PAY Refund record moves Initiated → Processing → Completed, and the native refund is recorded only on completion (BR-PAY-083).
**Given** a new provider adapter implements the connector SDK operations, **when** it is installed and configured, **then** it appears as a mobile-money option without changes to the framework.

**Given** bank transfer is available, **when** the order is placed, **then** a unique payment reference is generated (BR-PAY-020) and shown with the client's bank details on the confirmation page and email.

**Given** a bank statement line carries a valid reference and the exact amount, **when** the statement is imported or received through the bank API, **then** the transaction is matched, set Successful and the order marked paid through MarkOrderAsPaidAsync.

**Given** the amount differs or the reference is unknown, **when** the line is processed, **then** it is placed in the reconciliation exceptions list (PAY-014); the order is not marked paid (BR-PAY-021).

**Given** a bank system registered on the API with scope payments.notify (INT-001) posts a payment notification with a reference and an amount, **when** the notification reaches PAY, **then** it is matched under BR-PAY-021 exactly like a statement line; the API never marks an order paid itself; an unmatched notification becomes a reconciliation exception.

**Given** a bank-transfer order stays unpaid, **when** the INV-004 unpaid-order timeout for that payment method expires, **then** INV-004 applies its configured action (reminder, flag for follow-up or cancel); PAY takes no action of its own (BR-PAY-013).
**Given** a client has several bank accounts, **when** bank transfer is configured, **then** each account is set per store; the shopper sees the account of the store.

**Given** a bank-transfer order is waiting for funds and BR-PAY-170 is applied, **when** the native pending-order reminder delays (3 and 10 days by default) pass, **then** no native Reminders.PendingOrderFollowUp1 / 2 email is sent and the native automatic cancellation does not cancel the order; the reminder or cancellation, if any, is the INV-004 timeout action and the PAY-011 notification.

**Given** letter of credit is available for the buyer (B2B), **when** the buyer places the order, **then** the order is created with PaymentStatus Pending and an LC record is opened with the LC fields (data model).
**Given** an LC record exists, **when** finance staff record verification as Verified, **then** the shipment hold is released and the event audited (AUD-PAY-006).

**Given** the LC is not Verified, **when** anyone submits shipment creation for the order, **then** the shipment is refused before it is saved by the PAY LC guard provider (IC-ORD-11) called from the single IShipmentService.InsertShipmentAsync override hosted by the core feature ORD-010; the host action filter on AddShipment shows message Pay.LcNotVerified (BR-PAY-030, BR-ORD-055).
**Given** the LC is rejected or expires, **when** finance staff record it, **then** the buyer and export staff are notified; the order stays unpaid.

**Given** a buyer is not in a bulk-buyer customer role, **when** the buyer reaches payment, **then** letter of credit and escrow are not offered; the definition of a bulk buyer is Not stated in source (KG-08), so the role is configured per client.

**Given** escrow is configured with a bank or PSP escrow account and the buyer is a bulk buyer (PAY-006 story 03), **when** the buyer pays, **then** funds go into the escrow account (external); the order is marked Authorized (MarkAsAuthorizedAsync) and the escrow balance is recorded per order.

**Given** release stages are defined for the order, **when** native ShipmentSentEvent or ShipmentDeliveredEvent, or the ORD event OrderAcceptedEvent (IC-ORD-01: OrderId, AcceptedOnUtc, AcceptedBy, Deemed), occurs, **then** the event consumer only enqueues a release job; the scheduled release task sends the instruction for that stage and records the result; after the final stage the order is marked paid.

**Given** the buyer raises a dispute before acceptance, **when** the dispute case is open (RET-007), **then** no further release is sent until the case is resolved: the release task calls HasOpenCase(orderId) (IC-RET-01) synchronously inside the ILocker key 'pay-order-{OrderId}' before each release and does not rely on a RET event consumer (BR-PAY-031).
**Given** a release instruction fails, **when** the provider returns an error, **then** the stage stays unreleased, finance staff are alerted and can retry; every action is audited (AUD-PAY-007).

**Given** an ADM-002 workflow step of type payment release reaches an escrow stage of the order, **when** the step calls the PAY escrow release operation (IC-PAY-06) with the order, stage and case reference, **then** PAY applies BR-PAY-031 (stage order, no open dispute) under the same lock and returns Released, Refused with reason, or Failed; the workflow changes no payment or order state itself; order payment state changes only through IOrderProcessingService.

**Given** the buyer or finance staff raise a payment dispute on an escrow order, **when** PAY opens it, **then** the case is opened through RET OpenCase (IC-RET-01, type PaymentDispute, source module PAY and the escrow agreement reference); PAY keeps no case record of its own.

**Given** the CAT event Listing.Withdrawn is raised for a product (BR-CAT-015), **when** the PAY consumer receives it, **then** the consumer only enqueues a job; the PAY task lists for finance staff the orders with an unreleased escrow stage that contain the product; no release, refund or order change is made automatically.
basis: Proposed (automatic action on escrow: Not stated in source)

criterion: **Given** COD is allowed for every item, seller and the delivery area, **when** the shopper chooses COD, **then** the order is placed with PaymentStatus Pending and payment method COD.
**Given** one item or its seller does not allow COD, or the area is excluded, **when** the shopper reaches payment, **then** COD is not listed (BR-PAY-022).
**Given** cash at outlet is chosen, **when** the order is placed, **then** a secure payment reference (BR-PAY-020) is issued and shown to the shopper.

**Given** a shopper presents the reference at an outlet, **when** outlet staff take the cash and confirm, **then** the transaction is Successful, MarkOrderAsPaidAsync is called, a receipt is printed (PAY-034) and the amount is added to the staff member's open shift.
**Given** outlet cash payments exist, **when** reconciliation runs, **then** they reconcile against the closed shifts (PAY-014, PAY-034).

**Given** the courier collects cash, **when** delivery is confirmed with the collected amount, **then** the transaction becomes Successful and the order is marked paid through MarkOrderAsPaidAsync (PAY); the collected amount is the one recorded on the LOG-012 proof of delivery (ProofOfDelivery.CollectedCodAmount) and courier remittance is reconciled in LOG-014 (CodRemittance); PAY keeps no courier remittance record.
**Given** a cheque or payment slip is received, **when** finance staff record its reference and amount against an order, **then** the transaction is matched and audited (AUD-PAY-002).

**Given** the wallet is enabled by the client, **when** the shopper tops up, **then** the top-up is paid through an active payment method and the balance increases only after the top-up payment is Successful.

**Given** the balance covers the order and spend model (a) of WAL-01 applies, **when** the shopper pays by wallet, **then** the balance is debited once, the order is marked paid, and a wallet ledger entry records the debit.

**Given** the balance is lower than the order total, **when** the shopper selects wallet, **then** held by WAL-01: under (a) wallet is not offered and message Pay.WalletInsufficient is shown; under (b) the balance is applied as an order-total deduction supplied by a PAY provider to the CAT-042 IOrderTotalCalculationService override (PAY does not override the interface) and the rest is paid by another method.
**Given** the wallet is enabled, **when** the shopper opens My account, **then** the balance and ledger entries are shown.

**Given** a refund is approved and the shopper chose wallet, **when** the refund is processed, **then** the wallet is credited, the ledger records the order reference, and the native refund is recorded offline.

**Given** spend model (b) of WAL-01 applies and the PAY provider to the CAT-042 host (IC-CAT-06) returned a wallet deduction for the cart, **when** the CHK-003 placement override places the order and the CAT-042 placement participant (IC-CHK-06, BR-CAT-033) calls the PAY-009 provider operations of IC-CAT-06, **then** Reserve checks and holds the balance under ILocker key 'pay-wallet-{WalletId}' (a shortfall refuses placement with message Pay.WalletInsufficient); Confirm writes one WalletLedgerEntry of type Spend with the saved OrderId and the deducted amount; Release drops the hold; the deduction calculation itself writes nothing (BR-PAY-040); PAY registers no IC-CHK-06 participant of its own for the wallet, so the balance is reserved once.

**Given** an order carries a wallet deduction (spend model (b)), **when** DOC-001 renders its invoice or RPT totals the order, **then** they read the deduction as an order-total adjustment through the CAT-042 record (IC-CAT-06 GetOrderAdjustments; DOC token %Order.TotalAdjustments%); PAY registers no document token for it; the PAY operation GetWalletDeduction (IC-PAY-10) returns the Spend ledger entries of the order only for wallet reconciliation (PAY-019, RPT); native Order has no field for it.
basis: Proposed; WAL-01; FIT (Order has no field for a provider deduction); see CAT-042 (BR-CAT-033)

criterion: **Given** commission and fee rules (SEL-016) and delivery fees are configured, **when** an order line is paid, **then** split records are created per line: seller share, logistics fee, platform commission, each with the rule version applied; commission and fee amounts and rule version IDs are obtained from SEL through IC-SEL-02 GetRulesInForce for the order placement time (BR-PAY-050, BR-PAY-070).
**Given** the provider offers a split API, **when** the payment is processed, **then** the split is passed to the provider; otherwise the split is recorded for payout by SEL-017.
**Given** a line is partly refunded, **when** the refund completes, **then** split amounts are reversed in proportion with the rounding rule (BR-PAY-051, BR-PAY-052).
**Given** the order was paid by direct payment to the seller (PAY-035), **when** the payment is recorded, **then** no split is created; commission is invoiced (SEL-025).

**Given** SEL-017 builds a settlement batch (IC-SEL-02 GetEligibleSplits), **when** it includes a split, **then** the split's SettlementBatchId is set by SEL inside its settlement lock; a split that already has a SettlementBatchId is not returned again, so each split is in one batch only (BR-PAY-053).

**Given** IC-SEL-02 returns no rule for an order line, **when** the split is calculated, **then** no split is written for that line, a reconciliation exception is raised for finance staff (PAY-019 console) and the payment itself is not affected.
**Given** a payment attempt starts, **when** the adapter is called, **then** a PaymentTransaction is created with status Initiated, AttemptNo and the order reference.

**Given** a transaction exists, **when** its status changes, **then** only the transitions in state model SM-PAY-01 are allowed; each change is timestamped and audited (AUD-PAY-001); the native order PaymentStatus changes only through IOrderProcessingService (BR-PAY-010).

**Given** a payment is Pending or Failed, **when** the shopper opens the order or the status page, **then** the page shows the status, the next step (message keys Pay.Status.Pending / Pay.Status.Failed), a retry button where allowed and the support contact.

**Given** a payment Failed or is still Pending, the order PaymentStatus is Pending and AllowRePostingPayments is on, **when** the shopper retries, **then** a new PaymentTransaction (AttemptNo + 1) is created on the same order; Redirection-type adapters use the native RePostPayment path; Standard-type adapters (for example STK push) use the PAY retry action, because native re-post is limited to Redirection methods.
**Given** the order was cancelled after the payment window, **when** the shopper tries to retry, **then** retry is not offered and message Pay.RetryExpired is shown.

**Given** INV-004 is about to cancel an unpaid order, **when** it calls the PAY read service HasSuccessfulOrAuthorizedTransaction(orderId) (IC-PAY-07, consumed as IC-INV-02) inside the ILocker key 'pay-order-{OrderId}', **then** the service returns true if any PaymentTransaction of the order, including a group transaction linked to it (BR-PAY-014), is Successful or Authorized, otherwise false; it reads only and changes nothing.

**Given** CHK-004 places a checkout of several sellers under one CheckoutSession and the chosen method supports group payment, **when** the CHK-003 placement override processes payment once, before any sub-order is saved (BR-CHK-006), by calling the PAY group payment operation (IC-PAY-02, consumed as IC-CHK-04) with the CheckoutSession reference, the total and the share of each seller, **then** one PaymentTransaction is created for the checkout with the CheckoutSession reference as the merchant reference and one share per seller; the provider is asked for the checkout total once; one ProcessPaymentResult is returned for the checkout (BR-PAY-014).
basis: Proposed; OVR-REG; FIT (OrderProcessingService.PlaceOrderAsync processes payment before SaveOrderDetailsAsync)

criterion: **Given** a group transaction is Pending, **when** a verified success callback arrives, **then** under the lock 'pay-checkout-{CheckoutSessionId}' and then 'pay-order-{OrderId}' per sub-order, MarkOrderAsPaidAsync is called once for each linked sub-order (BR-PAY-012 applies per sub-order); the transaction becomes Successful; a sub-order linked later is handled at its Confirm (AC-PAY-011-04-07).

**Given** a group transaction fails or the shopper cancels, **when** the result is received, **then** the transaction becomes Failed, every sub-order stays Pending and the retry (story 02) applies to the whole checkout: the new attempt is again one group transaction for the sub-orders still Pending.

**Given** the group method is a Redirection-type adapter, **when** native checkout calls PostProcessPaymentAsync with the one order it received from placement, **then** the adapter finds the group transaction linked to that order and redirects for the checkout total with the CheckoutSession reference, not for that order alone.
basis: Proposed; FIT (IPaymentMethod.PostProcessPaymentAsync takes one Order; CheckoutController calls it once)

criterion: **Given** a verified success arrives for a group transaction and one sub-order was cancelled meanwhile, **when** the callback is processed, **then** the other sub-orders are marked paid; the share of the cancelled sub-order follows the SuccessfulAfterCancel path for that share (console exception, provider-side refund through PAY-016, AUD-PAY-001).

**Given** the chosen method or adapter does not declare group-payment support, **when** a checkout with more than one sub-order reaches payment, **then** the method is not offered for that checkout (BR-PAY-014); single-seller checkouts are not affected.

**Given** a group transaction exists for the checkout, **when** the CHK-003 placement host saves a sub-order and calls the PAY placement participant Confirm (IC-CHK-06; PAY uses Confirm only), **then** under 'pay-checkout-{CheckoutSessionId}' PAY writes the PaymentTransactionOrder link for that sub-order with its seller share; if the group result was Paid, the sub-order was saved Paid by native placement and PAY calls nothing more; if the group transaction became Successful by callback before the link, PAY calls MarkOrderAsPaidAsync for that sub-order once (BR-PAY-012).
basis: Proposed; OVR-REG; FIT (SaveOrderDetailsAsync takes the ProcessPaymentResult; ProcessOrderPaidAsync runs when it is Paid)

criterion: **Given** payment succeeded and a seller share has no saved sub-order because placement stopped (CheckoutSession PlacementException, AC-CHK-004-01-05), **when** PAY-019 lists exceptions, **then** the group transaction is shown with the unlinked share and the CheckoutSession reference as a console exception; PAY makes no refund on its own; a refund of that share arrives only from RET (source type PlacementFailure) through IC-PAY-05 (AC-PAY-016-01-08).

**Given** a configuration pack is applied to a store, **when** the pack loader runs, **then** ReminderSettings.PendingOrdersEnabled (install default on) and OrderSettings.AutoCancelEnabled (install default off) are set off unless the client pack states otherwise under BR-PAY-170, so no native reminder email goes to an order that is pending by design (on account, letter of credit, escrow, bank transfer awaiting funds) and payment-pending messages come only from the PAY notification Pay.Status.Pending through TRK-005.

**Given** a payment initiation request carries an idempotency key (default Order.OrderGuid + AttemptNo), **when** the same request is received again, **then** no second charge is initiated; the original result is returned.

**Given** a provider sends the same callback twice, **when** the second callback arrives, **then** it is recognised by provider reference and transaction status and ignored after logging; MarkOrderAsPaidAsync is not called again, even if the order is PartiallyRefunded (BR-PAY-012).

**Given** the order is placed twice in quick succession on one host, **when** the second placement is attempted, **then** the native placement lock and minimum interval prevent a duplicate order; across several web nodes the PLT-027 idempotency key (P2) is required because the lock is per host; until PLT-027 is delivered an instance serves checkout from one web node (BR-PLT-004).

**Given** checkout is retried within PaymentSettings.RegenerateOrderGuidInterval, **when** the order is placed, **then** the same OrderGuid is reused and passed to the provider as the merchant reference.

**Given** a payment becomes Successful and MarkOrderAsPaidAsync has run, **when** the native OrderPaidEvent is raised, **then** the receipt is sent on the channels configured for the event in TRK-005 and allowed by the customer's preferences (TRK-006), default the native OrderPaid email (PDF invoice attachable) plus one SMS delivered by TRK-005 over the CHN-005 gateway in the shopper's language; PAY sends no SMS of its own and no second email is sent.
**Given** the shopper has no mobile number, **when** the receipt is sent, **then** only email is sent and the skip is logged.
**Given** SMS delivery fails, **when** the gateway reports failure, **then** the failure is logged; email is unaffected.

**Given** the PAY plugin is installed, **when** installation runs, **then** PAY registers each PAY event code of §13 (BR-PAY-160) through IC-TRK-04 RegisterEventCode with its default channels and the default text of the message key of the same name; a PAY send with a code that is not registered is refused by TRK and logged.

**Given** a provider statement is retrieved through the adapter (GetStatement) or uploaded, **when** reconciliation runs, **then** each line is classed Matched, Unmatched — platform only, Unmatched — provider only, or Timing difference (BR-PAY-060).

**Given** exceptions exist, **when** finance staff open the reconciliation screen, **then** they can filter and resolve each exception with a mandatory note; every resolution is audited (AUD-PAY-005).
**Given** the day closes, **when** the scheduled task runs, **then** a daily reconciliation file is generated in the configured format and kept for download.
**Given** a provider has no statement API, **when** finance staff upload the provider file, **then** the same matching runs.

**Given** a seller settlement batch exists (SEL-017), **when** reconciliation runs, **then** provider-settled amounts are compared with the batch totals per seller; differences are listed as exceptions.

**Given** a fixed or percentage fee is set for a method, **when** the shopper selects it, **then** the fee is shown before payment and added to the order total; its taxability follows TaxSettings.PaymentMethodAdditionalFeeIsTaxable.

**Given** a new fee schedule version is saved with a future effective date, **when** an order is placed before that date, **then** the previous version applies; the order records the version used (BR-PAY-070).

**Given** a COD fee table by location type exists, **when** COD is chosen for a rural address (location type read from the LOG-004 coverage area, ServiceArea.LocationType), **then** the rural COD fee applies.
**Given** a COD fee table by service level exists (for example express and standard), **when** COD is chosen with express delivery, **then** the express COD fee applies.

**Given** a payment-method fee is charged on an order, **when** the order is placed, **then** the fee amount per order line and the fee-schedule version applied are stored, so the PAY-016 refund calculation can reduce it in proportion on a partial refund (one owner of the proportional adjustment: PAY-016, AC-PAY-016-04-01, BR-PAY-051).
**Given** a schedule is changed, **when** it is saved, **then** who, when, old and new values are audited (AUD-PAY-003).

**Given** the original method supports refunds, **when** a refund is approved, **then** a PAY Refund record is created (Initiated → Processing); for asynchronous providers the native order refund is recorded only on completion through RefundOfflineAsync / PartiallyRefundOfflineAsync; synchronous providers may use the native online RefundAsync (BR-PAY-083).
**Given** the original method does not support refunds, **when** a refund is approved, **then** the refund is recorded offline (or to wallet if chosen) and finance staff record the reference.

**Given** an order line is partly refunded, **when** the refund is calculated, **then** RefundLine records hold the line amounts; fees, commission and split amounts are adjusted in proportion (BR-PAY-051, BR-PAY-052); the total cannot exceed OrderTotal − RefundedAmount nor, per line, the line amount paid minus earlier line refunds (BR-PAY-081).
**Given** the refund amount exceeds the configured threshold, **when** it is submitted, **then** it waits for approval; the requester cannot approve it (BR-PAY-080).

**Given** a user with only Orders.OrdersCreateEditDelete presses a native refund button, **when** the request is posted, **then** it is intercepted and routed to the PAY refund flow with threshold and approval (BR-PAY-082).
**Given** a refund exists, **when** the shopper opens the order, **then** the refund status and the expected completion time for that payment method are shown.
**Given** a refund completes and the native refund is recorded, **when** OrderRefundedEvent is raised, **then** the native OrderRefunded customer notification is sent once.

**Given** RET-005 requests a refund through the PAY refund request operation (IC-PAY-05, consumed as IC-RET-02) with order ID, lines (OrderItem ID, quantity, amount), reason, source type and source ID, and an idempotency key, **when** the request is received, **then** PAY applies BR-PAY-081 and BR-PAY-080 under the lock 'pay-order-{OrderId}', creates a Refund record (Initiated, or waiting for approval above the threshold) with the source reference, and returns the Refund ID and state; a second request with the same idempotency key returns the first Refund and creates nothing (BR-PAY-084).

**Given** a Refund created from a RET request reaches Completed or Failed, **when** the state changes, **then** PAY raises the module event Refund.Completed or Refund.Failed carrying the RET source type and source ID; the RET consumer only enqueues its status sync; PAY never changes a return request.

**Given** a module other than RET (for example ORD-004 or ORD-006) needs an automatic refund, **when** it starts one, **then** it raises a refund trigger through RET (IC-RET-04); the PAY refund request operation accepts calls only from RET-005 and from PAY itself (finance staff refunds, SuccessfulAfterCancel); a call from another caller is refused and logged (BR-PAY-084).
basis: Proposed (product refund-trigger decision: RET-005 single owner)

criterion: **Given** RET requests a refund through IC-PAY-05 with order-level parts (component Shipping, PaymentFee or CheckoutAttribute and an amount), with or without order lines, **when** the request is received, **then** under 'pay-order-{OrderId}' PAY checks that the lines and the parts together do not exceed Order.OrderTotal minus Order.RefundedAmount (BR-PAY-081), stores each part as a RefundLine with its component and no OrderItemId, and on completion records the whole amount on the order through the native partial or full refund method; fees, commission and splits are adjusted only for the line amounts (BR-PAY-085).
basis: Proposed (RET IC-RET-04 order-level parts); FIT (OrderProcessingService.PartiallyRefundOfflineAsync / PartiallyRefundAsync take an order amount and check OrderTotal minus RefundedAmount)

criterion: **Given** RET requests a refund through IC-PAY-05 with source type PlacementFailure, no order ID, the CheckoutSession reference, the group PaymentTransaction ID and an amount, **when** the request is received, **then** under 'pay-checkout-{CheckoutSessionId}' PAY checks that the amount does not exceed the share of the group transaction that is linked to no sub-order minus earlier refunds of that share, creates a Refund with no OrderId, refunds provider-side only and on completion records it on the Refund record and the group transaction; no native order refund method is called, because no order exists (BR-PAY-085).

**Given** a gateway reports a chargeback, or staff record one, **when** it is created, **then** a chargeback case is linked to the payment and order with reason, amount, deadline and status Open (SM-PAY-05).
**Given** a case is open, **when** the response deadline is within the configured lead time, **then** assigned finance staff are notified.

**Given** a case is lost, **when** the outcome is recorded, **then** the transaction becomes Reversed and the order is refunded offline in full or in part by the chargeback amount (RefundOfflineAsync / PartiallyRefundOfflineAsync); audited (AUD-PAY-004).
**Given** a case is won, **when** the outcome is recorded, **then** no payment status changes; the case is closed and audited (AUD-PAY-004).

**Given** a velocity rule "more than N payment attempts per M minutes" is active, **when** a customer exceeds it, **then** the attempt is flagged (and blocked if the rule action is Block) and appears in the review queue.
**Given** a device rule is active, **when** more accounts than allowed use the same device identifier, **then** the accounts are flagged.
**Given** a rule is created, changed, enabled or disabled, **when** it is saved, **then** who, when, old and new values are audited (AUD-PAY-003).
**Given** a customer has an active restriction, **when** they reach checkout, **then** checkout is blocked with message Pay.CheckoutRestricted, which does not state the reason.

**Given** a SEL-013 list entry of type Block with scope checkout or all is Active for the customer, their email, phone, IP address or device, **when** they reach checkout, **then** the entry is an account restriction that PAY-018 enforces exactly as in AC-PAY-018-03-01 (message Pay.CheckoutRestricted); PAY keeps no copy of the list.

**Given** the shopper confirms the order, **when** the CHK-003 placement override calls the PAY risk evaluation as a placement validator (IC-PAY-03, consumed as IC-CHK-02) before payment, **then** each active rule is evaluated; a rule with action Block stops placement with message Pay.CheckoutRestricted and no order is placed; a rule with action Flag lets placement continue and writes a RiskFlag after the order exists.

**Given** a rule with action Flag and the option "hold order" matches at placement, **when** the order is placed, **then** PAY asks ORD-010 to create a hold with reason "risk rule {name}"; the hold blocks shipment through the ORD-010 guard provider (IC-ORD-11).

**Given** a rule of type "model score above threshold" is active and the AI-006 fraud-scoring service returns a score for the transaction, **when** the score is above the rule threshold, **then** a RiskFlag is written for the review queue showing the score, the model version and the reasons returned; the payment is blocked only if that rule's action is Block.

**Given** any rule fires, **when** the flag or block is recorded, **then** PAY writes the RiskFlag and raises the module event Risk.Flagged with the subject type (customer or transaction), the subject ID and the rule that fired; the CRM-010 consumer only enqueues, and its task creates a referral unless one is open for the same subject (AC-CRM-010-01-02); SEC-005 exports RiskFlag records with its own scheduled task (AC-SEC-005-01-01), not as an event consumer.

**Given** risk rules are registered as a controlled configuration type with PLT-004 (IC-PLT-03), **when** a rule is created, changed, enabled or disabled, **then** when PLT-004 is delivered (it is held by WF-ENG) the change follows the PLT-004 approval and rollback flow before it takes effect; until then the change takes effect when saved by a user holding the PAY risk-rule permission, the previous rule version is kept so it can be restored, and the audit trail records old and new values (AUD-PAY-003).

**Given** a model-score rule is active and the AI-006 scoring service does not answer in time, **when** a payment is initiated, **then** the model-score rule does not fire, every other active rule is evaluated as usual, the payment continues and the missing score is logged (as AC-AI-006-01-02); the score threshold is held only on the PAY-018 rule.

**Given** the user has Payments.Core.Transactions.View, **when** they open the console, **then** they see transactions with filters (date, method, status, order, provider reference) and an exceptions view (Pending beyond the wait time, callback errors, unmatched).

**Given** the user has Payments.Core.Transactions.CreateEditDelete, **when** they take a manual action (re-query status, mark paid with evidence, capture, void, cancel attempt), **then** a reason is mandatory, the action calls IOrderProcessingService and is written to the audit trail (AUD-PAY-002).
**Given** the user lacks the permission, **when** they open the console or post an action, **then** access is denied (standard permission criterion).
**Given** tax categories and rates are configured (native provider), **when** an order is calculated, **then** tax is computed per line and shown including or excluding tax per the store setting.

**Given** the shopper reaches the confirm step, **when** the summary is shown, **then** items, quantities, taxes, payment fees and delivery fees are listed before payment; the returns-policy acknowledgement is CHK's.
**Given** a tax rule applies to platform commission, **when** a split is calculated (PAY-010), **then** tax on the commission is calculated and stored with the split.
**Given** a period is selected, **when** the tax report runs, **then** totals by tax category, rate and transaction type are produced and exportable.
**Given** a rule has a future effective date, **when** transactions occur before it, **then** the old rule applies; the change is audited (AUD-PAY-003).
**Given** a batch file of recipients is uploaded, **when** it is validated, **then** invalid rows are reported; the batch cannot be approved until fixed.
**Given** a valid batch exists, **when** a second authorised person approves it, **then** payouts are sent through the Payout operation of the connector SDK (BR-PAY-080).
**Given** a payout fails with a transient error, **when** the retry policy applies, **then** it is retried up to the configured number; final status and reason are recorded (SM-PAY-08).

**Given** the recipient's bank offers account verification (INT-008, IC-INT-04 VerifyAccount), **when** a batch is validated, **then** each bank account and holder name is checked; a Mismatch is reported as an invalid row; NotSupported leaves the row valid and records that it was not verified.

**Given** several currencies are active and rates are maintained (native rate provider), **when** the shopper selects a currency, **then** prices and totals are shown in it; the order stores the customer currency and rate.
**Given** the gateway supports multi-currency charging, **when** the shopper pays, **then** the charge is in the customer currency and the rate and any conversion fee are disclosed before payment.
**Given** the gateway settles only in base currency, **when** the shopper pays, **then** the charge is made in base currency (USD for KTDA, C-FX) and the converted amount is shown before payment.

**Given** an adapter implements the connector SDK, **when** it is installed, **then** it declares its PaymentMethodType and a capability flag for each of InitiatePayment, HandleCallback, QueryStatus, Reverse, Refund, GetStatement and Payout (contract IC-PAY-01); payment adapters implement IPaymentMethod and appear at checkout; payout-only adapters do not implement IPaymentMethod and appear only in the PAY payout registry.
basis: D; REQ-MPC-PAY-001; Inference from REQ-KTDA-PAY-007 (a further global gateway is integrated as one more SDK adapter); FIT

criterion: **Given** an adapter does not support an operation, **when** that operation is requested, **then** the framework returns NotSupported and the console offers the manual path.

**Given** a provider callback arrives on the adapter's callback route, **when** the SDK receives it, **then** the signature, token or IP allow-list is verified before any status change; failures are logged and audited (AUD-PAY-010; NFR-PAY-002).

**Given** a provider refund is requested through the SDK, **when** the provider API is called, **then** the call uses TLS and the provider's authentication; credentials are read from the encrypted adapter settings.
**Given** credentials are entered, **when** they are saved, **then** they are stored encrypted and never exported in a configuration pack (BR-PAY-110).

**Given** an adapter is used for recurring orders (ORD-028), **when** it is installed, **then** it declares RecurringPaymentType; for Manual it implements ProcessRecurringPaymentAsync, which native ProcessNextRecurringPaymentAsync calls when the ORD task runs (5.00: no stored card data is passed; the adapter uses its own provider token); a mobile-money adapter returns Pending and the next order is marked paid by the callback (AC-PAY-004-01-02); NotSupported makes the method unavailable for recurring carts (native).

**Given** an adapter has settings that hold a credential, key or token, **when** its keys are listed in the PAY key catalogue, **then** each such key is flagged secret, so the PLT configuration-pack loader refuses it and exports omit it (BR-PAY-110).

**Given** e-invoicing is enabled for the country, **when** an invoice is issued (ORD-009) and the ORD event Invoice.Issued is raised (IC-ORD-04, InvoiceDocument), **then** the PAY consumer only enqueues the submission; the PAY task submits it through the country adapter; status Submitted / Accepted / Rejected is recorded (SM-PAY-07).
**Given** submission fails, **when** the error is transient, **then** it is retried per the retry policy; persistent failure alerts finance staff.

**Given** the authority returns a fiscal number or QR, **when** the invoice PDF is generated, **then** the fiscal number and QR payload are printed through a PAY token provider registered with DOC-001 (IC-DOC-02); PAY does not override IPdfService (DOC-001 is the only owner, BR-DOC-001, OVR-REG); an invoice with no fiscal data yet gets no fiscal tokens.

**Given** a refund is completed (PAY-016), **when** the credit note is issued, **then** it is rendered by DOC-001 templates with the PAY fiscal tokens in the same way, submitted through the same adapter and linked to the original invoice.
**Given** an invoice is submitted, **when** the payload is built, **then** line tax amounts and rates are those calculated by PAY-020 for the order.

**Given** SEL-025 issues a commission invoice to a seller and calls PAY SubmitFiscal (IC-PAY-09, consumed as IC-SEL-03), **when** e-invoicing is enabled for the country, **then** a FiscalSubmission of document type CommissionInvoice is queued and handled as in story 01; the fiscal status is returned to SEL.

**Given** the eTIMS adapter is configured with KTDA's credentials and the eTIMS interface specification has been received, **when** an invoice or credit note is submitted, **then** it is sent per that specification and the returned fiscal data stored — held by E-INV, not binding until the specification is received.

**Given** the EIS adapter is configured with Malawi Post's credentials and the EIS interface specification has been received, **when** an invoice or credit note is submitted, **then** it is sent per that specification and the returned fiscal data stored — held by E-INV, not binding until the specification is received.

**Given** the M-Pesa adapter is configured (till or paybill and credentials), **when** the shopper pays, **then** the request, callback, status-query and reversal flows of PAY-004 run through Safaricom M-Pesa.
basis: D; REQ-KTDA-PAY-004; FIT (Daraja STK push named in gap)

criterion: **Given** C-FX is decided, **when** an M-Pesa payment settles, **then** the settlement currency and conversion follow the C-FX rule — held by C-FX.

**Given** the Mpamba adapter is configured, **when** the shopper pays, **then** the PAY-004 flows run through TNM Mpamba over the provider's secure API, and refunds are sent through the provider refund API (AC-PAY-004-04-01).

**Given** the Airtel Money adapter is configured for the country, **when** the shopper pays, **then** the PAY-004 flows run through Airtel Money over the provider's secure API, and refunds are sent through the provider refund API (AC-PAY-004-04-01).
**Given** KTDA names the bank gateway and its adapter is built on PAY-002, **when** a shopper pays by debit or credit card, **then** the PAY-002 criteria hold for that gateway.

**Given** PAY-031 is configured with the merchant ID of the bank KTDA names, **when** a card payment is made, **then** the request goes to that bank's endpoint and the transaction records the acquirer reference — held by KG-04 (bank not named).
**Given** Malawi Post names the gateway and its adapter is built on PAY-002, **when** a shopper pays by card, **then** the PAY-002 criteria hold, including tokenisation.

**Given** a customer buys on account (CHK-016), **when** an invoice is issued, **then** an open receivable is created with due date = invoice issue date + CreditAccount.PaymentTermsDays of the buyer's CHK-016 credit account (BR-PAY-130).
basis: D; phasing basis: dependency of PRD-CHK-016

criterion: **Given** a payment is received, **when** finance staff allocate it, **then** it is matched to one or more invoices; partial allocation is allowed.
**Given** the ageing report runs, **when** receivables exist, **then** amounts are grouped by age band (bands are a setting).
**Given** the buyer opens My account, **when** they have receivables, **then** the statement, open invoices and overdue amounts are shown.

**Given** CHK-016 computes a buyer's available credit, **when** it calls the PAY receivables read operation (IC-PAY-08 GetOpenReceivables), **then** PAY returns the open amount of every receivable of that buyer (company or customer) that is not Settled; it changes nothing.

**Given** FIN-002 offers an open, undisputed, unassigned receivable to a lender, **when** FIN calls IC-PAY-08 LockForOffer, then Assign or ReleaseLock, **then** the receivable becomes Offered (no second offer is accepted), then Assigned with the lender as payee and its remit-to details, or Open again (SM-PAY-09); audited (AUD-PAY-011).

**Given** a payment received by the client is allocated to an Assigned receivable, **when** the allocation is saved, **then** the allocation is flagged "assigned — not for seller payout" and listed for finance staff to forward to the lender (as AC-FIN-002-02-03); the PAY-010 splits of the order lines on that invoice are not returned by IC-SEL-02 GetEligibleSplits, so SEL-017 never settles them to the seller (BR-PAY-131).
**Given** a receivable of the buyer is Assigned, **when** the buyer opens the statement, **then** the lender is shown as the party to pay with its remit-to details, instead of the seller.

**Given** SEL-025 issues a commission invoice to a seller and calls PostReceivable (IC-PAY-08, consumed as IC-SEL-03), **when** the receivable is created, **then** its debtor is the vendor (debtor type Vendor) and it follows the same ageing and allocation rules.

**Given** a receivable is Assigned and the lender reports to FIN-002 that the buyer paid it, **when** FIN calls IC-PAY-08 AllocateExternal with the receivable, the amount and the lender reference, **then** an allocation with source LenderReport and the lender reference is saved (no platform payment), the open amount falls and the receivable becomes Settled when it reaches zero (SM-PAY-09); audited (AUD-PAY-011).

**Given** an agent creates an assisted order (CHK-013), **when** the agent records the payment method and takes payment, **then** the transaction stores the agent identity and method; the 80 mm receipt shows order, amount, method, reference and agent identity.

**Given** a shift is open, **when** staff close it and enter counted cash, **then** expected cash (from the shift's cash payments) and counted cash are recorded with the difference; the shift locks (SM-PAY-06).
**Given** a difference is not zero, **when** the shift is closed, **then** it is flagged for finance review.
**Given** a shift is closed, **when** reconciliation runs, **then** the shift's cash payments, with their secure references, appear in PAY-014 reconciliation.

**Given** direct payment is enabled for the seller and the seller has connected an account through the connection kit, **when** a buyer pays for that seller's single-seller order, **then** the adapter resolves credentials from SellerPaymentAccount by the order's vendor, the payment goes to the seller's account and the result is recorded against the order.
**Given** direct payment is not enabled for a seller, **when** a buyer pays, **then** the normal client-collected flow applies.
**Given** an order is paid directly, **when** post-payment processing runs, **then** no split, escrow or payout is created; commission is left to SEL-025 (BR-PAY-150).

**Given** the seller refunds through the PAY seller endpoint, **when** the refund is reported, **then** the endpoint checks the order belongs to the vendor, the platform records the refund offline through IOrderProcessingService, and if the buyer contests, PAY opens a dispute case through RET OpenCase (IC-RET-01, type PaymentDispute, source PAY-035 and the refund reference).

**Given** the cart has items from several sellers, **when** direct payment is selected, **then** direct payment is not offered: orders with more than one vendor cannot use it (CHK-004 creates single-seller orders).

**Given** an order uses offline direct payment, **when** the seller marks it paid through the PAY seller endpoint and uploads proof, **then** the proof is stored as an OrderNote with DownloadId; the PAY transaction becomes AwaitingConfirmation; the native order PaymentStatus stays Pending.
**Given** the transaction is AwaitingConfirmation, **when** the buyer confirms, **then** the platform calls MarkOrderAsPaidAsync and the transaction becomes Successful.

**Given** the transaction is AwaitingConfirmation, **when** the buyer contests, **then** PAY opens a dispute case through RET OpenCase (IC-RET-01, type PaymentDispute, source PAY-036 and the transaction reference), the transaction returns to Pending and the order PaymentStatus remains Pending.
