**Given** products exist, **when** the user runs Products never purchased for a period, **then** products with no sales in the period are listed.
**Given** products with managed stock exist, **when** the user runs Low stock, **then** products whose stock is at or below their minimum stock quantity are listed with their stock level.

**Given** orders exist in the period and INV-013 exposes stock-movement data through IC-INV-06 GetStockMovementData (daily sellable-stock snapshots, movements by reason, current sellable stock per product and warehouse), **when** a user with Analytics.Core.StockReports.View runs the Fast and slow movers report for a period, **then** products are listed with units sold in the period (order lines of orders placed in the period, cancelled orders excluded, as in BR-INV-100), current sellable stock per warehouse from IC-INV-06 and days of cover by the INV-013 formula (sellable stock / average units sold per day, blank when nothing was sold), and can be sorted ascending (slow movers) or descending (fast movers) by units sold; products with no sales in the period are included with zero; the report reads INV-013 data only and changes no stock (decision ANL-002-OWN).
basis: REQ-KTDA-ANL-002; ANL-002-OWN; FIT (5.00.1: native Bestsellers still sorts only descending, Libraries/Nop.Services/Orders/OrderReportService.cs:727-728)

criterion: **Given** a user lacks Analytics.Core.StockReports.View, **when** they call the Fast and slow movers report, **then** access is denied and no data is shown.

**Given** orders and customers exist, **when** the user runs Country sales, Registered customers, Best customers by order total or by number of orders, **then** the native report is shown for the period chosen.
**Given** a role holds Reports.Bestsellers but not Orders.OrdersView, **when** a user of that role opens Bestsellers, **then** access is denied, because the native action requires both permissions.

**Given** a user holds the native permission of a report (for example Reports.Bestsellers with Orders.OrdersView), **when** they choose export all to Excel or to XML on that report page (sales summary, low stock, bestsellers, never sold, country sales, registered customers, best customers by order total or by number of orders), **then** the file holds every row of the report for the filters set, through the native IExportManager report exports, with the SEC-014 masking where SEC-014 is delivered; a user without the permission is refused.
basis: VER-500; REQ-KTDA-ANL-002; FIT (5.00.1: Presentation/Nop.Web/Areas/Admin/Controllers/ReportController.cs:119-976, e.g. ExportBestSellersExcelAll :425-429 with [CheckPermission] for Orders.OrdersView and Reports.Bestsellers; Libraries/Nop.Services/ExportImport/IExportManager.cs)

criterion: **Given** the BI platform reads the data warehouse (RPT-003) or the licensed Power BI plugin is installed (PAID-STUB), **when** a manager opens the executive dashboard for a period, **then** registrations, active buyers, active sellers, GMV, orders and conversion rate are shown, each computed by its KPI catalogue definition (BR-RPT-010).

**Given** the conversion-rate KPI needs visit counts, **when** the dashboard is built, **then** visits come from Google Analytics 4 data (MKT-010) loaded into the warehouse; nopCommerce stores no visit counts; if that source is not connected the KPI is shown as not available.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-276; Inference (no visit store in nopCommerce; GoogleAnalyticsSettings.EnableEcommerce sends events to GA4)

criterion: **Given** active KPI definitions exist (BR-RPT-010), **when** a manager opens the executive dashboard for a period, **then** each KPI is shown both as text (value with its unit, period and code) and as a graphic (a chart of the KPI over the period); the same values can be exported as a table (RPT-004).

**Given** a dashboard or report groups figures by financial year, quarter or month, **when** the periods are computed, **then** when PLT-012 (P2) is delivered they come from the PLT-012 fiscal-calendar service (FiscalCalendarSettings, client layer); until then (P1) the financial year is the calendar year and quarters and months are calendar periods, and the report states that calendar periods are used (BR-RPT-012).

**Given** the logistics KPI definitions of BR-LOG-120 (on-time rate, delivery success rate and the others listed there, all Proposed) exist, **when** the Logistics and postal pack is applied, **then** they are loaded into the KPI catalogue as Draft entries with code, formula and owner LOG-018, and once activated they are the only definitions used by RPT-010 and by the LOG-018 dashboard (BR-RPT-010).

**Given** a user has Analytics.Core.KpiCatalogue.CreateEditDelete, **when** they create a KPI with code, name, description, formula over data-dictionary fields, unit, owner and optional target, **then** the definition is stored as Draft, checked against the data dictionary (unknown fields refused with message Rpt.KpiFormulaInvalid), and when activated (SM-RPT-03) it is exported to the BI platform through IC-RPT-03 without code change.
**Given** an active KPI is changed, **when** the new version is saved with an effective date, **then** the old version stays for earlier periods and the change is audited (AUD-RPT-003).

**Given** the monthly template (sections and KPIs, content not stated) is configured in the BI platform, **when** a month ends, **then** the report for that month is generated from the KPI values and delivered as configured (RPT-004).

**Given** a KPI is shown, **when** the user drills down, **then** the BI platform moves through the configured dimensions (for example store, category, seller, region) to the record list; each order record links to its nopCommerce admin order page by ID.

**Given** a user has author rights in the BI platform, **when** they compose a dashboard from catalogue KPIs and share it with a BI group, **then** members of that group see it; others do not (RPT-005).

**Given** an extract dataset is configured (tables, mode, schedule — schedule not stated), **when** its run starts, **then** the RPT export task reads the changes since the last successful watermark and writes files with a manifest (dataset, row count, checksum) to the warehouse staging area through IC-RPT-01; the run follows SM-RPT-01 and is recorded.

**Given** a dataset is based on a native table without an update timestamp (for example Order, OrderItem, Customer and Shipment have no UpdatedOnUtc), **when** the dataset is configured, **then** its mode is ChangeFeed, reading the change records of the SEC-004 audit trail through IC-SEC-01 QueryAsync with the entity name and the filter sequence greater than the last successful watermark (paged; the last sequence number of the run becomes the new watermark), or Full extraction on each run; insert-only tables may use the Id range (BR-RPT-020).
basis: FIT (no UpdatedOnUtc on Order, OrderItem, Customer, Shipment); Proposed

criterion: **Given** a run fails, **when** the error is recorded, **then** the run becomes Failed, is retried per the retry setting (default not stated), administrators are notified, and the next run restarts from the last successful watermark.

**Given** the shop database has a read replica (hosting), **when** extracts run, **then** they read from the replica, not the primary database; without a replica they run in the configured off-peak window (setting, default not stated).
basis: REQ-MPC-ARC-001; D (without slowing down the shop)

criterion: **Given** the help desk is active, **when** the CRM datasets are configured (tickets and their extension, ratings, fraud referrals, call logs), **then** they are extracted like other datasets; data held in the licensed help-desk plugin is read only through the CRM read-only extract views (IC-CRM-05 GetExtractViews), never from the plugin tables directly.

**Given** datasets are configured, **when** the data dictionary is generated, **then** every extracted field is listed with name, type, description, source table and column, and personal-data class, and is published with each manifest.

**Given** quality rules for missing values, duplicates and invalid statuses are defined per dataset in the pipeline (external), **when** a load runs, **then** violations are written to a data-quality report with counts and sample keys; a dataset whose blocking rule fails is not loaded and the data owner is notified.

**Given** a dataset field is marked for pseudonymisation or removal (setting per field), **when** the extract runs, **then** the field is replaced by a keyed hash (key held only in the client instance, never exported) or removed before the file leaves nopCommerce; the manifest lists the fields treated.

**Given** KTDA names its AI or analytics platform (KG-17), **when** that platform is given a read-only warehouse account, **then** it reads the warehouse data views with the same pseudonymisation as other consumers.

**Given** a report schedule (frequency, recipients, format) is set in the BI platform, **when** the schedule time comes, **then** the report is e-mailed to each recipient as an attachment or link; a failed delivery is logged.
**Given** a recipient is not authorised for the report (RPT-005), **when** the schedule is saved, **then** the recipient is refused.

**Given** an analyst belongs to the analyst group of the BI platform, **when** they query the defined data views and export the result, **then** the query runs on the warehouse views only, never on the shop database tables, and the result exports to Excel or CSV.
**Given** the client uses the NopStation SQL manager instead (Post Gebeya ADM-04, V-01), **when** it is configured, **then** it connects with a read-only database user limited to the defined views.

**Given** a report is open in the BI platform, **when** the user exports it, **then** PDF, Excel and CSV are offered, and image export for charts; native admin lists (orders, customers, products) and, since 5.00, the native report pages keep their native Excel and XML export.
basis: D; FC-M19-003; FIT (5.00.1: OrderController.ExportExcelAll, ExportXmlAll; ReportController Export*ExcelAll, Export*XmlAll, Presentation/Nop.Web/Areas/Admin/Controllers/ReportController.cs:119-976)

criterion: **Given** an external system is registered with credentials and the datasets it may receive (Analytics.Core.BiConnection.CreateEditDelete), **when** a batch delivery is due, or the system calls the report API (INT-001), **then** only the datasets authorised for that API client are delivered (file with manifest, or API response); batch files go through the INT-004 message log with its retry; each delivery is audited (AUD-RPT-008).
**Given** an analyst saves a query in the BI platform, **when** they share it and others comment, **then** the query keeps a version history and the comments are stored with it.
**Given** native reports are in use, **when** a role is given or refused a Reports permission, **then** only roles holding it see and open that report (native).
**Given** BI groups are mapped to client roles, **when** a user without a group membership for a dashboard opens it, **then** access is denied and no data is shown.

**Given** fields have a personal-data or sensitive class in the data dictionary, **when** a user whose group lacks the sensitive-data right opens a report with such fields, **then** those fields are hidden or masked by the BI field-level security.
**Given** row-level rules limit groups to a store, seller or region (Proposed), **when** a limited user opens a report, **then** only rows in their scope are shown.
**Given** a role-to-group mapping changes, **when** it is saved, **then** the change is recorded in the BI platform log.

**Given** an auditor holds the permission of the SEC-004 compliance report, **when** they open Reports, Compliance in the RPT report menu, **then** the menu entry opens the SEC-004 compliance report of logins, admin actions and configuration changes (AC-SEC-004-05-01); RPT builds no second report of the same content.

**Given** the SEC-004 audit store is read through IC-SEC-01 QueryAsync or its signed exports and loaded to the warehouse, **when** a BI analyst builds a dashboard on audit data, **then** the warehouse holds the audit events with user, entity, time and before and after values for BI use; the compliance report itself is SEC-004 (see SEC-004 (REQ-MPC-FR-287)).

**Given** complaint tickets (CRM-004), risk flags (PAY-018), fraud referrals (CRM-010) and privacy requests (IAM-017, SEC-012) are in the warehouse, **when** the compliance report runs for a period, **then** counts, statuses and handling times are shown per category.
**Given** a regulator format is defined (not stated), **when** the report is produced for that regulator, **then** it follows that format.

**Given** staff read access to customer personal data (customer edit, order edit and customer address pages) is recorded as AUD-IAM-010 by the IAM filter (BR-IAM-080) and stored in the SEC-004 audit store, **when** the auditor runs the access report for a period, read through IC-SEC-01 QueryAsync (event AUD-IAM-010), **then** who viewed which customer and order records, and when, is listed with staff user, customer and page.

**Given** public metrics are selected and the page is published (Analytics.Core.PublicDashboard.CreateEditDelete), **when** a visitor opens the public page, **then** aggregate figures are shown from the latest snapshot, refreshed on the configured schedule (default not stated).

**Given** a figure would come from fewer records than the minimum group size (setting, default not stated), **when** the snapshot is built, **then** the figure is suppressed and message Rpt.SuppressedSmallGroup is shown in its place.
**Given** a metric would expose a field classed as personal data in the data dictionary, **when** the administrator selects it, **then** the selection is refused.

**Given** the official nopCommerce Power BI plugin is licensed and installed (PAID-STUB, V-01), **when** it is configured, **then** the reports delivered by the plugin are listed in the client's Power BI workspace and show data of the configured store; which reports the licensed plugin contains (the stub names 13) is confirmed under V-01.
basis: FIT (5.00.1: Misc.PowerBI stub — plugin class, controller, event consumer and a configuration view linking to nopcommerce.com — plugin.json SupportedVersions 5.00)

criterion: **Given** the client uses its own BI tool on the warehouse instead, **when** the connection is configured (Analytics.Core.BiConnection.CreateEditDelete), **then** the tool connects read-only to the warehouse views by the method the warehouse offers (for example direct database, OData or JDBC), per the security policy.

**Given** any BI connection is configured, **when** credentials are saved, **then** they are stored encrypted in the client instance, never in a configuration pack, and no connection has write rights to the shop database.
**Given** only the bundled Misc.PowerBI plugin is installed, **when** the administrator opens its configuration, **then** it shows a link to the paid plugin and no data connection exists.

**Given** work-queue items (ADM-007), tickets (CRM), returns and cases (RET) record their assignee, **when** the manager opens operator metrics for a period, **then** items handled per operator and per team are shown.
**Given** SLA timers exist for the operator's items (CRM-014), **when** the metrics are shown, **then** the share of timers Met and Breached per operator is shown.

**Given** the rework and dispute-rate definitions are configured (definitions not stated), **when** the metrics are shown, **then** rework rate and dispute rate per operator are shown by those definitions.
**Given** a user has Analytics.Core.OperatorMetrics.ViewOwn only, **when** they open operator metrics, **then** they see their own figures only.

**Given** shipment and tracking data are in the warehouse, **when** the logistics report runs for a period, **then** on-time delivery rate, delivery success rate and average transit time are shown by outlet, hub, user and service, using the KPI catalogue definitions shared with LOG-018.

**Given** PAY transactions, refunds and reconciliation lines are in the warehouse, **when** the payments report runs, **then** payment success rate, method mix (count and amount), reconciliation exceptions by class and refunds by status are shown per payment method.

**Given** seller orders, cancellations, returns (RET) and seller ratings (SEL-012) are in the warehouse, **when** the seller report runs, **then** fulfilment SLA adherence, cancellations, returns rate and ratings are shown per seller and can be exported to Excel or CSV.

**Given** risk flags (PAY-018) and fraud referrals (CRM-010) are in the warehouse, **when** the fraud report runs, **then** flagged transactions, triggers per rule and referral outcomes are shown for the period.

**Given** queue, ticket, case and timer data are in the warehouse, **when** the operations dashboard refreshes (refresh interval setting, default not stated), **then** open case-load, throughput, exception rate and SLA compliance per queue, the complaint backlog, average post-resolution rating (CRM-005 ratings) and, where the schemes pack is active, scheme review queues are shown; ticket, timer, rating and fraud-referral data come from the CRM extract views (IC-CRM-05) and RET case data.

**Given** orders, refunds, return fees and imported spend are in the warehouse, **when** the cost dashboard runs for a period, **then** product cost (OrderItem.OriginalProductCost x quantity), shipping charged (Order.OrderShippingInclTax), returns (refunded amounts and return fees), discounts (Order.OrderDiscount and Order.OrderSubTotalDiscountInclTax), advertising spend (imported) and taxes (Order.OrderTax) are shown by period and category.

**Given** orders were placed in several customer currencies, including fixed per-currency prices (CAT-042), **when** a cost or sales figure is shown, **then** amounts are in the primary store currency as nopCommerce stores them, labelled with that currency; customer-currency totals are also offered from Order.CustomerCurrencyCode and Order.CurrencyRate (BR-RPT-011).

**Given** a user has Analytics.Core.AdSpend.CreateEditDelete, **when** they upload a spend file in the IC-RPT-02 layout (date, source, campaign, channel, amount, currency) and the file passes the ADM-008 upload policy for the data imports context (type, size and scan are checked only by ADM-008, decision SINGLE-FILTER), **then** each row is validated; invalid rows are listed with message Rpt.AdSpendRowRejected; valid rows are loaded (SM-RPT-02) and sent with the next extract; the import is audited (AUD-RPT-004).
**Given** spend for the same source and date range was loaded before, **when** a new file for that scope is loaded, **then** the earlier rows are replaced, so spend is never counted twice.

**Given** customer data is in the warehouse, **when** the demographics dashboard runs, **then** customers and sales are shown by gender and age band (only where CustomerSettings.GenderEnabled and DateOfBirthEnabled collect them), location, customer role and MKT-011 attributes; behaviour shows orders per customer, repeat rate, average order value and categories bought, plus Google Analytics 4 behaviour where connected (MKT-010).

**Given** cart items are extracted (ShoppingCartItem has UpdatedOnUtc; since 5.00 also Customer.LastShoppingCartUpdateDateUtc and the reminder step reached, Customer.LastAbandonedCartFollowUpNumber, used by the native abandoned-cart reminders of MKT-012), **when** the abandoned-cart dashboard runs, **then** carts idle longer than the RPT abandoned-cart idle time (setting, default not stated) are counted with value and top products, and recovery (carts followed by an order from the same customer) is shown.

**Given** discount usage, newsletter campaigns, campaign tags and imported spend are in the warehouse, **when** the campaign dashboard runs, **then** orders and revenue per discount or coupon (DiscountUsageHistory), newsletter campaigns sent, campaign traffic and conversions from Google Analytics 4 e-commerce data of links carrying the MKT-010 UTM tags (where GA4 is connected), and cost per order using imported spend are shown; MKT-010 supplies only the tags.

**Given** address, outlet, role, MKT-011 attributes and seller attributes are in the warehouse, **when** the segmentation report runs, **then** buyers and sales are shown by district or outlet, buyer type, age band, gender, rural or urban location and seller type.

**Given** at least two years of data are loaded, **when** the trend view runs, **then** time series with year-over-year comparison and moving averages are shown; cohorts by sign-up month and first-order month are shown.

**Given** EGV ServiceApplication records (EGV-002) and RemittanceLine records (EGV-005) are in the warehouse, **when** the report runs for a period, **then** applications, fees collected and remitted, and fulfilment status are shown by agency and service type — held by FG-06 (e-government scope).
**Given** a community engagement data source is named (not stated), **when** its data is loaded to the warehouse, **then** it is joined by district and period into the adoption dashboards.

**Given** the instance is live with a TLS certificate (PLT-007), **when** a request arrives over plain HTTP, **then** it is redirected to HTTPS; Store.SslEnabled is true for every store, because the native HttpsRequirement filter redirects HTTPS to HTTP when it is false.

**Given** TLS is terminated at a proxy or load balancer, **when** the application receives requests, **then** HostingConfig.UseProxy and ForwardedProtoHeaderName are set so the application sees the original HTTPS scheme and issues the auth cookie with the Secure flag (native CookieSecurePolicy.SameAsRequest).

**Given** the go-live hosting checklist (PLT-001) is run, **when** TLS protocol versions and cipher suites are tested, **then** only the versions and suites in the checklist are accepted; the minimum version is Not stated in source (catalog target TLS 1.2 or higher, FC-M21-002, Proposed).

**Given** a product adapter calls an external system (payment, SMS, carrier, registry), **when** the call is made, **then** it uses HTTPS; an adapter configured with a plain-HTTP endpoint is refused at save time.

**Given** the go-live hosting checklist is run, **when** the database, file storage and backups are inspected, **then** encryption at rest is enabled for each (hosting function, for example transparent data encryption) and recorded with evidence.

**Given** the instance is installed, **when** SecuritySettings is checked, **then** UseAesEncryptionAlgorithm is true (install default) and EncryptionKey is unique to the instance and not taken from a configuration pack (BR-SEC-002).

**Given** a user sets a password, **when** the password is saved, **then** CustomerPassword holds a salted hash; CustomerSettings.DefaultPasswordFormat is Hashed and HashedPasswordFormat is SHA512 (install defaults).
**Given** a configuration pack sets DefaultPasswordFormat to Clear or Encrypted, **when** the pack is applied, **then** it is rejected and nothing is changed (BR-SEC-001).

**Given** payment plugins are installed, **when** the platform team checks them before go-live, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500): now native — nopCommerce 5.00 removed card storage: ProcessPaymentResult has no AllowStoringCreditCardNumber (Libraries/Nop.Services/Payments/ProcessPaymentResult.cs), the Order card fields are obsolete and no longer written (Libraries/Nop.Core/Domain/Orders/Order.cs:322-358), the admin EditCreditCardInfo action and the bundled Payments.Manual plugin are removed; verified by AC-SEC-001-04-02.

**Given** a client instance runs nopCommerce 5.00.1 with the product payment plugins, **when** an order is placed and paid with any active payment method, and the order is opened in admin, **then** no card number, masked card number, card holder, expiry or security code is stored on the order or shown in admin, and no admin action to edit card data exists (BR-SEC-003).
basis: VER-500; REQ-MPC-FR-148; FIT (5.00.1: Libraries/Nop.Core/Domain/Orders/Order.cs:322-358 [Obsolete]; no card fields in Libraries/Nop.Services/Payments/ProcessPaymentResult.cs; Presentation/Nop.Web/Areas/Admin/Controllers/OrderController.cs has no EditCreditCardInfo)

criterion: **Given** the instance goes live, **when** public traffic is traced, **then** every public request passes the WAF and DDoS service of the hosting or CDN provider, and the application accepts traffic only from that service.
**Given** a test sends SQL-injection and cross-site-scripting requests, **when** they reach the edge, **then** they are blocked and logged by the WAF.

**Given** the WAF or proxy forwards requests, **when** the application records an IP address (IAM-012, SEC-004), **then** HostingConfig.ForwardedForHeaderName, KnownProxies and KnownNetworks are set so the real client IP address is recorded, not the proxy address.

**Given** KTDA has chosen the cloud provider (AWS or Azure preferred) and region (DP-01), **when** the instance is provisioned (PLT-001), **then** the hosting checklist records provider, region, WAF / DDoS service and encryption at rest as evidence.
**Given** SecuritySettings.AdminAreaAllowedIpAddresses lists addresses, **when** a request to the admin area comes from another address, **then** it is refused by the native ValidateIpAddress filter.
**Given** SecuritySettings.HoneypotEnabled is on, **when** a bot fills the hidden honeypot field on a protected form, **then** the request is rejected and, with LogHoneypotDetection on, logged.

**Given** a customer uploads a file through Nop.Web ShoppingCartController.UploadFileProductAttribute, UploadFileCheckoutAttribute or ReturnRequestController.UploadFileReturnRequest [POST], **when** the upload succeeds, **then** the SEC action filter records an UploadOwnership row with the download GUID, the uploading customer and, for a product attribute, the product (BR-SEC-005).
basis: Proposed; FIT (the actions return the download GUID; attributeId of UploadFileProductAttribute is a product attribute mapping)

criterion: **Given** a download GUID of an uploaded file, **when** someone requests Nop.Web DownloadController.GetFileUpload with it, **then** no registered rule provider claims the file, and the single SEC ownership filter serves it only to the uploading customer, to a user holding Orders.OrdersView who is not a vendor user, or to a vendor user whose vendor owns the product; anyone else gets access denied with message Sec.FileAccessDenied and AUD-SEC-012 is written.
basis: Proposed; FIT (GetFileUpload serves any upload to anyone holding the GUID)

criterion: **Given** a file was uploaded before the SEC plugin was installed (no UploadOwnership row), **when** it is requested through GetFileUpload, **then** it is served only to a user holding Orders.OrdersView who is not a vendor user.

**Given** a vendor user holds Security.AccessAdminPanel (native default for Vendors), **when** the vendor user requests Admin DownloadController.DownloadFile with a GUID, **then** the single SEC ownership filter serves it only if the file is recorded in UploadOwnership for a product of that vendor or is the download or sample download of a product of that vendor, and no claiming rule provider denies it; otherwise access is denied with message Sec.FileAccessDenied and AUD-SEC-012 is written.
basis: Proposed; FIT (DownloadFile serves any download by GUID to any admin-area user)

criterion: **Given** a module has registered a download-access rule provider (IC-SEC-05; for example EGV-002 for files of e-Government applications) and the provider claims the requested file, **when** the file is requested through GetFileUpload or Admin DownloadFile, **then** the SEC filter applies the provider decision instead of the base rule: the file is served only when every claiming provider returns Allow; a Deny gives access denied with message Sec.FileAccessDenied and AUD-SEC-012; the provider adds no filter of its own on these actions (BR-SEC-005).
basis: Proposed (owner decision: one download-ownership filter, SEC-002)

criterion: **Given** an upload has a file type outside the allowed list, **when** it is posted, **then** it is refused by the ADM-008 upload policy (BR-ADM-060), which owns server-side type checks for all upload actions; SEC adds no type check of its own.
basis: FIT (native upload actions check size only; allowed extensions are checked only in the browser)

criterion: **Given** a card payment adapter is configured (PAY-002), **when** its PaymentMethodType is read, **then** it is Redirection (hosted payment page) or uses gateway-hosted fields; the platform never receives the card number or security code (see PAY-002 (REQ-MPC-FR-129); BR-PAY-011).
**Given** the gateway offers tokenisation, **when** a card payment completes, **then** only the gateway token and the masked last digits are stored.
**Given** an adapter is proposed that takes card fields in the shop page and sends them to the gateway API, **when** it is reviewed, **then** it is not accepted for card payments (BR-SEC-003).
**Given** test card payments were made in the test environment, **when** the database and the logs are scanned for card-number patterns, **then** no card number is found (test note T-PAY-05).

**Given** the SEC plugin registers a decorator of IRepository<> in its INopStartup (Order greater than 10, after NopDbStartup registers EntityRepository<> at Order 10), **when** an audited entity is inserted, updated or deleted through any repository method, including calls with publishEvent false, **then** an AuditEvent is written with actor (current customer and, when impersonating, the original customer), IP address, UTC time, store, entity name, entity id, old values (LoadOriginalCopyAsync) and new values (BR-SEC-010).
basis: D; FIT (5.00.1: IRepository, Libraries/Nop.Data/IRepository.cs:115-175 — async members only, the synchronous Insert, Update, Delete, GetById and GetAll were removed in 5.00; NopDbStartup Order 10, Libraries/Nop.Data/NopDbStartup.cs:88)

criterion: **Given** a repository DeleteAsync with a predicate is called, **when** it runs, **then** the matching rows are read first and one delete event with old values is written per row.

**Given** AclService.SaveAclAsync or StoreMappingService.SaveStoreMappingsAsync changes the SubjectToAcl or LimitedToStores flag directly through INopDataProvider, **when** the change is saved, **then** the SEC overrides of these virtual methods write the change event (BR-SEC-011).

**Given** a changed field is on the redaction list (password hashes and salts, secret settings, code hashes), **when** the event is written, **then** the field name is recorded and the value is written as "[redacted]" (BR-SEC-012).
**Given** an update changes only fields on the ignore list (for example Customer.LastActivityDateUtc), **when** it is saved, **then** no audit event is written.

**Given** writing the audit event fails, **when** the repository call runs, **then** the entity change and the audit insert run in one transaction, so the change is rolled back and an error is logged (BR-SEC-015).

**Given** events are appended, **when** the chain writer runs under ILocker key 'sec-audit-chain', **then** each event gets the next sequence number and a hash over its canonical content and the previous hash (BR-SEC-013).

**Given** any user, including an administrator, looks for a way to change or delete an audit event, **when** the screens and services are inspected, **then** none exists; the database login of the application has insert and select rights only on the audit tables (hosting checklist).

**Given** an event was altered, removed or reordered in the database, **when** integrity verification runs (scheduled or on demand), **then** the result is Broken at the first bad sequence number, the security officer is alerted with message Sec.ChainBroken and AUD-SEC-003 is written.

**Given** a user holds Security.Core.AuditTrail.View, **when** the user searches by actor, entity type, entity id, event id (AUD-...), store, date range and amount where the entity has one, **then** matching events are listed with old and new values, without SQL.

**Given** a user holds Security.Core.AuditTrail.Export, **when** the user exports a search result, **then** files are produced in CSV, JSON and XLSX (formats Proposed) with a manifest holding the filter, event count, first and last sequence numbers, the chain hashes at both ends and a signature of the manifest; message Sec.AuditExportReady is shown and AUD-SEC-002 is written.
**Given** an entity id and a past time T, **when** the auditor runs replay, **then** the field values of the entity at T are rebuilt from its events and shown with the event that set each value.

**Given** a user and a past time T, **when** the auditor runs access replay, **then** the roles, permission mappings, ACL, store mappings, scopes and delegations in force for that user at T are rebuilt from their audited changes.

**Given** a period is chosen, **when** the compliance report runs, **then** it lists logins and failed logins (AuthEvent copies, IAM-012), changes made in the admin area by user, setting changes (Setting entity events, PLT-004) and staff read access to customer records (AUD-IAM-010, IAM-010), and can be exported.

**Given** IAM writes AUD-IAM-010 for each staff view of a customer record, an order or a customer address in admin (BR-IAM-080), **when** a reader such as the RPT-006 access report calls IC-SEC-01 QueryAsync with event id AUD-IAM-010 and a period, **then** the view events are returned with staff user, customer, page and time in sequence order; views of other record types are not captured.

**Given** a Setting row is inserted, updated or deleted through ISettingService (including PLT-004 applying a change set), **when** the repository call runs, **then** the event records actor, time, key (Setting.Name), StoreId, old value and new value; for a key flagged secret (BR-PLT-013 list or a plugin key catalogue) both values are written as "[redacted]" (BR-SEC-012).

**Given** a module calls IAuditTrail.WriteAsync (IC-SEC-01) with an event id such as AUD-PAY-003, **when** the call returns, **then** the event is in the same chain, linked to the entity changes of the same request by a correlation id.

**Given** a reader such as RPT-003 calls IC-SEC-01 QueryAsync with "sequence greater than" a watermark, an entity name and a page size, **when** the call returns, **then** events are returned in sequence order without gaps, one page at a time, with the last sequence number of the page, so a repeated call from that number returns the next page.

**Given** a fraud rule is enabled, disabled or changed (AUD-PAY-003), **when** the change is saved, **then** the audit trail holds the old and new values, the actor and the time, and the event is found by searching for the rule.

**Given** a high-risk action is requested and approved (for example a payout account change, SEL-005, through ADM-006), **when** the approval completes, **then** the request, the approval decision, the approver and the resulting change are linked by one correlation id in the audit trail.

**Given** the security-monitoring export is configured (Security.Core.SecurityExport.CreateEditDelete), **when** audit events, authentication events (IAM-012), risk flags (PAY-018) and system-log errors are written, **then** they are sent through IC-SEC-02 in batches by a scheduled task, in sequence order, without gaps.

**Given** the monitoring system is unreachable, **when** an export batch fails, **then** the batch stays Queued and is retried; when the backlog exceeds the configured age the security officer is alerted (AUD-SEC-011).

**Given** correlation and anomaly rules are configured in the monitoring system, **when** events arrive, **then** detection and alerting happen in the monitoring system (external); the product supplies complete events only.
basis: D; FIT (no correlation engine in nopCommerce)

criterion: **Given** DP-01 is decided for the client, **when** the instance is provisioned (PLT-001), **then** the database, file storage, backups and logs are created in the decided region and the region is recorded in the instance profile and the hosting checklist.

**Given** an integration sends personal data to a service hosted outside that region (for example SMS gateway, email service, security monitoring, captcha), **when** the integration is enabled, **then** a transfer record exists for it in the SEC-012 register; without it the go-live checklist fails.
**Given** a backup copy is made, **when** its location is checked, **then** it is in the decided region, or a transfer record covers its location.

**Given** cookie categories are configured (necessary, and others such as analytics, personalisation and marketing; the list is Proposed) and GdprSettings.GdprEnabled is on, **when** a visitor arrives without a stored choice, **then** the consent banner (message Sec.CookieBanner) offers accept all, reject all except necessary, and choose per category; only necessary cookies are set before a choice (BR-SEC-020); the native single-button DisplayEuCookieLawWarning banner is off.

**Given** a visitor saves or changes a choice, **when** the choice is stored, **then** it is kept per visitor (customer record or cookie for guests), message Sec.CookieSettingsSaved is shown, it applies from the next page, and a consent record with categories, banner version and time is written (AUD-SEC-007).

**Given** the analytics category is not accepted, **when** a page is rendered, **then** widget plugins assigned to that category (for example the bundled Widgets.GoogleAnalytics and Widgets.FacebookPixel) are not rendered, through the SEC override of IWidgetPluginManager.LoadActivePluginsAsync.

**Given** the personalisation category is not accepted, or is withdrawn, **when** search and catalogue pages are rendered, **then** no search history is kept for personalisation and no data is sent to the recommendation service for that visitor (SRC-009, SRC-012 read the consent through SEC-007); on withdrawal by a registered customer IAM-017 informs SRC through IC-IAM-08.

**Given** the AI-003 chat widget is mapped to the functional cookie category (WidgetCategoryMap; category and mapping Proposed), **when** a visitor who has not accepted the functional category opens a page, **then** the chat widget is not rendered (SEC override of IWidgetPluginManager.LoadActivePluginsAsync, BR-SEC-020); after the visitor accepts the category it is rendered from the next page.

**Given** the country profile (SEC-012) states that server-side analytics events need consent, or the value is not configured, **when** a configuration pack or an administrator sets GoogleAnalyticsSettings.EnableEcommerce to true, **then** the pack fails validation, or the SEC action filter on WidgetsGoogleAnalyticsController.Configure [POST] refuses the save with message Sec.ServerSideAnalyticsBlocked; the setting stays false, because the bundled plugin sends order placed, paid and refunded events from event consumers for every order, without a per-visitor consent check, so widget gating cannot stop them (BR-SEC-021).
basis: REQ-KTDA-ANL-008; FIT (5.00.1: Widgets.GoogleAnalytics Plugins/Nop.Plugin.Widgets.GoogleAnalytics/EventConsumer.cs — Events.cs was replaced by EventConsumer.cs; the order handlers check only EnableEcommerce, :329, :357, :382)

criterion: **Given** GdprSettings.LogPrivacyPolicyConsent and LogNewsletterConsent are on, **when** a customer accepts the privacy policy at registration or subscribes or unsubscribes from the newsletter, **then** the native GDPR log records the event.

**Given** GdprSettings.GdprEnabled is on, **when** a registered shopper opens the GDPR tools page, **then** export of personal data (native XLSX) and the deletion request are offered; the flows are IAM-017.

**Given** a country pack is applied, **when** gdprsettings.* values are written, **then** GdprEnabled, LogPrivacyPolicyConsent, LogNewsletterConsent and LogUserProfileChanges are on; the native task "Delete inactive customers (GDPR)" stays disabled unless the retention rule of the country profile says so, and the install value DeleteInactiveCustomersAfterMonths = 36 is not adopted as a product default.
basis: Inference from REQ-KTDA-LEG-001 (law names inference, DP-01); FIT (InstallRequiredData; DeleteInactiveCustomersTask)

criterion: **Given** Widgets.GoogleAnalytics is active, mapped to the analytics category, and the country profile requires consent for it or is not configured, **when** a visitor who has not accepted analytics adds an item to the cart or wishlist or removes one, **then** no add-to-cart, remove-from-cart or wishlist event is sent to Google, because the SEC-007 override answers IsPluginActiveAsync(Widgets.GoogleAnalytics) with false for that visitor; after the visitor accepts analytics the events are sent from the next request (BR-SEC-021).

**Given** a user holds Security.Core.Breaches.CreateEditDelete, **when** the user records a breach with discovery time, description, data categories and systems, **then** a BreachCase is Open, its regulator and subject deadlines are computed from the country profile (SEC-012) and AUD-SEC-005 is written.

**Given** a deadline value is missing in the country profile, **when** the case is created, **then** the case shows message Sec.DeadlineNotConfigured and the privacy officer is alerted; no default deadline is assumed (BR-SEC-030).

**Given** selection criteria are entered (customer list, affected entity types and record dates, stores), **when** the affected list is generated, **then** the list of affected people and their contact channels is produced and frozen with its count and criteria.

**Given** the case is assessed as notifiable and templates exist per regulator and per affected class, **when** the officer sends the subject notices, **then** each notice is sent through the notification engine (TRK-005, IC-TRK-04 SendEvent with the recipient list and the case as sender reference) using the breach-notice event code Sec.BreachNotice that SEC registered at installation (IC-TRK-04 RegisterEventCode, BR-SEC-100; SMS default text from the key Sec.BreachNotice) on the channel available for the person, and each send and its delivery result per person are recorded.

**Given** the regulator notice is submitted outside the platform, **when** the officer records the submission, **then** the date, channel and reference are stored and the case moves to RegulatorNotified (SM-SEC-02).
**Given** a deadline is within the configured lead time and not met, **when** the deadline task runs, **then** the officer is alerted; when the deadline passes the case is marked Overdue.

**Given** the case is assessed as not notifiable, **when** the officer records the decision with a reason, **then** a second user holding Security.Core.Breaches.CreateEditDelete must confirm it before the case can close.

**Given** a user holds Security.Core.AuditTrail.Export, **when** the user runs the evidence export for a period, **then** it produces: access audit report (IAM-011), MFA status, privileged accounts, audit-chain verification results, configuration change log, auditor-access grants and dependency-scan results recorded for each release (SEC-011), each with its manifest.

**Given** the evidence files are produced, **when** they are loaded into the compliance (GRC) tool, **then** the tool can read them (CSV and JSON); control mapping and certification are done in the tool and by the organisation (external, ORG-SVC).
basis: D; FIT (no compliance component in nopCommerce)

criterion: **Given** an audit is completed by the auditor, **when** the auditor requests the integrity statement for the audited period, **then** the platform produces the verification result for the period (first and last sequence numbers, chain hashes, Verified) signed with the instance signing key, for the auditor to countersign.

**Given** a user holds Security.Core.AuditorAccess.CreateEditDelete, **when** the user grants access to an auditor account with start, end, stores and period of records, **then** the account is in the Auditor role, which holds Security.AccessAdminPanel, native *View permissions and Security.Core.AuditTrail.View only; between start and end the grant is Active (SM-SEC-03).
basis: D; FIT (native view / create-edit-delete split, unchanged in 5.00.1: Libraries/Nop.Services/Security/StandardPermission.cs)

criterion: **Given** an auditor tries any create, edit or delete action in admin, **when** the request is posted, **then** it is denied by the native permission check and nothing changes.

**Given** the end of the grant passes, **when** the auditor makes a request, **then** access is denied at once through the IAM IPermissionService override (BR-IAM-060), message Sec.AuditorAccessExpired is shown and the grant becomes Expired (AUD-SEC-004).
**Given** the grant limits the period and stores, **when** the auditor searches the audit trail, **then** only events in that period and those stores are returned.
**Given** the auditor views or exports records, **when** the action completes, **then** it is recorded in the audit trail with the auditor as actor.

**Given** an Increment is built, **when** the dependency (software composition) scan runs in the pipeline, **then** a new high or critical vulnerability fails the build and the Increment does not meet Definition of Done criterion 5 (NFR-X-001).

**Given** the runtime scanner of the hosting environment reports a finding, **when** it is recorded in the tracking tool, **then** it has a severity, an owner and a fix deadline per severity (deadlines Not stated in source).

**Given** a penetration-test report is received, **when** its findings are recorded, **then** each finding is tracked to Fixed with retest evidence or to RiskAccepted with the approver named (SM-SEC-05).

**Given** a penetration test is scoped for a release, **when** the scope is written, **then** it includes every entry of the extension register (BR-ADM-001) and every known platform finding of BR-SEC-081, each with its product control or "accepted risk".

**Given** the instance country is set (Kenya or Malawi), **when** the privacy officer opens the country profile, **then** it holds: law name(s) as text (inference, DP-01), regulator, data-request response time, breach deadlines to the regulator and to people, transfer conditions, consent texts per language; every value comes from configuration and unset values are shown as "not configured".

**Given** a required profile value is not configured, **when** the go-live checklist runs, **then** it lists the missing value with message Sec.ProfileIncomplete; IAM-017 and SEC-008 timers show "not configured" (BR-SEC-040).

**Given** the country profile is opened, **when** the privacy officer reads the further duties, **then** it also holds: whether personal data may be sent to external AI and translation providers and to which countries (AI-003), SMS opt-out duties and which message types are essential and sent despite opt-out (CHN-012), consent texts per partner data-sharing purpose (FIN-001 to FIN-003; the consents are recorded through IAM IC-IAM-05), and retention values per record type (read by PLT-020, including chat transcripts); every value is configuration, unset values show "not configured".

**Given** a user holds Security.Core.PrivacyProfile.CreateEditDelete, **when** the user records a processing activity (purpose, data categories, people concerned, lawful basis, retention rule from PLT-020, recipients, transfers, systems), **then** it is saved as a new version, listed, and exportable to CSV and XLSX (AUD-SEC-006).

**Given** an integration or hosting location sends personal data outside the instance country, **when** the transfer record is created (destination, recipient, safeguard, data categories), **then** it is linked to the processing activities and integrations concerned (SEC-006).

**Given** an external AI or translation provider (AI module), a recommendation service (SRC-009) or a lender (FIN) receives personal data, **when** the integration is enabled, **then** a processing activity and, when outside the instance country, a transfer record exist for it and the country profile allows it; otherwise the go-live checklist fails (BR-SEC-040).

**Given** a new processing activity is flagged as needing an impact assessment, **when** the assessment is recorded (risks, measures, decision, document, review date), **then** the processing activity shows the assessment status; on the review date the privacy officer is reminded.

**Given** a privacy request is received under IAM-017, **when** its due date is set, **then** the due date is the receipt time plus the response time of the profile; requests past it are listed as Overdue.
**Given** analytics is used, **when** the register is checked, **then** an analytics processing activity exists with lawful basis consent, and it is linked to the SEC-007 analytics cookie category.

**Given** CaptchaSettings.Enabled is on with CaptchaType ReCaptchaV3 or CheckBoxReCaptchaV2 and the public and private keys entered for the instance, **when** a visitor submits the registration, login, contact, product review or forgotten-password form (ShowOnRegistrationPage, ShowOnLoginPage, ShowOnContactUsPage, ShowOnProductReviewPage, ShowOnForgotPasswordPage), **then** the form is accepted only with a valid captcha; otherwise the native message Common.WrongCaptchaMessage is shown.
**Given** mobile registration and code request pages exist (IAM-002), **when** a visitor requests a code, **then** the same captcha check applies before a code is sent.

**Given** the public tracking page or the guest order lookup (TRK) is configured with captcha after a number of lookups (setting, default not stated), **when** a visitor exceeds that number of lookups in the session, **then** further lookups need a valid captcha; the TRK actions use the native ValidateCaptcha filter attribute with the CaptchaSettings of SEC-013.
basis: Proposed; FIT (ValidateCaptchaAttribute is a TypeFilterAttribute usable on plugin actions)

criterion: **Given** ReCaptchaV3 is used, **when** a submission scores below CaptchaSettings.ReCaptchaV3ScoreThreshold, **then** it is refused as above; the threshold value is per client (default not stated for the product).
**Given** the captcha service sends visitor data to its provider, **when** the instance goes live, **then** a transfer record for the captcha provider exists in the SEC-012 register.

**Given** a user holds Security.Core.DataClassification.CreateEditDelete, **when** the user sets the class of a field (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted, Personal, Financial — classes from FC-M21-004) and its masking rule, **then** the classification is saved and audited (AUD-SEC-009).

**Given** a field is masked for the role of the user, **when** an admin page or admin grid shows it, **then** the value is masked by the SEC global result filter (for example only the last digits of a phone number); if masking fails the value is not shown (fail closed, BR-SEC-060).
basis: D; FIT (ModelPreparedEvent consumers would swallow errors, so a result filter is used)

criterion: **Given** a user holds Security.Core.UnmaskedData.View, **when** the user chooses Reveal on a masked value, **then** the full value is shown and AUD-SEC-008 is written.

**Given** staff export customers or orders (native export), **when** the file is produced, **then** masked fields are masked in the file through the SEC override of IExportManager, except in the customer's own GDPR export (IAM-017).
**Given** a product plugin writes a log or audit entry containing a classified field, **when** the entry is written, **then** the value is masked or redacted according to its class.

**Given** SEC-014 is enabled and the CRM-003 360-degree view has its own masked-field list, **when** the classification is in force, **then** CRM-003 reads the class and masking rule of each field through IC-SEC-04 and the CRM list is no longer used; reveal rights stay with the CRM permission for the 360-degree view.

**Given** an incident is handled in the external incident tool, **when** the security officer requests evidence for a period, **then** the platform exports the audit events, authentication events and system-log entries of that period with a manifest (IC-SEC-02 or file export).
basis: D; FIT (no incident component in nopCommerce)

criterion: **Given** an incident involves personal data, **when** it is recorded, **then** a breach case is opened in SEC-008 and linked to the incident reference.

**Given** VendorSettings.AllowCustomersToApplyForVendorAccount is on and the applicant is a registered customer who is not an administrator, **when** the applicant submits the native apply-for-vendor form with name, email, description, optional logo and the configured vendor attributes, **then** a vendor record is created with Active = false, Customer.VendorId is set to it, the store owner receives VendorAccountApply.StoreOwnerNotification, and SEL records the application as Submitted (SM-SEL-01).
**Given** a guest (not registered) opens the apply-for-vendor page, **when** the page is requested, **then** the guest is asked to log in or register first; no vendor record is created.
basis: FIT (ApplyVendor returns Challenge for non-registered customers)

criterion: **Given** a vendor attribute is configured as required, **when** the applicant submits without it, **then** the form is redisplayed with the attribute warning and no vendor record is created.

**Given** the application is Submitted or Under Review, **when** the applicant opens My account, **then** the seller application page shows the current status (SM-SEL-01) and the next required action; the applicant has no admin access (the customer is not yet in the Vendors role).

**Given** the vendor record was created but the SEL application record failed to save, **when** the application list is opened, **then** a vendor with Active = false and no application record is listed as Submitted (BR-SEL-002).

**Given** the client has not confirmed a marketplace (KG-01 / MG-02 open or answered single seller), **when** the instance is configured, **then** the Marketplace pack plugin is not installed and AllowCustomersToApplyForVendorAccount is off; the apply-for-vendor page redirects to the home page (BR-SEL-001).
basis: D; FIT (ApplyVendorSubmit redirects when the setting is off)

criterion: **Given** the seller type and tier require document types A and B, **when** the applicant opens the documents page, **then** A and B are listed as required with status Missing; each upload is stored through IC-DOC-03 Store (native Download plus DOC-002 metadata: type, owner = the vendor, vault flag, expiry date) and SEL records the document type, issue date, expiry date and DOC version, and the document becomes Uploaded (SM-SEL-03).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-027; FIT (vendor attributes exclude FileUpload, so documents are a SEL entity)

criterion: **Given** identity and business registration details are configured as required vendor attributes (text box, for example registration number), **when** the applicant applies, **then** the values are stored with the vendor (native generic attribute VendorAttributes) and shown to compliance staff on the application.

**Given** a document is Uploaded, **when** compliance staff accept it, request resubmission with a reason, or reject it with a reason, **then** the document becomes Accepted, ResubmitRequested or Rejected; the reason is mandatory for the last two and is shown to the seller; the action is audited (AUD-SEL-002).
**Given** the document was ResubmitRequested, **when** the seller uploads a new version, **then** the new version becomes Uploaded and the old version is kept as Superseded.

**Given** the administrator adds a required vendor attribute or a document type required for a tier, **when** the change is saved, **then** new applications and the checklist of existing sellers in that tier show the new requirement without a code change; the change is audited (AUD-SEL-005).

**Given** a document is Accepted and its expiry date is within the configured alert lead time, **when** the daily expiry task runs, **then** the document becomes ExpiringSoon and the seller and compliance staff are notified (TRK event code Sel.DocumentExpiring.SellerNotification, IC-TRK-04).

**Given** an Accepted or ExpiringSoon document reaches its expiry date with no accepted renewal, **when** the expiry task runs, **then** the document becomes Expired; if the client setting "pause listings on expiry" is on, SEL requests a listing pause with reason DocumentExpired (IC-SEL-01).

**Given** a user other than the seller, its staff, compliance staff or an administrator, **when** requests a seller document file through the DOC-002 document endpoint or by its download GUID (Nop.Web DownloadController.GetFileUpload, Admin DownloadController.DownloadFile), **then** access is denied and the attempt is logged: the DOC-002 endpoint checks ownership (BR-DOC-011) and the SEC-002 download ownership filter, the single filter on the native download actions, applies the seller-document rule that SEL supplies as a rule provider (owning vendor's users, holders of Marketplace.Core.Applications.View or Marketplace.Core.Documents.Review, administrators); SEL adds no filter of its own on those actions.

**Given** the seller already holds a valid vault document of a required type in DOC-002, **when** the seller attaches it to the application, **then** it satisfies the requirement without a new upload and is reviewed as above; an expired vault document is not accepted.

**Given** the ADM-008 upload policy for the upload context "seller document" (registered by SEL) does not allow the file type, or the file is larger than its maximum, **when** the seller uploads the file, **then** IC-DOC-03 Store refuses it before anything is stored, with message Adm.UploadTypeNotAllowed or Adm.UploadTooLarge (BR-ADM-060); SEL keeps no type or size check of its own.

**Given** an application is Submitted, **when** SEL has submitted it to the ADM-006 seller-verification queue (IC-ADM-03 Submit) and a reviewer takes it from that queue, **then** it becomes Under Review and the assigned reviewer is recorded on the application.

**Given** an application is Under Review, every required document of the tier is Accepted, the current seller terms are accepted (SEL-006) and the block-list check (SEL-013, SEL-024) passes, **when** the reviewer approves the ADM-006 item and ADM-006 calls the SEL OnApproved callback (IC-ADM-03), **then** the application becomes Approved; SEL sets Vendor.Active = true through IVendorService.UpdateVendorAsync and adds the applicant customer to the native Vendors role (ICustomerService.AddCustomerRoleMappingAsync); the seller is notified (Sel.ApplicationApproved.SellerNotification); audited (AUD-SEL-001).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-028; FIT (ApplyVendor leaves Active false and the Vendors role unassigned)

criterion: **Given** a guard of the approval is not met, **when** the reviewer opens the application or tries to approve the ADM-006 item, **then** the application detail shows message Sel.ApprovalBlocked listing the unmet conditions; before recording an approval, an approval with conditions or the confirmation of conditions, ADM-006 calls the SEL guard IC-ADM-03 CanDecide, SEL refuses with the unmet conditions, and ADM records nothing and shows Adm.DecisionBlocked with the SEL reason (BR-ADM-031); if a guard becomes unmet after CanDecide and the OnApproved callback runs, SEL leaves the application Under Review and returns a module error (IC-ADM-03, raised to ADM-009).

**Given** an application is Under Review, **when** the reviewer rejects the ADM-006 item with a reason (OnRejected callback, IC-ADM-03), **then** it becomes Rejected, the reason is shown to the applicant and sent (Sel.ApplicationRejected.SellerNotification); the vendor stays inactive.

**Given** a seller is Approved, **when** compliance staff suspend it with a reason, **then** the application becomes Suspended; Vendor.Active is set to false (seller users are challenged in admin by the native ValidateVendor filter) and a listing pause with reason SellerSuspended is requested (IC-SEL-01), because Vendor.Active alone does not hide products (BR-SEL-006).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-028; FIT (ProductService.SearchProductsAsync has no vendor-status filter)

criterion: **Given** a seller is Suspended, **when** compliance staff reinstate it, **then** it becomes Approved, Vendor.Active is set to true and the SellerSuspended pause reason is cleared.

**Given** a user with Customers.VendorsCreateEditDelete edits a vendor whose application is not Approved, **when** they save the native vendor edit or create page with Active = true, **then** the SEL action filter on Admin VendorController.Create / Edit [POST] refuses the save with message Sel.ActivationBlocked (BR-SEL-002).
basis: FIT (Admin VendorController.Edit takes VendorModel and checks ModelState); Proposed

criterion: **Given** a user with Customers.VendorsCreateEditDelete opens a vendor whose application is Approved, **when** they save the native vendor edit page with Active = false, or delete the vendor (Admin VendorController.Delete [POST]), **then** the SEL action filter refuses the request with message Sel.UseSuspension; the seller can be taken off the marketplace only by suspension (SEL-003) or blacklisting (SEL-024), which also pause its listings (BR-SEL-006).
basis: FIT (Admin VendorController.Edit copies Active from the posted model; Delete only clears Customer.VendorId and soft-deletes the vendor; neither unpublishes products); Proposed

criterion: **Given** tiers T1 and T2 exist with different required document types, checks (for example IAM-020 identity check) and limits, **when** an applicant of seller type S applies, **then** the tier assigned by the configured rule for S applies, and only its requirements appear in the checklist.

**Given** an administrator changes a tier's required checks or limits, **when** the change is saved, **then** it applies to new decisions without a code change and is audited (AUD-SEL-005); sellers already approved keep their tier until re-verified (Proposed).

**Given** a tier limit (for example maximum active listings) is configured, **when** a seller of that tier exceeds it at publish, **then** the CAT-022 publish gate receives a failed eligibility check from SEL with message Sel.ListingNotEligible.
**Given** a seller is Approved at tier T1, **when** they open the verification page, **then** it shows the current tier, what it allows, what the next tier needs and a button to request an upgrade.

**Given** a seller requests an upgrade or appeals a rejection or suspension with a statement and optional files, **when** the request is submitted, **then** a verification request is Open (SM-SEL-02) in the compliance queue; a decision Granted or Declined with a reason is shown to the seller; audited (AUD-SEL-001).
**Given** a reviewer decided the original case, **when** the appeal of that case is assigned, **then** it cannot be assigned to the same reviewer (BR-SEL-003).

**Given** a seller-verification moderation queue is configured in ADM-006 with an assignment rule (round robin among Compliance role members, or by seller type, tier or country), **when** an application is Submitted, **then** SEL submits it through IC-ADM-03 with object type SellerApplication, the seller type and tier; ADM-006 places it in the matching queue and assigns it by the rule; unassigned items stay in the shared queue.

**Given** an IAM-020 adapter supports the country and identity type (IC-IAM-02 GetCapabilities), and the tier requires the check, **when** the application reaches Under Review, **then** SEL calls IC-IAM-02 Verify with country, subject type, identity type, identity number and name, and stores the result Verified, NotVerified, Inconclusive or Unavailable with the adapter reference, matched fields and time.

**Given** the result is NotVerified, **when** the reviewer opens the application, **then** approval is blocked until a second authorised user records an override reason or the seller corrects the data and the check is re-run (BR-SEL-007).

**Given** the adapter returns Unavailable or times out, **when** the check runs, **then** the application stays Under Review with the check marked Unavailable and is retried by the scheduled task; a reviewer may decide manually with a reason.

**Given** IC-IAM-02 GetCapabilities reports mobile-money KYC support for the seller's provider, **when** the seller gives the mobile-money number, **then** SEL calls IC-IAM-02 Verify with identity type mobile number; the registered name returned is compared with the seller or owner name and the result is stored as above.

**Given** no adapter reports mobile-money KYC support for the provider, **when** the seller gives the number, **then** the check is recorded as NotAvailable and document verification (SEL-002) applies instead.

**Given** the result is Inconclusive, **when** the reviewer opens the application, **then** the check is shown as needing manual review (decision ONE-RECORD); approval is blocked until a user with Marketplace.Core.Applications.Decide records a manual review outcome Confirmed or NotConfirmed with a reason and an evidence reference; Confirmed satisfies the check; NotConfirmed is treated as NotVerified (override rule above).

**Given** the seller is Approved, **when** the seller adds a mobile-money account (provider, number, account name) or a bank account (bank, branch, account number, account name), **then** the account is saved with status PendingVerification (SM-SEL-04); the account identifier is stored encrypted and shown masked (BR-SEL-008).
**Given** the seller has two Verified accounts, **when** the seller marks one as default, **then** settlements are paid to the default account; only one account is default at a time.

**Given** an account is PendingVerification, **when** the configured verification method completes with success (bank account check through INT-008 IC-INT-04 VerifyAccount; mobile-money registered-name check through IC-IAM-02 Verify where GetCapabilities reports mobile-money KYC; or confirmation by finance staff with evidence), **then** the account becomes Verified with the method and time recorded; on failure it becomes Failed with the reason.

**Given** a bank payout account is PendingVerification and the verification method for bank accounts is bank check, **when** SEL calls IC-INT-04 VerifyAccount (bank, account number, holder name) on the INT-008 bank adapter, **then** Match sets the account Verified and Mismatch sets it Failed, each with the bank reference; NotSupported or Unavailable leaves it PendingVerification and the next configured method (finance confirmation with evidence) applies; INT-008 changes no account state itself.

**Given** an account is Verified, **when** the seller changes its details, **then** a change record is created, the account becomes ChangePending and SEL submits an approval item to ADM-006 through IC-ADM-03 Submit (object type PayoutAccountChange); payouts continue to the current details until the change is approved; the seller's owner email and phone are notified of the request (Sel.PayoutAccountChangePending.SellerNotification).

**Given** a change is ChangePending and verified, **when** a finance user who did not request it approves the ADM-006 item and ADM-006 calls the SEL OnApproved callback (IC-ADM-03), **then** the new details become active and the account Verified; audited with old and new values and the approval item reference (AUD-SEL-003).

**Given** a change is ChangePending, **when** the requester or a seller staff user tries to approve it, or the OnApproved callback names the requester as approver, **then** approval is refused with message Sel.SelfApprovalNotAllowed; in the callback SEL keeps the change ChangePending and returns a module error (BR-SEL-007).

**Given** a change is ChangePending, **when** finance staff reject the ADM-006 item with a reason (OnRejected callback, IC-ADM-03), **then** the old details stay active, the account returns to Verified, the seller sees the reason; audited (AUD-SEL-003).

**Given** VendorSettings.TermsOfServiceEnabled is on and the topic VendorTermsOfService is published, **when** the applicant submits the apply-for-vendor form without ticking acceptance, **then** the SEL action filter on Nop.Web VendorController.ApplyVendor [POST] refuses the submission with message Sel.TermsRequired; no vendor record is created.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-030; FIT (native acceptance is checked only by browser script in ApplyVendor.cshtml)

criterion: **Given** the applicant ticks acceptance, **when** the form is submitted and the vendor is created, **then** SEL records the acceptance through IC-IAM-05 RecordAcceptance with customer, vendor, policy system name VendorTermsOfService, version (the Effective MKT-008 PolicyVersion read through IC-MKT-03 GetEffectivePolicyVersion), channel and IP address; IAM stores it and writes the audit event (AUD-IAM-012); SEL keeps no acceptance record of its own (decision ONE-RECORD).

**Given** IC-IAM-05 HasAcceptedCurrent (vendor, VendorTermsOfService) returns false, **when** the reviewer approves (SEL-003) or an administrator sets Active = true, **then** activation is refused (Sel.ApprovalBlocked / Sel.ActivationBlocked) (BR-SEL-002).

**Given** a new PolicyVersion of VendorTermsOfService becomes Effective with the MKT-008 flag "re-acceptance required" set, **when** the owner user of an approved seller makes a request in the seller portal, **then** the IAM-016 re-acceptance filter (IC-IAM-05 HasAcceptedCurrent) redirects the owner to the seller terms acceptance page and seller portal pages stay blocked until the owner accepts; the acceptance is recorded through IC-IAM-05 as above.
basis: D (gap: versioned re-acceptance); ONE-RECORD; Proposed (reuses IAM-016)

criterion: **Given** a new PolicyVersion of VendorTermsOfService becomes Effective without the re-acceptance flag, **when** seller users use the portal, **then** no prompt is shown; new applicants accept the new version.

**Given** the administrator creates SEL rules of the types seller type allowed per category, minimum pictures and tier listing limit, and prohibited categories, items and terms exist in CAT-021 (BR-CAT-011), **when** the rules are saved and published, **then** the SEL rules are versioned (BR-SEL-009) and the rule summary page (topic visible to the Vendors role) shows the published SEL version together with the current CAT-021 prohibited list and the CAT-002 mandatory fields; audited (AUD-SEL-005).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-046; Proposed (one owner per rule type: prohibited content CAT-021, mandatory fields CAT-002)

criterion: **Given** delivery service levels are defined in ORD-011, **when** the rules page is published, **then** it shows the service levels sellers must meet; their measurement is SEL-011.
**Given** a category has the native flag RestrictFromVendors, **when** a seller tries to add a product to it, **then** the native check refuses it (CategoryService.CanVendorAddProductsAsync).
**Given** VendorSettings.MaximumProductNumber is set, **when** a seller at the limit opens product create, **then** the native admin refuses with the maximum-products message.

**Given** an active SEL rule is violated by a product (for example the seller type is not allowed in the category, or it has fewer pictures than required), **when** the seller or staff submit the product for review or publishing through any path (admin create or edit, bulk edit, import), **then** the CAT-002 IProductService host (decision OVR-REG) with the CAT-022 lifecycle as publish-gate provider, calls the SEL eligibility provider (IC-SEL-01 CheckEligibility, registered as the IC-CAT-04 publish guard provider) and the listing does not advance; message Sel.ListingNotEligible names each failed rule.

**Given** all SEL rules pass, **when** the product is submitted for publishing, **then** the SEL check returns Pass and CAT-022 continues with its own checks (BR-CAT-002, BR-CAT-011) and approval steps.

**Given** a rule is changed so that published products now violate it, **when** the change is published, **then** the products are listed in a violations report for compliance staff; they are not unpublished automatically (Proposed).

**Given** an applicant is not yet Approved, **when** they open the seller application page in My account, **then** the checklist shows each item with done or open: profile complete, terms accepted, each required document Accepted, identity checks passed, payout account Verified; open items link to the page that completes them.

**Given** a seller is Approved, **when** a seller user opens the admin home page, **then** a SEL widget on the vendor dashboard shows the checklist items still open (for example first product published, payout account Verified), required actions (documents ExpiringSoon or ResubmitRequested, payout change rejected, open appeal) and the next payout date and amount (SEL-017).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-034; FIT (vendors use the admin dashboard scoped to their data)

criterion: **Given** every checklist item is done, **when** the dashboard is shown, **then** the checklist shows complete and is collapsed.

**Given** the administrator has defined seller staff profiles (for example Orders only, Catalogue only), each a subset of native vendor permissions, **when** the seller owner invites a staff user by email and chooses a profile, **then** the user receives an invitation; on acceptance the customer is linked to the seller (Customer.VendorId), added to the Vendors role and to the chosen profile; audited (AUD-SEL-009).
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-038; FIT (Customer.VendorId; native Admin AddCustomerToVendorPopup needs vendor-edit rights the seller does not have)

criterion: **Given** a staff user with profile Orders only, **when** opens or posts a product page in the admin area, **then** the SEL global action filter refuses with message Sel.StaffActionDenied; order pages work, scoped to the seller's orders by the native vendor scoping.
**Given** a staff user, **when** tries to change payout accounts, staff or terms, **then** refused (Sel.StaffActionDenied) unless the profile allows it.

**Given** the seller owner removes a staff user, **when** the removal is saved, **then** Customer.VendorId is cleared, the Vendors role and profile are removed and the user's sessions lose seller access on next request; audited (AUD-SEL-009).

**Given** the seller is Suspended, **when** a staff user opens the admin area, **then** the native ValidateVendor filter challenges the user, because the user is in the Vendors role and the vendor is inactive (BR-SEL-010).

**Given** seller types (for example manufacturer, distributor, service provider) and sizes are configured, **when** a seller is classified, **then** the seller type is stored as the SEL SellerType (authoritative) and the size as the vendor attribute "seller size" captured under MKT-011 (AC-MKT-011-01-03); the type drives: verification tier (SEL-003), required documents (SEL-002), commission rules (SEL-016), settlement cycle (SEL-017) and terms version (SEL-006).
**Given** a seller's type is changed by compliance staff, **when** the change is saved, **then** the new type's rules apply from that time; the change is audited (AUD-SEL-005).

**Given** orders, shipments, return requests and complaints exist for a seller, **when** the daily KPI task runs, **then** a snapshot per seller and period stores orders fulfilled, cancellation rate, return rate, complaint count and on-time delivery rate, computed from the seller's orders (single-seller orders, CHK-004) and ReturnRequest, with the complaint count read through IC-CRM-05 GetComplaintCounts (vendor, period).

**Given** a user with Marketplace.Core.Reports.View, **when** opens the performance view, **then** KPIs per seller and period are listed with filters and export; a seller sees only its own KPIs in the seller portal.

**Given** a threshold "return rate above X in period P: action Warn" is configured, **when** a seller crosses it, **then** the seller receives a warning notification and an intervention record is created; audited (AUD-SEL-006).

**Given** a threshold with action PauseListings is configured, **when** a seller crosses it, **then** a listing pause with reason PerformanceIntervention is requested (IC-SEL-01) and compliance staff are notified.

**Given** a threshold with action Suspend is configured, **when** a seller crosses it, **then** a suspension proposal is placed in the compliance queue; the seller is suspended only when compliance staff confirm (BR-SEL-014).
**Given** delivery service levels are defined (ORD-011), **when** a seller's on-time delivery rate falls below the configured threshold, **then** the configured action runs as above.

**Given** an order of seller V has OrderStatus Complete, **when** the buyer of that order opens it in My account, **then** a rate-the-seller form (score and comment) is offered once per order and seller.
**Given** the order is not Complete, or the user is not the buyer, or a rating exists for that order and seller, **when** a rating is posted, **then** it is refused with message Sel.RatingNotAllowed.
**Given** ratings require approval (setting), **when** a rating is posted, **then** it is Pending and shown only after a moderator publishes it; a rejected rating keeps its reason (SM-SEL-06).
**Given** a published rating is reported as abusive by the seller or a user, **when** a moderator upholds the report, **then** the rating becomes Hidden; audited (AUD-SEL-010).

**Given** published ratings exist for seller V, **when** the vendor page is shown, **then** the average score and count of published ratings are shown next to the native vendor reviews link (CatalogController.VendorReviews, product reviews of the seller's products).

**Given** a user has Platform.Core.Lists.CreateEditDelete, **when** they add an entry with subject type (customer, vendor, email, phone, IP address or range, device identifier), list type (Block, Watch, Allow), scope (registration, login, checkout, seller application, all), reason, start and optional end, **then** the entry is Active from its start; every create, change and revoke is audited with old and new values (AUD-SEL-007).
**Given** an Active entry has an end date, **when** the end date passes, **then** the entry becomes Expired automatically and no longer applies.

**Given** a customer, the customer's email or phone, or the request IP matches an Active Block entry with scope checkout or all, **when** the customer reaches checkout, **then** an account restriction is raised for PAY-018 and checkout is blocked there with message Pay.CheckoutRestricted, which does not state the reason.

**Given** a subject matches an Active Block entry with scope registration or seller application, **when** the registration POST (native CustomerController.Register or the IAM mobile registration) or the apply-for-vendor POST is made, **then** the SEL action filter refuses it with message Sel.Blocked, which does not state the reason; the attempt is logged.
