**Given** a subject matches an Active Block entry with scope login or all, **when** the login POST is made (Nop.Web CustomerController.Login, including a 5.00 login by mobile number and code), **then** the SEL action filter refuses it with message Sel.Blocked before IAM authentication runs; the attempt is logged; IAM services (ICustomerRegistrationService, IAuthenticationService, owner IAM per OVR-REG) are not overridden.

**Given** a subject matches an Active Watch entry, **when** the subject places an order or applies to sell, **then** the action proceeds and a flag is raised in the review queue with the entry reason.
**Given** a subject matches an Active Allow entry, **when** a Watch rule would flag it, **then** no Watch flag is raised (BR-SEL-016).
**Given** the request IP matches an Active Block entry with scope all, **when** any storefront page is requested, **then** the response is HTTP 403 with message Sel.Blocked.

**Given** a mobile number or the request IP matches an Active Block entry with scope login or all, **when** a native 5.00 code-login action is called directly (CustomerController.SendOtp or CommonVerificationOtp), without passing the login POST, **then** the same SEL action filter refuses it with message Sel.Blocked before a code is sent or a sign-in happens; the attempt is logged.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-118; FIT (Presentation/Nop.Web/Controllers/CustomerController.cs:561, 649: both are public POST actions); Proposed; VER-500

criterion: **Given** a seller is Approved (SEL-003), **when** procurement staff add it to the panel of category C with a validity end date, **then** the panel membership is Approved (SM-SEL-09); audited (AUD-SEL-005).

**Given** a buyer issues a request for quotation in category C and seller quoting exists (ORD-012 / ORD-013), **when** invitations are sent, **then** only Approved, unexpired panel members of C are invited (BR-SEL-019).

**Given** a membership is within the configured renewal lead time of its end date, **when** the daily task runs, **then** it becomes RenewalDue and the supplier is notified (Sel.PanelExpiring.SellerNotification).
**Given** the end date passes without renewal, **when** the task runs, **then** the membership becomes Expired and the supplier is no longer invited.
**Given** a file in the published template is uploaded, **when** the import runs, **then** each row is validated field by field; valid rows create a pending invitation with the given details.

**Given** an invitation is created, **when** it is sent by email or SMS (TRK-005), **then** the recipient opens the link, confirms or completes the pre-filled profile, sets a password and, for sellers, lands on the seller application (SEL-001) with the details filled in.

**Given** a row's email or phone matches an existing customer or another row, **when** the import runs, **then** the row is marked Duplicate with message Sel.DuplicateRow and no invitation is created.
**Given** the import completes, **when** the user opens the result, **then** every row shows Created, Duplicate or Error with the field and reason, and the result can be downloaded.
**Given** an invitation is not accepted before its expiry (setting), **when** the expiry passes, **then** the invitation becomes Expired and can be re-sent.

**Given** commission rules exist for category C (percentage) and for logistics service L (fixed fee), **when** an order line in C using L is paid, **then** PAY-010 asks SEL for the rules in force and records commission and logistics fee on the split with the rule version IDs (IC-SEL-02).

**Given** a rule for seller V and a rule for category C both match a line, **when** the rule is resolved, **then** the more specific rule applies in the order seller, seller type or tier, listing or service type, category, default (BR-SEL-011).

**Given** no rule matches a line, **when** the line is paid, **then** the default rule applies; if no default exists, the split is flagged as an exception for finance staff and no commission is assumed.

**Given** a rule version with a future effective date is saved, **when** an order is placed before that date, **then** the previous version applies and the line keeps the version in force at order placement (BR-PAY-070).
**Given** a rule is created or changed, **when** it is saved, **then** the change takes effect without a release and is audited with old and new values and effective date (AUD-SEL-005).

**Given** a fee type such as a listing fee is configured, **when** the triggering event occurs (for example a product is published), **then** a fee charge is recorded for the seller and deducted in the next settlement (SEL-017).

**Given** PAY-010 split records exist for paid lines of seller V that meet the eligibility event and hold period (settings), **when** the settlement cycle of V closes, **then** a settlement batch is Calculated with: seller shares, minus refund reversals (BR-PAY-051), minus fee charges (SEL-016), minus seller charges supplied through IC-SEL-05 (ORD-004 penalties, FIN-001 repayment deductions, RET merchant-paid return charges), plus or minus adjustments; each split and each charge is included in exactly one batch (BR-SEL-012).
**Given** the net amount of a batch is zero or negative, **when** the batch is calculated, **then** it becomes CarriedForward and the amount is carried to the next batch; no payout is made.
**Given** a refund completes after its split was paid out, **when** the next batch is calculated, **then** the reversal is deducted in that batch as an adjustment with the order reference.

**Given** an order line is a service line (SVC), **when** the batch is calculated, **then** the line is eligible only when its service stage is Accepted; lines NotDelivered or Failed are excluded (BR-SVC-041).

**Given** ORD-004 recorded a SellerPenalty (VendorId, OrderId, RuleId, Amount, Reason) for seller V and passed it through IC-SEL-05 AddSellerCharge with source type Penalty (BR-ORD-031), **when** the batch is calculated, **then** a penalty line with the order and rule reference is deducted and shown on the statement; penalty rules and amounts are ORD settings (not stated in source).

**Given** a return of seller V uses a merchant-paid return shipping model (BR-RET-020) and RET supplied the charge through IC-SEL-05, **when** the batch is calculated, **then** the charge is deducted as a seller charge line with the return reference.

**Given** a lender has instructed a repayment deduction for seller V (FIN-001), **when** the batch is calculated, **then** a deduction line is added through IC-SEL-05, capped at the lowest of the instructed amount, the outstanding loan balance and the batch net, with the lender and loan reference; it is shown on the statement.

**Given** a payment for an order line of seller V was allocated to a receivable Assigned to a lender (FIN-002) and flagged "assigned — not for seller payout" (BR-PAY-131), **when** the batch is calculated, **then** the related split is not included in any batch of V and is listed for finance staff as excluded with the receivable reference.

**Given** seller V has cycle Weekly and seller W has cycle Daily, **when** the settlement task runs, **then** each seller's batch closes on its own cycle; changing a cycle applies from the next period and is audited (AUD-SEL-005).

**Given** a batch is Calculated and V has a Verified default payout account, **when** a user with Marketplace.Core.Settlements.Release releases it, **then** a payout is sent through the PAY-024 Payout operation (IC-PAY-01) with idempotency key batch ID + attempt, using the account snapshot taken at release; the batch becomes PayoutSent; audited (AUD-SEL-008).
**Given** V has no Verified payout account, **when** release is attempted, **then** release is refused with message Sel.NoVerifiedPayoutAccount and V is notified.

**Given** the provider reports success or failure, **when** the payout result arrives, **then** the batch becomes Paid or Failed with the provider reference or reason; a Failed batch can be retried with a new attempt number.

**Given** a batch becomes Paid and it holds FIN repayment deduction lines, **when** the status is saved, **then** SEL publishes the event Seller.SettlementPaid (VendorId, SettlementBatchId, PaidOnUtc, Net, deduction lines with source and reference); the FIN consumer only enqueues IC-FIN-01 ReportRepayment.

**Given** batches exist for V in a calendar month, **when** V opens or downloads the statement for that month, **then** the statement (PDF generated through DOC-001 IC-DOC-01, and CSV) lists, per order line: earned, commission, fees, tax on commission (PAY-021), refunds, penalties, repayment deductions with lender reference, other seller charges, adjustments, paid out, with batch and payout references, and the closing balance.
**Given** another seller's statement is requested, **when** the request is made, **then** access is denied.

**Given** the seller is Approved, **when** the seller adds a location with a native Address, type (business, pickup point, drop-off) and pickup or drop-off preference, **then** the location is saved for that seller only; it is the pickup origin for LOG-011 seller pickups, and the pickup or drop-off choice is read by LOG-011 (pickup) and LOG-022 (drop-off at an outlet).
**Given** a location is used by open shipments, **when** the seller deactivates it, **then** deactivation is refused with message Sel.LocationInUse until the shipments are closed.

**Given** the client has marked a fulfilment service available for the seller's location area, **when** the seller opts in, **then** the opt-in is recorded with date and service and LOG-008 treats the seller's order lines as client-fulfilled unless the product overrides it (BR-LOG-060).
**Given** no service is available for the seller's locations, **when** the seller opens the opt-in page, **then** no service is offered and message Sel.FulfilmentNotAvailable is shown.

**Given** the seller schedules vacation with start, end and a localized message, **when** the start time is reached, **then** the vacation becomes Active and SEL requests a listing pause with reason Vacation (IC-SEL-01); Vendor.Active is not changed, so seller users keep portal access.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-049; FIT (inactive vendors are challenged in admin by ValidateVendor)

criterion: **Given** vacation is Active, **when** a customer opens the seller's vendor page, **then** a notice (Sel.VacationNotice) with the seller's message and the end date is shown in widget zone vendordetails_top.

**Given** vacation is Active and CatalogSettings.AllowViewUnpublishedProductPage is on, **when** a customer opens a paused product page, **then** the same notice is shown in widget zone productdetails_top; with the setting off the page returns not found (native).
**Given** a customer has a paused product in the cart, **when** the cart is shown, **then** the native unpublished-product warning applies and the item cannot be checked out.

**Given** the end time is reached or the seller ends vacation early, **when** the vacation task runs, **then** the vacation becomes Ended and the Vacation pause reason is cleared; listings resume only if no other reason remains (BR-SEL-005).

**Given** the native vendor templates OrderPlaced.VendorNotification, OrderPaid.VendorNotification, OrderCancelled.VendorNotification and QuantityBelow.VendorNotification are active, **when** an order event occurs, **then** the seller receives the email (native) and, where TRK-005 maps the event to further channels, the SMS or app message, in the seller's language.

**Given** a verification event occurs (application decision, document ResubmitRequested, Rejected, ExpiringSoon or Expired, payout account change decision), **when** the event is raised, **then** SEL calls IC-TRK-04 SendEvent with the SEL event code it registered at installation (IC-TRK-04 RegisterEventCode; BR-TRK-023) and TRK-005 notifies the seller on the configured channels with the required action and a link, applying the TRK-006 preferences and opt-outs.

**Given** a complaint against the seller is registered (CRM-004), **when** CRM publishes the event Complaint.Created (ticket, seller, category), **then** the SEL consumer only enqueues the seller notification with the complaint reference and the response due date; the job sends it through IC-TRK-04 SendEvent (TRK-005).
**Given** a channel fails, **when** the gateway reports failure, **then** the TRK-005 fallback applies and the failure is logged.

**Given** application history exists (SM-SEL-01 transitions with times), **when** the funnel report runs for a period, **then** it shows counts for registered, submitted, approved and rejected, and the median and maximum time from submitted to decision and between each step, filterable by seller type and tier, with export.

**Given** the report is run, **when** "registered" is counted, **then** registered = customers who started a seller registration through the seller sign-up entry (Proposed definition); submitted = applications created (SEL-001).

**Given** characteristics are configured as vendor attributes (checkbox or dropdown), **when** sellers declare them at application or in their profile, **then** the values are stored with the vendor (native) and are visible to compliance staff.
**Given** values exist, **when** the diversity report runs for a period, **then** it shows the share of approved sellers, of active listings and of sales value per characteristic.

**Given** training topics are published with ACL limited to the Vendors role (Topic.SubjectToAcl), **when** a seller user opens the seller help page, **then** the topics and their downloadable templates are listed; customers outside the Vendors role cannot open them.

**Given** onboarding topics are published for applicants (ACL Registered), **when** an applicant opens the seller application page, **then** links to the onboarding content are shown next to the checklist (SEL-008).
**Given** a topic is changed, **when** it is saved, **then** the change follows MKT-008 approval when that is enabled for the topic.

**Given** compliance staff blacklist seller V with reason and period (SEL-013 entry, subject vendor, list Block), **when** the entry becomes Active, **then** V is Suspended (SM-SEL-01), listings are paused with reason SellerBlacklisted (IC-SEL-01), and the identifiers of V (owner and staff email and phone, registration number, payout account identifiers) are added as linked Block entries (BR-SEL-017); audited (AUD-SEL-007).
**Given** a linked identifier of a blacklisted seller, **when** is used in a new seller application, **then** the application is refused at submission with message Sel.Blocked.
**Given** compliance staff add V to the watch list, **when** V lists products or receives orders, **then** actions proceed and each is flagged for review.

**Given** V is blacklisted, **when** V submits an appeal from the seller account page (storefront, because admin access is suspended), **then** an appeal is Open (SM-SEL-08) for a reviewer who did not create the entry; Upheld revokes the entry and reinstates V; Dismissed keeps it; V is told the outcome.
**Given** the blacklist period ends, **when** the list task runs, **then** the entry becomes Expired; V stays Suspended until compliance staff reinstate it (Proposed).

**Given** an order of seller V was paid by direct payment (PAY-035), **when** the payment is recorded, **then** a commission accrual per line is recorded with the SEL-016 rule versions in force at order placement; no PAY-010 split exists for the order (BR-PAY-150).

**Given** accruals exist for V in the closed invoicing period (setting), **when** the invoicing task runs, **then** a commission invoice is Issued to V with lines per order, commission, fees and tax on them (PAY-021); it is posted as a receivable in PAY-033 (IC-SEL-03); V can download it in the seller portal.
**Given** e-invoicing applies (E-INV), **when** the invoice is issued, **then** it is submitted through PAY-025 as a fiscal document and becomes FiscalAccepted on acceptance.

**Given** an invoice is unpaid past its due date plus the configured grace days, **when** the daily task runs, **then** the invoice becomes Overdue, V is notified and, if the client setting is on, a listing pause with reason CommissionOverdue is requested (IC-SEL-01).

**Given** V pays and PAY-033 allocates the payment, **when** allocation is recorded, **then** the invoice becomes PartlyPaid or Paid and the CommissionOverdue reason is cleared when nothing is overdue.
**Given** a direct-paid line is refunded before invoicing, **when** the period closes, **then** the accrual is reduced in proportion (BR-PAY-051).

**Given** no search provider is selected and a published product is named "Green Tea", **when** the shopper searches "tea", **then** the product is found: the name is matched as a substring (SQL LIKE through string.Contains); SKU and manufacturer part number match only when equal to the whole term.

**Given** the SRC search provider (SRC-014) is selected, **when** the shopper searches a word that appears only in a product's full description or tags, **then** the product is found, because the provider indexes name, short and full description, SKU, manufacturer part number and tags.

**Given** no search provider is selected, **when** the shopper uses the simple search box, **then** descriptions and tags are not searched; they are searched only when the shopper ticks "search in product descriptions" or "search in product tags" in the advanced search (native).
**Given** two or more languages are published and the working language is L, **when** the shopper searches, **then** localized names and short descriptions in L are also matched.

**Given** the term is shorter than CatalogSettings.ProductSearchTermMinimumLength, **when** the shopper searches, **then** no search runs and the native message Search.SearchTermMinimumLengthIsNCharacters is shown.
**Given** a product has an attribute combination with its own SKU, **when** the shopper searches that exact SKU, **then** the product is found.

**Given** the SRC provider is selected and a client mapping links units (for example kg) to the specification attribute that holds pack size, **when** the shopper searches "black tea in 1 kg packs", **then** Withdrawn (VER-500): now native — the free-text request is sent by the bundled Google AI Commerce Search plugin (AIRecommendation.GoogleAI 5.00.01, the AI recommendation provider of SearchProductsAsync) to Google Cloud Retail Search as SearchRequest.Query, against the synced catalogue (title, descriptions, categories, manufacturers, specification attributes, tags, price, availability), and the products come back in Google relevance order; no SRC parser or unit mapping is built; Google-side understanding of quantities is verified by AC-SRC-001-02-05.

**Given** the active ISearchProvider throws an error or returns no product and CatalogSettings.UseStandardSearchWhenNoResults is on (5.00 name of UseStandardSearchWhenSearchProviderThrowsException), **when** the shopper searches, **then** results of the native standard search are shown; native code does not log the provider error (empty catch), so the SRC provider logs its own errors before it throws (Proposed).

**Given** a product has tags, **when** the shopper opens a tag page, **then** products with that tag are listed with paging (ProductsByTagPageSize) and, if ProductsByTagPriceRangeFiltering is on, a price filter.

**Given** the storefront is open, **when** the shopper looks for products, **then** a search box is on every page; the search page offers an advanced form (category with subcategories, manufacturer, seller if VendorSettings.AllowSearchByVendor, price, search in descriptions, search in tags); category menus and tag pages are also available.

**Given** the client has accepted Google Cloud Retail for its store (data protection and cost confirmed, open items below), **when** the client instance is configured, **then** the bundled Google AI Commerce Search plugin is installed and named in ArtificialIntelligenceSettings.ActiveAIRecommendationProviderSystemName; GoogleAiSettings.Enabled and SearchAllowed are on and ProjectId, LocationId, CatalogId and BranchId are set; the Google service-account key is supplied to the host through Application Default Credentials (environment variable GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS), never in a configuration pack (BR-PLT-013); the bundled Google Analytics widget it depends on is active; the catalogue sync has run; and ArtificialIntelligenceSettings.UseStandardSearchWhenNoResults and CatalogSettings.UseStandardSearchWhenNoResults are on (BR-SRC-150).
basis: VER-500; FIT (GoogleAiPlugin.cs:17; plugin.json DependsOn Widgets.GoogleAnalytics; GoogleAiSettings.cs:13-49; ArtificialIntelligenceSettings.cs:93)

criterion: **Given** the Google AI plugin is active and GoogleAiSettings.EnableForRegisteredUsersOnly is on (install default), **when** a guest searches, **then** the plugin returns no product, the standard path (ISearchProvider or native search) answers with the keywords, and the everyday-language behaviour of story 02 applies only to registered shoppers; whether guests are included is a client setting (EnableForRegisteredUsersOnly off includes them).

**Given** the Google AI plugin is active, **when** the client acceptance set of everyday-language queries (KTDA and Malawi Post examples such as "black tea in 1 kg packs") is run, **then** each query returns the products the client marked as expected among the first results; result quality is Google-side behaviour that cannot be verified from source, so this test is the acceptance evidence.
basis: VER-500; Proposed (acceptance set Not stated in source)

criterion: **Given** the Google AI plugin is active and Google fails or returns no product, **when** the shopper searches, **then** with ArtificialIntelligenceSettings.UseStandardSearchWhenNoResults on, the ISearchProvider or the native search runs with the keywords; with it off native code would return the product list without any keyword filter, which BR-SRC-150 forbids.

**Given** the Google AI plugin is active and the visitor has no Google Analytics client-id cookie (for example analytics cookies refused), **when** the shopper searches, **then** no request is sent to Google and the standard path answers, so results can differ by cookie-consent state.

**Given** the Google AI plugin is active and two or more languages are published, **when** the catalogue is synced, **then** only the default admin language is sent to Google, so searches in another language are matched against default-language text; multilingual search stays a SRC-014 build.

**Given** ProductSearchAutoCompleteEnabled is on and ProductSearchTermMinimumLength is reached, **when** the shopper types in the search box, **then** up to ProductSearchAutoCompleteNumberOfProducts product suggestions appear (10 when the setting is 0), with pictures when ShowProductImagesInSearchAutoComplete is on.
**Given** more products match than are shown and ShowLinkToAllResultInSearchAutoComplete is on, **when** suggestions appear, **then** a "view all results" link is shown.
**Given** fewer characters than the minimum are typed, **when** the shopper types, **then** no suggestions are shown.

**Given** the SRC provider is selected (or the AI recommendation provider, which SearchProductsAsync calls first, BR-SRC-150), **when** suggestions are requested, **then** they come from that provider, because autocomplete calls SearchProductsAsync with the keywords.

**Given** ShowSearchBoxCategories is on and the shopper chose a category in the search box, **when** suggestions are requested, **then** only products of that category and its subcategories are suggested.
**Given** CatalogSettings.EnablePriceRangeFiltering is on, **when** the shopper sets a price range on a category page, **then** only products within the range are listed.
**Given** a specification attribute (for example Grade or Size) has options with AllowFiltering on, **when** the shopper ticks one option, **then** only products with that option are listed.

**Given** the shopper ticks two options of one attribute and one option of another, **when** the list refreshes, **then** products matching either of the first two and the third are listed (OR within an attribute, AND across attributes).
**Given** EnableManufacturerFiltering is on, **when** the shopper picks a brand, **then** only that brand's products are listed.

**Given** the seller facet is on (setting), **when** a category or search page is shown, **then** a seller filter lists the active sellers that have products in the result; picking one restricts the list through the SRC search-filter provider (IC-SRC-02) of the CAT-002 IProductService override (decision OVR-REG).

**Given** the in-stock facet is on (setting), **when** the shopper ticks "In stock only", **then** only products with sellable stock above 0, products that do not manage stock and products that allow backorders are listed (BR-SRC-011).
**Given** the shopper is on the search page, **when** they choose a category in the advanced form with "include subcategories", **then** results are limited to that category and its subcategories.
**Given** filters are configured, **when** the shopper opens a category page or the search page, **then** the same filters (price, attributes, brand, seller, in stock) are offered on both pages.

**Given** district is defined per client as the state/province or county of an address, and warehouses have addresses, **when** the shopper chooses district X, **then** only products with sellable stock in a warehouse whose address is in district X are listed.

**Given** warehouses have coordinates (INV-002) and the shopper gives a location (browser location with consent, or a chosen district centre) and a radius, **when** the distance filter is applied, **then** only products with sellable stock (GetTotalStockQuantityAsync per warehouse, which subtracts unsellable lots through IC-INV-04) in a warehouse within the radius (great-circle distance from the coordinates read through IC-INV-05) are listed, nearest first when sorted by distance.
**Given** the shopper gave no location and refused browser location, **when** they choose the distance filter, **then** the filter is not applied and message Src.LocationNeeded asks for a district.

**Given** delivery options come from LOG (for example home delivery and pickup), **when** the shopper filters by an option, **then** only products that can be fulfilled with that option for the shopper's district are listed.

**Given** pickup points (native StorePickupPoint) are linked to warehouses (LOG-003 PickupPointWarehouse, read through IC-LOG-06), **when** the shopper selects an outlet in "nearby pickup" mode, **then** only products with sellable stock in the warehouse linked to that outlet are listed, and the outlet's address and opening hours are shown.
**Given** the shopper selects a district in "nearby pickup" mode, **when** the list is shown, **then** products available at any outlet in that district are listed with the outlets that have them.

**Given** CatalogSettings.AllowProductSorting is on, **when** the shopper opens the sort list on a category or search page, **then** the native options position, name A-Z, name Z-A, price low to high, price high to low and newest are offered, except those in ProductSortingEnumDisabled, in the order of ProductSortingEnumDisplayOrder.

**Given** the SRC search provider is selected, **when** the shopper searches with the sort "position", **then** results keep the provider's order, and the option is labelled with locale key Src.SortRelevance on the search page.
basis: FIT (ProductExtensions.OrderBy, ProductExtensions.cs:99, called at ProductService.cs:1176 for the ISearchProvider and at :911 for the AI provider); REQ-MPC-FR-078 (relevance)

criterion: **Given** the popularity basis is set (units sold in a period, default not stated), **when** the shopper sorts by popularity, **then** products are ordered by units sold in that period, highest first; products with no sales follow in position order.

**Given** a specification attribute is configured as "origin", **when** the shopper sorts by origin, **then** products are ordered by the origin value alphabetically in the working language; products without an origin come last.

**Given** popularity or origin is chosen, **when** the list is built, **then** the sort is applied by an SRC ordering provider (IC-SRC-02) of the CAT-002 IProductService override (decision OVR-REG) and the options are added by an override of the Nop.Web CatalogModelFactory.PrepareSortingOptionsAsync (public virtual); the native ProductSortingEnum and its values are not changed in core.
basis: FIT (ProductExtensions.OrderBy falls back to display order for unknown values); OVR-REG; Proposed

criterion: **Given** CategoryBreadcrumbEnabled is on, **when** the shopper opens a sub-category page, **then** the breadcrumb shows the path from the home page.

**Given** a category has published sub-categories, **when** its page is opened, **then** the sub-categories are shown with pictures, and if ShowProductsFromSubcategories is on their products are listed too.

**Given** products are marked IsFeaturedProduct in a category, **when** its page is opened, **then** they are shown in the featured block; they also appear in the normal list only if IncludeFeaturedProductsInNormalLists is on.

**Given** AllowProductViewModeChanging is on, **when** the shopper switches between grid and list, **then** the list is shown in the chosen view; DefaultViewMode applies on first visit; page sizes follow DefaultCategoryPageSizeOptions.

**Given** the main menu is configured with categories (native menus, Libraries/Nop.Core/Domain/Menus), **when** the shopper opens the menu, **then** categories can be reached from the menu, the category pages and the breadcrumb.
basis: REQ-MPC-UX-004; Inference from REQ-MPC-UX-001 (no measurable criterion); FIT

criterion: **Given** the user has ContentManagement.MenusCreateEditDelete, **when** they add menu items of type category, manufacturer, vendor, product, topic or custom link to the main or footer menu, **then** the storefront menu shows them in the set order.
**Given** the bundled Widgets.Swiper plugin is configured with slides, **when** the home page is opened, **then** the slides rotate with the configured autoplay.

**Given** a product carousel or collection is defined by a product list or a rule (category, tag, new, on sale), **when** the page holding its widget zone is opened, **then** the carousel shows the matching published products.

**Given** a banner or featured category has a start and an end date, **when** the storefront is opened before, during and after the window, **then** it is shown only during the window (store time zone); native Swiper slides have no dates, so dated placements come from the licensed plugin or the SRC build.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-082 (banners, featured categories); FIT (Slide has no dates)

criterion: **Given** a campaign page is built from a topic and blocks (HTML, carousel, banner) placed in widget zones, **when** the shopper opens the campaign URL, **then** the blocks are shown in the configured order; the page is visible only between its start and end dates.

**Given** a product has MarkAsNew on and today is inside its "mark as new" dates, or has an old price above its price, **when** its card is shown, **then** the ribbon "New" or "Sale" is shown on the picture.
**Given** related products are defined for a product, **when** its page is opened, **then** the related products are shown.
**Given** cross-sell products are defined and ShoppingCartSettings.CrossSellsNumber is above 0, **when** the shopper opens the cart, **then** up to that number of cross-sells are shown.
**Given** ProductsAlsoPurchasedEnabled is on, **when** a product page is opened, **then** up to ProductsAlsoPurchasedNumber products bought in the same orders are shown.

**Given** RecentlyViewedProductsEnabled is on, **when** the shopper has viewed products, **then** up to RecentlyViewedProductsNumber recently viewed products are shown in the recently viewed block and page (stored in a cookie).
**Given** NewProductsEnabled is on, **when** the shopper opens the new products page, **then** products marked as new are listed.
**Given** a product in a recommendation block is not eligible (BR-SRC-050), **when** the block is built, **then** it is not shown.

**Given** the consent for personalisation (native GdprConsent) is not given, **when** the shopper browses and buys, **then** no behaviour event is sent to the recommendation service and only rules-based blocks (SRC-008) are shown.

**Given** the consent is given, **when** the shopper views products, adds to cart and buys, **then** when a recommendation provider is registered (IC-SRC-04; AI-007 when the AI pack is installed), these events are passed to it with a pseudonymous customer key only; with no provider registered no event leaves the platform.

**Given** a registered recommendation provider (IC-SRC-04 Recommend) returns ranked product IDs for the shopper and surface, **when** a page with the recommendation widget is shown, **then** the recommended products are shown after removing products that are unpublished, hidden, or not allowed by ACL or store mapping (BR-SRC-050).

**Given** personalised ranking is on and the shopper searches with keywords, **when** results are built, **then** the SRC search provider orders the IDs using the ranking of the registered recommendation provider (IC-SRC-04), and keeps the native relevance order when none is registered (ISearchProvider returns ordered product IDs); category listings use an SRC ordering provider (IC-SRC-02) of the CAT-002 IProductService override (decision OVR-REG).

**Given** the shopper withdraws consent, **when** the withdrawal is saved, **then** events stop at once and, when a recommendation provider is registered, a deletion request for the shopper's data is passed to it (IC-SRC-04 DeleteSubjectData).

**Given** no recommendation provider is registered (P1 default, AI pack not installed), or the registered provider does not answer within its timeout or is unavailable, **when** a page with the recommendation widget is shown, **then** the widget shows the native related, cross-sell or bestseller products (RelatedProduct, CrossSellProduct, bestsellers report; SRC-008, SRC-015), filtered by BR-SRC-050, and the page is not delayed beyond the timeout; this is the only fallback specification for recommendations.
**Given** the shopper has PublicStore.EnableWishlist, **when** they add a product to the wish list, **then** it is saved for the shopper (registered or guest record) up to MaximumWishlistItems.
**Given** EmailWishlistEnabled is on, **when** the shopper sends the wish list to a friend, **then** the native message template Wishlist.EmailAFriend is sent.

**Given** the shopper selects items in the wish list, **when** they choose "add to cart", **then** the items are added to the cart, and removed from the wish list if MoveItemsFromWishlistToCart is on.
**Given** AllowMultipleWishlist is on, **when** the shopper creates named wish lists, **then** up to MaximumNumberOfCustomWishlist lists can be created.

**Given** the shopper is registered and has Search.Core.SavedSearches.Use, **when** they save the current search (keywords and filters), **then** it is stored up to the per-customer limit; above the limit message Src.SavedSearchLimit is shown.

**Given** a saved search exists, **when** the alert task runs and products published since the last run match it, **then** SRC asks TRK-005 to send one alert listing the new matches (IC-TRK-04 SendEvent, event code Src.SavedSearchMatch registered by SRC at installation through RegisterEventCode, email as the default channel); TRK applies the channels and TRK-006 opt-outs; nothing is sent when there are no new matches.

**Given** the shopper watches a product at price P, **when** the price falls below P, **then** one price-drop alert is sent for that drop through TRK-005 (IC-TRK-04 SendEvent, event code Src.PriceDrop).

**Given** AllowBackInStockSubscriptions is on and the product is out of stock, **when** the shopper subscribes to "notify me" and stock returns, **then** the native message template Customer.BackInStock is sent; MaximumBackInStockSubscriptions limits subscriptions per customer.
**Given** an alert is received, **when** the shopper uses its unsubscribe link, **then** the saved search or watch is stopped.

**Given** a shopper searches, **when** the native ProductSearchEvent is published, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500): now native — the search model factory inserts one SearchTerm row per search with the customer, store and time, so no SRC consumer of ProductSearchEvent is built.

**Given** the shopper has recent searches, **when** they focus the search box, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500): now native — with CatalogSettings.ShowSearchTermHistory on, focusing the empty search box lists the customer's own recent terms for the store (up to NumberOfSearchTermHistoryItems) and choosing one runs that search; verified by AC-SRC-012-01-05.

**Given** the shopper chooses "clear history", **when** the request is confirmed, **then** Withdrawn (VER-500): now native — the shopper removes terms one at a time from the history list (CatalogController.DeleteProductSearchTermItems), verified by AC-SRC-012-01-06; a one-step "clear all" for the shopper is not native and is not built (open item); message Src.HistoryCleared is not used.

**Given** the customer record is deleted under the data-protection functions, **when** deletion runs, **then** the SRC erasure provider (BR-SRC-140, IC-IAM-08) hard-deletes every SearchTerm row of the customer, including rows already soft-deleted by the shopper, through IRepository<SearchTerm>.DeleteAsync(predicate); native erasure does not delete search terms.
basis: Proposed; NFR-X-002; FIT (GdprService.PermanentDeleteCustomerAsync has no SearchTerm deletion; EntityRepository.cs:500-505 bulk delete)

criterion: **Given** CatalogSettings.ShowSearchTermHistory is on and NumberOfSearchTermHistoryItems is set (install and 5.00 upgrade default: on, 10), **when** a shopper (registered or guest record) who has searched focuses the empty search box, **then** only that customer's own most recent terms for the current store are listed, at most NumberOfSearchTermHistoryItems, and choosing one runs the search; no term of another customer is listed.

**Given** a term is in the shopper's history list, **when** the shopper deletes it from the list, **then** the term no longer appears in that shopper's history; its rows are soft-deleted (SearchTerm.Deleted) and still counted in the admin popular-search-terms report.
**Given** CompareProductsEnabled is on, **when** the shopper adds products to the comparison list, **then** up to CompareProductsNumber products are kept; adding one more removes the oldest.

**Given** products in the comparison list have specification attributes, **when** the shopper opens the comparison page, **then** name, price and each specification attribute are shown side by side, and the short and full descriptions if IncludeShortDescriptionInCompareProducts / IncludeFullDescriptionInCompareProducts are on.

**Given** the SRC provider plugin is installed and named in CatalogSettings.ActiveSearchProviderSystemName, **when** the shopper searches with keywords, **then** the provider returns an ordered list of product IDs; native code then applies store mapping, ACL, published, deleted and availability-date filters and keeps the provider order when the sort is "position" (BR-SRC-002).

**Given** the bundled Search.Lucene plugin is installed, **when** the administrator looks for a search provider to select, **then** it is not selectable and nothing changes, because it implements IMiscPlugin and not ISearchProvider (PAID-STUB).
**Given** a synonym group "A, B" is saved for language L, **when** the shopper searches A in language L, **then** products matching B are also returned.
**Given** a stemmer exists for language L, **when** the shopper searches the plural of a word in a product name, **then** the product with the singular form is found.
**Given** the allowed typing distance is set, **when** the shopper misspells a word by that many characters, **then** the intended product is found, ranked below exact matches.

**Given** two or more languages are published and the working language is L, **when** the shopper searches, **then** the provider searches the localized values in L, reading the language from IWorkContext because ISearchProvider.SearchProductsAsync receives only the keywords and an isLocalized flag; when nothing matches in L it searches the default language.

**Given** a boosting rule raises category C (or featured products, or products stocked in the shopper's district) by a weight, **when** the shopper searches a term matching products inside and outside C equally, **then** products in C are ranked first.

**Given** the user has Search.Core.Relevance.CreateEditDelete, **when** they create, change, enable or disable a boosting rule or synonym group, **then** the change is saved as a new version and audited with user, time, old and new values (AUD-SRC-001); users with Search.Core.Relevance.View can read the history.
**Given** the provider index is behind the database, **when** an unpublished product is still in the index, **then** it is not shown, because native filters run after the provider.
**Given** an administrator searches products in the admin area, **when** the search runs, **then** the native standard search is used (the provider is not called when showHidden is set).

**Given** an AI recommendation provider (Google AI Commerce Search, SRC-001) and the SRC ISearchProvider are both active for the store, **when** the shopper searches with keywords, **then** the AI provider answers first; the SRC provider, its synonyms and its boosting rules are used only when the AI provider returns nothing or fails and ArtificialIntelligenceSettings.UseStandardSearchWhenNoResults is on; the client configuration names one primary relevance engine per store (BR-SRC-150).

**Given** the SRC provider returns an empty list for the keywords, **when** the search completes, **then** with CatalogSettings.UseStandardSearchWhenNoResults on, the native standard search runs with the keywords (5.00: an empty provider result also falls back, not only an exception).
**Given** ShowBestsellersOnHomepage is on, **when** the home page is opened, **then** up to NumberOfBestsellersOnHomepage best sellers are shown.

**Given** the aggregation task has run, **when** a category page or region page with the trending widget is opened, **then** most viewed and trending products for that category or for the region of the shopper's chosen district are listed.

**Given** the refresh interval is set, **when** the interval passes, **then** the aggregation task recalculates views and sales per product, category and region; trending = growth of views and units sold in the latest window compared with the previous window (Proposed).
**Given** a product in a list is not eligible (BR-SRC-050), **when** the widget is built, **then** it is not shown.

**Given** the user has Search.Core.Taxonomy.Propose, **when** they submit a new-category proposal with name, parent and reason, **then** the proposal is Submitted and no category is visible in the storefront (SM-SRC-02).

**Given** a proposal is Submitted, **when** another user with Search.Core.Taxonomy.Approve approves it, **then** the category is created or changed through ICategoryService and the proposal becomes Approved; the proposer cannot approve their own proposal (message Src.CannotApproveOwn).
**Given** a proposal is Submitted, **when** the approver rejects it with a reason, **then** the proposal becomes Rejected and nothing changes in the category tree.

**Given** a retirement proposal is approved for a category, **when** it is applied, **then** the category is unpublished, no new product can be mapped to it and a list of its products that need another category is produced.

**Given** SRC-016 is active, **when** a user posts the native category Create, Edit, Delete, DeleteSelected or ImportFromXlsx action, **then** an SRC action filter refuses it with message Src.UseTaxonomyWorkflow; only the governance service changes the tree (BR-SRC-060).
**Given** any proposal changes status, **when** it is saved, **then** user, time, old and new values are audited (AUD-SRC-002).

**Given** the user has Search.Core.Badges.CreateEditDelete, **when** they create a badge type with name and icon and assign it to a seller, **then** the badge is shown on the seller page, on product pages of that seller and on product cards through the productbox_addinfo widget zones.
**Given** a badge assignment has an end date, **when** the date passes, **then** the badge is no longer shown.
**Given** a seller is deactivated (Vendor.Active off), **when** any page is shown, **then** none of the seller's badges or featured placements are shown.

**Given** a seller is featured with start and end dates, **when** the home page is opened before, during and after the window, **then** the seller appears in the featured-sellers block only during the window.

**Given** LOG-005 provides a delivery window for the product and the shopper's district (or the store default when none is chosen), **when** a listing page is shown, **then** each card shows the window through a widget in the productbox_addinfo_middle zone.
**Given** the same data exists, **when** the product page is opened, **then** the same window is shown on the product page.
**Given** the product can be picked up at an outlet in the shopper's district (SRC-004), **when** a listing page is shown, **then** the card shows "Pickup available" (locale key Src.PickupAvailable).
**Given** no delivery window can be calculated for a product, **when** its card is shown, **then** no delivery text is shown.

**Given** a listing page with many cards is shown, **when** the cards are built, **then** the windows are read from the LOG-005 precomputed DeliveryWindowCache through IC-LOG-06, not from a shipping-rate call per card.
**Given** a product is unpublished, deleted or outside its availability dates, **when** the shopper searches, **then** it is not in the results.

**Given** a seller is suspended under SEL-003 (Vendor.Active false and a listing pause with reason SellerSuspended through CAT-022, BR-SEL-006), **when** the shopper searches or opens a category, **then** the seller's products are not listed, because the paused listings have Published false and native search excludes unpublished products; SRC adds no vendor-status filter, since SearchProductsAsync has none.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-098 (suspended); FIT (no vendor Active filter in SearchProductsAsync); (BR-SEL-006)

criterion: **Given** SEL-003 reinstates the seller and the SellerSuspended pause reason is cleared, **when** the shopper searches, **then** the listings that return to Published are listed again; SRC changes no product data.
**Given** the rule "hide out-of-stock items in search" is on, **when** a product manages stock, does not allow backorders and has sellable stock 0 or less, **then** it is not in the search results.
**Given** the rule is off, **when** the same product matches a search, **then** it is listed and its page shows the native out-of-stock text.
**Given** a product has LowStockActivity Unpublish, **when** its stock reaches MinStockQuantity, **then** the product is unpublished by native code and disappears from results.
**Given** an administrator searches in the admin area, **when** the search runs, **then** eligibility rules of this feature are not applied.

**Given** a root category for services with sub-categories, a main-menu entry and a topic landing page are configured, **when** the shopper opens the services menu entry, **then** the landing page and the services categories are shown apart from the goods categories.
**Given** services categories use ACL or store mapping, **when** a shopper without access opens the store, **then** the services area is not shown to them.
**Given** a service in the area is opened, **when** the shopper reads it, **then** the service page shows its description; ordering follows the SVC flow (SVC-005).

**Given** the bundled Google Analytics widget is configured with GoogleId and EnableEcommerce is on, **when** a shopper views a product, adds it to the cart and buys, **then** the e-commerce events are sent to the client's analytics property.

**Given** the native search-term statistics run, **when** shoppers search, **then** each search is stored as a SearchTerm row with its store (and, from 5.00, the customer, which SRC-012 uses as history) and the admin popular-search-terms report lists the terms by number of searches.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-091 (search analytics); FIT (SearchTerm; SearchTermService.GetStatsAsync; Admin CommonController.PopularSearchTermsReport, CommonController.cs:489)

criterion: **Given** the Facebook Pixel widget is configured, **when** pages are viewed, **then** the pixel events are sent.
**Given** the cookie consent required by the data-protection profile is not given, **when** a page is shown, **then** analytics scripts are not loaded.

**Given** the shopper uses only the keyboard, **when** they move to the search box, type, move through suggestions with the arrow keys and press Enter, **then** the chosen suggestion or the results page opens; focus is always visible.
**Given** the shopper uses only the keyboard, **when** they use the filters and the main and footer menus, **then** every filter and menu item can be reached, opened and applied with the keyboard.
**Given** a screen reader is used, **when** the search box, suggestions list, filters and menus are read, **then** each has a label from a locale resource and the number of suggestions is announced.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-092 (screen-reader labels); FIT (search box has aria-label only)

criterion: **Given** the accessibility audit (PLT-018) runs on search and navigation, **when** it completes, **then** no WCAG 2.1 AA failure remains on these pages.

**Given** a search or suggestion request takes longer than the configured timeout, **when** the timeout passes, **then** message Src.SearchSlow is shown with a retry button and the typed text is kept.

**Given** the browser reports that it is offline, **when** the shopper submits a search, **then** message Src.Offline is shown and the search is sent once automatically when the browser reports it is online again.
**Given** retries keep failing, **when** the configured number of retries is reached, **then** no more automatic retries are made and the retry button stays.
**Given** suggestions fail to load, **when** the shopper presses Enter, **then** the normal search page request is still sent.

**Given** a channel system is registered as an API client in INT-001 and holds a token (OAuth 2.0, decision API-GW) with scope search.read (BR-INT-006), **when** it calls the search endpoint with keywords, page, page size and language, **then** it receives product ID, name, price, availability text and product URL, built with the same SearchProductsAsync, provider and eligibility rules as the storefront.
**Given** the token is missing, expired or revoked, or lacks scope search.read, **when** the endpoint is called, **then** it answers 401 (or 403 outside the scope or store) and no data (BR-INT-002).
**Given** a client exceeds its INT-001 per-client rate limit, **when** it calls again, **then** it answers 429 (BR-INT-004).
**Given** the compact format is requested, **when** results are returned, **then** each result has only ID, a shortened name and price, for SMS or USSD screens.

**Given** a signed-in buyer searches a term, **when** the unified results page is shown, **then** results are grouped into products, own orders (order number or custom order number), own RFQ requests and quotes (Misc.RFQ) and own account records, each group with a link to its page.
**Given** a guest searches, **when** the page is shown, **then** only products are returned.
**Given** a term matches another customer's order number, **when** a buyer searches it, **then** the order is not returned.
**Given** no provider is selected, **when** a product is published or its price changes, **then** the next search shows the change, because native search queries the database.

**Given** the SRC provider is selected, **when** a product is created, changed or deleted, **then** an entity-event consumer queues the product for re-indexing and the index task applies it within the configured interval; until then native filters still hide unpublished or deleted products.

**Given** the SRC provider is selected and CAT raises Listing.StateChanged for a product, **when** the SRC consumer receives the event, **then** it only queues the product for re-indexing; the index task keeps the product in the index only while its listing state is Published (BR-CAT-005); native filters after the provider still hide any product that is no longer published.
**Given** a response-time target is approved, **when** the load test runs, **then** the 95th percentile of search response time is reported against the target.
**Given** EmailAFriendEnabled is on, **when** the shopper sends a product to a friend, **then** the native message template Service.EmailAFriend is sent.
**Given** EstimateShippingProductPageEnabled is on, **when** the shopper enters a destination on the product page, **then** the shipping options and costs are estimated.
**Given** the quick-view plugin is installed, **when** the shopper uses quick view on a card, **then** a preview of the product opens without leaving the list.
basis: D; FIT (licensed plugin; 5.00 build to confirm, VER-500)

criterion: **Given** the buy-now function is installed, **when** the shopper presses "buy now", **then** the product is added to the cart and checkout opens.
basis: D; FIT (licensed plugin; 5.00 build to confirm, VER-500)

criterion: **Given** previous / next links are installed, **when** the shopper opens a product in a category, **then** links to the previous and next product of that category are shown.
basis: D; FIT (licensed plugin; 5.00 build to confirm, VER-500)

criterion: **Given** a service product has a price and no pricing model other than Fixed, **when** the shopper adds it to the cart, **then** the native price applies and the item is ordered at that price.

**Given** a service uses the Per time unit model with unit Hour, Day or Week and a unit price, **when** the shopper books it through CAT-027 for a slot of a given length, **then** the quantity is set to the number of units covered by the slot (whole units, rounding up — Proposed) and the line total is unit price × quantity.
basis: D; FC-M01-029; Proposed (unit model instead of RentalPricePeriod, which has no Hour)

criterion: **Given** a service uses the Per unit model with unit label "hectare", **when** the shopper opens the product page, **then** the price is shown with the localised unit label (for example "per hectare") and the quantity box is labelled with the unit.
**Given** a Per unit service has a minimum and maximum number of units, **when** the shopper enters a quantity outside them, **then** the native quantity warning is shown and the item is not added.

**Given** a service has required attributes whose values change the price and CatalogSettings.DisplayFromPrices is on, **when** the service is listed, **then** the native from-price (lowest possible price) is shown with the From label.

**Given** a service is marked Price on request in SVC (CallForPrice and DisableBuyButton stay off), **when** the shopper opens the product page, **then** no price is shown and the buy button is replaced by Request a quote, which calls IC-ORD-08 (ORD-012) to create a quote request for that service without using the cart.
basis: D; Proposed (SVC flag); FIT (CallForPrice / DisableBuyButton items fail PlaceOrderAsync cart warnings)

criterion: **Given** a service is Price on request, **when** anyone posts AddProductToCart_Catalog or AddProductToCart_Details for it directly, **then** the SVC action filter refuses it with message Svc.QuoteRequired; only lines created from an accepted quote (Misc.RFQ) enter the cart.
basis: Proposed; FIT (5.00.1: Presentation/Nop.Web/Controllers/ShoppingCartController.cs:791, AddProductToCart_Details(productId, shoppingCartTypeId, form, customwishlistid) — the filter reads the product id only)

criterion: **Given** a quote for the service is accepted, **when** the cart is created from the quote, **then** the quoted unit price applies through the Misc.RFQ GetShoppingCartItemUnitPriceEvent handler and the order is placed at that price.

**Given** a vendor in the service-provider category (SEL-010), **when** creates a resource of type Staff, Team, Equipment or Vehicle with a name, linked services and capacity per slot, **then** the resource is saved for that vendor only and appears in the vendor resource list.
**Given** a vendor not in the service-provider category, **when** opens the resources page, **then** access is refused with message Svc.NotServiceProvider.

**Given** a service requires qualification Q, **when** a resource without a valid Q (missing or expired) is checked for a slot, **then** the resource is not counted as available for that service (BR-SVC-010).

**Given** a qualification expires, **when** the daily SVC task runs, **then** the resource is marked not qualified for the services needing it, future bookings assigned to it are listed for the provider to reassign, and the provider is notified.

**Given** working hours and a closure date are set for a resource, **when** availability is calculated for that date, **then** no slot outside working hours or on the closure date is offered for that resource.
**Given** a resource covers a set of areas (LOG-004 areas), **when** availability is requested for a location outside them, **then** the resource is not counted as available (see SVC-006).

**Given** CAT-027 asks which resources may serve a service for a period and location (IC-SVC-01 GetEligibleResources), **when** the SVC availability service answers, **then** only resources that meet BR-SVC-010 are returned, and CAT-027 shows only BookingSlots of those resources; each slot capacity is generated from the resource CapacityPerSlot and working hours (IC-SVC-01 GenerateSlots, written through IC-CAT-07 WriteSlots).

**Given** a resource working hours, closures or capacity change, **when** the change is saved, **then** IC-SVC-01 GenerateSlots updates the future BookingSlots of that resource; a slot with confirmed bookings above the new capacity is not reduced below them and is listed for the provider to rebook (message Svc.CapacityConflict).

**Given** a service policy is saved with a free-change period, a fee type (fixed or percentage) and value, and a maximum number of reschedules, **when** it is saved, **then** the policy is versioned with an effective date; bookings keep the version in force when they were made (BR-SVC-020); audited (AUD-SVC-003).

**Given** a booking is Confirmed and the start is further away than the free-change period and the reschedule count is below the maximum, **when** the shopper picks another free slot, **then** SVC calls IC-CAT-07 Move; CAT moves the booking to the new slot under both slot locks and frees the old place (BR-CAT-021); the reschedule count increases and a confirmation is sent through TRK-005; if the new slot is full the move is refused with message Cat.SlotFull and nothing changes.
**Given** the free-change period has passed or the maximum is reached, **when** the shopper tries to reschedule, **then** rescheduling is refused with message Svc.RescheduleNotAllowed.

**Given** a paid booking is cancelled by the shopper inside the free-change period, **when** the shopper confirms, **then** SVC records outcome CancelledByCustomer through IC-CAT-07 RecordOutcome, which releases the place (SM-CAT-05 Released), and a full refund of the amount paid for the booking is requested through a RET-005 refund trigger (source BookingCancellation).

**Given** a paid booking is cancelled by the shopper after the free-change period, **when** the shopper opens the cancel step, **then** the fee and the refund amount (paid minus fee, never below zero) are shown with message Svc.CancellationFee before confirmation; on confirmation a RET-005 refund trigger (source BookingCancellation) requests that amount.

**Given** an order holding a booking is cancelled through the native storefront OrderController.CancelOrder action, **when** the request is posted, **then** the SVC action filter applies the booking cancellation rules first; for an unpaid order the native cancellation then runs; for a paid order the native cancel is not run and the SVC cancellation applies (the native action does not check payment status).

**Given** a booking is Confirmed and its start plus the grace period has passed, **when** the provider records Customer no-show, **then** SVC records outcome NoShowCustomer through IC-CAT-07 RecordOutcome (SM-CAT-05 Completed); no refund is raised unless the policy says so; any deposit follows SVC-004; audited (AUD-SVC-002).

**Given** a booking is Confirmed, **when** operations staff confirm a provider no-show reported by the shopper or provider, **then** SVC records outcome NoShowProvider through IC-CAT-07 RecordOutcome, a full refund is requested through a RET-005 refund trigger (source ProviderNoShow), and the shopper is offered free slots to rebook without a fee.

**Given** the provider cancels a booking, **when** the cancellation is saved with a reason, **then** SVC records outcome CancelledByProvider through IC-CAT-07 RecordOutcome (place released) and a full refund is requested through a RET-005 refund trigger (source BookingCancellation); the shopper is notified.

**Given** a payment plan Deposit is set for a service with a fixed or percentage deposit and a balance due point (before the start or at completion), **when** it is saved, **then** the plan is versioned and a booking keeps the version in force when made (BR-SVC-020).

**Given** a service has plan Deposit and the shopper books it, **when** the cart line is priced, **then** the line unit price is the deposit amount, set by the SVC handler of GetShoppingCartItemUnitPriceEvent (Misc.RFQ pattern) as the plan share of the full unit price returned by the IShoppingCartService.GetUnitPriceAsync product overload, which runs IPriceCalculationService (single owner CAT-042 under OVR-REG) and so keeps the CAT price precedence (BR-CAT-020); the order (order 1) is placed and paid in full natively for that amount; a BookingPaymentPlan records order 1 as the deposit (SM-SVC-03).
basis: D; FIT (GetShoppingCartItemUnitPriceEvent; PaymentStatus has no partly-paid state)

criterion: **Given** the confirm step is posted (CheckoutController.ConfirmOrder or OpcConfirmOrder) for a cart holding a booking line, **when** the SVC action filter compares the line unit price with the amount due under the plan, **then** if they differ (for example because the price handler failed, as event consumer exceptions are swallowed) the order is not placed and message Svc.PriceCheckFailed is shown (BR-SVC-031).

**Given** a service has plan No payment upfront, **when** the shopper books it, **then** the booking line is priced zero, the native zero-total order is placed with PaymentStatus Paid and no payment step, and the whole price becomes the balance.
basis: D; FIT (OrderProcessingService: no payment workflow when the total is zero)

criterion: **Given** a balance is due, **when** the shopper selects Pay balance in My account, **then** a cart with one line for the service is created with the balance as unit price (same handler), the shopper pays it as order 2, and the plan records order 2 as the balance; the booking becomes fully paid when order 2 is Paid.

**Given** a shopper pays the balance at an outlet, **when** outlet staff create the balance order for the booking through assisted checkout (CHK-013) and record payment (PAY-034), **then** the plan records that order as the balance.

**Given** the balance due point passes and the balance is unpaid, **when** the daily SVC task runs, **then** the plan becomes BalanceOverdue and the action in the plan is applied: remind the shopper, or cancel the booking with the deposit treated under the cancellation policy (action is a setting, default not stated).

**Given** a booking with a paid deposit is cancelled, **when** the cancellation policy (SVC-003) gives the refundable share, **then** a refund of that share of order 1 is requested through a RET-005 refund trigger (source DepositRefund) and the rest is kept; the plan becomes DepositRefunded or DepositForfeited (partly refunded deposits are DepositRefunded with the amount recorded).

**Given** an order line is for a service product, **when** the order is placed, **then** a ServiceOrderStage record starts at the first stage of the line stage set returned by IC-ORD-10 GetLineStageSet (ORD-002; default SM-SVC-01, Requested); the native OrderStatus is not changed by SVC.

**Given** a line is Requested, **when** the provider confirms and, where the service is booked, the CAT-027 booking exists, **then** the stage becomes Confirmed and then Scheduled with the booking date; each change records who and when and is shown to the shopper.

**Given** a stage change is not in the configured transitions, **when** anyone posts it, **then** SVC asks IC-ORD-10 ValidateLineTransition before the change; on refusal the change is refused with message Svc.StageNotAllowed and nothing is saved (BR-ORD-014).

**Given** a line is In progress, **when** the provider marks it Completed with a completion note and optional evidence files, **then** the stage becomes Completed and the shopper is asked to confirm with message Svc.ConfirmService through TRK-005.

**Given** a line is Completed, **when** the shopper confirms delivery, **then** the stage becomes Accepted, SVC records booking outcome Attended through IC-CAT-07 RecordOutcome, and the line is marked eligible for the provider settlement (SEL-017) (BR-SVC-041).

**Given** a line is Completed, **when** the sign-off window passes without an answer, **then** the stage becomes Accepted automatically and the history records the auto-acceptance (window is a setting, default not stated).

**Given** a line is Completed, **when** the shopper reports Not delivered with a reason, **then** the stage becomes NotDelivered, payout eligibility is withheld, and operations staff are notified to review.

**Given** a line is NotDelivered, **when** operations staff decide Failed, **then** the stage becomes Failed and SVC raises the module event Service.Failed (order, line, reason); RET-005 enqueues the refund trigger (source ServiceFailure) under the client refund policy; SVC never calls PAY-016 directly (BR-SVC-021).
**Given** a line is NotDelivered, **when** operations staff decide Rework, **then** the stage returns to Scheduled and the booking is moved to a new slot through IC-CAT-07 Move.

**Given** a service order is paid and has no shippable item, **when** native order processing runs, **then** the native OrderStatus becomes Complete at payment (CheckAndSaveOrderStatusAsync) while the service stage stays Requested; reports and payout use the service stage, not the native status (BR-SVC-040).

**Given** a service product is set NotReturnable, **when** the shopper opens the order, **then** no native return request is offered for the service line; service failure follows the NotDelivered path.

**Given** an order holds Malawi Post service lines, **when** the shopper opens the order in My account, **then** each service line shows its current stage, the next step and the date of each stage change.

**Given** the TRK-005 engine asks the SVC order-kind provider (IC-TRK-05) about an order before sending OrderCompleted.CustomerNotification, **when** the order lines are all service lines, or the order holds any other line, **then** the provider returns order kind Service in the first case and none in the second; it sends no message itself, and TRK-005 applies the action configured for the kind (BR-TRK-024).

**Given** a service allows the location types At site, At outlet and Remote, **when** the shopper books it, **then** the booking step asks for one allowed type; At site asks for an address, At outlet lists the allowed pickup points (StorePickupPoint), Remote asks for the contact channel.

**Given** the cart holds only services (no shippable item), **when** the shopper checks out, **then** the native shipping step is skipped, so the location is captured in the SVC booking step and stored on the booking, not on the order shipping address.
basis: FIT (CheckoutController skips shipping when ShoppingCartRequiresShippingAsync is false)

criterion: **Given** At site is chosen, **when** the shopper places a pin, **then** the latitude and longitude are stored on the BookingLocation (the native Address has no coordinates) and shown to the provider with the address.

**Given** the chosen site or outlet is outside the coverage of every available resource (SVC-002) or not serviceable under LOG-004, **when** the shopper confirms the location, **then** the booking cannot continue and message Svc.LocationNotCovered is shown.
**Given** the location is covered, **when** availability is shown, **then** only slots of resources covering that location are offered (IC-SVC-01).

**Given** a product is downloadable with activation When order is paid, **when** the order becomes Paid, **then** the download is allowed and the link appears in the order details and in order emails (native IsDownloadAllowedAsync, MessageTokenProvider).
**Given** a product is downloadable with activation Manually, **when** an administrator activates the item on the order, **then** the download becomes allowed for that order line only.

**Given** Unlimited downloads is off and a maximum is set, **when** the shopper reaches the maximum, **then** further downloads are refused with the native message DownloadableProducts.ReachedMaximumNumber.
**Given** DownloadExpirationDays is set, **when** that many days have passed since the paid date (When order is paid) or since the order date (Manually), **then** the download is refused.
**Given** the product has a user agreement, **when** the shopper starts the download, **then** the agreement must be accepted before the file is served.
**Given** CustomerSettings.DownloadableProductsValidateUser is on, **when** another customer opens the download link, **then** the download is refused.
**Given** an administrator uploads a licence file for an order line, **when** the shopper opens the order, **then** the licence download is available for that line only, under the same rules.
**Given** downloads exist and HideDownloadableProductsTab is off, **when** the shopper opens My account, Downloadable products, **then** each allowed download is listed with its link.

**Given** a product is a rental product priced per day or week with a rental price length, **when** the shopper enters start and end dates, **then** the price is the native price × the number of rental periods (IProductService.GetRentalPeriods) and the dates are stored on the order line.
**Given** the end date is before the start date, or the start date is before today, **when** the shopper adds the item, **then** the native rental warning is shown and the item is not added.

**Given** a provider sets the number of hire units for a rental product (or links equipment resources from SVC-002), **when** it is saved, **then** availability for any date is that number minus units on overlapping non-cancelled order lines and active holds.

**Given** all units are taken for any day of the requested period, **when** the shopper adds the item or places the order, **then** the SVC rental-availability cart check provider (IC-CHK-01, which passes the candidate item with its rental start and end dates), called from GetShoppingCartItemWarningsAsync and GetRentalProductWarningsAsync by the single IShoppingCartService override owned by CHK-003 (BR-CHK-015), adds message Svc.RentalUnavailable and the item is not added; placement fails because PlaceOrderAsync re-runs GetShoppingCartItemWarningsAsync for each cart item.
basis: D; OVR-REG; FIT (ShoppingCartService.GetShoppingCartItemWarningsAsync calls GetRentalProductWarningsAsync, public virtual; OrderProcessingService re-runs item warnings at placement)

criterion: **Given** a unit is free for the period, **when** the item passes the check at the confirm step, **then** a RentalHold is created under ILocker key 'svc-rental-{ProductId}' and counted for other customers until the order is placed or the hold expires (hold time is a setting, default not stated).

**Given** a service product issues vouchers with a validity period and a number of uses, **when** an order line becomes Paid (OrderPaidEvent), **then** the consumer only enqueues an issue job; the task creates one voucher per unit with a unique, non-guessable code and QR payload (BR-SVC-070), status Issued, and sends it through TRK-005; issuing is idempotent per order line.
**Given** vouchers were issued, **when** the shopper opens My account, **then** each voucher is shown with code, QR, service, validity and status.

**Given** an Issued voucher for a service of the redeeming vendor is presented within its validity, **when** the user with Services.Vouchers.Redeem validates and redeems it, **then** its uses decrease by one; at zero it becomes Redeemed; the time, user and place are recorded; audited (AUD-SVC-004).

**Given** a voucher is Redeemed, Expired, Cancelled or for another vendor service, **when** it is validated, **then** redemption is refused with message Svc.VoucherInvalid stating only that it is not valid.
**Given** the same voucher is scanned at two places at once, **when** both redemptions run, **then** under ILocker key 'svc-voucher-{Code}' only one succeeds.
**Given** an unredeemed voucher line is refunded (PAY-016), **when** the refund completes, **then** the voucher becomes Cancelled.
**Given** the validity end passes, **when** the daily SVC task runs, **then** unredeemed vouchers become Expired.
**Given** a ticketing partner service is listed under FIN-005 with voucher issue enabled, **when** the customer pays, **then** an e-ticket is issued as in story 01.

**Given** reminder lead times are set for a service (for example a list of hours before the start; values not stated), **when** the SVC scheduled task runs and a Confirmed booking reaches a lead time, **then** one reminder per lead time is sent through TRK-005 on the channels the customer allows (TRK-006); it is not sent twice.
basis: D; FIT (MessageTemplate.DelayBeforeSend counts from queueing, not from the booking start, so a scheduled task is needed)

criterion: **Given** a booking is cancelled or rescheduled, **when** the task runs, **then** no reminder is sent for the cancelled slot; reminders follow the new slot.

**Given** a service line becomes Accepted (SVC-005), **when** the follow-up delay passes, **then** a feedback request is sent with a link to the product review form (CAT-029); only one request per order line.
**Given** the customer has opted out of feedback messages (TRK-006), **when** the follow-up is due, **then** no request is sent.

**Given** the feature state productfeature.<prd-id> of PRD-SVC-010 is off for store S (IC-PLT-02), **when** the SVC reminder task runs, **then** no reminder or feedback request is sent for bookings or order lines of S (BR-SVC-100).

**Given** a target set is saved for a service (and optionally for a service level chosen as an attribute) with a response target, a completion target and the start point of each clock (order placed or scheduled start), **when** it is saved, **then** it is versioned with an effective date; orders keep the version in force when placed; audited (AUD-SVC-003).

**Given** a service order line starts its SLA clocks, **when** the targets apply, **then** the response due time (until Confirmed) and completion due time (until Completed) are computed and stored on the SlaClock (SM-SVC-05).
**Given** the at-risk threshold of a clock is reached before the stage is reached, **when** the SVC task runs, **then** the clock becomes AtRisk and the first escalation level is notified.

**Given** a due time passes before the stage is reached, **when** the SVC task runs, **then** the clock becomes Breached, each escalation level is notified in turn at its configured interval, and the breach is recorded for reports (SVC-012).
**Given** the stage is reached before the due time, **when** the stage change is saved, **then** the clock becomes Met and no escalation is sent.
**Given** targets exist for the service, **when** the shopper views the service and the order, **then** the response and completion targets are shown.

**Given** a service level (for example express or standard) is chosen by the shopper as an attribute of the service, **when** the order is placed, **then** the targets of that service level apply to the line.

**Given** bookings exist, **when** the bookings report runs for a period, **then** counts by service, provider and status (Confirmed, Attended, CancelledByCustomer, CancelledByProvider, NoShowCustomer, NoShowProvider) are shown and exportable.

**Given** resources with capacity exist, **when** the utilisation report runs, **then** for each resource and period, booked units ÷ available units (from working hours and capacity, SVC-002) is shown.
**Given** service orders exist, **when** the completion report runs, **then** counts of Accepted, NotDelivered, Failed and cancelled service lines by service and provider are shown.
**Given** SLA clocks exist, **when** the SLA report runs, **then** per service and target: Met, Breached, share met, and average time to response and completion.
**Given** a vendor user runs any service report, **when** the report is shown, **then** only the vendor own services and resources are included.

**Given** a shipment has events in TRK-002, **when** anyone enters its tracking number (Shipment.TrackingNumber or another ShipmentReference such as S10 or waybill) on the public tracking page, **then** the timeline lists each event with common event name, local date and time and location where the source gave one, newest first, plus the expected delivery range (LOG-005).
**Given** the number matches no shipment, **when** it is submitted, **then** message Trk.TrackNotFound is shown and nothing else is revealed.

**Given** the public page is used, **when** the timeline is shown, **then** it shows no customer name, address, phone or email; delivery-agent contact is shown only if the source supplied it and the client enabled it (BR-TRK-030).

**Given** the configured number of lookups from one client address is exceeded in the period (setting, default not stated), **when** another lookup is made, **then** a CAPTCHA (SEC-013) is required before the result is shown.

**Given** a signed-in shopper opens an own order, **when** the order page loads, **then** each shipment shows its timeline from TRK-002 (native ShipmentDetails through the hub tracker when ShippingSettings.DisplayShipmentEventsToCustomers is on); the order ID path to tracking is available to the order owner only.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-201; REQ-MPC-FR-208; FIT (OrderController.ShipmentDetails requires the order customer)
