criterion: **Given** a signed-in shopper has orders, **when** they open My account orders, **then** each order shows its latest tracking event and expected delivery range.

**Given** a shipment is shown to its owner or on a tracking page, **when** the shopper creates a share link, **then** a signed link with an expiry (setting, default not stated) is created; opening it shows the public timeline only, never account details (SM-TRK-06).
**Given** a share link exists, **when** the owner revokes it or it expires, **then** opening it shows message Trk.ShareLinkExpired; creation and revocation are audited (AUD-TRK-007).

**Given** the tracking page is open, **when** the configured refresh interval passes (setting, default not stated), **then** the timeline reloads from TRK-002 without a full page reload and the time is shown with message Trk.LastUpdated.

**Given** the tracking page is open, **when** the user presses refresh (message Trk.Refresh), **then** the timeline reloads at once; if the carrier supports on-demand Track (IC-LOG-01), a pull is requested no more often than the per-shipment minimum interval (setting).
**Given** the shipment has no events yet, **when** the timeline is shown, **then** message Trk.NoEventsYet is shown with the shipment creation date.

**Given** a source (scanner app, carrier adapter, postal interface, PostGlobal via INT-007, manual entry) is registered with credentials, **when** it posts a batch of events (IC-TRK-01), **then** each event is authenticated, stored as Received with source, source code, reference, event time, location, staff and device identifiers, then processed (SM-TRK-01).

**Given** an event's reference matches a shipment and its source code has a mapping, **when** it is processed, **then** it becomes Applied with its common event code and appears in the shipment timeline.

**Given** a shipping system registered as an API client with scope shipments.write (INT-001), or PostGlobal through INT-007, is a tracking source, **when** it sends an event, **then** the event enters through IC-TRK-01 and is mapped by that source's rows in the TRK-002 SourceCodeMapping (for PostGlobal the rows of the PostGlobal source; INT keeps no status map, BR-INT-030); only TRK-002 calls ShipAsync or DeliverAsync for it (BR-TRK-012); the API and INT-007 never change shipment state.

**Given** an event's reference is a return tracking reference registered by RET-003 through IC-TRK-01 RegisterExternalReference (carrier or RET-generated reference), **when** it is processed, **then** it becomes Applied against that return reference, appears in the return timeline, changes no native shipment state, sends no TRK-012 message and is published as Tracking.EventApplied with the ReturnShipment id, which the RET consumer only enqueues.

**Given** the same event is received twice (same source event id, or same shipment, code, time and location), **when** the second is processed, **then** it becomes Duplicate and nothing else changes (BR-TRK-011).

**Given** an Applied event has a common code flagged "shipped" and the order is not a pickup order and ShippedDateUtc is not set, **when** it is applied, **then** IOrderProcessingService.ShipAsync is called once under ILocker key 'shipment-{ShipmentId}' (BR-TRK-012, BR-LOG-001).

**Given** an Applied event is READY_FOR_PICKUP on a pickup order, or DELIVERED / COLLECTED, **when** it is applied, **then** ReadyForPickupAsync, or DeliverAsync after the proof check of BR-LOG-080, is called once; a carrier DELIVERED event counts as proof method "courier confirmation" only where the service level accepts it.
**Given** events arrive out of order, **when** they are applied, **then** the timeline is ordered by event time; native shipment state never moves backwards.

**Given** the event dictionary holds the common codes (BR-TRK-010) and each source has a mapping table from its codes to them, **when** an administrator edits a mapping, **then** it is saved, audited (AUD-TRK-002) and used for events received after the change.

**Given** an event arrives with a source code that has no mapping or a reference that matches no shipment, **when** it is processed, **then** it becomes Rejected with the reason, appears in the rejected-events queue and triggers no customer notification (BR-INT-030); after the mapping is added or the shipment linked, staff reprocess it and it becomes Applied (AUD-TRK-001).

**Given** an expected-scan rule says that after event X on route or service level R, event Y must follow within a time limit (setting, default not stated), **when** the limit passes without Y, **then** a scan alert opens (SM-TRK-02) in the operations queue with shipment, last event and expected event.
**Given** a scan alert is Open, **when** event Y arrives or staff resolve it with a note, **then** the alert becomes Resolved; a staff resolution is audited (AUD-TRK-008).
**Given** a scan alert stays Open beyond the long-stuck limit (setting), **when** the alert task runs, **then** the alert becomes Escalated and a LOG-013 incident of type delayed is opened.

**Given** a retention rule for tracking events exists in PLT-020 (active period, archive period), **when** the retention task runs, **then** Applied events older than the active period are moved to the archive store and remain searchable by staff; events older than the archive period are deleted; each run is logged.

**Given** a user with Tracking.Core.Events.View searches by order number, tracking reference, S10 or customer phone, **when** the search runs, **then** matching shipments are listed and each opens its full timeline, scan alerts and notification log (TRK-007).

**Given** the external app sends scans of type pickup, hub arrival or departure, or delivery through IC-TRK-01, **when** the batch is received, **then** each scan becomes a TRK-002 event of the matching common code and appears in the timeline.

**Given** a device is registered by a user with Tracking.Core.Devices.CreateEditDelete and linked to a staff identifier, **when** the device submits scans, **then** every event stores the staff identifier and device identifier; a scan from an unregistered or revoked device is rejected and audited (AUD-TRK-003).

**Given** scans were captured offline, **when** the device syncs, **then** events keep their capture time from the device, the receipt time is recorded, and events older than the configured sync window are accepted but flagged late (setting, default not stated).
**Given** the scan carries coordinates, **when** it is stored, **then** the coordinates are kept with the event; location is captured with the consent recorded by the app.

**Given** the scan carries photo, voice or video files, **when** it is stored, **then** each file is checked through IC-ADM-08 CheckUpload for the TRK upload context "tracking scan media" (registered by TRK at installation through IC-ADM-08 RegisterUploadContext) before it is stored as a Download linked to the event; a refused file is not stored and the event keeps the ADM message key as refusal reason; on admin DownloadFile the SEC-002 filter asks the TRK download-access provider (IC-SEC-05), which claims the file and allows it only to holders of Tracking.Core.Events.View.
basis: FC-M04-028; SINGLE-FILTER; FIT (DownloadService.InsertDownloadAsync takes bytes and is not covered by the ADM-008 IFormFile backstop)

criterion: **Given** the app requests the work list of the signed-in staff member, **when** the request is authorised, **then** it receives that member's route list (LOG-024) or pickup list (LOG-011).

**Given** a native message template (for example OrderPlaced.CustomerNotification, ShipmentSent.CustomerNotification) is active for the store, **when** its trigger occurs, **then** the email is rendered with tokens (for example %Order.OrderNumber%, %Customer.FullName%) in the customer's language through LocalizedProperty and queued (QueuedEmail) through the TRK-005 engine.
**Given** a template is limited to store A (LimitedToStores) and a store-B copy exists, **when** an order of store B triggers it, **then** the store-B copy is used.

**Given** TRK adds tokens (for example outlet opening hours, pickup code, expected delivery range), **when** an administrator edits a template, **then** the new tokens are listed in the allowed-token list and are filled at send time by the TRK-005 engine.
basis: FC-M02-040; FIT (AdditionalTokensAddedEvent for the list); Proposed

criterion: **Given** a bounce feed is configured (IC-TRK-03), **when** a hard bounce is reported for an address, **then** the customer with that email is flagged with the bounce date (SM-TRK-07), the flag shows on the admin customer page with message Trk.EmailBounced, and the email channel is skipped for that customer so the engine uses the fallback channel.
**Given** a customer is flagged bounced, **when** they change or revalidate their email, **then** the flag is cleared and email resumes; both changes are audited (AUD-TRK-009).

**Given** a user with ContentManagement.MessageTemplatesCreateEditDelete edits subject, body, active flag, delay or attachment of a template, **when** it is saved, **then** the next message uses the new content; the change is audited through the platform audit trail (AUD-TRK-002).

**Given** the TRK plugin overrides IWorkflowMessageService (WorkflowMessageService.SendNotificationAsync; INopStartup Order ≥ 3000), **when** any native or product message is sent, **then** it passes through the engine, which resolves the notification definition for the template name or product event code and sends on each channel the definition lists (BR-TRK-020).
basis: D; FIT (5.00.1: WorkflowMessageService.SendNotificationAsync is public virtual, signature unchanged, Libraries/Nop.Services/Messages/WorkflowMessageService.cs:2847-2853; Misc.Brevo BrevoMessageService uses the same override, Plugins/Nop.Plugin.Misc.Brevo/Infrastructure/NopStartup.cs:44)

criterion: **Given** a definition lists SMS and email for an event and both channels are enabled, **when** the event occurs, **then** one email (native QueuedEmail) and one SMS (through the CHN-005 adapter) are sent from the channel variants of the same definition, with the same tokens.
**Given** in-app is enabled for the client and the definition lists it, **when** the event occurs, **then** an in-app notification is created for the customer (TRK-008).
**Given** a channel is disabled for the client, **when** an event listing it occurs, **then** that channel is skipped and the skip is logged (TRK-007).

**Given** the recipient must be found for SMS, WhatsApp, push or in-app, **when** the engine resolves it, **then** it uses the Order.OrderId token, else the Shipment.ShipmentNumber token (shipment id), else the Customer.Email token, to load the customer; the phone is Customer.Phone, else the billing address phone (Proposed).

**Given** the customer's language is L (a language published in the store) and the SMS variant has a translation in L, **when** the message is sent, **then** the L text is used (the native languageId passed by WorkflowMessageService).

**Given** a channel variant has no translation for the customer's language, **when** the message is sent, **then** the client default-language text is used and the gap is logged (Proposed; differs from FC-M17-008, see §5.2).

**Given** a definition sets SMS first and email as fallback, **when** the SMS provider reports failure, or the customer has no phone, **then** the email is sent and both attempts are logged with their outcome (SM-TRK-03).
**Given** an order is placed, **when** OrderPlaced.CustomerNotification is triggered by native placement, **then** the confirmation with the order number is sent on the channels of its definition.

**Given** an order changes status (native OrderProcessing, OrderCompleted, OrderCancelled templates; shipment templates; ORD-002 product statuses through the engine API IC-TRK-04), **when** the change is saved, **then** the status message for that status is sent on the channels of its definition.

**Given** a user with Tracking.Core.NotificationSettings.CreateEditDelete edits a definition (channels, order, fallback, category, mandatory, urgent) or the channel content of an event, **when** it is saved, **then** the next message uses it and the change is audited (AUD-TRK-002).
**Given** Misc.Brevo is installed, **when** TRK is installed, **then** installation is refused with a message that Misc.Brevo also overrides IWorkflowMessageService (BR-TRK-021).

**Given** a module registers a product event code with its default definition (IC-TRK-04 RegisterEventCode) at plugin installation, **when** an administrator opens notification definitions, **then** the code is listed with its owning module and default channels and can be configured like a native template; codes in the BR-TRK-023 catalogue are registered by their owners.
basis: Proposed ( ADM, CHK, CRM, ORD, SEL, SVC, SEC, EGV)

criterion: **Given** a channel adapter (SMS IC-CHN-01, messaging IC-CHN-04, push IC-CHN-05, voice IC-CHN-03) returns Refused for a message, **when** the result is received, **then** the log row becomes Refused with the provider reason and the next channel of the definition is tried, as for Failed (SM-TRK-03).

**Given** a native message that nopCommerce sends only by email (order placed, paid, shipped, password recovery, GDPR) is triggered for a customer whose account has a mobile number and no email (IAM-002), **when** the engine receives it with no recipient email address, **then** no QueuedEmail with an empty address is created; the SMS variant of the definition is sent to the account phone; if the definition has no SMS variant the message is logged Failed with reason no address (BR-TRK-025).
basis: Proposed; see IAM-002 (REQ-MPC-FR-001); FIT (WorkflowMessageService.SendNotificationAsync queues the email without checking the address)

criterion: **Given** an order whose lines are all e-Government services (EGV) or service products (SVC) is set to Complete at payment by native CheckAndSaveOrderStatusAsync, **when** OrderCompleted.CustomerNotification is triggered, **then** the engine asks the registered order-kind providers (IC-TRK-05); for a matching order kind it applies the configured action — send the native template, suppress it, or send the substitute definition of that order kind (BR-TRK-024); the store-owner notification is unchanged.
basis: Proposed; FIT (OrderProcessingService.SetOrderStatusAsync sends OrderCompleted.CustomerNotification when status becomes Complete)

criterion: **Given** nopCommerce 5.00 sends one of its new templates (Reminders.AbandonedCartFollowUp1 to 3, Reminders.PendingOrderFollowUp1 and 2, Reminders.RegistrationFollowUp, NextRecurringPaymentNotification.CustomerNotification, ReturnRequest.WithdrawalLinkMessage), **when** the template is triggered by its native task or action, **then** it reaches the engine through SendNotificationAsync; TRK installs an e-mail-only default definition for each, so it is sent as natively until the client adds channels, and the ignoreDelayBeforeSend value of the native call is kept (BR-TRK-020).

**Given** notification categories and channels are configured, **when** a signed-in shopper opens notification preferences in My account, **then** a matrix of category × enabled channel is shown with the client defaults; mandatory categories are shown as not changeable.

**Given** the shopper turns off SMS for category "Shipping updates", **when** a shipping update is sent, **then** no SMS is sent to them; the message is logged Suppressed (preference); other channels follow their settings; the change is audited (AUD-TRK-005).
**Given** a category is marked mandatory by the client, **when** the shopper has turned a channel off, **then** mandatory messages still go on their primary channel (BR-TRK-031).

**Given** the shopper set quiet hours and a non-urgent message falls inside them, **when** the engine processes it, **then** it is Held and released when the quiet period ends; urgent messages are sent at once (BR-TRK-032).

**Given** a shopper opens an order or the tracking page of a shipment they can see, **when** they press unsubscribe from updates for this order, **then** tracking-update messages for that order are no longer sent to them (message Trk.Unsubscribed); mandatory messages still go.
**Given** a shopper unsubscribed from an order, **when** they press subscribe, **then** updates resume for later events (message Trk.Subscribed).
**Given** a message about an order is sent, **when** it is rendered, **then** it contains a signed one-click link to unsubscribe from that order's updates, usable without signing in.

**Given** the client sets default quiet hours per channel and a limit of N non-mandatory messages per customer per channel per period (values not stated), **when** the limit is reached, **then** further non-mandatory messages in the period are Suppressed (limit) and logged (BR-TRK-032).
**Given** the client changes suppression defaults, **when** they are saved, **then** customers who have not set their own values follow the new defaults; the change is audited (AUD-TRK-002).

**Given** a channel needs opt-in (WhatsApp, Telegram, push, voice) and the customer has not opted in, **when** a message lists that channel, **then** the channel is skipped for that customer and the next channel is used; opting in or out from My account, or from the channel (CHN-006, CHN-013, CHN-004 call IC-TRK-06 UpdatePreference), is stored in TRK-006 and audited (AUD-TRK-005).

**Given** a customer texts the SMS opt-out keyword from the phone number of their account, **when** CHN-012 calls IC-TRK-06 UpdatePreference with the customer, channel SMS, opted out and source keyword, **then** SMS is turned off for every non-mandatory category for that customer and the change is audited (AUD-TRK-005); mandatory messages still go by SMS only if SMS is their primary channel (BR-TRK-031).

**Given** a customer has no event-level preference for a category and has a default preferred channel in IAM-015, **when** a message of that category is sent, **then** the default preferred channel is used first, then the definition order (BR-TRK-031).

**Given** an opt-out keyword arrives at CHN-012 from a phone number that belongs to no customer account, **when** CHN-012 calls IC-TRK-06 UpdatePreference with the number in international format (BR-IAM-010), channel SMS, opted out and source keyword, **then** a ContactOptOut record for that number and channel becomes OptedOut (SM-TRK-09) and is audited (AUD-TRK-005); no customer record is created (BR-TRK-033).

**Given** a ContactOptOut record for a phone number is OptedOut, **when** the engine is to send a non-mandatory SMS to that number (for example a guest order, or an account whose phone is that number), **then** the SMS is not sent; the message is logged Suppressed with reason opted out and the next channel of the definition is tried (BR-TRK-031, BR-TRK-033).

**Given** a ContactOptOut record is OptedOut for the phone number of a signed-in customer, **when** the customer turns SMS on in My account, or texts the opt-in keyword and CHN-012 calls IC-TRK-06 UpdatePreference with opted in, **then** the customer preference is set on and the ContactOptOut record becomes OptedIn with the source; both changes are audited (AUD-TRK-005).

**Given** a sender outside the engine is about to send (a reply in a conversation the customer started: IC-CHN-04 SendReply for a CRM agent or AI-003, a CHN-005 reply to an inbound SMS command, a CRM agent e-mail reply on a ticket; or an IAM-002 one-time code through IC-IAM-01), **when** it calls IC-TRK-06 CheckAllowed with the recipient (customer id, or phone number or channel address), channel, category and sender module, **then** TRK answers Allowed, or Blocked with the reason, by BR-TRK-031 and BR-TRK-033 (quiet hours and limits do not apply, BR-TRK-026); the sender sends nothing when Blocked, and a Blocked answer is logged in the notification log as Suppressed with the sender module and reason.

**Given** the engine sends, holds, suppresses or fails a message, **when** the outcome is known, **then** a log row stores channel, definition, template version, recipient, order and shipment ids where known, status (SM-TRK-03), provider message id and times.

**Given** a provider sends a delivery receipt or failure (IC-TRK-02), **when** it is received, **then** the log row moves to Delivered, Failed or Refused by provider message id; a failure or refusal starts the fallback channel if one is defined.

**Given** a module sends one notice to many people and must prove each delivery (for example SEC-008 breach notices to affected persons), **when** the notices are sent through IC-TRK-04, **then** one log row per person and channel is kept with its outcome, and the sending module can read the outcome per person by its reference.

**Given** an email is queued, **when** QueuedMessagesSendTask sends it or reaches the native retry limit, **then** the log row moves to Sent (QueuedEmail.SentOnUtc set) or Failed; Delivered is set only if the email provider reports delivery.

**Given** a user with Tracking.Core.Notifications.View opens an order in admin, **when** the notifications panel loads (admin_order_details_block), **then** every message for that order and its shipments is listed with channel, status and time, and the content can be viewed.
**Given** messages were sent in a period, **when** the delivery report is run, **then** counts of sent, delivered, failed, held and suppressed are shown by channel and event type, and exported.
**Given** the PLT-020 retention period for the notification log passes, **when** the retention task runs, **then** rows older than the period are deleted and the run is logged.

**Given** in-app is enabled and the customer has unread notifications, **when** any storefront page loads for the signed-in customer, **then** the bell in the header (widget zone header_links_after) shows the unread count.

**Given** the customer opens the bell, **when** the list is shown, **then** notifications are listed newest first with text, time and link to the order or shipment; opening one marks it Read (SM-TRK-08).
**Given** the customer clears a notification, **when** they confirm, **then** it is Cleared and no longer listed; it stays until cleared otherwise.

**Given** a user with Tracking.Core.Outreach.CreateEditDelete builds a notice with criteria (shipment status or last event, outlet, area, carrier, order status, date range), **when** they preview it, **then** the number of matching customers and a sample are shown before sending.

**Given** a notice is ready, **when** a user with Tracking.Core.Outreach.Send sends it now or schedules it, **then** each matching customer receives it through the TRK-005 engine in their language, preferences applied for the category "Service notices"; the send is audited (AUD-TRK-006) (SM-TRK-04).

**Given** a banner with text, stores, start and end time is created and activated, **when** a storefront or tracking page loads within the period, **then** the banner is shown at the top of the page (widget zone header_before) and disappears after the end time (SM-TRK-05).

**Given** a tracking source has sent no events for longer than its stall limit (setting, default not stated), **when** the source monitor runs, **then** an automatic banner with message Trk.UpdatesDelayed is activated on the tracking pages for shipments of that source, and removed when events resume.
**Given** a notice is scheduled, **when** the user cancels it before the time, **then** it is Cancelled and nothing is sent.

**Given** a seller signs in to the admin area (Vendors role, Orders.ShipmentsView), **when** they open the shipment list, **then** only shipments of their own products are listed with shipped, ready-for-pickup and delivered dates.

**Given** ShippingSettings.DisplayShipmentEventsToStoreOwner is on, **when** the seller opens one of their shipments, **then** the TRK-002 timeline is shown through the hub tracker, including hand-over events (pickup, drop-off accepted) and delivery.
basis: REQ-MPC-FR-218; REQ-MPC-ORD-001; FIT (admin OrderModelFactory uses GetShipmentTrackerAsync)

criterion: **Given** the seller opens a shipment of another seller by id, **when** the page is requested, **then** access is refused (native HasAccessToShipmentAsync).

**Given** the FoxNetSoft guest order-status plugin for nopCommerce 5.00 is licensed and installed (V-01), or the custom fallback is built, **when** a guest enters an order number and the phone or email of the order, **then** if both match one order, its status, shipments and TRK-002 timeline are shown without personal details beyond the masked contact.
**Given** the order number and contact do not match, **when** the lookup is submitted, **then** message Trk.GuestLookupFailed is shown without saying which field is wrong.
**Given** the configured number of failed lookups from one client address is exceeded, **when** another lookup is made, **then** a CAPTCHA (SEC-013) is required.

**Given** a shipment is shipped through ShipAsync, **when** ShipmentSent.CustomerNotification is triggered, **then** the message is sent on the channels of its definition with the tracking number and tracking link.

**Given** TRK-002 applies an OUT_FOR_DELIVERY event, **when** it is applied, **then** template ShipmentOutForDelivery.CustomerNotification (new) is sent once per shipment, with the delivery OTP where the service level requires it (LOG-012).
**Given** a shipment is delivered or collected through DeliverAsync, **when** ShipmentDelivered.CustomerNotification is triggered, **then** the message is sent on the channels of its definition.

**Given** a pickup shipment is made ready through ReadyForPickupAsync, **when** ShipmentReadyForPickup.CustomerNotification is triggered, **then** the message includes the outlet name and address, opening hours (StorePickupPoint.OpeningHours), the pickup code or QR (CHK-012), the configured text on identification to bring, and the pickup deadline.

**Given** a delivery attempt fails with a reason code (LOG-013), **when** the attempt is recorded, **then** template ShipmentDeliveryAttemptFailed.CustomerNotification (new) is sent with the reason text and a signed link to the LOG-013 rescheduling page.

**Given** a parcel awaits collection and the reminder lead time before the deadline is reached (setting, default not stated), **when** the reminder task runs, **then** template ShipmentPickupReminder.CustomerNotification (new) is sent once per reminder step with the deadline and any holding charge due (LOG-017).

**Given** the pickup deadline passes and the parcel is not collected (LOG-017 Uncollected), **when** the reminder task runs, **then** ShipmentUncollected.CustomerNotification (new) goes to the buyer and ShipmentUncollected.StoreOwnerNotification (new) to the outlet and operations contacts.
**Given** the same event is applied twice for a shipment, **when** the notification step runs, **then** no second message is sent for that shipment and event (BR-TRK-022).
